jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Database & Data Platform
jobs.description:
Location: Boston, New York City

PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology.

Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. We have a track record of success in deploying AI algorithms for histopathology in translational research, pathology labs and clinical trials.  Rigorous science and careful analysis is critical to the success of everything we do. Our team, composed of diverse employees with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, is passionate about solving challenging problems and making a huge impact on patient outcomes.

At PathAI, we are constantly evaluating our tech stack and our current tools consist of:

• Languages & Frameworks: Python, SQL, Django / DRF, FastAPI

• Platform: PostgreSQL, Kubernetes (on-prem and EKS), RDS / PostgreSQL

• Tooling: GitLab CI/CD, Terraform, Docker, Datadog

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a database focused Staff Software Engineer to own the data tier for AISight across on-premises, multi-tenant cloud, and private cloud deployments. You will design, deploy, tune, and operate the PostgreSQL databases behind our clinical platform and set the standard for how every team works with data.

• You will own the deployment, administration, and lifecycle of AISight's PostgreSQL databases across on-prem (Kubernetes), multi-tenant cloud, and private cloud, including high availability, replication, backup and restore, upgrades, and disaster recovery.

• You will define a consistent database architecture and operating model across these environments, accounting for where managed services (RDS) and our self-managed deployments differ.

• You will design and evolve multi-tenant data strategies, including tenant isolation, migration management at scale, and the tradeoffs between shared and dedicated databases.

• You will diagnose and resolve performance problems: query plans, indexing, partitioning, vacuum and bloat, connection pooling, locking, and configuration tuning, including how Kubernetes resource limits and storage classes affect database behavior.

• You will design schemas with application teams and review migrations for safety and performance at scale.

• You will plan capacity and storage for growing datasets, including retention, archival, and expiration strategies.

• You will build tooling, automation, and runbooks that make database operations repeatable and observable.

• You will drive database architecture decisions, considering the team and our future product roadmap.

• You will collaborate with product, design, machine learning, infrastructure, and SRE teams.

• You will foster a culture of continuous learning by mentoring teammates and documenting systems clearly so others can maintain them.

• You will contribute to a platform used in clinical settings, ensuring reliability, data integrity, and compliance with industry standards.

• You will collaborate with clinical, QA, and regulatory teams to ensure database changes meet validation expectations and support inspection readiness.

Who You Are: (Required)

• You have a BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering or closely related technical field.

• You have 7+ years of full life cycle development experience, including deep, hands-on PostgreSQL experience in production. At the Staff level, you have demonstrated technical leadership across teams and ownership of complex, multi-system problems.

• You have demonstrated expertise in schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.

• You have demonstrated experience running PostgreSQL on Kubernetes, including operators (e.g., CloudNativePG, Zalando, Crunchy) or equivalent, persistent storage, and stateful workloads.

• You have demonstrated experience with managed PostgreSQL on AWS (RDS / Aurora).

• You have demonstrated experience with high availability and failover, replication, backup and point-in-time recovery, and major-version upgrades with minimal downtime.

• You have experience with multi-tenant database architectures and their isolation, migration, and operational challenges.

• You have strong Python skills for automation and tooling.

• You have a demonstrated ability to collaborate with a distributed team and to work autonomously on projects; You have demonstrated problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced, agile environment.

• You have strong interpersonal and communication skills, including clear technical documentation and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-experts.

Preferred:

• We have a hybrid work environment with 2 days a week in person at one of our office

• You have an advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or closely related technical field

• You have experience working in a regulated environment such as healthtech, including change control and validation

• You have hands-on experience with CI/CD tools, e.g. GitLab CI

• You have knowledge of some IaC framework, e.g. Terraform

• You have familiarity with Linux, storage, and networking fundamentals as they affect database performance

• You have experience with Apache Airflow or similar workflow orchestration

• You have experience with ETL / data warehousing, or with analytics-heavy or ML data environments

• You have experience with data governance, retention policy, or storage cost optimization

• You have experience supporting customer-hosted or air-gapped deployments

• You have excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects efficiently.

This is a hybrid position based in Boston, MA.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location Boston, MA is $146,250 - $224,250.  Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

PathAI is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. The company's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination, including but not limited to, discrimination on the basis of Protected Veteran status, individuals with disabilities status, and consistent with all federal, state, or local laws.

• Experiência com Jetpack Compose.

• Conhecimento em Firebase.

• Certificações em tecnologias relacionadas ao desenvolvimento de software.

• Experiência com desenvolvimento android para POS.

• Experiência com publicação e gerenciamento de aplicações na Google Play.

• Conhecimento em segurança mobile e proteção de dados.

• Experiência com Azure DevOps ou outras ferramentas de automação e gerenciamento de pipelines.

O que você vai encontrar na Hiper:

E para cuidar muito bem de você:

🧳 Seguro de vida;

jobs.title: Research Associate 1
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Research Associate 1 follows research protocols. Performs research and/or development tasks in collaboration with others.  Makes detailed observations, analyzes data, and interprets results.  Investigates, creates, and develops new methods and technologies for project advancement.  Maintains high level of professional expertise through familiarity with scientific literature.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Independently execute simple experiments.

• Assist with SOP development.

• Receive and process laboratory specimens following the standard methods and procedures with superb attention to detail.

• Track samples with use of LIMS, database queries, and advanced excel techniques; verify that correct specimens are being processed and analyzed.

• Maintain equipment and instruments in good operating condition, recognize any malfunctions and troubleshoot as needed.

• Complete routine preventive maintenance and troubleshooting on instruments and equipment.

• Responsible for maintaining updated understanding and knowledge of the methods employed in the laboratory.

• Utilize molecular biology techniques in performing laboratory tests. This role will have occasional access to PHI both in paper and electronic form and have occasional access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job.

• Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.

• Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.

​QUALIFICATIONS:

• BS/BA in a biological science or equivalent.

• Minimum of 1 year of Molecular Biology laboratory experience.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• gDNA isolation from biological samples (preferred).

• Practical knowledge of LIMS/database query tools (preferred).

• Experience with PCR library preparation for next generation sequencing and sequencing platforms (NextSeq, HiSeq, Ion Torrent.)

• Sample analysis/QC on the Agilent Bioanalyzer, Nanodrop, Qubit, electrophoresis.

• Skill conducting quantitative-PCR (optional).

• Experience with laboratory robotics platforms (optional).

• Must have proven interpersonal, communication, computer, and technical skills.

• Excellent oral and written communication skills required.

• Microsoft Excel experience required.

Compensation & Total Rewards

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of  hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and skills considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

• Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

• 401(k) with company match

• Generous paid time off and company holidays

• Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range

$73,000—$91,200 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

jobs.title: Community Lead & Talent Acquisition Advisor - DACH
jobs.description:
Hi, I’m Kayla https://www.linkedin.com/in/kayla-ricketts-9727976b/ :) I lead global community activation within Partnerships at Ashby. Before joining a year ago, I spent 15 years in TA and was an Ashby customer. I made the move out of TA into this role, and nothing I’d learned has gone to waste. If anything, I’ve learnt even more from the community. It’s genuinely one of the most rewarding and fun roles I’ve had, and as I step into a leadership role, I’m on the hunt for someone to take over the work in EMEA and evolve it further.

We’re hiring an experienced TA Expert & Community Lead to grow one of our most successful GTM experiments: a high-touch, customer-led approach to growth. The model is already working across EMEA, built on curated events, product education and early community activation. We already work with some well-known teams in the region, and we’ve recently announced an EMEA data centre. We want to invest properly in the community there, and we know that needs to be led by someone local. Someone who knows the market, speaks the language and understands how TA teams in the region actually work. You’ll own the DACH community end to end, from customer breakfasts and curated experiences to enablement sessions and product demos.

This role suits someone who has worked with Ashby All-in-One, has a solid background in TA, and cares about tools, process, hospitality and community building. It also works well for TA people who still love the work but want to use what they know somewhere new. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Product Marketing, own a region end-to-end, and see how community connects to pipeline and retention.

A quick summary on travel, since it’s usually the first question and we know it means time away from home: you’ll have events in Germany regularly, plus travel to another DACH (or wider EMEA) country every month, usually for around four days. There is flex, though. I’m a mum of three, and in this role, I’ve been able to stay home and take meaningful time off during every school holiday. We plan the calendar well in advance, so you’ll know what’s coming and can sort things at home with plenty of notice.

It’s also one of the best parts of the job. I’ve met some amazing people and had some really cool experiences along the way, from hosting a dinner cruise on the Seine  https://www.linkedin.com/posts/ashbyhq_last-night-we-spent-a-great-evening-with-activity-7518934121507913728-51U1?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAA7jUaYB2IctkRuC7u91bcl_fuRCHV_o-w8and a TA leader workshop with a partner https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7519293611298131968 at the Shangri-La Paris, to spending time in customers’ offices https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7519293611298131968 in Stockholm, our company offsite  https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7516557949570412544in Playa Del Carmen, and hosting the mainstage at our first Ashby One London. https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7503489909475876864

What you’ll do

 - Lead DACH Community Events
   
   - Run community events across target DACH markets. Event types might include:
     
     - Customer learning breakfasts
     
     - A mixed ecosystem event for customers and prospects
     
     - Partner cocktail events or roundtables co-hosted with local ecosystem players
   
   - Build and nurture relationships with TA leaders
   
   - Partner with Event Ops on venue selection, invites, and post-event recaps
   
   - Drive improvement and reimagine how we can show up in a very meaningful way for the community

 - Drive Customer Education
   
   - Become an Expert in Ashby + TA leader needs to curate relevant content
   
   - Design and lead live sessions that help customers activate key Ashby features and keep customers ahead on key TA trends and topics
   
   - Partner with CS and Product Marketing teams on the Ashby Hidden Gems program
   
   - Develop and distribute product tips, dashboards, and templates to increase customer sophistication

 - Expand EMEA Community and Customer Advocacy
   
   - Help Ashby deepen its brand and trust by showing up consistently and thoughtfully
   
   - Participate in and help advise on content for ACE (Ashby Customer Expert) events when we bring the program to EMEA
   
   - Partner with GTM teams on prospect and customer onsite visits
   
   - Moderate panels, attend events, and build a presence at industry gatherings
     

Who you’ll work with

You’ll report directly to me, but work closely with myself and Willem https://www.linkedin.com/in/willemwijnans/, who has pioneered what community growth looks like at Ashby. Within partnerships, you’ll also work closely with Katie https://www.linkedin.com/in/katherineelainecampbell/ to scale trusted community partner relationships and Louise https://www.linkedin.com/in/louisecross89/ to bring Owned Community experiences, like Ashby Cafe https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7478334221007294465, to life. You’ll also partner day to day with our EMEA Sales and CS teams, who know our customers and prospects best and help shape who we bring into the room.

About You

We think the ideal person for this role will have experience and skills that look something like this:

 - You’ve been an Ashby power user or at least very familiar with Ashby and seen its benefits first-hand—someone who knows the product and Ashby community, champions good recruiting practices, and isn’t afraid to dive into dashboards, workflows, or templates

 - You’ve built a reputation inside organizations as the go-to expert on TA process and tooling

 - You’re a strong communicator—whether facilitating a breakfast, writing a post-event summary, or helping a customer understand how to build a dashboard

 - You love curating and connecting people and ideas. You get energy from hosting, matchmaking, and finding smart formats to share what works

 - You’re excited about being on the road ~2x/month and tapping into your existing network (and growing it!) in the TA space

 - You have strong business acumen. You understand how community supports the wider business and work well with Sales and CS to make sure our programs are reaching the right people

 - You’re entrepreneurial and experimental in nature. You’re not looking for rigid playbooks; you want room to try new formats and evolve what ‘great’ looks like. You come prepared with AI tools / automations that help us execute faster while maintaining quality.

 - You believe in unreasonable hospitality—the idea that going above and beyond for a customer doesn’t just build goodwill, it builds momentum.

 - You’re fluent in German and English, and have a strong understanding of how hiring works in DACH

This Role Probably Isn't Right If ...

 - You’re not excited about hosting or don’t enjoy the details of curating small, thoughtful gatherings

 - You hate writing and have difficulty building a cohesive brief (this is a very important skill at Ashby)

 - You don’t enjoy travelling and building new connections while you’re at it

 - You’ve never had hands-on TA experience

 - You’ve never used Ashby and aren’t familiar with modern TA systems and practices

 - You prefer working from a very established playbook and are uncomfortable with ambiguity or iteration

 - You’re uncomfortable with moderating discussions or being a speaker

 - You’d rather focus purely on the community side and aren’t keen to understand how it connects to the wider business

 - You only have an ‘events background’. For this role, we need folks with deep knowledge of the TA ecosystem and a proven network in major city hubs across the DACH region

 - You aren’t fluent in both German and English

Interview Plan

 - Recruiter Screen with Kayla/Willem - 30 minutes

 - Hiring Manager Interview with Kayla - 45 minutes

 - Cross-functional Panel - 1 hour

 - Assignment (written) - 2 hours
   
   - Followed by Assignment Review with Kayla - 30 Minutes

 - Final Round - 1-1.5 hours

Benefits

 - Compelling benefits offerings, location dependent

 - 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

 - Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

 - Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

 - $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

jobs.title: Data Center Security Manager
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Data Center Security Manager to help safeguard our critical infrastructure in Vineland, NJ that is operated 24/7. In this role, you’ll be responsible for implementing and maintaining Nebius’s physical security standards, ensuring compliance with global policies and regulatory frameworks, and maintaining a culture of security awareness across our operations. You will manage access control, perform security audits, collaborate with colocation partners, and support investigations or incident response activities. This role is ideal for a hands-on, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a high-availability environment and takes pride in building secure, resilient facilities. This role is an onsite position.

Your responsibilities will include:

Physical Security Management

• Implement and enforce physical security standards across Nebius data centers and partner facilities.

• Oversee facility access requests, approvals, and revocations according to “least privilege” principles.

• Conduct periodic security inspections, risk assessments, and internal audits.

• Lead and document security incident investigations, ensuring timely remediation.

Compliance and Policy

• Maintain alignment with Nebius global security frameworks and compliance standards (ISO 27001, SOC 2, etc.).

• Support internal and external audits with required evidence and documentation.

• Maintain an updated inventory of security controls and ensure their effective operation.

Training and Awareness

• Develop and deliver training for employees, vendors, and visitors on site security procedures.

• Foster a strong security culture through regular communications and refresher programs.

Collaboration

• Serve as the local point of contact for physical security, coordinating with operations, facilities, and IT teams.

• Liaise with external partners and contractors to ensure security compliance and operational integrity.

We expect you to have:

• Minimum 3 years of experience in physical security operations, preferably within data centers or critical infrastructure.

• Background in law enforcement, military, or corporate security law enforcement, military, or corporate security is highly valued.

• Strong understanding of physical security technologies (CCTV, access control, intrusion detection).

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Proficiency with productivity tools (Google Workspace, MS Office, etc.).

• Relevant certifications (PSP, CPP, CPTED, Genetec, Axis) are an advantage.

• This is an onsite role requiring attendance Monday through Friday, from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET, with availability for calls outside regular business hours as needed.

Key employee benefits in the US:

• Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.

• 401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.

• Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.

• Remote work reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.

• Disability & life insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range

$107,100—$133,800 USD

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative culture

• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

• International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Practice Lead, Commercial
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

The Practice Lead, Commercial Practice leads end-to-end delivery for Datavant’s Commercial pillar in Life Sciences. You will be both the senior domain authority and the delivery leader for programs that connect pharma data assets to commercial use cases such as launch planning, patient journey analytics, adherence and persistence, provider targeting, and omnichannel measurement.

This role is for someone who has spent a career in commercial analytics and knows the US healthcare data landscape deeply: how claims, EHR, lab, specialty pharmacy, hub and patient services, mortality, and consumer data are built, where each one is strong or weak, and how patients are resolved across them. You will lead the team who run Commercial programs, and your expertise will set the standard for how those programs are scoped, executed, and quality-checked.

Customers buy one integrated outcome, but delivery spans Science, Privacy, Technical Solutions, Data Harmonization, and Record Retrieval, all moving in parallel. You will make sure the Commercial practice runs those programs to a consistent standard, with one governance model and one accountable owner. You will work closely with Sales, Account Management, and Delivery & Ops, and alongside peer Engagement Directors across Clinical, HEOR/MA/Safety-Epi, and Ecosystem.

This is a build-and-scale role. The Engagement Management function is newly dedicated, and you will help set the standards and ways of working the organization adopts into 2027.

Responsibilities of the Role

• Lead, coach, and grow the Commercial pillar Engagement Management team, including Senior Engagement Managers and Engagement Managers.

• Own delivery execution quality and program-level CSAT for all Commercial engagements.

• Serve as the practice’s subject matter authority on patient mastering and linkage, including identity resolution approaches, token match rates, deduplication, longitudinal patient construction, and the tradeoffs that affect commercial analytics outcomes.

• Advise on US data source selection and fit for commercial use cases, including coverage, lag, latency, capture, and bias across claims, EHR, lab, specialty pharmacy, patient services, mortality, and consumer and digital data.

• Review program designs and data plans before and during delivery to confirm the chosen sources and linkage approach can support the customer’s intended commercial analysis.

• Run multi-workstream programs to a repeatable standard, with clear governance, program tiering, cross-functional sequencing, and escalation paths.

• Partner with Delivery & Ops leaders across Privacy, Science, Technical Solutions, Data Harmonization, and Record Retrieval so functional teams are accountable to Engagement Managers for program delivery while expert standards stay intact.

• Join Sales Executives, Sales Specialists, and Solution Consulting before signature to confirm that scope, SLAs, milestones, program tier, and delivery model are executable.

• Work with Account Management on a clean handoff from delivery to value realization, so delivery outcomes feed the value story and renewal.

• Serve as the senior delivery relationship for key Commercial programs at top-50 pharma accounts, translating technical data and linkage topics into clear language for commercial analytics, brand, and executive audiences.

• Manage capacity, staffing, and utilization for the practice, using hours and coverage data to plan against ACV, program count, and complexity.

• Build and maintain Commercial practice playbooks, program templates, data source guides, QA standards, and customer-facing delivery materials.

• Report on delivery health, risks, quality, and capacity to the VP, Engagement Management, and contribute to the function-wide operating model.

• Contribute to career frameworks and levels, and support development and promotion decisions for your team.

• Feed delivery learnings and customer feedback to Product and Partnerships to improve Commercial offerings and tooling.

Qualifications of the Role

• 10+ years of experience in commercial analytics for life sciences, whether at a pharma company, data vendor, analytics provider, or consultancy.

• Deep understanding of patient mastering and identity resolution, including tokenization, probabilistic and deterministic matching, match quality, and the effect of linkage choices on downstream analysis.

• Deep knowledge of US healthcare data sources (claims, EHR, lab, specialty pharmacy, hub and patient services, mortality, and consumer/digital data) and how each applies to commercial use cases such as launch, patient journey, adherence and persistence, targeting, and omnichannel measurement.

• Strong grasp of how pharma commercial, brand, analytics, and data teams buy, consume, and operationalize data.

• 3+ years leading managers or multi-person delivery teams, with experience running complex, multi-workstream customer programs for pharmaceutical or similarly regulated customers.

• Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed environment (Sales, CS, Product, Privacy, Legal, Science, Ops) where you don’t own every function involved.

• Executive presence with senior customer stakeholders, and the ability to explain complex data and privacy concepts to business audiences.

• A metrics-driven approach to quality, CSAT, capacity, and utilization.

• Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM, PSA tools, and the Google suite.

• Ability to travel for customer meetings, program kickoffs, and company events.

Bonus Points If

• You have worked inside a pharma commercial analytics or data strategy organization.

• You have hands-on experience with privacy-preserving linkage, tokenization, or clean room environments.

• You are familiar with the RWD vendor ecosystem and have evaluated or integrated multiple sources for a single use case.

• You have led delivery or engagement teams at a healthcare data, RWE, or life sciences analytics company.

• You have built delivery playbooks, program tiering models, or data source frameworks that scaled.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
LOCATION:

This will be a hybrid role (1 day a week) working out of our San Carlos, CA location.

POSITION SUMMARY:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications, APIs, and data services, with equal emphasis on backend systems, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure as on the user-facing layer. You have experience building reliable, scalable services and are comfortable working across the stack, from data modeling and API design to deployment and operations.

You care about great user experience, but your strength is delivering well-engineered systems end to end. You are comfortable integrating APIs and services, both local and cloud-based, and you’ll work with tools such as Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, React, Snowflake, dbt, AWS (ECS Fargate, Lambda, S3), and AWS CDK.

You also have experience adopting AI across the software development lifecycle, including AI-assisted coding, spec-driven development, and automated testing and review, and you have hands-on experience designing and building agentic workflows that automate real operational tasks.

Together with the engineering team, product managers, and designers, you will build new and impactful experiences for our customers.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Technical ownership: Design the architecture for applications, integrations, and data flows. Participate in design and code reviews, follow and contribute to engineering standards, and balance delivery speed against reliability, maintainability, and cost. Provide technical input to roadmap planning.

• Delivery and operations: Translate operational requirements into clear specifications and designs. Ensure production systems are monitored, supportable, and well documented, with defined incident response and on-call practices. Own testing, CI/CD, and release practices for your systems, and maintain cloud infrastructure, security, access patterns, and infrastructure as code. Experience in regulated or validated environments is a plus.

• Collaboration: Partner with data scientists and analysts to productionize models, forecasts, and reports. Work with operations, automation, IT, and quality stakeholders on integrations with systems such as ticketing, data warehouses, and specialized equipment software. Communicate tradeoffs, risks, and progress clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• AI and innovation: Design and build AI agents that automate operational workflows. Apply AI throughout the development lifecycle, including AI-assisted coding, spec-driven development, and agentic engineering practices. Evaluate emerging tools and frameworks, and help define guardrails for safe and effective use, including data privacy.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• 7+ years of overall software development experience, preferably secure, scalable web applications with frontend and backend web technologies

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

Backend and APIs

• Experience with Python and modern backend frameworks, especially FastAPI (with Pydantic and Uvicorn)

• Experience designing and building RESTful APIs

• Experience with microservice architectures, cross-platform integration, and building scalable applications in heterogeneous environments

Data

• Strong relational database skills, including database design and optimization, with SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and cloud data platforms

• Experience with data warehousing and analytics, especially Snowflake and dbt

Frontend

• Experience with React and TypeScript, ideally with Material UI and Vite

• Experience with identity and integration platforms such as Okta (SSO)

Cloud and infrastructure

• Experience with cloud providers, with AWS preferred

• Experience with AWS services such as ECS (Fargate), Lambda, Step Functions, S3, SQS/SNS, CloudFront, ECR, EFS, and Secrets Manager

• Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CDK (TypeScript)

• Experience with Docker and container-oriented technologies

Software development lifecycle and quality

• Experience with the full software development lifecycle, including build, configuration management, change control, release, and deployment

• Experience with CI/CD, specifically GitLab CI

• Experience with automated testing using pytest, Vitest, and Playwright

• Quality assurance mindset; familiarity with regulated environments is a plus

Professional skills

• Demonstrated teamwork and a solid analytical background

• Excellent organizational, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills

Compensation & Total Rewards

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of  hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

• Annual performance incentive bonus

• Long-term equity awards

• Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

• 401(k) with company match

• Generous paid time off and company holidays

• Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range

$147,500—$184,400 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

For more information:
- BBB announcement on job scams
- FBI Cyber Crime resource page

jobs.title: Khan Kids: Senior Consumer Marketing Manager (1 year contract, 40 hours/week, $62/hour)
jobs.location: San Mateo, CA / Remote (Continental US + Hawaii + Canada Only)
jobs.description:
Notice to applicants:

We have seen a rise in recruitment scams. Please note that outreach from Khan Academy recruiters will only come from the @khanacademy.org domain. Our team does not use Gmail or other personal accounts for contacting potential candidates. Khan Academy will never solicit money, equipment fees, or sensitive financial information at any stage of the hiring process. We also do not work with external recruiting agencies, so outreach from headhunters presenting opportunities on behalf of Khan Academy is illegitimate. Please always check the email domain and cross-reference the position with the official Khan Academy Careers page to confirm an opening is valid.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY

Khan Academy is a nonprofit with the mission to deliver a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers free, high-quality supplemental learning content and practice that cover Pre-K - 12th grade and early college core academic subjects, focusing on math and science. We have over 181 million registered learners globally and are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, focusing on learners in historically under-resourced communities.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY KIDS

Khan Academy Kids is a free and fun learning program for children ages 2 to 8. Kodi Bear and a cast of animated characters lead children on a personalized education journey filled with fun, standards-aligned activities in early literacy, math, executive functioning and social emotional skills. Built by a small but mighty team, Khan Academy Kids is used by millions of children in homes and classrooms around the world.

OUR COMMUNITY

Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, traditional/non-traditional education, big tech companies, and tiny startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in-house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world-class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.

THE ROLE

The Khan Academy Kids team is excited to add a contract Marketing Specialist to our team. Working closely with the Marketing Lead, this role runs the channels where families and teachers discover Khan Academy Kids in support of the launch of our new English language learning product. The Marketing Lead sets overall strategy and priorities. From there, the Marketing Specialist builds the channel-level plans and executes them across app store marketing, consumer digital advertising, and organic social media, and serves as our hands-on analyst for all three. We're looking for someone who is curious about what the numbers are telling them and who finds real joy in getting high-quality learning into the hands of more kids..

Responsibilities:

Working with the Marketing Lead, who sets overall strategy and priorities, you will:

• Manage app store marketing across the Apple App Store and Google Play, including listing optimization, creative testing, promotional events, and seasonal updates.

• Run consumer advertising across Apple Ads, Google Ads, and Meta. Build campaigns, manage spending within approved budgets, test audiences and creative, and develop ad materials with the Marketing Lead's review.

• Run organic social across Instagram, Threads, Facebook, and TikTok, and manage our creator and ambassador programs. Own the publishing calendar, community engagement, and partnerships from outreach through delivery. Create content that sounds like us: our characters, our warmth, and learning that feels like play.

• Support the US and international launch of our new English language learning product. Coordinate localization of store listings and creative, and adapt campaigns and social content for each market.

• Own performance reporting across channels and markets, including app store impressions, conversion, and installs. Share regular readouts and recommend where to invest next.

• Work with Khan Academy Kids' design, content, and product teams and Khan Academy's marketing team to keep messaging consistent. Support website updates, content promotion, and occasional school and district marketing. The role may expand to include lifecycle and family email.

• Use AI tools responsibly to work faster without sacrificing quality, accuracy, or brand voice.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 4–6 years of digital marketing experience, including hands-on consumer app marketing. You understand app store discovery, install conversion, and the difference between a download and an engaged user.

• Direct experience with at least two of Apple Ads, Google Ads, or Meta Ads, including writing copy, briefing creative, running campaigns, and reading test results.

• Experience creating organic social content and managing creator, influencer, or ambassador relationships.

• Experience adapting marketing for international audiences through localized store listings, creative, or campaigns. You know what it takes to make copy land in a market that isn't your own.

• Strong analytical skills. You can pull your own numbers, explain what they mean, and turn them into recommendations. Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Semrush, or Brandwatch is a plus but not required.

• Clear communication and strong project management. You can write for families and teachers, present recommendations, and keep multiple channels and collaborators moving without dropping details.

• Real investment in the mission. You care about making high-quality learning accessible and reaching the kids who need it most. Experience marketing to families, teachers, or in edtech is a plus.

• Experience using AI responsibly in marketing, with good judgment about where it helps and where a person needs to own the output.

This is a 1 year contract at 40 hours/week for $62/hour.

MORE ABOUT US

• Sal’s TED talk from 2011

• Sal’s TED talk from 2015

• Sal's TED talk from 2023

• Our team: http://www.khanacademy.org/about/the-team

OUR COMPANY VALUES

Live & breathe learners

We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.

Take a stand

As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.

Embrace diverse perspectives

We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.

Work responsibly and sustainably

We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non-profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.

Bring out the joy

We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co-create with our teammates, partners and donors.

Cultivate learning mindset

We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.

Deliver wow

We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end-to-end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we encourage candidates from historically underrepresented groups to apply.

As part of this commitment, Khan Academy will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact careers@khanacademy.org

The Medical Assistant reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organizations Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Medical Assistant is a member of the health care team primarily responsible for providing support to physicians, nurses, and other licensed medical staff by facilitating efficient patient flow, assisting with various patient care activities, and performing related administrative functions. The Medical Assistant is responsible for ensuring efficient patient flow through the clinic; maintaining neat, clean and safe patient care areas; promoting patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner; safeguarding patient confidentiality.

Responsibilities:

• Assures efficient patient flow through the site:Escorts patient to exam room, identifies patient with 2 identifiers and prepares patient for examination.Obtains accurate vital signs, per organization standards.Documents reason for visit and updates/confirms, allergies, smoking history and pharmacy information.Promptly informs the provider and registered nurse of any significant change in vital signs or acute symptoms.Anticipates/sets up equipment or supplies needed for visit.Cleans and prepares exam room for next patient.Responds to needs to expedite visits and maintain flow of patients and prioritize tasks accordingly.
• Assists practitioner with medical and surgical procedures in accordance with established protocols such as: Electrocardiogram (ECG), venipuncture, immunizations, setting up procedure trays, specimen collection and/or Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) waived testing as directed by Provider.
• Provides high quality care by:Prepares and stocks all exam rooms in treatment area by following established protocols for disinfecting and sterilizing equipment and instruments.Participates in environmental safety rounds.Maintains vaccine/medication inventory.Monitors and maintains equipment and instruments according to clinic guidelines.Assists in ordering supplies and correctly disposes of all expired items.Adheres to office opening and closing procedures.
• Functions as an integral part of the patient care team and promotes patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner:Accepts and performs delegated responsibilities in a positive manner.Offers assistance to others.Attends and participates in staff meetings.Communicates appropriately and effectively with patients and patient care team (in the office and on the phone.
• Performs delegated procedures common to the specialty area in a safe, effective, and efficient manner (see specialty practice addendum.
• Performs all other duties as assigned by the Supervisor or Manager

Required:

• Candidate must have written proof of meeting candidate eligibility requirements for writing one of the five eligible certification exams (AAMA, AMT, NCCT, NHA, NRCMA)
• Accepted documentation:New MA Graduates within 6 months from date of graduation from an MA Program must submit: a letter from the school or a letter from the certifying bodyNon-Certified MAs or new graduates past 6 months from date of graduation from an MA program must submit: a letter from the certifying body
• Within first six months of employment, will complete one of the following certifications after up to two test attempts:Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) through American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA)Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) through American Medical Technologists (AMT) orNational Certified Medical Assistant (NCMA) through the National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT)Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) through the National Healthcareer Association (NHA)Nationally Registered Certified Medical Assistant (NRCMA) through the National Association for Health Professionals (NAHP)

All Candidates/Incumbents:

• High school diploma or GED.
• American Heart Association accredited Basic Life Support (BLS/CPR) certification.
• Signed acknowledgement during onboarding that certification must be attained within 6months, as a condition of employment
• Strong computer skills

Preferred:

• One to two years of ambulatory care experience.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US
jobs.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

The Team

Pinterest's Infrastructure organization builds and operates the platforms that every engineer at Pinterest uses to build, test, ship and run software. Our CI and deployment platforms handle the journey of every change from commit to production. We're investing heavily in making that journey faster, more efficient and safe by default, especially as AI-assisted development sharply increases how much we ship. We work closely with engineering teams across Pinterest to make sure the platform scales with the business.

What You'll Do

• Lead cross-team programs that make production changes safe by default, driving adoption of progressive rollouts, automated canary analysis and fast rollback across code, config, data and ML model deployments.

• Drive the CI platform roadmap to reduce build cost and wait times, improve fleet utilization and migrate CI workloads to our next-generation compute platform.

• Define and track the delivery and reliability metrics that measure success, such as change failure rate, recovery time, lead time for change and build performance, and build dashboards that surface regressions early.

• Manage dependencies and migrations across CI, artifact, deployment and compute platforms and the many service teams that depend on them.

• Influence engineering teams across Pinterest to adopt new standards and paved paths, managing timelines, pushback and risk.

• Communicate technical tradeoffs among velocity, safety, cost and reliability clearly to audiences from individual engineers to senior leadership.

• Use GenAI as the default operating model for program execution: produce AI-assisted first drafts of core program artifacts, turn high-toil workflows into AI-first mechanisms (for example, intake triage, status synthesis, action and decision extraction, and risk and dependency tracking), and synthesize signals to surface risks, tradeoffs and escalation paths early.

• Prototype solutions that improve decisions with data (dashboards, analysis) or simplify processes (workflow helpers, internal tools) using AI coding assistants ("vibe coding").

• Follow Pinterest AI guidance for risk, governance and safety by design: handle sensitive data appropriately, validate AI-generated outputs, document assumptions and limits, and make sure AI-assisted workflows meet policy and compliance expectations before broad adoption.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of TPM experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs in infrastructure, platform engineering, developer productivity or SRE.

• A solid understanding of CI/CD systems, build infrastructure and safe-deployment practices (canaries, progressive delivery, automated rollback), and the tradeoffs between velocity and safety.

• A track record of driving platform or standards adoption across many engineering teams without direct authority.

• Strong analytical skills, with experience defining delivery and reliability metrics (for example, DORA metrics) and using data to drive decisions.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including giving clear, candid status and risk updates to senior leadership.

jobs.description:
Hybrid-based position in our Seattle, WA office.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Are you excited about understanding, interpreting, and navigating complex issues? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature? Are you a curious and open-minded person?

If this sounds like you, or you are curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment & Health team as our new Consultant and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

Ramboll is seeking a GIS Consultant based in Seattle, Washington to work as part of a collaborative team providing GIS, data management, and analytical support for environmental and consulting projects. You will work with project managers, scientists, engineers, field teams, and other technical staff to develop maps, manage, and analyze project data, support digital applications, and prepare client-specific deliverables.

The successful candidate will be able to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment and serving as a technical GIS resource for project managers and staff. Common needs include geospatial data management, spatial analysis, mapping and visualization, presentation development, quality control, and development and maintenance of web-based GIS applications and workflows. This role also includes opportunities to communicate findings and technical information directly to clients and project teams.

This is primarily an office-based position. The role will support field activities through the configuration and maintenance of digital data collection tools, preparation of GIS data and applications for field teams, troubleshooting, and management and validation of field-collected data.

Your key tasks and responsibilities will be:

• Develop maps, spatial analyses, data visualizations, and other client-ready deliverables supporting environmental and consulting projects.
• Manage, integrate, and perform QA/QC on geospatial and project data from multiple sources.
• Develop and maintain ArcGIS Online web maps, applications, dashboards, and other GIS-based workflows.
• Configure and support digital field-data collection tools, including preparing applications for field teams and validating field-collected data.
• Collaborate with project managers, scientists, engineers, field teams, and clients to translate project needs into practical GIS and data-management solutions.

About you

• Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Geology, Geomatics, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related field and 3+ years of relevant professional experience; or a master’s degree in one of these fields and relevant experience.
• Experience using Esri desktop and web-based GIS products, including ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online.
• Demonstrated skills in spatial analysis, geospatial database management, mapping, data visualization, and data QA/QC.
• Ability to work independently, manage multiple assignments, and contribute effectively within multidisciplinary and multi-user project teams.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information clearly to project teams and clients.

What we can offer you

• Meaningful, high-impact work
• Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
• Competitive compensation and benefits
• Professional development and leadership opportunities
• A collaborative and inclusive culture
• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. jobs.title: Director of Partner Solutions
jobs.description:
MEET ASCERTAIN

Ascertain is building AI agents to automate the administrative work that burdens care teams. We are in major health systems and large specialty groups, saving hundreds of staff hours every week.

Our backers include Northwell Health, New York’s largest health system, and Deerfield Management, a leading healthcare investment firm.

Together, we’re on a mission to restore time, trust, and focus to the people who keep healthcare running. Our work is urgent — not because of startup timelines, but because our customers rely on us to drive financial resilience and operational clarity in a system under strain.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As our next Partner Solutions hire, you will lead post-sale success, implementation, adoption, and retention efforts for Ascertain's most strategic partners. This role is ideal for someone with experience in healthcare technology, healthcare consulting, or SaaS implementation, and a strong background in ambulatory revenue cycle operations, who is excited to build a high-impact function from the ground up.

You will own the customer journey after the initial sale, overseeing pilot delivery, driving change management and adoption, and ensuring long-term retention and expansion. Working directly with care management, revenue cycle, and clinical operations teams, you will ensure our platform integrates seamlessly into daily workflows and delivers measurable business and clinical value. Successful implementations will serve as a foundation for future product adoption and expansion into adjacent workflows.

As a trusted advisor to our partners, you will engage executive stakeholders, align teams around operational goals, and leverage data-driven insights to demonstrate ROI. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to ensure deployments are successful, customer feedback informs product development, and outcomes support broader go-to-market strategies.

This is a highly visible, hands-on role for someone who thrives in relationship management, transformational implementations, and operational problem-solving. You will help define Ascertain's partner success strategy, create scalable processes and playbooks, and shape the overall customer experience.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own partner success after the sale by leading onboarding, implementation, adoption, and long-term retention efforts for strategic healthcare customers.

 - Serve as the primary partner contact, building relationships with executive sponsors, operational leaders, and clinical stakeholders.

 - Lead deployments from kickoff through go-live, managing timelines, milestones, risks, training, and change management activities.

 - Drive adoption and measurable outcomes by helping customers integrate Ascertain into daily workflows and achieve operational and financial goals.

 - Measure and communicate ROI using key performance metrics to support renewals, expansion opportunities, and strategic decision-making.

 - Partner with Sales to grow existing accounts through upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on customer needs and success.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to improve the customer experience and influence product development.

 - Build scalable processes and playbooks for onboarding, training, support, and customer success as the function grows.
   


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 4+ years leading implementations, onboarding, or post-sale delivery for healthcare technology or SaaS platforms.

 - Hands-on ambulatory revenue cycle management experience, gained in practice management, ambulatory specialty, or primary care settings. We value deep revenue cycle expertise over experience in any single specialty.

 - Experience working with healthcare providers and operational teams, with a strong understanding of ambulatory practice workflows.

 - Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder implementations and drive adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term customer success.

 - Familiarity with ambulatory EHR platforms such as athenaOne, NextGen, eClinicalWorks, or similar systems.

 - Strong communication, relationship management, and analytical skills, with the ability to engage both executive and operational stakeholders.

 - Startup or high-growth company experience is preferred.
   


BENEFITS & PERKS:

 - Cutting-edge technology: Work directly with the latest advancements in AI and automation, tackling challenging problems that meaningfully impact healthcare.

 - Ownership & growth: You'll join Ascertain at a pivotal early stage, shaping our products, technical direction, and culture, with significant opportunities for career advancement.

 - Collaborative team: Join a talented, passionate, and supportive team with backgrounds from top tech companies and clinical institutions.

 - Competitive compensation: We offer competitive salary, meaningful equity, comprehensive health insurance, and more.

Why Ascertain? Make a real difference: Your work will directly impact healthcare organizations and improve patient care. Join Ascertain in transforming healthcare with AI!

Founded in 1965, Prometheus is the largest privately held owner of apartments in the San Francisco Bay Area, with a portfolio of over 13,000 apartments in the Silicon Valley, Portland, and Seattle regions. We invest in real estate long-term and the focus on enduring quality drives every element of what we do - from our selection of locations to design decisions, reinvestments into our Neighborhoods and our operating strategy.

We are a vertically integrated company with four main core competencies in-house: acquisitions/investments, development, value-add renovations, and operations/property management. Prometheus has a long history of award-winning approaches to what we do, receiving over 100 awards for design and excellence including Fortune Magazine’s list of 100 Best Small & Medium Companies, the 100 Best Workplaces for Women and Best Places to Work in the Bay Area.

OUR PURPOSE

jobs.title: Associate Director - Cost Manager / Quantity Surveyor - Data Center Construction
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Associate Director, Cost Management / Quantity Surveying to join our team and provide strategic commercial leadership on a large-scale, mission-critical data center program in Cheyenne, Wyoming. Because this position supports a major project site in Cheyenne, it requires a regular onsite presence based on project requirements. Candidates residing in the Fort Collins, CO area, within a reasonable commuting distance of Cheyenne, or those open to relocating to the region are encouraged to apply.

In this key client-facing leadership role, you will oversee the full commercial and financial lifecycle of a 115-acre, $1.2 billion hyperscale data center campus, from pre-construction cost planning, estimating, budgeting, and procurement through construction delivery, contract administration, change management, and project closeout. Working directly with client stakeholders, consultants, and contractors, you will lead a site-based commercial team, drive cost certainty, manage commercial risk, and support the successful delivery of this multi-phase, ground-up development.

Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end cost management across all project phases, ensuring alignment with scope, budget, and schedule for hyperscale data center programs and other sectors.
• Develop and maintain detailed cost plans, estimates, and forecasts using industry benchmarks and technical documentation.
• Manage change control: review and negotiate change orders, track post-contract variances, and ensure robust commercial governance.
• Oversee contractor and subcontractor pricing reviews, scope validation, and procurement strategy development; advise on contracting and procurement approaches and support program-level capital planning.
• Coordinate closely with scheduling teams to integrate cost forecasts with project timelines and milestones.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for commercial status reporting; produce and present monthly cost reports, executive summaries, and financial updates to stakeholders.
• Take a lead role interfacing with clients, stakeholders, and consultants at all project stages; maintain excellent communication and build strong relationships with clients, vendors, and project teams.
• Drive cost risk analysis, scenario planning, and sensitivity testing; monitor market trends and provide insights on escalation, labor availability, and material pricing.
• Develop strategies for cost optimization and value engineering to enhance outcomes and reduce lifecycle costs.
• Set and track performance via KPIs and critical success factors; prepare and deliver presentations to senior leadership.
• Manage financial performance using internal systems to track margins, forecasts, and reporting; implement and maintain Business Management Systems (BMS) and company delivery methodologies to ensure best practice.
• Identify opportunities to improve cost management processes, templates, and tools; champion knowledge management by capturing lessons learned and key data.
• Provide strong leadership with a clear strategy and ambition for the team; mentor and develop junior staff, conduct performance reviews, and foster a high-performance, collaborative culture.
• Act as a brand ambassador; develop market understanding, build a pipeline of opportunities, and identify cross-selling and business generation opportunities.
• Participate in proposals/RFP responses and attend networking events to expand market presence and relationships.
• SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

• Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field; graduate degree preferred.
• 8–10+ years of experience in cost management or project controls within the construction industry, ideally on large-scale, mission-critical projects (e.g., data centers, high-tech, industrial).
• Proven experience in construction consultancy and client-facing delivery.
• Strong understanding of MEP systems, resilience requirements, and campus-scale infrastructure.
• Expertise in budgeting, financial reporting, cost control systems, Earned Value Management (EVM), and procurement strategies.
• Proficiency with industry-standard cost management tools and software (e.g., CostX, Oracle, Excel, Primavera).
• RICS accreditation or equivalent certification (or progress toward certification) highly desirable.
• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
