jobs.title: Recruiting Sourcer
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB



Palette is a fast-growing startup at the center of the creator economy. Our team of 80+ is working towards defining the standard for talent management and marketing in an era of new media dominated by digital-first entertainers.



Our management infrastructure mirrors the depth of attention given to the world’s biggest cultural and entertainment icons, and previously reserved for artists in traditional arenas of entertainment. Today, it services a roster of 200+ creators and influencers with a combined following of 1B+ serving over 45.8B impressions monthly. Our creators have starred in Super Bowl commercials, launched national brands, and have been featured in nearly every major publication.



Our marketing agency executes strategy for some of the most influential brands and organizations in the world, including: The Biden White House, Amazon, simplehuman, and the Gates Foundation. Forty-two percent of Americans under the age of 40 are no longer accessible through traditional marketing channels—we enable organizations to speak to those audiences. Our marketing team has been recognized with 5 Shorty Impact Awards and has advised three U.S. Presidents on the future of the internet.




THE ROLE



Palette is seeking a Recruiting Sourcer to help build exceptional talent pipelines as we continue to scale. This is an ideal opportunity for someone early in their recruiting career who is passionate about identifying top talent, building relationships, and learning the fundamentals of strategic recruiting.



As a Recruiting Sourcer, you'll partner closely with our recruiting team to identify, engage, and qualify candidates across a variety of business functions. You'll leverage modern sourcing tools, recruiting technology, and creative outreach strategies to proactively build diverse talent pipelines while helping deliver an exceptional candidate experience.



This role is highly collaborative, analytical, and fast-paced, offering significant exposure to recruiting strategy and the opportunity to grow into a full-cycle recruiter.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build and maintain proactive talent pipelines across multiple business functions through LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, networking, and other sourcing channels.

 - Conduct market mapping and competitive research to identify high-quality passive talent.

 - Craft personalized outreach messaging that generates strong candidate engagement and response rates.

 - Conduct initial outreach and recruiter screens to evaluate candidate alignment before advancing qualified talent.

 - Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand hiring priorities and ideal candidate profiles.

 - Maintain accurate candidate records and pipeline data within the applicant tracking system.

 - Schedule and coordinate interviews while ensuring a seamless candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

 - Track sourcing activity, outreach metrics, pipeline health, and conversion rates to continuously improve recruiting effectiveness.

 - Assist with employer branding initiatives, talent communities, campus recruiting, and other recruiting projects as needed.

 - Stay informed on talent market trends, competitor hiring activity, and creative sourcing strategies.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 1–2 years of experience in recruiting, sourcing, talent acquisition, recruiting coordination, sales, customer-facing roles, or internships in recruiting.

 - Strong interest in recruiting, talent acquisition, and building relationships with candidates.

 - Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter or other sourcing platforms is preferred.

 - Familiarity with applicant tracking systems such as Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, or similar platforms is a plus.

 - Excellent written communication skills with the ability to craft engaging, personalized outreach messages.

 - Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

 - Comfortable working with spreadsheets, recruiting metrics, and pipeline reporting.

 - Curious, resourceful, and motivated to learn modern sourcing techniques and recruiting best practices.

 - Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships across candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers.

 - Passion for startups, digital media, technology, or the creator economy is a plus.

 - Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Communications, Psychology, or a related field.

jobs.title: Warehouse Sanitation Associate (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
The Warehouse Sanitation Associate uses standard operating procedures (SOP) to perform the picking, loading, and unloading of delivery trucks and/or receives and stores materials/products. Assists with ICL, auditing or production functions as needed. Maintains safe work area through general housekeeping and performs sanitation functions as required. Wears proper PPE as required.

• Hourly Rate: $20.50
• Shift: 5am -1:30pm Sat, Sun, Mon

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Sanitation Duties:

• Remove dough trays/carts and returns product from truck
• Update inventory to reflect received product and sorts and stores usable product
• Thoroughly cleans cargo area of trailer to ensure sanitary storage area for product during transport
• Pre-cool cargo area of trailer to company specifications prior to loading product

Picker Duties:

• Operate scanner so that the proper order is picked, and inventory is managed accurately
• Ensure that orders are accurate, including quantity, size, and date
• Stage items correctly for loaders and delivery
• Efficiently loads product onto carts maximizing space
• Operate handling equipment and ensures safety regulations are followed
• Move product from staging area to trailer using equipment such as forklift, pallet jack or two-wheeled cart
• Stage each order with the use of handheld scanner in preparation of loading onto trailers

Loader Duties:

• Complete load verification with handheld scanner and verifies accuracy of assembled loads
• Load trailers according to company specifications for maximum delivery accuracy
• Secure load within cargo area of trailer using load bars, or straps
• Load outbound trailers/routes according to load sheets
• Inspect product for quality before loading onto trailers
• Assist with pulling orders for walk up customers, as needed

Auditor Duties:

• Verify dough and product is accurate on assigned trailers
• Work with leadership and loaders to correct variances that have been identified

• One – two years previous experience in warehouse, or manufacturing environment
• High School diploma or equivalent
• Experience working with an RF Scanner and warehouse management systems (WMS)
• Basic computer skills for order processing and inventory control
• Basic math: addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division
• Keen attention to detail
• Use a forklift or walking pallet jack for transporting/lifting loads within the warehouse
• Use "First In, First Out" (FIFO) procedure to ensure proper rotation of existing stock
• Must successfully pass a background checks every 3rd year on your anniversary date
• Adherence to work schedule and attendance policy
• Understand and utilize safe lifting practices

Additional Requirement:

• Follow Domino’s dress code standards
• Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor or manager
• Maintain forklift, pallet jack and scissor lift certifications

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• Ability to stand and/or walk for long periods of time, climb stairs, and lift to from floor above head 25 lbs. frequently, and 50 lb. occasionally throughout shift
• Work in extreme temperatures [0-38 degrees] or heat [80+ degrees], and environment with exposure to loud machinery
• Ability to work well on a team but can be self-motivated and independent at times
• Must be available to work during a shift which may be scheduled anytime during a 24-hour day, over any 7-day period, including weekends and holidays
• Must be able to work around yeast and flour

jobs.title: Sr Director, UX Design
jobs.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Senior Director, User Experience & Design

Why We Have This Role

We are seeking a visionary Senior Director of User Experience based in Seattle to shape the future of customer interactions across our entire product ecosystem. This role is pivotal in defining and implementing an overarching UX strategy that aligns with our business goals and enhances our competitive edge. As a leader in our organization, you’ll drive cross-functional collaboration, foster a customer-first mindset, and build products that resonate with users. Reporting directly to our Head of UX, you’ll be at the forefront of UX innovation, ensuring that our products are not only functional but also delightful to use.

How You’ll Find Success

Success in this role will mean achieving excellence across several critical areas:

• Strategic Leadership: Define and implement a compelling UX vision that aligns with our product and business goals, inspiring stakeholders to prioritize user-centric design.

• Team Leadership & Development: Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing UX team, fostering a collaborative environment that drives exceptional results.

• Customer-Centric Design: Champion a user-first mentality and partner closely with product and engineering teams to integrate UX best practices into every stage of the product lifecycle.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with leaders in product management, engineering, marketing, and sales to create a cohesive approach to product design and customer experience.

• Research & Insights: Leverage user research, usability studies, and analytics to continually refine and enhance user experience, driving data-driven design improvements.

• Innovation: Stay abreast of UX trends, tools, and technologies, driving innovation in design practices to maintain our competitive advantage.

• Operational Excellence: Manage UX budgets and resources effectively, developing processes and methodologies to optimize design execution.

• Executive Reporting: Provide regular updates to the C-suite on UX performance metrics, customer feedback, and the impact of UX on business KPIs such as user adoption, satisfaction, and retention.

How You’ll Grow

This role offers opportunities for personal and professional growth through:

• Expanding strategic thinking and leadership capabilities in a fast-paced environment.

• Leading a dynamic team and shaping their development.

• Engaging with cutting-edge UX trends and AI first tooling that will continuously enhance your expertise and modernize your team.

• Collaborating with multiple functionalities, thus broadening your understanding of business operations.

Things You’ll Do

• Define and communicate a clear UX vision and strategy for our Understand intelligence system teams.

• Mentor and support your UX team in developing their skills and careers.

• Analyze user research to inform design decisions.

• Facilitate collaboration across departments to ensure consistency and quality in user experiences.

• Monitor and report on UX performance metrics to inform stakeholders about progress and areas for improvement.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

• A minimum of 15+ years in user experience, product design, or a related field, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within a B2B software company.

• Demonstrated success leading UX efforts at scale for enterprise-level software products.

• Expertise in modern UX design principles, usability testing, and design thinking methodologies.

• Leading and designing for complex BI platforms, with expertise in AI first text analytics, natural language processing and agentic frameworks is strongly preferred.

• Proven ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams, with strong interpersonal and collaboration skills.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a talent for conveying complex design strategies to diverse audiences.

• Hands-on experience with today’s UX/UI design tools including Figma, Cursor and Claude Code as well as JIRA.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Design, or a related field is preferred.

What You Should Know About This Team

Our UX team is passionate about creating exceptional user experiences that meet our users' needs and drive business success. We prioritize collaboration and innovation, believing that the best solutions come from diverse perspectives. Our work environment fosters creativity, encourages risk-taking, and promotes continuous learning, making it an exciting place for those who want to leave a mark on UX within our product ecosystem.

Our Team's Favorite Perks and Benefits

• We take pride in our offices design aiming at cultivating creativity from our rooftop views to open and collaborative work spaces

• On top of the standard benefits package (medical, dental, vision, life insurance, etc) we provide snacks, drinks, and free lunches in our office

• We believe in sharing Qualtrics success which is part of the compensation for all employees

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.

jobs.title: Summer Camp Director, Littleton (2027)
jobs.description:
Galileo is looking for an experienced leader to join our team as a Camp Director. Camp Directors lead our dynamic summer camps for K–8th grade, serving as both site General Manager and the public face of the organization.

You will open and operate a Camp Galileo location serving campers and their families within your community! You will lead a dynamic seasonal team of educators as well as enthusiastic entry-level staff to create joyful, safe environments and ensure smooth daily operations. With a focus on exceptional camper and family experiences, you will uphold program quality, foster creativity, and deliver excellence in customer care, curriculum, and team leadership.

Why This Role Matters

Galileo started in 2002 with a single summer camp in Palo Alto, named for Galileo Galilei, one of history’s great innovators. Today we run 90+ sites across eight states, and Camp Directors are still the people who give each camp its own traditions and magic. Our mission is to develop innovators who envision and create a better world, and at camp, you’re the one who makes that real for campers, families, and staff every day.

You will be Accountable for

Bringing Galileo’s Spirit to Life

• Infuse camp with joy, tradition, and creativity

• Build an inclusive environment where every camper, staff member, and family feels seen, supported, and inspired

Leading with Ownership and Vision

• Own every aspect of your camp’s launch, from preseason planning through end-of-summer wrap-up

• As both operational lead and culture builder, oversee every detail from daily camp operations to parent communication while delivering an exceptional program

Keeping Camp Safe and Running Smoothly

• Prioritize camper safety, family trust, and program fidelity at all times

• Anticipate needs, adapt quickly, and problem-solve on the fly so camp runs seamlessly, even when things don’t go as planned

Developing and Managing Your Team

• Train and mentor a staff of 7 to 40 (depending on site size), including educators and entry-level staff, while actively building your team culture

• Provide clear expectations for instructional and program standards, ongoing feedback, and professional development

• Own core management responsibilities such as training support, scheduling, payroll, and ongoing performance management

Embracing Challenge and Innovation

• Use the Galileo Innovation Approach (GIA) to encourage curiosity and problem-solving

• Lead your team in turning challenges into opportunities, keeping both spirit and operations aligned to Galileo’s mission

• Communicate openly with your Field Program Manager, seek out feedback, and turn it into action

• Take ownership of your own professional development, staying self-motivated to learn, grow, and improve throughout the summer

Building Strong Partnerships

• Serve as the primary face of camp within the community

• Communicate proactively with families, facilities partners, and cross-functional teams

• Collaborate with your Field Program Manager and cultivate trust with community partners, staff, and campers

Location & Work Schedule:

This is a seasonal role running March–September 2027, with a schedule divided into three phases. Exact dates will vary based on hire date and specific site operating dates:

• Phase One: Training & Prep (March–June): 5 to 15 hours per week, depending on tenure and start date — mostly flexible and remote, with some required scheduled and in-person commitments. jobs.title: Specimen Processor l
jobs.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

• We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.

• We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.

• We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.

• We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

Primarily responsibility for receiving and accessioning specimens, handling specimen documentation, and data entry of requisitions. They are also responsible for keeping the lab in a clean and orderly condition. Specimen Processor I are knowledgeable in sample integrity issues and are a resource to others in the lab. They maintain flexibility regarding work schedules including daily assignments, holiday schedules, and days of the week as determined by business need.

Schedule: Tuesday - Saturday, 8:00 am - 4:30 pm.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

• Accessioning clinical specimens upon receipt and entering data into LIS system.

• Specimen verification, labeling, tracking, and all related clerical functions.

• Capable of identifying specimen processing problems that may adversely affect the reporting of test results and immediately notifying the supervisor.

• Documenting all corrective actions taken when test systems deviate from the laboratory's established performance specifications.

• Following the laboratory's established policies and procedures.

• Understanding of compliance regulations related to test ordering.

• Compliant with company policies, procedures, safety requirements and regulations.

• Contributing to the safety of the laboratory operations by complying with established safety procedures and making recommendations for improvement.

• Engaging in training and competency assessments.

• Attending and participating in department meetings.

• Participating in activities associated with regulatory compliance and inspections.

• Assisting in continuous improvement activities/projects.

• Assisting in research and validation activities.

• Helping perform weekly, monthly, and other periodic room and equipment maintenance procedures in accordance with standard operating procedures.

• Helping track and stock laboratory supplies.

• General clean-up tasks, e.g. break down and trash shipping boxes/packaging, disinfect lab benches and surfaces, and put away supplies.

• Working cooperatively in a team environment and supporting senior laboratory and management staff.

• Working cross-functionally with Customer Care regarding specimen issues and Accessioning requests.

• Complete other related administrative duties, including printing, copying, filing, faxing, and quality control of spreadsheets.

Who You Are:

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

• 0-2 years of accessioning experience and/or in a lab setting

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• Bachelor’s degree preferred.

• Good verbal and written communication skills.

• The ability to navigate efficiently through, or have familiarity with, various laboratory information systems (LIS) and have proficiency in Microsoft Office products (Excel, Word, Access and PowerPoint).

• Good judgment and problem-solving skills

• Excellent teamwork and collaborations skills

• Ability to work independently

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• Repetitive movement of hands, arms and legs

• Repetitive movement of fingers (typing and/or writing)

• Sitting, with occasional walking, standing, stooping and moving about

• Talking and hearing

• Occasionally required to lift up to 25 pounds

#LI-Onsite

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Pay range

$19—$23 USD

What We Can Offer You

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose.

About Veracyte

Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. For more information, please visit www.veracyte.com or follow us on LinkedIn or X (Twitter).

Veracyte, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability status. Veracyte participates in E-Verify in the United States. View our CCPA Disclosure Notice

If you receive any suspicious alerts or communications through LinkedIn or other online job sites for any position at Veracyte, please exercise caution and promptly report any concerns to careers@veracyte.com

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Foundations
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Assistance Engineering team builds world-class tools for Airbnb's global network of support agents, so guests and hosts get a great experience 24/7, 365 days a year. Airbnb's operational staff must scale with our user base, and we own the entire tech stack behind their success.
Within Assistance Engineering, Assistance Foundations builds the shared platforms that support runs on: case management, the agent workspace, quality and coaching systems, money tooling, data services, agent routing, provisioning and training, and reliability. We are forming a dedicated Machine Learning Engineering group so that intelligence is built once on this foundation and reused across support, rather than rebuilt by each team. You will be one of its founding engineers.

Some of what we are building and shipping:

• LLM-based quality evaluation that scores support cases against the quality standard, at scale

• AI coaching that turns quality evidence into coaching plans for team leads

• Simulation environments that train agents on realistic support scenarios

• Natural language search and chat tools that help agents and supervisors find answers faster

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the LLM-based and agentic systems behind quality, coaching, case intelligence, and decision support for agents. The work spans prompt design, retrieval, fine-tuning, agent orchestration, dataset engineering, and evaluation. This is a product-building role: you will take systems from first experiment to production and own how they perform for real users.

A Typical Day:

• Design, build, and ship LLM-based and agentic systems, from technical design through implementation, experimentation, and deployment.

• Build offline and online evaluation (human-labeled sets, LLM-as-judge, A/B tests) so that quality is measured, not assumed.

jobs.title: Summer Camp Director, Denver Highland/Wheat Ridge (2027)
jobs.location: Denver Highland/Wheat Ridge, CO, United States
jobs.description:
Galileo is looking for an experienced leader to join our team as a Camp Director. Camp Directors lead our dynamic summer camps for K–8th grade, serving as both site General Manager and the public face of the organization.

You will open and operate a Camp Galileo location serving campers and their families within your community! You will lead a dynamic seasonal team of educators as well as enthusiastic entry-level staff to create joyful, safe environments and ensure smooth daily operations. With a focus on exceptional camper and family experiences, you will uphold program quality, foster creativity, and deliver excellence in customer care, curriculum, and team leadership.

Why This Role Matters

Galileo started in 2002 with a single summer camp in Palo Alto, named for Galileo Galilei, one of history’s great innovators. Today we run 90+ sites across eight states, and Camp Directors are still the people who give each camp its own traditions and magic. Our mission is to develop innovators who envision and create a better world, and at camp, you’re the one who makes that real for campers, families, and staff every day.

You will be Accountable for

Bringing Galileo’s Spirit to Life

• Infuse camp with joy, tradition, and creativity

• Build an inclusive environment where every camper, staff member, and family feels seen, supported, and inspired

Leading with Ownership and Vision

• Own every aspect of your camp’s launch, from preseason planning through end-of-summer wrap-up

• As both operational lead and culture builder, oversee every detail from daily camp operations to parent communication while delivering an exceptional program

Keeping Camp Safe and Running Smoothly

• Prioritize camper safety, family trust, and program fidelity at all times

• Anticipate needs, adapt quickly, and problem-solve on the fly so camp runs seamlessly, even when things don’t go as planned

Developing and Managing Your Team

• Train and mentor a staff of 7 to 40 (depending on site size), including educators and entry-level staff, while actively building your team culture

• Provide clear expectations for instructional and program standards, ongoing feedback, and professional development

• Own core management responsibilities such as training support, scheduling, payroll, and ongoing performance management

Embracing Challenge and Innovation

• Use the Galileo Innovation Approach (GIA) to encourage curiosity and problem-solving

• Lead your team in turning challenges into opportunities, keeping both spirit and operations aligned to Galileo’s mission

• Communicate openly with your Field Program Manager, seek out feedback, and turn it into action

• Take ownership of your own professional development, staying self-motivated to learn, grow, and improve throughout the summer

Building Strong Partnerships

• Serve as the primary face of camp within the community

• Communicate proactively with families, facilities partners, and cross-functional teams

• Collaborate with your Field Program Manager and cultivate trust with community partners, staff, and campers

Location & Work Schedule:

This is a seasonal role running March–September 2027, with a schedule divided into three phases. Exact dates will vary based on hire date and specific site operating dates:

• Phase One: Training & Prep (March–June): 5 to 15 hours per week, depending on tenure and start date — mostly flexible and remote, with some required scheduled and in-person commitments. This phase includes in-person training(s), a Bay Area retreat, scheduled virtual training(s), marketing events, and on-site prep at your camp location during the week leading up to camp. Some events may take place during evenings and weekends.

• Phase Two: On-Site (June–August): On-site hours typically range from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM (M-F), up to 50 hours per week over 5–8 weeks, depending on camp placement.

• Phase Three: Wrap-Up (Aug–Sept): Up to 5 hrs total, remote, for final admin tasks and staff reviews.

Compensation:

(Year 1 estimate):

• Preseason (Feb–June): Earn hourly pay ($22-24/hour) for flexible, part-time prep and training

• Camp Season (June–Aug): Transition to a weekly salary ($1,400/week plus an additional $50/week for each year of returning tenure in this role) as a full-time, exempt Camp Director during summer operations

• Postseason (Aug–Sept): Wrap up with light part-time work, paid hourly ($22-24/hour)

• Bonus/Commission: Earn an additional $1 per camper-week enrollment, plus potential commission for add-on weeks

Exact compensation may vary and will be based on multiple factors, including geography and Galileo camp director tenure. Our pay practices are guided by a commitment to equity and informed by market benchmarking and internal audits to minimize bias and ensure fairness across all roles.

Perks:

• Free camp for your child(ren) or two giftable weeks (incl. extended care)

• 15% Friends & Family discount

• Priority nomination for financial assistance for someone you know

• 3+ years of experience working directly with students in an education setting (out-of-school time, teaching, education administration, camps/recreation, etc.) is required

• Minimum 1 year of experience managing or supervising adult staff is required

• Proven experience creating safe, inclusive environments for children and building trust with families

• Proven experience setting clear expectations, giving ongoing feedback, and coaching staff to improve

• Demonstrated ability to manage operational details like scheduling, staffing, and payroll

• Track record of staying calm and making sound decisions in fast-paced situations, including safety issues and challenging conversations with families

• Strong written and verbal communication with families, partners, and supervisors

• Experience with hands-on, project-based learning (STEAM, art, design, maker programs) is a plus

• Availability for part-time remote work starting Feb 2027, and full-time on-site work starting June 2027 (dates vary by location)

• Willingness to travel in the region to up to 3 in person marketing events, in the preseason

• Ability to complete all required training before camp begins

• Ability to meet state requirements to work with children, including mandated screenings and Adult & Child First Aid/CPR/AED certification

jobs.title: Engineering Geologist
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Engineering Geologist to provide expert geological and geotechnical support for transportation infrastructure projects across New Jersey and New York.  Primary functions include performing various geotechnical engineering services related to construction of tunnels, highways bridges and other transit related developments.

The role is available immediately.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform field reconnaissance and geological mapping to identify hazards such as landslides, subsidence, soil liquefaction, or unstable slopes.
• Perform inspection of SOE reinforcement and rock mass grouting.
• Conduct geological and geotechnical site investigations, including soil, and rock.
• Develop geological models, cross-sections, and maps to support transportation design and construction.
• Analyze geotechnical and prepare detailed technical risk assessments and geologic reports.
• Collaborate with civil and structural engineers, planners, and NJDOT (or similar agencies) to integrate geological findings into transportation project designs.
• Ensure projects comply with environmental and safety regulations, including federal, state, and local transportation standards.
• Oversee fieldwork logistics and supervise drilling operations, test pits, groundwater instrumentation, probe hole drilling and permeability testing.
• Oversight of geotechnical instrumentation including deformation and vibration monitoring.
• Preparation of field reports including geologic maps, in-situ testing, probe hole and boring logs, etc. documenting daily construction activities; The employee will also perform complex calculations to document the acceptability of the completed construction and will prepare necessary reports and drawings as required. or geotechnical monitoring equipment.
• Support construction monitoring, ensuring that geological recommendations are enacted during build phases.
• Communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, including NJDOT representatives, project managers, and regulatory agencies.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Engineering Geology, Geological Engineering, Civil Engineering (with a geotechnical focus), or a related field plus six years of related experience.
• Valid US Drivers License.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Engineering Geology, Geotechnical Engineering, Soil/Rock Mechanics, or Hydrogeology.
• 8 years of related geotechnical experience, with demonstrated experience in underground structures; (tunnels, shafts, caverns, rock reinforcement, grouting, ground improvement, etc.
• Utilize computer software programs such as: Dips, RocSlope, RocFall, and Swedge.
• Valid New York State Professional Engineering or Professional Geologist license.

• Sponsorship for US employment authorization is available.
• Relocation is not available for this position.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION:

A career here is life-enhancing.

At Syner-G, we enable our people to build careers that impact positively on their quality of life. Through our expertise, insight, consulting and management skills, we accelerate breakthrough science and delivery of life-enhancing therapies to more patients. We work across a diverse range of clients and projects, supporting many organizations from the most critical phases of the drug discovery and approval process through to commercialization. It is meaningful, varied and thought-provoking work with a strategic emphasis, a solutions-driven approach and significant, real-world outcomes, from science to delivery/success. To learn more about who we are and what drives us, watch our company video here.

Underpinning this mission is a culture that aligns perfectly with what we want to achieve. We enable our people to grow, we support them in their learning and we reward them in so many different ways. In return, they play an instrumental role in maintaining our reputation across the globe as a strategic biopharma product development and delivery partner.

Syner-G was recently honored with BioSpace's prestigious "Best Places to Work" 2027 award, for the fourth consecutive year, along with many other award-winning programs to make a career here truly life-enhancing. These recognitions are a testament to our commitment to fostering a positive and engaging work environment for our employees, with a particular emphasis on culture, career growth and development opportunities, financial rewards, leadership and innovation.

At Syner-G, we recognize that our team members are our most valuable asset. Join us in shaping the future, where your talents are valued, and your contributions make a meaningful impact.

For more information, visit www.Synergbiopharma.com

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are seeking a Program Manager with extensive experience in executive communication, PMO leadership, project portfolio management, MS Office, and Smartsheet. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record leading enterprise-wide strategic initiatives, establishing and managing Project Management Office (PMO) functions, and overseeing large IT and business transformation programs within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry.

This role requires deep expertise in program and portfolio management, project governance, systems deployment, organizational change management, risk management, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment. The successful candidate will serve as both a strategic program leader and PMO champion, driving consistency in project execution, resource planning, governance, reporting, and decision-making across multiple initiatives while ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and measurable business outcomes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

(This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented or changed as necessary.)

• Develop project tasks, deliverables, dependencies, and resource requirements.

• Leverage interpersonal skills and sound judgment to effectively navigate and drive project execution to meet or exceed project goals.

• Collaborate with cross-functional groups to create, execute, and communicate overall project plans, including scope, schedule, staffing plans, quality, risk management, budget, and procurement, and revise them as needed to meet changing project requirements.

• Identify needs for changes to project plans and communicate them to teams and stakeholders to ensure alignment with business objectives.

• Facilitate team meetings and workshops to meet project and program needs.

• Schedule and lead phase gate reviews with executive approval committees.

• Identify and resolve or escalate program issues, facilitate trade-off decisions, and remove obstacles.

• Continuously analyze and manage risks to enable successful project completion.

• Utilize appropriate tools and methodologies to manage projects, solve problems, and document project information, including RACI and SIPOC frameworks.

• Define and optimize project management and development processes, methodologies, and tools to improve organizational efficiency and effectiveness.

• Lead large cross-functional programs that drive strategic business transformation across IT and operational domains.

• Manage IT program portfolios with a focus on systems deployment, integration, and stakeholder alignment.

• Champion business transformation initiatives, ensuring alignment with enterprise goals and successful change adoption.

• Establish, implement, and continuously improve PMO standards, methodologies, governance processes, and project management best practices.

• Manage project and program portfolios, ensuring prioritization and alignment with strategic business objectives.

• Develop and maintain executive-level portfolio dashboards, project health metrics, and governance reporting.

• Facilitate governance reviews, steering committee meetings, and executive decision-making forums.

• Drive resource planning and capacity management across multiple projects and workstreams.

• Lead portfolio risk identification, mitigation planning, and escalation processes.

• Ensure consistency in project execution through standardized tools, templates, and project management methodologies.

• Mentor project managers and project teams while fostering project management excellence throughout the organization.

• Monitor portfolio performance through key performance indicators and recommend corrective actions to maximize delivery success.

• Partner with business and IT leaders to evaluate, prioritize, and govern strategic initiatives and investments.

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the education, experience, skills, knowledge, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

Education

• Bachelor's degree in a life science, business, information technology, or related field required.

Technical Experience

• 10+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device industry, including at least 3+ years leading cross-functional strategic initiatives.

• Experience using MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint, and Smartsheet.

• Experience within a cGMP and FDA-regulated environment.

• Experience leading enterprise-wide PMOs and/or managing large strategic program portfolios within a complex, matrixed organization.

• Demonstrated experience establishing PMO governance frameworks, project management methodologies, portfolio management processes, and executive reporting structures.

• Experience managing strategic business transformation initiatives, IT system implementations, and cross-functional organizational change efforts.

• Life sciences industry experience required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.

• PgMP, PMI-PMOCP, or equivalent program/project management certification preferred.

• Excellent communication and leadership skills, along with a strong work ethic.

• Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Knowledge of drug development and the pharmaceutical industry is essential.

• Strong understanding of systems deployment and integration, including requirements management, risk management, stakeholder alignment, governance, and oversight of multiple workstreams.

• Strong knowledge of PMO governance frameworks, portfolio management methodologies, project lifecycle management, and organizational change management principles.

• Experience developing executive dashboards, portfolio reporting, project metrics, and performance indicators for senior leadership.

• Proven ability to balance competing priorities and allocate resources effectively across multiple programs and projects.

• Strong facilitation skills with experience leading steering committees, governance boards, and executive stakeholder forums.

• Experience implementing project governance processes and driving project management maturity within an organization.

• Skilled in portfolio planning, capacity management, budgeting, roadmap development, and strategic initiative tracking.

• Comfortable leading the use of PM tools and dashboards, including Power BI and Smartsheet.

• Enjoys clarifying ambiguity, solving complex business problems, and deploying systems with user adoption and business outcomes in mind.

• Experience building, transforming, or leading a PMO within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or life sciences organization preferred.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of the requirements that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer keyboard and mouse; reach with hands and arms; talk and listen. The employee is frequently required to walk and sit, as well as to lift and carry objects such as books and files weighing up to 25 pounds. The employee is occasionally required to stand, stoop, or kneel. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, including moderate noise level, an indoor temperate environment, and light levels that are bright and conducive to minimal eye strain, typical for an office environment.

TOTAL REWARDS PROGRAM:

We define total rewards as compensation, benefits, remote work/flexibility, development, recognition and our culture with programs that support each of our reward pillars. This includes a market competitive base salary and annual incentive plan, robust benefit offerings, and ongoing recognition and career development opportunities. Employees also enjoy our generous flexible paid time off program, company paid holidays, flexible working hours, and fully remote work options for most positions and the ability to work “almost anywhere”. However, if a physical work location is more for you, we have office locations in Greater Boston; San Diego, CA; Boulder, CO; and India.

Applicants must have current work authorization when accepting a position at Syner‑G. Currently, Syner‑G is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time

LEGAL STATEMENT:

Syner-G is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employers. All employment decisions, including the recruiting, hiring, placement, training availability, promotion, compensation, evaluation, disciplinary actions, and termination of employment (if necessary) are made without regard to the employee’s race, color, creed, religion, sex, pregnancy or childbirth, personal appearance, family responsibilities, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, political affiliation, source of income, place of residence, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, age, marital status, military veteran status, unfavorable discharge from military service, physical or mental disability, or on any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Syner-G is an E-Verify employer.

jobs.title: Master Technician - up to a $6,000 Bonus
jobs.description:
We’re looking for automotive mechanics with a minimum of 3 years of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Experienced Auto Technician, you will perform a full range of automotive repairs—from light maintenance to heavy engine work—and diagnostics on our vehicles, including:

• Performing general to complex repairs on all makes and models, ranging from timing belts and suspension systems to heavy engine work.

• Diagnosing and repairing advanced vehicle electrical issues, including work on electric and hybrid vehicles.

• Completing repairs for wheel bearings and axles, as well as vehicle climate control systems including ACs and heater cores.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including but not limited to: 100% company paid healthcare, dental & vision insurance, a 401(k with a Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers.

• Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.

• Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available across our Inspection Center network. Check out our Careers site to learn more!

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English

jobs.title: Transportation Team Leader
jobs.description:
Simply Put, A Great Place to Work

Benesch is a growing, multi-disciplined planning, engineering, and professional services firm. We enhance infrastructure and communities across the country – creating spaces and providing connections in ways that make a difference.

We pride ourselves on being nimble enough to remain responsive to client needs yet large enough to offer exceptional bench strength. As a member of our team, you’ll have an opportunity to draw from those resources when you need them and, likewise, contribute your expertise when you have something to share.

At Benesch, we are looking for candidates with varied backgrounds and worldviews. We are committed to offering an inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and respected. Statistics show that women and underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a position if they don’t meet 100% of the qualifications. If this statement resonates with you, don’t be so hard on yourself—apply for the job!

Transportation Team Lead

Benesch is seeking a Transportation Team Leader to help shape the future of our Michigan Transportation practice. This is an opportunity to take on a visible leadership role where your industry relationships, technical expertise, and ability to identify new opportunities will directly contribute to our continued growth.

You'll partner with regional leadership to expand our presence in the Michigan transportation market, strengthen relationships with MDOT and other key clients, and pursue exciting infrastructure projects. Along the way, you'll help lead and develop a talented team of transportation professionals, provide oversight on complex projects, and help position Benesch for long-term success.

Beyond the impact you'll make today, this role is designed to help prepare you for the next step in your leadership career. You'll gain greater exposure to business strategy, practice growth, and leadership decisions while building the experience and relationships needed to take on broader responsibilities in the future.

Location
This position offers a flexible hybrid work schedule based in our East Lansing, MI offices.

The Impact You Will Have
•    Drive business development efforts by identifying new project opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and positioning Benesch for future transportation work.
•    Build and maintain relationships with MDOT, local agencies, industry partners, and other transportation clients.
•    Partner with regional leadership to develop and execute strategies that support the growth of our Michigan Transportation practice.
•    Lead project pursuits, contribute to proposals, and develop strategic teaming relationships.
•    Support the development and mentorship of transportation engineers and technical professionals, supporting their performance and professional growth.
•    Oversee transportation project delivery, ensuring quality, budgets, schedules, and client expectations are met.
•    Collaborate with Project Managers and leadership to align staffing, resources, and technical capabilities with current and future project needs.
•    Provide technical leadership and quality oversight for roadway, highway, and interstate design projects.

What You Will Bring
•    Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering required.
•    Michigan Professional Engineer (PE) license required.
•    12+ years of progressive transportation engineering experience, including roadway and highway design.
•    Strong experience delivering MDOT transportation projects.
•    Demonstrated ability to develop client relationships, pursue new business, or contribute to winning transportation projects.
•    Experience leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, or managing multidisciplinary project teams.
•    Strong understanding of project management, including budgets, schedules, quality, and resource planning.
•    Established relationships within Michigan's transportation industry, particularly MDOT, strongly preferred.
•    Experience with MicroStation and OpenRoads Designer preferred.
•    Strong communication, leadership, and relationship-building skills.

Why Benesch?

It’s simple. We invest in our people, not just our projects.

Your next opportunity should do more than offer a new title. It should build on the experience you've gained, challenge you to keep growing, and give you the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

At Benesch, we believe great work starts with great people. That's why we're committed to creating an environment where you can contribute your ideas, develop your skills, and build a career you're proud of.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Real career growth: Professional development, leadership training, mentorship, and opportunities to take on new challenges and greater responsibility.

• A strong financial future: Up to 9% retirement contribution for benefit-eligible employees.

• Flexibility that works: Work schedules that support your professional and personal life.

• Time to recharge: Generous paid time off and parental leave for benefit-eligible employees.

• Work that makes an impact: Opportunities to collaborate, contribute ideas, solve meaningful challenges, and see the difference your work makes.

• Room to grow your way: Whether you want to deepen your expertise, explore new opportunities, or grow into leadership, we want to help you take the next step.

Your Next Chapter Starts Here

Whether you're just starting your career or bringing years of experience, Benesch offers an opportunity to build on what you've accomplished while continuing to grow.

Bring your experience, your ideas, and your ambition. Discover what you can accomplish at Benesch.

Explore our full benefits here: Click here

Equal Opportunity & Accessibility

At Benesch, we believe great work starts with great people and that means creating a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed.

Benesch is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and prohibits employment discrimination for employees and applicants in all protected groups, including veterans and individuals with disabilities, or other status protected by federal, state, and local laws.

Benesch is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with a physical disability or other impairment.

If you are limited in your ability or are unable to access Benesch's Careers website due to a physical disability or other impairment, you may request a reasonable accommodation by emailing TalentAcquisition@benesch.com. This option is only available to those in need of an accommodation due to a disability or other impairment. Please do not use this as an alternative method for general inquiries or status on applications, as you will not receive a response. Reasonable requests will be responded to as soon as possible on a case-by-case basis.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here.

Know your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal

We will be accepting applications on an ongoing basis until a candidate is found.

External Recruiters and Staffing Agencies

Benesch shall have no obligation to compensate any external recruiter or search firm for candidate submissions made without a valid, current, and fully executed agreement. Submission of candidate information does not establish entitlement to a fee.

All recruiting activity must be coordinated and authorized through the Benesch Talent Acquisition team. Please direct all communications to TalentAcquisition@Benesch.com

jobs.title: Content Creator, FloElite
jobs.description:
FloSports is a world-class sports media company strategically positioned to be the essential  destination for passionate sports fans, delighting them with live event coverage, breaking news,  highlights, stats, rankings, and team and player profiles. We are growing Our Sports every day  by continuing to invest in our ever-expanding ecosystem, which consists of over a dozen sport  verticals and hundreds of streaming partners. FloSports is creating the home for college  conferences/leagues and sports like grappling, hockey, track & field, racing, cheer, wrestling,  and more, and we are looking for innovative and passionate people like you to help us! 



THE ROLE: 

FloSports is looking for a Content Creator to support FloElite, our destination for CrossFit and functional fitness competition.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who deeply understands the CrossFit community and knows how to turn live competitions, athletes and storylines into compelling social content that grows our audience and drives fans to watch on FloElite.

You’ll be the primary person responsible for FloElite’s social presence, including ideating, creating and publishing content around live events and maintaining an active, relevant presence between competitions. Because FloElite’s live event calendar is more concentrated than some of our other sports, this role requires someone who can find creative ways to keep the audience engaged even when there is not an event happening every weekend.



RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 - Own the day-to-day content ideation and publishing for FloElite social channels

 - Build content plans around major CrossFit competitions, athletes and storylines with the goal of driving viewership and subscription signups

 - Identify compelling narratives before live events and develop content that gives fans a reason to watch

 - Cover live events in real time by identifying key moments, clipping competition footage and publishing social content throughout the event

 - Work with additional FloSports support when needed during larger live events

 - Maximize FloElite’s live event assets by turning full-event replays into highlights, short-form clips, athlete-focused content, compilations and other formats that extend the life of each event

 - Maintain a consistent social presence between live events through athlete stories, competition storylines, evergreen content, archival footage, trends and other relevant CrossFit content

 - Look for creative ways to keep FloElite relevant and active during gaps in the live competition schedule

 - Help establish the athletes, rivalries and broader narratives that make FloElite events feel must-watch

 - Develop social-first concepts designed to reach both highly engaged CrossFit fans and broader fitness audiences

 - Travel to selected FloElite events to support on-site coverage and capture additional content

 - Create original video content when opportunities and resources allow

 - Coordinate with FloSports teams on event priorities, assets, marketing needs and broader promotional plans



KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:  

 - Deep knowledge of CrossFit, functional fitness competition, athletes, events and the broader community

 - Strong understanding of what CrossFit fans care about and which athletes, rivalries and storylines can drive interest

 - Experience creating social-first sports content, particularly short-form video and real-time event coverage

 - Ability to identify compelling moments from live competitions and quickly turn them into engaging social content

 - Strong instincts for building anticipation and narratives around live events

 - Experience independently managing social content from idea through publication

 - Strong video instincts and an understanding of what makes a clip, highlight or social moment perform

 - Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of a vertical’s social presence without a large supporting content team

 - Ability to stay creative and productive during periods when there are fewer live events

 - Comfortable working nights and weekends when live competitions require coverage

 - Willingness to travel for selected FloElite events

 - Video shooting and editing experience is a plus



BONUS:

This is a contract role designed for someone who can provide consistent weekly support across both live-event periods and the stretches between competitions. The workload will increase around major FloElite events, with the expectation that the contractor remains actively engaged in maintaining the brand’s social presence throughout the calendar.



OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY:

At FloSports, we are bonded by our passion for sports and our purpose to unite communities around experiences that finally give underserved sports the love they deserve. We recognize the need to build a company that seeks out, embraces, and celebrates our individual differences, ideas, and talent. FloSports is committed to the pursuit of a fair, equal and inclusive workplace where everyone is given the opportunity to grow to their fullest potential.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager Patient Marketing, Rare Disease
jobs.description:
Kyowa Kirin is a global specialty pharmaceutical company backed by more than 70 years of breakthrough life science innovation, dedicated to discovering and advancing treatments for diseases in which unmet need is greatest. Based in Japan with worldwide operations, we work across the continuum from drug discovery to commercialization, guided by our commitment to patients and their families.

Our research teams, located in California and around the world, are focused on developing the next generation of antibody, cell, and gene therapies, with particular emphasis on bone and mineral disorders, hemato-oncology, and rare diseases. We accelerate development through collaborations with industry, academia, patients, and healthcare providers, and since 2018 we have introduced four new therapies serving patients with progressive illnesses often in need of new therapeutic alternatives.

Our culture is grounded in our values: Commitment to Life, Integrity, Innovation, and Teamwork/Wa, and brought to life through the Kabegoe Principles, which define the behaviors and actions that guide how we work together to deliver meaningful impact for patients.

We’re proud of the progress we’ve made and mindful of the countless individuals still waiting for their own breakthroughs. A commitment to making people smile unites our efforts. Learn more at www.kkna.kyowakirin.com.

Summary of Job:

The Senior Product Manager, Patient Marketing, Rare Disease is responsible for developing promotional programs and materials for both Patient Marketing and Patient Services within the current US Crysvita indications, X-Linked Hypophosphatemia and Tumor Induced Osteomalacia. The Senior Product Manager, Patient Marketing, Rare Disease will be responsible for managing execution of the patient speaker ambassador program, serving as liaison with the Digital Center of Excellence (COE) for Patient Marketing, and developing and managing the Social Strategy for the brand & disease state. The Senior Product Manager, Patient Marketing, Rare Disease will work collaboratively with cross functional matrix teams, managing external agencies and ensuring the alignment of stakeholders.

Essential Functions:

• Assists the Director, Patient Marketing in developing and implementing patient and caregiver marketing strategy and tactical planning for the XLH and TIO disease states.

• Leads the development of Patient Marketing unbranded and branded program design and support materials aligned to the XLH and TIO patient journey.

• Leads the patient ambassador speaker program including planning, execution, program analysis/evaluation and recommendations for optimization.

• Collaborate with Patient Services to plan and develop patient programs and materials to assist in supporting patients.

• Along with the Director, liaison with the Digital COE to plan and execute creative assets for digital media channels and social media.

• Assists with managing the branded CRM program executed through Patient Services collaboration.

• Participates in primary and secondary market research developing actionable program measurement, patient insights and appropriate interventions.

• Ensures the implementation of tactical plans within associated budgets and project timelines.

• Ensures a productive and cost-effective relationship with external agencies and partners.

• Ensures consistent patient messaging is maintained across patient channels both online and offline.

• Ensures key promotional programs are managed effectively achieving KPIs on time and on budget.

• Responsible for the submission and review of promotional pieces to the Promotion Review Committee (PRC) and ensuring a smooth and compliant process.

• Ensures close collaboration with Patient Services and Patient Advocacy to identify and address key areas of need within the patient journey including addressing patient and caregiver barriers.

Job Requirements:

Education

Bachelor’s Degree, MBA a plus

Experience

• Minimum 4 years of pharmaceutical (preferably rare disease) patient marketing, consumer marketing or patient services marketing experience

• Experience in submitting and obtaining approvals with a Promotion Review Committee (PRC).

• Excellent social competencies and ability to work in a highly matrixed organization effectively and efficiently.

• Excellent communication skills and strong ability to build and cultivate relationships within internal and external networks.

• Strong operational skills and project/ timeline management capabilities

• Detail-oriented and excellent follow-through.

Technical Skills

Proficient in MS Office Suite and Veeva Submissions

Physical Demands: Normal office environment with prolonged sitting and extensive computer work. Ability to lift, carry and otherwise move up to 25 pounds

Working Conditions: Requires up to 10% domestic travel. Remote position with occasional on-site meetings.

jobs.title: Photonic Circuit Design and Simulation Engineer
jobs.description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real.

Job Summary:

The Circuits team works at the interface of system architecture, photonic hardware development, and experimental characterization. We are looking for an engineer to model and optimize photonic circuits and components, with a focus on photonic switching networks and other linear-optics circuits. The role will also evaluate calibration procedures and help translate simulation results into design decisions for upcoming tapeouts.

Responsibilities:

• Model and simulate photonic circuits, including linear-optics circuits and switching networks.

• Analyze and optimize photonic components and subcircuits against performance, loss, and footprint requirements.

• Evaluate design trade-offs and compare circuit and component alternatives.

• Simulate calibration procedures and assess sensitivity to component variation.

• Develop or maintain Python tools for modeling, simulation, and analysis.

• Present findings and collaborate with design and test teams to inform circuit reviews and tapeout decisions.

Experience/Qualifications:

Essential

• Master’s degree, PhD, or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Applied Physics, or a related field.

• Experience with photonic circuit modeling or simulation.

• Python programming skills for technical modeling and analysis.

• Ability to connect component behavior to circuit-level performance and communicate results clearly.

Preferred

• Experience with linear-optics circuits, photonic switching networks, and integrated photonic components.

• Experience with component optimization, calibration simulation, or measured-data comparison.

• Familiarity with photonic layout or GDS workflows, Git, and collaborative software development.

• Familiarity with quantum computing, particularly photonic quantum information systems.
