jobs.title: Partner Success Manager, Education (Texas)
jobs.description:
At Yondr, we believe in the power of presence. Our mission is to create phone-free spaces that deepen human connection and elevate shared experiences. We partner with artists, educators, and visionaries to design environments that put people, not devices, at the center.



Yondr’s business segments span numerous industries, primarily across education and live events. Yondr supports schools through cell phone-free programs. Our education programs facilitate the successful implementation of phone-free school environments by providing administrators and teachers with education, training, and development resources, along with all necessary equipment. In addition, Yondr supports top artists in music and comedy by creating phone-free shows, allowing performers and audience members to enjoy live performances without the distraction of phones.



ROLE SUMMARY

The Partner Success Manager supports Yondr’s education partners from implementation through ongoing program success. As part of a regional pod, the Partner Success Manager collaborates closely with Education Account Executives throughout the sales process, providing implementation expertise during discovery and helping schools prepare for a successful launch. The Partner Success Manager owns the end-to-end onboarding and implementation process, ensuring a seamless transition from sales to program execution. Following launch, they serve as a trusted partner to schools, providing ongoing support, monitoring program performance, and leveraging data and partner feedback to drive continuous improvement and long-term program success.



KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. Implementation & Onboarding

 - Support new school accounts through the implementation process, including onboarding, product and program setup, training, and customization to meet their specific requirements.

 - Collaborate closely with Education Account Executives to seamlessly transition new partners from the sales phase to the implementation phase.

 - Oversee implementation specialists designated for your region or schools, ensuring seamless coordination and support throughout the implementation process.

2. Partner Relationships & Support

 - Sustain relationships with existing school accounts by initiating year-round communication that supports successful use of the Yondr program and aligns with partner goals.

 - Promptly address inquiries to foster positive interactions and build trust with education partners.

 - Promptly address and resolve issues that arise for new and existing partner accounts.

 - Communicate effectively with school administrators, teaching staff, and parent communities through engaging presentations and written and virtual communication.

3. School Programming & Partner Satisfaction

 - Drive exceptional partner satisfaction, measured through partner surveys, leading to strong reference partnerships.

4. Data, Reporting & Program Effectiveness

 - Maintain and update the CRM and other supporting systems with detailed records of outreach efforts and school performance KPIs.

 - Assess the effectiveness of the Yondr school program, using data to identify and address potential issues and opportunities for improvement.
   
   

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

 - Travel is based on partner demand and manager approval: 20-30% during non-peak seasons and 50-60% during peak seasons.



JOB LOCATION:

 - Remote postion, but this person must live within the assigned territory. Our preference is for this Partner Success Manager to be located in Dallas, Houston, or Austin areas.



YONDR BENEFITS

 - 100% paid medical coverage plan option for employees and access to 15+ plan types, including PPO, HMO and HDHP

 - Dental and vision and ancillary benefits such as short-term disability, long-term disability and life insurance

 - Generous PTO for rest and recharge throughout the year

 - 12 weeks of paid parental leave

 - 1 week paid holiday break at the end of December, for a company-wide closure + 11 additional nationally recognized holidays

 - 401(k) offering

 - Tech tool preference, including choice of PC or Mac.

 - Hybrid employees receive catered lunch twice a week.

Recruitment Fraud Notice: Yondr will never request payment during recruitment or onboarding. All recruiting emails from our team come from an @overyondr.com http://overyondr.com address. Please report any suspicious recruiting activity to support@overyondr.com.

Yondr is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in its hiring of employees based on race, religion, gender, or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Aviation Checkpoints
jobs.description:
The Sr. Program Manager, Aviation Checkpoint Programs, reports directly to the SDI Head of Program Management. The Sr. Program Manager has authority and responsibility within the SDI organization to establish and manage a program team made up of personnel from SDI functional organizations (Executive team, Sales, Contract Management, Technology – Engineering/Project and Product Management, Quality Assurance, ILS/Field Services, Operations/Manufacturing, and Finance/Accounting) to execute customer programs.

Responsibilities

Job duties to include but are not limited to;

• Performs as SDI primary day-to-day and overall Customer point of contact for execution of assigned Customer Aviation Checked Baggage contract(s). Performs as direct interface for Customer personnel relative to execution of new and existing contracts/orders and management of any customer issues.

• Leads internal matrixed program team to review/assess contract requirements, ensure complete contract compliance and on-time completion of all deliverables, and to coordinate and define program solutions as required.

• Coordinate with Customer stakeholders on all equipment deliveries and deliverable submittals, equipment/deliverable acceptances, field deployments, equipment problem resolution, task scheduling, new resource requirements, training needs, and task clarification, as required.

• Provide program control leadership to monitor contract technical, schedule and cost performance including risk identification and mitigation. Proactively communicates risk and mitigation plans to SDI internal and customer stakeholders. Escalates problem issues to SDI stakeholder leadership if required to obtain resolution.

• Provide Customer with updated status of program performance and issues via contract deliverable reporting, Program Management Reviews (PMRs), weekly or requested meetings, and responding to Customer requests.

• Provide internal business performance tracking and reporting/forecasting for each assigned program including delivery status, contract issues, revenue, margin and cash flow, risks and opportunities, key actions/escalations to ensure business performance success.

• Work closely with Sales, Proposal Management, and other organizations to identify, pursue and win new and/or follow-on business opportunities in aviation passenger checkpoint market sector.

Education Requirements Required/Preferred

Engineering

Education Level

BS

Additional Qualifications

MBA or Masters of Engineering Management

Years of Experience

Recommended Minimum

10 Years

• A minimum of ten (10) years related experience in leading customer programs/projects on high technology equipment and/or service contracts. Experience in leading programs on Federal customer contracts a plus. Customer Sales experience a plus. Experience managing DHS TSA programs a plus.
• Experience in building, managing, and leading cross functional matrixed teams in a fast paced and challenging business environment.
• Strong customer relationship skills and customer focus required including ability to maintain high customer satisfaction while also ensuring all SDI company goals and objectives are met.
• Strong working knowledge of acquisition processes, proposal development, contract negotiations, and executing varied contract types
• Demonstrated strong team building and collaboration abilities with effective leadership for this level of responsibility.
• Must have effective communication, presentation, and analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Professional Experience: Combination of extensive professional experience, training and certification in Program Management required (PMP or equivalent)

Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Advanced program & program architecture; mastery of dependency mapping, critical path analysis and scenario planning
• Governance framework & program controls
• Lifecycle management
• PM software such as MS Project, Jira Align, Asana
• Compliance and regulatory controls

We offer…

Join us and we’ll help build your career, with excellent training and opportunities for career growth across the business, both locally and globally. You’ll experience an inclusive environment, with strong leadership and a focus on safety and wellbeing. You’ll also have the flexibility to choose from a wide range of benefits to suit your lifestyle, offering you and your family support from a health and wellbeing, financial and lifestyle perspective.

Join us and work for a world-leader, with the benefits and training to reward your dedication and skills. Be part of a team where we are making the world a safer place.

jobs.description:
Ingram Content Group (ICG) is hiring forklift Associates to start  with our Operations team in La Vergne, TN.

Want to join a key team that helps the world read?

At Ingram, the Operations team serves a key role within the organization.  We ensure that our distribution centers and warehouse facilities function at maximum efficiency.   Safety is a core value in our distribution environment.  We emphasize this through training, education and accident prevention programs.  Process Improvement is another core value, and through innovations such as voice and Radio Frequency (RF) technologies, as well as feedback from our associates, we work toward constant improvement.

The world is reading, and it is our goal to connect as many people as possible to the content they want in the simplest ways.  If you want to be part of a customer-centric team that strives for excellence, collaboration, innovation, we can’t wait to meet you!

What You Need:

• Certification as an equipment operator or qualified for certification.
• 1 year work experience in at least one previous job
• 6 months' work experience which included walking, standing, lifting/carrying, pushing/pulling, gripping/grasping, bending, squatting/kneeling, twisting/turning, climbing, crawling, reaching above shoulders, typing/keyboard.

What You'll Do:

• Operates forklift and uses a radio frequency scanner to perform stocking activities such as pull down or put away.
• Moves stock as assigned.
• Signs out forklift after completing a daily safety checklist.
• Reports any unsafe conditions to the supervisor.
• Stacks product physically onto and off of pallets repetitively throughout the designated shift.
• Loads and unloads trucks

Physical Requirements:

• Ability to walk and stand continuously during the assigned shift.
• Ability to pass physical examination that includes testing for satisfactory vision (distance, peripheral, and depth perception), hearing, and blood pressure/pulse exams for safe operation of motorized equipment.
• Ability to escalate up to 25 feet in height on equipment.
• Ability to lift/carry in full range of motion up to 70lbs during the assigned shift – 30lbs or less continuously, 50lbs frequently, and 70lbs occasionally.
• Ability to push/pull in a warehouse environment up to 130lbs force to push during the assigned shift – 1-50lbs continuously, 51-70lbs occasionally, and 71-130lbs as needed for battery changes.
• Ability to grip/grasp continuously during the assigned shift.
• Ability to bend, squat/kneel, twist/turn, climb, crawl, reach above shoulder, and type/keyboard frequently during the assigned shift.
• Ability to work designated shift including overtime as required, which could include time before or after the designated shift and/or weekends.
• Exposure to wide range of temperatures
• Ability to successfully complete forklift certification process
• Reading comprehension skills up to high school level
• Writing skills up to high school level
• Math skills – basic arithmetic, addition, subtraction
• Attention to detail.
• Ability to work safely and adhere to safety guidelines in a warehouse environment.
• Ability to perform repetitive manual tasks.
• Ability to work independently or in a group environment.
• Ability to be flexible/ multi-task based on workflow demands.
• Ability to meet and maintain production standards.
• Ability to maintain reasonably reliable attendance.
• Ability to read, write, speak, hear, see, think, communicate, concentrate, learn, and work.

Why You Should Apply

• Pay starting at $19.50/hr with a $2.50 shift differential
• Benefits start on DAY ONE - Medical/Prescription Drug plans, HSA, Vision, Dental and Health Care FSA
• PTO & sick days accrued annually + additional personal days
• Encouraged continued education with our tuition reimbursement program
• Excellent opportunities for growth & advancement
• Casual dress code

jobs.title: KIP Spring 2027 -  Ballot Measures Team Intern - Ballotpedia
jobs.description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!


About Ballotpedia
Ballotpedia is a mission-driven organization dedicated to providing Americans with accurate, relevant, and reliable information about politics, elections, and public policy. Our goal is to close the ballot information gap and help voters make informed decisions. We value innovation, humility, hunger, structure-first approaches, mission-driven mindsets, and the ability to understand the perspectives of others, and we are committed to continuously improving our offerings to better serve our audiences, readers, and candidates.
 
Role description
As an intern, you will go through a similar onboarding experience to full-time Ballotpedia employees. You will learn how to code the Ballotpedia website, be oriented to Ballotpedia’s style guide, learn about what we do to prevent and detect bias in our resources, and much more. Following orientation, you will join the Policy Team, working alongside full-time staff writers and researchers on Ballotpedia's public policy coverage.
 
As a Ballotpedia Policy Team intern, you may:
be embedded in our Content Department on the Policy Team and work directly with Policy Team staff members;
research and write about a variety of policy topics, covering key arguments, reform proposals, legislation, regulations, case law, state surveys, and more, depending upon your assignment;
assist our teams in news tracking, legislation tracking, and primary source monitoring;
conduct other detailed research projects;
participate in brainstorming sessions and planning meetings with experienced staff members;
assist with metrics and reporting on data collection
 
Environment
Ballotpedia interns will work remotely, as all Ballotpedia staff work remotely. To join Ballotpedia, you must have a well-functioning computer with Internet access. Ballotpedia uses Google Applications (Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive and more) to accomplish our goals. Some familiarity with Google Applications is helpful.
 
To Apply
Please provide the following in PDF format:
résumé
cover letter, including the contact information for two professional references
neutral writing sample (under five pages) 
Note: please include this in the same file as your résumé and cover letter
Please ensure that either your resume or your cover letter includes your current address.
Applications that do not include a current address will not be accepted.

jobs.title: Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
About Stitch Fix, Inc.

Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) Stitch Fix is redefining retail by combining human creativity with advanced data science and Generative AI. As we build the future of personalized shopping, we’re equally committed to building yours.  We believe in investing in our team as much as our technology. Join us to be a trendsetter in the industry and help us redefine what’s possible for our clients, while we help you reach your full potential.

About the Role

As a Strategy Manager at Stitch Fix, you will play an important role in supporting how we communicate our business performance, strategic priorities, and long-term vision to our Board of Directors and executive leadership team. Reporting to the Head of Strategy & Transformation, you will help develop Board materials, executive presentations, and strategic business reviews, translating complex business information into clear, compelling narratives that support informed decision-making.

You’ll partner closely with leaders across Finance, Technology, Marketing, Merchandising, Operations, and Client Services to gather insights, analyze performance, and ensure executive materials accurately reflect company priorities. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical thinking, exceptional communication skills, and attention to detail with an interest in corporate strategy and executive-level decision-making. You will get a front row seat into executive operating rhythms and decision-making.

Responsibilities

• Support Board of Directors preparation, including developing presentations, coordinating content across stakeholders, synthesizing business updates, and ensuring materials clearly communicate company performance, strategic priorities, risks, and opportunities.

• Develop executive-ready presentations and strategic narratives that translate complex financial, operational, and business information into clear, concise insights for senior leadership and Board discussions.

• Partner cross-functionally with Finance and business leaders to gather, validate, and synthesize information, maintain consistency in reporting, and deliver accurate, high-quality materials within established timelines.

• Conduct strategic analysis and research to support corporate planning, executive discussions, and high-priority initiatives, including evaluating business performance, competitive trends, and opportunities for improvement.

• Manage assigned projects and deliverables independently, demonstrating strong organization, attention to detail, and accountability while collaborating with senior stakeholders to meet critical deadlines.

How AI and Tools Show Up in Your Day-to-Day Work

• Leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT for Work, Gemini, and emerging technologies to accelerate research, synthesize information, structure presentations, and improve the efficiency and quality of strategic work.

• Use presentation, reporting, and analytics tools to develop polished, data-driven materials for executive leadership and Board discussions.

• Identify opportunities to streamline Board preparation, business reporting, and strategic planning through AI-enabled workflows and improved processes.

About You

This is what you’ll need to succeed in this role from day 1.

Requirements

• 4–6+ years of experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, strategic finance, business operations, investor relations, or a related analytical or strategic function.

• Experience developing executive presentations, business reviews, or strategic communications for senior leadership, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, actionable insights.

• Strong presentation development and storytelling skills, including proficiency in Google Suite and the ability to create polished, executive-ready materials.

• Solid business and financial acumen, with experience analyzing financial results, operational KPIs, and business performance trends.

• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative information, identify key takeaways, and communicate the "so what."

• Experience collaborating across functions, gathering input from multiple stakeholders, and managing deliverables against competing priorities and deadlines.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to tailor information for executive audiences.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage projects while knowing when to escalate questions, risks, or decisions.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment while maintaining accuracy, discretion, and a collaborative mindset.

• Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and a willingness to leverage technologies such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar systems to improve the quality and efficiency of strategic work.

• This position may require the ability to sit for extended periods of time, use a computer or other office equipment, and communicate effectively (verbal and written).

Nice to Have

• Experience contributing to Board of Directors materials, executive leadership presentations, or investor relations communications.

• Experience in a publicly traded company or working with senior executives on business performance reporting and strategic initiatives.

• Background in management consulting, corporate strategy, strategic finance, or a similar function requiring strong analytical and presentation skills.

• Experience developing narratives that connect financial performance, operational results, and company strategy.

• Experience improving executive reporting, business review, or strategic planning processes.

• Exposure to retail, e-commerce, consumer technology, or other fast-paced, data-driven industries.

Why you'll love working at Stitch Fix...

• We are a group of bright, kind people who are motivated by challenge. We value integrity, innovation and trust. You’ll bring these characteristics to life in everything you do at Stitch Fix.

• We cultivate a community of diverse perspectives— all voices are heard and valued.

• We are an innovative company and leverage our strengths in fashion and tech to disrupt the future of retail.

• We win as a team, commit to our work, and celebrate grit together because we value strong relationships.

• We boldly create the future while keeping equity and sustainability at the center of all that we do.

• We are the owners of our work and are energized by solving problems through a growth mindset lens. We think broadly and creatively through every situation to create meaningful impact.

• We offer comprehensive compensation packages and inclusive health and wellness benefits.

Compensation and Benefits

This role will receive a competitive salary, benefits, and equity. The salary for US-based employees hired into this role will be aligned with the range below, which includes our three geographic areas. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, location, and performance. This position is eligible for an annual bonus, and new hire and ongoing grants of restricted stock units, depending on employee and company performance. In addition, the position is eligible for medical, dental, vision, and other benefits. Applicants should apply via our internal or external careers site.

Salary Range

$145,000—$180,000 USD

jobs.description:

Parse products are utilized in more than 3,000 laboratories worldwide and include Evercode™ Whole Transcriptome, Evercode™ TCR, Gene Capture, and associated software solutions.

Founded based on technology developed at the University of Washington, Parse operates a 34,000-square-foot headquarters and laboratory facility in Seattle’s South Lake Union district.

THE POSITION

The District Sales Manager, West, leads a team of Technical Sales Managers (TSMs), Account Executives (AEs) and Sales Development Representatives (SDRs). Parse offers the most scalable and flexible single cell sequencing solution on the market, and researchers want guidance on how to use it to speed up biological discovery. You will hire, coach and guide your team to meet and exceed role-based sales targets. Your main focus will be team performance and development, with an emphasis on growing revenue and winning new business.

Co-travel with your team is required and is central to building a world-class sales team. You will also partner with leadership, provide accurate forecasts and communicate sales needs. Candidates should have strong technical sales skills, the ability to build and manage customer relationships, and a drive to overachieve. A deep understanding of Parse's products and market will be critical to success.

TERRITORY AND TRAVEL

The West district covers the western and central U.S., the Mid South (CO, KS, MO, AR, KY, TN, MS, AL) and Canada. The role requires about 50% travel, including some travel to Canada.

IN THIS POSITION, YOU WILL

• Manage the activities of TSMs, AEs and SDRs to meet and overachieve role-based sales targets across the district (~9+ direct reports)

• Keep employee satisfaction high and develop team members to their full potential

• Provide technical and sales coaching as needed, including regular field co-travel with each team member

• Be a leader: motivate, coach and advocate for your team

• Partner with global managers, Field Application Scientists and Marketing to build a cross-functional team that exceeds customer expectations

• Prioritize coverage and resources across the district's established hubs and emerging markets, including Canada, to make the most of territory potential

• Actively drive process improvement

• Partner with the VP of Sales and global counterparts on growth strategies

• Share successes with global counterparts

• Evaluate employee performance and give regular feedback

• Work with each functional group on strategies and tactics for role-specific goals

• Set up procedures to monitor results against goals

• Keep CRM records and KPI reports current and provide weekly forecasts

FOR THIS POSITION, WE LOOK FOR

• Bachelor's degree in biology, genomics or a related field; a Master's or PhD is a plus

• 5+ years of relevant RUO sales experience in Next Generation Sequencing, genomics and/or single cell analysis

• At least 2 years directly managing a sales team, with accountability for team quotas and performance

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Residence within the territory, ideally near a major life science hub or a major airport

• Ability and willingness to travel about 50% of the time, including to Canada (a valid passport is required)

jobs.title: Flagship Pioneering: Formulations Research Associate Co-Op
jobs.description:
This position is open exclusively to current Northeastern University Co-Op students.

Work Period: January 2027 to June 2027. This is a full - time, 40 hours per week position with 5 days in office.

About the Company

Our start-up is building a novel chemical discovery platform to reshape how we develop formulations at the molecular level. By combining artificial intelligence with a cutting-edge laboratory discovery pipeline, our interdisciplinary team will chart an unexplored chemical landscape, enabling breakthroughs in drug delivery, agrichemical formulation, and safe, high-performance industrial chemicals.

About Flagship Pioneering

Pioneering Medicines was founded by Flagship Pioneering's venture creation engine that invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health or sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $90 billion in aggregate value. Many of the company’s Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program

Welcome to Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program for the cohort dreaming big and taking courageous leaps. You'll join fellow peers across our ecosystem of companies and learning firsthand how we build first-in-category companies. You’ll have access to enrichment sessions, a dedicated professional development track, and a mentor that help guide you toward your next step. By the end, you will carry on a meaningful project outcome, a genuine network, and a front-row view of how Flagship pioneer new ventures that change the world.

Role Summary

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented undergraduate co-op to join our formulation discovery team for a 6-month rotation. This role will provide hands-on experience in the physicochemical characterization of small molecule formulations, supporting our laboratory pipeline and generating high-quality experimental data. The co-op will work closely with formulation scientists and contribute directly to the platform's data generation workflows. This is an excellent opportunity for a student with a strong interest in formulation science, analytical chemistry, or pharmaceutical sciences to gain experience in a fast-paced startup environment.

Key Responsibilities

Physicochemical characterization

• Measure and record physicochemical properties of small molecule formulations including particle size (DLS), zeta potential, UV-Vis absorbance, optical density, viscosity, and density.

• Prepare formulation samples and standards with care and reproducibility.

• Perform excipient and solubility screening across varied formulation conditions.

• Maintain rigorous experimental records with strict sample labeling and traceability throughout all workflows.

• Log data and experimental details accurately in an electronic lab notebook (ELN) and relevant databases.

• Support high-throughput experimental pipelines by executing characterization workflows with consistency and accuracy.

Laboratory support

• Support formulation scientists in day-to-day experimental workflows.

• Assist with general lab management tasks.

• Follow established SOPs and flag any procedural gaps to the supervising scientist.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment.

Qualifications

Required

• Currently enrolled in a BS program in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, or a related field.

• Completion of coursework in organic chemistry, physical chemistry, or analytical chemistry.

• Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and a methodical approach to experimental work.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary team environment.

Preferred

• Prior laboratory experience in an academic or industry setting.

• Familiarity with analytical instrumentation (spectroscopy, particle sizing, or similar).

• Familiarity with differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) or other thermal analysis techniques.

• Experience with pipetting, sample preparation, or basic formulation techniques.

• Coursework or interest in formulation science, colloid chemistry, or drug delivery.

What We Offer

• Build alongside founders. You’ll work inside the same hypothesis-driven process Flagship uses to conceive and launch first-in-category companies.

• This can be the start of a longer story. Strong co-ops are considered for future opportunities across Flagship and its portfolio companies, not just for this one role.

• Work alongside people who left the safe path. Your colleagues are scientists, engineers, and operators who chose to build something new rather than join something already established.

• Take on real ownership. You're contributing to ventures that are still being defined. Your work can shape real decisions, not just support them.

• Be paid like the contributor you are. Compensation reflects the real work you take on.

Equal Opportunity Statement: Flagship Pioneering is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Compensation: The pay range for this role is $25 - $35 per hour. This role is a short-term engagement that is not eligible for health and welfare benefits. Retirement benefits may be available after completing a set number of hours. Compensation and benefits information is based on Flagship Pioneering's good faith estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future.

Privacy Notice for Applicants: When you apply for a role at Flagship Pioneering, we collect and use personal information you provide (such as your name, contact details, work history, and application materials) to evaluate your application, communicate with you, and comply with legal obligations. Your application data is processed through Greenhouse, our applicant tracking system, and may also be reviewed using AI-assisted screening tools. We do not sell your personal information. California residents have rights under the CCPA/CPRA including to know, delete, and opt out of the sharing of their personal information. jobs.title: KIP Spring 2027 -  Law Team Intern - Ballotpedia
jobs.description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!


About Ballotpedia
Ballotpedia is a mission-driven organization dedicated to providing Americans with accurate, relevant, and reliable information about politics, elections, and public policy. Our goal is to close the ballot information gap and help voters make informed decisions. We value innovation, humility, hunger, structure-first approaches, mission-driven mindsets, and the ability to understand the perspectives of others, and we are committed to continuously improving our offerings to better serve our audiences, readers, and candidates.
 
Role description
As an intern, you will go through a similar onboarding experience to full-time Ballotpedia employees. You will learn how to code the Ballotpedia website, be oriented to Ballotpedia’s style guide, learn about what we do to prevent and detect bias in our resources, and much more. Following orientation, you will join the Policy Team, working alongside full-time staff writers and researchers on Ballotpedia's public policy coverage.
 
As a Ballotpedia Policy Team intern, you may:
be embedded in our Content Department on the Policy Team and work directly with Policy Team staff members;
research and write about a variety of policy topics, covering key arguments, reform proposals, legislation, regulations, case law, state surveys, and more, depending upon your assignment;
assist our teams in news tracking, legislation tracking, and primary source monitoring;
conduct other detailed research projects;
participate in brainstorming sessions and planning meetings with experienced staff members;
assist with metrics and reporting on data collection
 
Environment
Ballotpedia interns will work remotely, as all Ballotpedia staff work remotely. To join Ballotpedia, you must have a well-functioning computer with Internet access. Ballotpedia uses Google Applications (Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive and more) to accomplish our goals. Some familiarity with Google Applications is helpful.
 
To Apply
Please provide the following in PDF format:
résumé
cover letter, including the contact information for two professional references
neutral writing sample (under five pages) 
Note: please include this in the same file as your résumé and cover letter
Please ensure that either your resume or your cover letter includes your current address.
Applications that do not include a current address will not be accepted.

Weinstein Properties is hiring its first Senior Director of Talent Acquisition to lead how we hire across our apartment communities and corporate teams. We’re a multifamily owner and operator, and our hiring needs are as varied as the people who keep our communities running. One day you might be helping the team find maintenance talent in a tight market. The next, you might be using Greenhouse data to show where great candidates are dropping out and what we can do about it.

You’ll report to our Chief Human Resources Officer and lead a dedicated group of recruiting professionals who are already finding better ways to hire. In this newly created role, you’ll build on their progress, test fresh ideas, and see what works across our communities and corporate offices.

What you’ll do

• Put Greenhouse data to work. Own recruiting reporting and use it to spot stalled searches, understand where candidates drop off, and give leaders clear recommendations they can act on. Connect hiring trends with early turnover to see where we can make better decisions.

• Make hiring work better for everyone. Partner with hiring managers to sharpen intake conversations, improve interviews, and keep candidates informed. Test new sourcing strategies and recruiting tools, then expand what delivers results.

jobs.title: Photonic Circuit Data Analysis Engineer
jobs.description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real.

This role will work closely with the Circuits and Test & Measurement teams, with additional coordination with downstream subassembly test teams.

But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Associate Recruiter

Why We Have This Role

At Qualtrics, we are redefining how organizations manage and improve customer, employee, product, and brand experiences. As we scale and capture new market opportunities, our Talent Acquisition team serves as the frontline catalyst for business execution.

We are seeking an Associate Recruiter who operates as a true talent advisor rather than an order taker. In this role, you will lead full-lifecycle recruitment across high-velocity Sales roles. We need an agile operator who can navigate market shifts, leverage modern recruitment technologies and AI-augmented workflows to accelerate pipeline development, and partner directly with recruiting leaders to acquire high-performing talent.

How You’ll Find Success

• Success in this role is measured by business outcomes, operational rigour, and consultative influence.

• Build Business Understanding: Learn the metrics that drive our business, translating team goals into clear talent requirements.

• Utilize Data & Insights: Track conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and talent market trends to keep hiring managers and recruiting leaders informed and aligned.

• Embrace Modern Efficiency: Continuously refine your workflow using automation and AI sourcing copilots to streamline tasks and focus on candidate engagement and evaluation.

• Build Strong Relationships: Establish trust with hiring managers and recruiting leaders through clear communication, responsiveness, and proactive updates on pipeline progress.

How You’ll Grow

• Annual performance development and feedback sessions for career growth

• Frequent Career Action Planning with Manager

• Internal Mobility opportunities

Things You’ll Do

• Full-Cycle Execution: Manage end-to-end recruitment across Sales functions, supporting requisitions from initial intake through structured interviews, offer coordination, and close.

• Talent Market Research: Assist with market mapping, talent pool research, and compensation benchmarking to keep hiring teams informed of external talent conditions.

• AI & Sourcing Execution: Utilize emerging AI tooling for market mapping, customized outreach campaigns, and candidate screening workflows to drive stronger response rates and reduce time-to-hire.

• Modern Sourcing & AI Fluency: You will deploy advanced talent discovery techniques—including AI-powered sourcing platforms, predictive market mapping, and programmatic outreach—to engage passive, tier-one talent faster and more efficiently.

• Conversion & Offer Architecture: You will act as the brand ambassador who articulates the Qualtrics equity, culture, and market trajectory, effectively closing competitive candidate pools in enterprise software.

• Agility Across Verticals: You will pivot across sales functions without sacrificing speed, quality, or candidate experience.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

• Experience: 1–3 years of recruiting or sourcing experience, ideally supporting Sales talent within SaaS, Cloud, or technology environments.

• Modern Sourcing Toolkit: Familiarity with talent identification tools (e.g., LinkedIn Recruiter, modern ATS like Greenhouse or Workday, and AI-enabled sourcing/outreach software).

• Passive Outreach Skills: Demonstrated ability to craft personalized outreach and engage passive candidates in competitive tech markets.

• Adaptability & Drive: Comfort operating in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities, balancing speed with attention to detail and candidate quality.

What You Should Know About This Team

• Supportive environment with opportunities to work both autonomously and collaboratively

• Fun, inviting, and inclusive team made up of passionate, kind, and smart people who exemplify what it means to be Customer Obsessed

• Continuous Improvement guides our path forward

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

• Catered lunch

• Culture - Incredible work environment - you can wear jeans and bring your dog to the office, anytime

• Quarterly team activities, winter and summer parties, and lots of Qualtrics swag

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid

Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:Family & Medical Leave Act, Equal Opportunity Employment, Employee Polygraph Protection Act

Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.

Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics - upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. jobs.description:
Who is Trace3?

Trace3 is a leading Transformative IT Authority, providing unique technology solutions and consulting services to our clients. Ready to discover the possibilities that live in technology?

Come Join Us!

Street-Smart - Thriving in Dynamic Times

We are flexible and resilient in a fast-changing environment. We continuously innovate and drive constructive change while keeping a focus on the “big picture.” We exercise sound business judgment in making high-quality decisions in a timely and cost-effective manner. We get things done and drive results. We lead without a title, empowering others through a can-do attitude. We look forward to the goal, mentally mapping out every checkpoint on the pathway to success, and visualizing what the final destination looks and feels like.

We appreciate the individuality of the people around us.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Microsoft CSP Specialist supports the reliable delivery of Microsoft cloud operations across the customer lifecycle, including CSP quote preparation, onboarding and provisioning, renewal readiness, subscription and agreement maintenance, and recurring operational reporting. Supporting a portfolio of 300+ CSP customers, this role is measured on accuracy, responsiveness, cycle time, and data integrity.

This is a specialized cloud operations role that works from defined intake channels, documented runbooks, policies, and controls. The consultant partners closely with Sales and Sales Operations to translate validated requests into accurate quotes and service actions, and coordinates with Finance to support purchase-order validation, billing readiness, and accurate system records. Customer-facing communication remains with Sales and Customer Success, while this role identifies exceptions, documents findings, and routes issues to the appropriate owner for resolution.

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Service Delivery

• Prepare Microsoft CSP vendor quotes from validated requests received through the CSP intake queue, in accordance with the CSP Quoting Policy.

• Validate product types, SKU eligibility, term and billing model, quantity, and pricing inputs before the quote is structured.

• Build and maintain standardized quoting templates within CPQ to improve accuracy and speed-to-quote.

• Deliver finalized vendor quotes internally to Sales and Sales Operations, who own customer presentation and communication.

• Flag non-standard requests — custom terms, month-to-month structures, mid-term changes, zero-dollar internal orders — for review rather than improvising a solution.

• Execute new-customer setup: reseller relationship links, GDAP and Partner Center role assignment, tenant validation, and Lighthouse/PEC configuration.

• Confirm a valid internal purchase order exists before any order is placed or tenant is provisioned.

• Create and maintain the corresponding agreement and configuration records in ConnectWise Manage and downstream systems.

• Verify provisioned products against the signed quote and the sales order before confirming activation.

• Complete the documented internal handoff to the Customer Success Manager after provisioning is verified.

Renewal Operations and Reporting

• Maintain a rolling 90-day forward-looking CSP renewal forecast with weekly completion, so Sales, Lifecycle, and Customer Success have consistent visibility into upcoming workload.

• Generate renewal tickets, environment data, and renewal reporting on the established milestone cadence (approximately 90 / 60 / 45 / 30 / 7 days).

• Produce renewal quotes to meet the 45-day delivery expectation, including multi-SKU and multi-line bundled renewals that require additional preparation and revision handling.

• Process approved renewals, validate the PO, and align the resulting agreement records.

• Escalate at-risk, silent, or non-responsive renewals to the CSM and Sales on a defined trigger rather than absorbing the risk in Operations.

Systems and Billing Operations

• Ensure all required CSP subscription, agreement, and customer data in ConnectWise Manage is accurate, complete, and current.

• Maintain consistent records across ConnectWise Manage, Microsoft Partner Center, the distributor portal, and NetSuite.

• Identify and correct data-hygiene issues that create downstream renewal or reporting errors.

• Produce recurring operational reports and dashboard inputs on the defined schedule.

Process Improvement

• Work consistently from documented SOPs, controls, checklists, and handoff definitions; escalate when a documented process no longer matches reality.

• Maintain and improve SOPs, runbooks, and validation rules.

• Identify repetitive, rules-based tasks that are candidates for automation, and support the build and testing of Power Platform automations or AI agents that reduce manual effort.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Associate degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.

• 1–3 years of experience in cloud operations, licensing, order processing, sales support, finance operations, or data administration.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including sorting, filtering, basic formulas, and lookups.

• Strong written English and the ability to clearly document an issue, the actions taken, and the resulting status.

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to following documented processes, service levels, checklists, and controls.

• Ability to manage recurring deadlines, prioritize multiple work items, and escalate exceptions with complete supporting information.

• Availability for a predictable U.S. business-hours overlap window, with expanded overlap during renewal-deadline periods.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 1–3+ years in licensing operations, order management, sales operations, or channel/reseller operations.

• Experience executing a recurring, deadline-driven operational cycle against defined controls and SLAs.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, data cleansing, and validation of high-volume datasets.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently across time zones and manage competing deadlines.

• Direct experience with the Microsoft CSP program in an indirect/Tier 2 reseller model.

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Partner Center, distributor portals (for example Ingram Xvantage or Arrow ArrowSphere), ConnectWise Manage, CPQ, or NetSuite.

• Microsoft role-based certification or Applied Skills credential (for example MS-900 or AZ-900), or a willingness to earn one within the first year.

• Microsoft Titan Skilling Academy certification in the Security, Cloud & AI Platforms, or AI Business Solutions focus areas (or willingness to attain within the first three months).

• Exposure to Power Query, Power BI, Power Automate, or scripting used to automate data preparation and validation.

• Prior experience supporting a geographically distributed team across offshore and North American hours.

Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, skill set, performance, licensure and certification, and business needs. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ. Certain positions may also be eligible for variable incentive compensation, such as bonuses or commissions, that is not included in the base salary.

Estimated Pay Range

$65,000—$75,000 USD

The Perks

• Comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans for you and your dependents

• 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Match, 529 College Savings Plan, Health Savings Account, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability

• Competitive Compensation

• Training and development programs

• Major offices stocked with snacks and beverages

• Collaborative and cool culture

• Work-life balance and generous paid time off

Our Commitment

At the core of Trace3's DNA is our people. We are a diverse group of talented individuals who understand the importance of teamwork and demonstrating leadership, character, and passion in all that we do.

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to grow. We recognize that embracing diversity drives innovation, improves outcomes, fosters collaboration, boosts teammate satisfaction, and builds a more inclusive culture.

As an equal opportunity employer, Trace3 bases all employment decisions based on individual qualifications, merit, and business requirements. We do not engage in discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, age (40 or older), disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Any demographic information provided is strictly voluntary, kept confidential in accordance with Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) regulations, and will not be used in employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, or mentorship programs. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process or participate in an interview, please email recruiting@trace3.com.

***To all recruitment agencies: Trace3 does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Please do not forward resumes/CVs to our careers email addresses, Trace3 employees or any other company location. Trace3 is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.

jobs.title: Strategic Sourcing Manager - Modular
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Team

The Strategic Sourcing team builds and scales CoreWeave’s global supplier ecosystem to support rapid data center growth. The team works closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, Construction, and Sales to source owner-furnished, contractor-installed (OFCI) equipment and professional services competitively, reliably, and at scale across CoreWeave’s growing portfolio.

As the Strategic Sourcing Manager, you will own category strategy, supplier selection, and commercial execution for critical data center infrastructure and services. You will turn capital plans and demand signals into sourcing strategies that balance cost, risk, capacity, and speed. You will lead competitive sourcing events, manage supplier performance, and work across teams to make sure CoreWeave has the right partners to meet aggressive growth timelines.

This role requires up to about 30% travel to sites, suppliers, and industry events.

Key Responsibilities:

• Category Strategy: Develop and execute category strategies for assigned OFCI equipment and professional services, aligned with CoreWeave policies, standards, and long-term business objectives.

• Sourcing & Budget Planning: Turn capital plans and sales forecasts into rolling 12-month sourcing and budget plans, and give Development and Program teams accurate cost, schedule, and risk inputs.

• Commercial Execution: Lead RFPs, negotiations, and contract awards that secure commercial value, mitigate risk, and lock in performance commitments.

• Procurement & Delivery Oversight: Own procurement and delivery oversight for data center OFCI categories, including mechanical, electrical, and power generation. Keep each category aligned with design standards, project schedules, cost targets, and supplier performance expectations.

• Supplier Performance: Establish and track supplier KPIs (cost, delivery, quality, capacity, responsiveness), and lead supplier performance improvement initiatives and periodic business reviews.

• Supply Risk: Assess market conditions and develop contingency plans to reduce supply and capacity risk, working with stakeholders to assess business impacts.

• Construction Support: Source OFCI equipment and construction-related services on schedule for construction teams. Resolve technical or commercial sourcing issues with engineering and project teams.

• Design Standards: Make sure suppliers receive and execute against the latest design standards and specifications.

• Inventory & Redeployment: Track equipment inventory and recommend redeployment to avoid unnecessary capital spend.

• Logistics Services: Procure and manage logistics, storage, rigging, and transportation services as needed, and support receiving transactions and documentation for audit compliance.

• Process Excellence: Maintain sourcing documentation, business process flows, and training materials. Continuously improve sourcing processes for faster, higher-quality outcomes and lower total cost of ownership.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Finance, Operations, or Construction Management.

• 5+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, supply chain, or project delivery.

• Direct experience sourcing critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure or related services.

• Demonstrated experience leading sourcing initiatives, contract negotiations, and supplier management.

• Proven ability to develop long-range category strategies and manage complex stakeholder requirements.

• Experience in data center, industrial, or large-scale infrastructure environments.

• A valid driver’s license and the ability to travel up to about 30% to sites, suppliers, and industry events.

• Authorization to work without current or future sponsorship.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience supporting hyperscale or AI-focused data center deployments.

• Familiarity with ERP systems and digital procurement workflows.

• Experience operating in global or multi-region supply chains.

• Strong understanding of global supply markets and capacity constraints, and how procurement scales in hyper-growth environments.

• Systems thinking applied to complex, cross-functional challenges, turning technical and commercial requirements into sourcing strategies with predictable, measurable outcomes.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

• Be Curious at Your Core

• Act Like an Owner

• Empower Employees

• Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

• Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization’s growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $143,000 to $191,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave

• Company-paid Life Insurance

• Voluntary supplemental life insurance

• Short and long-term disability insurance

• Flexible Spending Account

• Health Savings Account

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

• Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health

• Family-Forming support provided by Carrot

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside

• 401(k) with a generous employer match

• Flexible PTO

• Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations

• A casual work environment

• A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Applicants

California Consumer Privacy Act

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. As part of the recruitment process, CoreWeave may request limited information reasonably necessary to assess applicable export-control requirements.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Control Plane
jobs.description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Cribl Stream unlocks the value of all machine data by giving users a new level of observability, intelligence, and control over real-time data. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help shape the systems that let customers operate Cribl Stream reliably and confidently at scale.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Stream Control Plane team,you will be a technical expert working alongside skilled engineers as part of a cross functional team that delivers highly reliable and scalable software to drive customer value and satisfaction. You’ll help set technical direction for the deployment, configuration, and orchestration of distributed nodes, improving the scalability, resilience, security, and operability of the platform.

This is a fully remote role, and Cribl is a remote-first company. Our culture embraces the diversity of team members across the globe.

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

• Design, build, and evolve the services and APIs that power reliable deployment, configuration, and orchestration of Cribl Stream’s distributed nodes at scale.

• Lead the technical approach for systems that must meet demanding availability, performance, scalability, and operational requirements, while balancing delivery speed and maintainability.

• Partner with engineers, product managers, and designers to turn product requirements into practical technical designs and high-quality implementations

• Stay hands-on: prototype, implement, review, test, and troubleshoot critical parts of the system, and help teams navigate complex technical problems.

• Raise the quality of engineering design and execution through thoughtful design reviews, code reviews, testing strategies, and reusable patterns.

• Improve the reliability and operability of production services through observability, capacity and performance improvements, incident learning, and automation.

• Mentor and coach engineers, helping strengthen technical judgment, ownership, and engineering practices across the team.

• Use AI-assisted tools and agentic workflows effectively in development, debugging, testing, and operational work, applying sound engineering judgment to their use.

• Help maintain and support our SaaS offerings, including participation in a 24x7 on-call rotation and occasional stand-by, on-call, or off-hours responsibilities as needed.

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

• Applicants must be able to comply with U.S. government security requirements for access to FedRAMP-authorized systems, which may include U.S. citizenship and US residence.

• BS in CS/EE with 7+ years of experience or MS with 4+ years

• Strong hands-on software development experience delivering production systems and customer-facing capabilities in cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

• Significant experience designing, building, and operating production APIs and services, such as REST or RPC interfaces.

• Strong coding experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript, or the ability to contribute effectively in a comparable modern programming ecosystem.

• Experience with production operations, including on-call participation, incident response, and using operational feedback to improve system resilience.

• Knowledge of or experience with data streaming and transformation, high-volume telemetry, logs, metrics, or observability systems.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics and build alignment in remote, distributed teams.

• A track record of ownership, sound technical judgment, and delivering durable outcomes in fast-paced, collaborative environments.

• Comfortable working in an AI-native, agentic engineering environment and using AI-assisted tools to improve productivity, code quality, and customer outcomes.

#LI-Remote

Bring Your Whole Self

jobs.title: Practice Administrator II (Multispecialty)
jobs.description:
The Practice Administrator II reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Practice Administrator II is responsible for planning, directing and monitoring operations in an intermediate ambulatory environment to achieve excellence in the delivery of patient care in the physician practice while creating an inspiring and rewarding environment for staff members. The Practice Administrator II is responsible for the financial and operational management and coordination of the overall activities, clinical services and programs for RMG Practices. The Practice Administrator II manages multiple sites or departments within RMG.

Responsibilities:

• Stays informed of current and emerging issues and trends for areas of accountability, NM organization and healthcare industry. Communicates and educates staff on requirements, changes, advances, opportunities, directions and projections for the future.
• Thinks and acts in ways that support NM’s mission, vision and values. Identifies opportunities for new business growth and development, expansion of current services, etc.
• Practices fiscal accountability. Encourages staff and team accountability by involving them in budget preparation, identifying ideas for increasing efficiency, cost savings, developing and growing the business and existing services.
• Measures and monitors budget and business development plans; provides ongoing updates to staff.
• Identifies staff's individual skills and interests; provides timely, positive, constructive feedback; addresses performance gaps as they occur with clear action plans and timelines for improvement.
• Supports ongoing learning and skill development for self and staff; provides coaching and mentoring; assigns stretch goals, cross-training and other opportunities for career development within CDH.
• Involves staff in planning and decision-making as appropriate. Holds staff accountable for follow-through and results.
• Facilitates change readiness and agility among staff and teams.
• Achieves departmental and organizational goals.

Required:

• Bachelor's degree. Equivalent experience may be accepted in lieu of formal education.
• Five (5) years management experience in a medical setting or related experience.
• Demonstrated success in medical office management.
• Demonstrates personal alignment with NM’s core values of integrity, excellence, patients first, and teamwork.
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to plan, organize, and direct the activities of others.

Preferred:

• Master’s degree.
• Certification in area of specialty or administration.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

About the Team

The Procurement Operations & MEP Delivery function sits at the center of CoreWeave’s owner-furnished, contractor-installed (OFCI) supply chain. The team makes sure critical mechanical, electrical, and power infrastructure is delivered safely, on time, and to specification across a rapidly scaling global data center portfolio. It works closely with Strategic Sourcing, PMO, Engineering, Finance, and site teams to drive execution excellence and manage risk across long-lead, high-value equipment.

As the Procurement Operations & MEP Delivery Manager, you will own end-to-end execution from purchase order issuance through equipment delivery, installation readiness, and after-sales support. You will be accountable for supplier performance, data integrity, and issue resolution across multi-million-dollar MEP assets. You will establish repeatable processes, enforce governance standards, and act as the operational first line of defense against schedule, cost, and quality risk. Success in this role requires strong supplier engagement, disciplined execution, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Supplier Management: Work with sourcing teams on supplier onboarding, qualification, and performance reviews. Lead supplier improvement initiatives and ensure adherence to CoreWeave’s standards.

• Risk Frameworks: Develop risk- and metrics-driven frameworks covering financial, commercial, reputational, and operational exposure.

• Procure-to-Delivery Oversight: Oversee execution from PO issuance through equipment delivery, keeping it aligned with schedule and budget. Maintain visibility on deliverables and provide executive reporting that enables rapid decision-making.

• Escalation Management: Manage post-contract escalations involving manufacturing, logistics, and installation readiness. Resolve daily operational roadblocks, such as shipping damage, missing components, or documentation gaps, without compromising project timelines.

• Master Data Management: Maintain the accuracy of the Procurement Tracking Matrix (PTM), making sure every PO, change order, and delivery date is reflected in real time in the ERP and project management systems.

• Digital Workflow Execution: Use AI-powered tools and automated dashboards to deliver weekly “At-Risk” reports to the PMO Manager that flag potential schedule slips before they affect the critical path.

• Performance Analytics: Track and report on MEP supplier KPIs, including On-Time Delivery (OTD) and First-Pass Quality upon site receipt.

• Standardization: Enforce use of the PMO Playbook across all project sites for a consistent approach to receipting, inspection (FAT/SAT), and warranty activation.

• Financial Alignment: Review and validate supplier milestone invoices against physical progress so Finance pays only for verified work and delivery.

• After-Sales Support: Support sites after delivery, making sure warranty, maintenance, and service obligations are met. Coordinate spare parts, service contracts, and supplier accountability for ongoing performance.

• Field-to-Procurement Feedback: Run feedback loops so lessons learned about equipment quality and shipping methods are built into future RFPs.

Qualifications:

• 7+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain, or operations supporting large-scale infrastructure, industrial, or data center projects.

• Demonstrated experience managing long-lead MEP equipment (e.g., generators, switchgear, chillers, transformers).

• Proven ability to build and manage procurement metrics, dashboards, and reporting systems.

• Strong track record of supplier performance management and risk mitigation.

• Experience working cross-functionally with sourcing, PMO, engineering, finance, and construction teams.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience operating in global or multi-region supply chains.

jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence.
