jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT CHILI PIPER

Chili Piper is a B2B SaaS company that helps GTM teams turn inbound leads into qualified meetings - instantly. Our Demand Conversion Platform makes it easier for buyers and sellers to connect fast, without the usual friction in the funnel.

We’re a fully remote, global team that loves building solutions that truly help our customers, moving fast, and having fun while creating something meaningful. We’re growing quickly and aiming big!


***Currently only considering candidates based in the US***

Enterprise Account Managers are the commercial lead for Chili Piper’s largest customers. You’ll own a book of enterprise accounts and the full revenue number that comes with it: renewals, upsell and cross-sell. You’ll work hand in hand with a dedicated Enterprise CSM and our Department of Customer Love team, so every customer has one joined-up team. Our goal is simple: turn complexity into clarity, and clarity into long-term growth.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Help marketing and revenue leaders bring AI into their website, martech stack and inbound flows to drive more pipeline.

 - Own retention and growth across your book, closing renewals well ahead of term with no surprises.

 - Identify and close expansion: new teams and new use cases.

 - Build a network of champions and map/activate route to power.

 - Win competitive flips by consolidating customers onto Chili Piper through multi-product, multi-year agreements.

 - Prove value with each customer’s baseline, milestones and ROI, through QBRs and AI roadmap reviews.

 - Spot risk early and act with a clear plan to mitigate any churn or contraction.
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in SaaS with real closing experience as an AM or AE.

 - A consistent record of beating a retention and expansion number on a large enterprise book.

 - Experience leading commercial conversations with the C-suite: pricing, multi-year terms and consolidation.

 - A track record of growing accounts through new use cases and products, not just renewing what’s there.

 - Experience working with or selling to marketing, sales or operations teams.

 - A strong grasp of the modern martech stack and how AI is changing websites and inbound.

 - Based in the US and working East Coast hours (ET).


YOU ARE

 - Commercial to your core. Every renewal is the start of the next deal.

 - A strategist, not a firefighter. You spot risk well in advance.

 - Politically sharp. You know the person with the title isn’t always the person with the power.

 - Steady under pressure. You can give an executive hard news and leave the relationship stronger.

 - All in on the team. To the customer, you and your CSM are one unit.


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Why you'll love being a part of our team:

Our team loves Chili Piper because we’re building the company of the future.  https://www.chilipiper.com/post/company-of-the-future

 - Work with an immensely talented global team

 - Work in a business that’s run fairly and transparently

 - Competitive pay based on market rate wherever you live

 - We lead by example--showing industry peers and leaders how to innovate, improve, and grow--while having fun

How we work:

 - Freedom and flexibility. We’re a 100% distributed team working from around the world, and we've been fully remote since 2016. Our team members can work from wherever they want in the world, as long as they show up on our weekly all hands meeting on Zoom.

 - Solve interesting problems. The software landscape has exploded. There are dozens of solutions for each problem. We want to be different. We come up with new angles on existing problems or invent better solutions to help companies with their sales and marketing. Then we turn these ideas into beautiful, smart software.

 - Autonomy and ownership. Working on a distributed team means you don’t have someone micromanaging you or looking over your shoulder to make sure you’re getting things done. We’re a team of do-ers who take full ownership for their results.

 - Be helpful. Our first value as a company is help. Help our customers be successful. Help our prospects get the right information and make the right decision whether or not it includes our products. Help our team members reach their full potential.

The perks:

 - Unlimited vacation (and we do mean it, and we do take it!)

 - Generous health, dental, and vision insurance

 - Any equipment/software/tech that you need to do your job

 - Annual professional development stipend of $2,000 USD

 - Equity - all Pipers receive stock options

 - Annual company retreat in epic locations (past trips: Paris, Morocco, Tulum, Iceland, Ibiza, India). Check out the video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=66XNNBqh37I from last year’s retreat in Tenerife.

jobs.title: Property Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
Job Opportunity: Maintenance Technician (Residential Property Maintenance) with Inclusive Housing Resources (IHR) in Fairfield, OH

Looking for stability, structure, and meaningful work? Have residential/property maintenance experience and a troubleshooting mindset? Known for being reliable and working independently? If you want a weekday role and don’t mind traveling between properties, apply today!

At Inclusive Housing Resources (IHR), our Maintenance Technicians keep our homes safe, functional, and well‑maintained for individuals with developmental disabilities. You’ll work a predictable weekday schedule, receive clear work orders, and have the support and tools needed to do the job right.

This role is a great fit for a reliable, self‑directed maintenance professional who values consistency, accountability, and long‑term employment—and who wants to join a mission‑driven team keeping safe, supportive homes running smoothly.

• Pay: $20-$30/hour (based on experience)

• Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:30am-3:30pm

• Support: paid training, company vehicle & tools, full benefits, purpose‑driven work

What You’ll Do

If that sounds like you, this is a hands‑on, independent field role supporting occupied residential properties.

• Complete daily work orders across multiple housing locations

• Perform repairs and maintenance in areas such as: Carpentry Plumbing Electrical Painting Appliances

• Troubleshoot issues efficiently and make quality repairs the first time

• Prioritize work orders and manage your time independently

• Maintain a professional and respectful presence when working in occupied homes

What We’re Looking For

• High School Diploma or GED

• 1+ years of hands‑on residential or building maintenance experience with consistent employment history

• Practical knowledge in two or more skilled trades

• Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to work independently

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform physical, hands‑on work

• Proven record of reliable attendance and completing work as scheduled

• Valid driver’s license (fewer than 6 points) and ability to pass a background check

This Role Is a Great Fit For Someone Who:

• Has held steady maintenance or trade roles and values long‑term employment

• Takes pride in finishing work right the first time

• Shows up consistently and manages time independently

• Wants a predictable weekday schedule and stable, mission‑driven career

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING 👨‍💻👩‍💻 🛰 🛰

You will be responsible for developing and integrating software Command & Control solutions for satellite vehicles as well as working with customer stakeholders to decompose mission requirements and engineer solutions with existing products. The successful candidate will have very strong software integration and debugging skills and deep experience in low level software integration with hardware (satellites or other!). You will bring or build expertise with C2 concepts and common industry standards and protocols such as CCSDS, CSP, CFDP, XTCE, and MIB. Your primary responsibility will be integrating new satellites and flight software into Quindar’s mission management platform and you will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to do this while supporting development and integration of solutions into Quindar’s broader product suite. Ultimately, you will contribute to Quindar’s mission of simplifying operations and allowing our customers to utilize their satellites like servers!

This is a hybrid role with 2-3 days in-office in Arvada, CO. We aim to maximize benefits of having in-person collaboration spaces while also working on a flexible schedule with a large amount of remote work!




TECH SKILLS:

 - Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java

 - Experience developing real-time embedded software and/or integrating hardware assets with mission management software

 - Preferred experience with satellite communication protocols such as CCSDS, CSP, CFDP, IP and data processing algorithms

 - Preferred understanding of standardized command and telemetry definitions such as XTCE and MIB or similar concepts from other industries

 - Understanding of encryption algorithms such as AES-256 GCM, AES-256 CFB, AES-256 ECB, NSA Type 1 PEGASUS, NSA Type 1 CARIBOU

 - Preferred experience with AWS services such as Lambda, ECS, EKS, CloudWatch, S3, EFS/EBS, EC2, and RDS

 - Familiarity with Git and GitHub or similar framework for version control

 - Preference for experience with open source software


SOFT SKILLS:

 - Deep technical analysis and troubleshooting skills

 - Highly adaptable; you will integrate a wide variety of missions into Quindar’s software and will need to find creative solutions to work through unknowns and unforeseen challenges quickly

 - A foresight for scalability and proliferation of c2

 - Independent self-starter; able to complete projects on time with minimal guidance

 - A high standard for software maintainability, quality, resilience, and performance

 - Strong cross-functional communication and ability to distill complex information for internal and customer-facing audiences


BACKGROUND QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field

 - 3+ years [professional] experience with satellite command and control systems or similarly complex hardware-software integration efforts

 - Ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

 - To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/ddtc_public/ddtc_public?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.



HIRING PROCESS

 - Introductory Call with People Ops (20 min)
   A member of our HR team will introduce you to the company and the role, learn more about your background and career goals, and answer your initial questions.

 - Hiring Manager Interview (30 min)
   The hiring manager will discuss your experience in greater detail and explore how your skills align with the needs of the role.

 - Panel Interview (45 min)
   You will meet with two prospective colleagues for a deeper conversation about your experience, technical knowledge, and approach to collaboration.

 - Technical Assessment (Offline)
   You will complete a capped take-home technical assessment designed to reflect the type of work you would encounter in the role.

 - Assessment Review
   We will review your submission with you and discuss your approach, decisions, and thought process.

 - Final Interview with the CEO (30 min)

   The hiring manager will request two professional references from within the past five years. These may be former managers or colleagues.

 - Offer
   The hiring manager will first share a verbal offer, followed by a formal written offer within 24 hours.

 - Hiring timeline
   We expect to extend offers to selected candidates in late September.
   


WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT QUINDAR

 - We take work life balance very seriously. We require employees to take 15 days off but provide unlimited PTO and follow most US federal government holidays.

 - Mental health is just as important as physical so we provide quarterly health & wellness benefits.

jobs.title: Talent Specialist - Customer and University
jobs.description:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a key member of the Talent team, you’ll play a hands-on role in attracting, sourcing, and hiring world-class talent to support our business as we scale globally. You’ll work closely with hiring managers to understand their team needs, anticipate upcoming roles, and manage end-to-end recruitment processes that ensure we bring in exceptional people who align with our mission and values.

Reporting to the Talent Manager, North America, you’ll own recruitment across our customer teams, an always-on, high-volume hiring space critical to Halter’s success. You’ll focus on building and maintaining strong pipelines of talent across Customer Support, Customer Onboarding, Fleet and University ensuring we consistently hire the best people to deliver an outstanding experience to our farmers and ranchers.

You’ll execute recruitment strategies, manage proactive talent pools, and deliver a world-class candidate experience that reflects the calibre of our product, our team, and our culture. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, enjoys partnering closely with teams across the business, and is energised by high-volume, high-impact hiring.

If you love pace, ownership, and building scalable recruitment processes, this is the role for you.

What Your Day Will Look Like:

 - Manage full-cycle recruitment for roles across regions and functions, from sourcing and screening to coordinating interviews, assessments and supporting offer processes.

 - Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines for current and future roles, proactively sourcing talent through multiple channels.

 - Work closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, team goals, and key success profiles.

 - Provide guidance on hiring processes and help managers run smooth, effective, and inclusive recruitment cycles.

 - Deliver an exceptional, consistent candidate experience at every stage of the process, reflecting our culture and values.

 - Ensure all communication and interactions contribute positively to our employer brand.

 - Maintain our ATS and recruitment workflows to keep the hiring process efficient and organized.

 - Track and share key metrics like time-to-fill, pipeline progress, and candidate feedback to help improve our approach over time.

 - Support initiatives around internal mobility, diversity, and employer branding.

 - Look for opportunities to improve recruitment processes and tools as we scale.

 - We’re a fast-moving growth company, so from time to time, other responsibilities will pop up and you’ll be part of making it all happen!

Who are we looking for?

 - Ideally you have experience working across high-volume recruitment.

 - Proven experience building and scaling high-performing teams across multiple region.

 - Strategic business partner who can zoom in and out: from exec-level reporting to day-to-day hiring excellence. Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, a true business partner to hiring teams.

 - Demonstrated success working in a fast-paced, high-volume hiring environment without compromising on the quality of talent we bring through the door.

 - High emotional intelligence with excellent communication skills; a proactive, solutions-focused self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and takes strong ownership and accountability.




OUR BENEFITS:

 - Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): Own a part of Halter and share in our growth and success

 - Unlimited PTO: Take time off when you need it—no accrual required, available from day one

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP) & paid wellness leave: Access confidential support through JustWorks plus 3 paid wellness days per year

 - Comprehensive health benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first day of the month after you join (with most premiums covered, including 100% of employee-only health premiums on select plans)

 - Personal growth fund: $750 USD per year to support learning, development, or personal growth goals

 - Parental leave: 16 weeks paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks paid leave for non-birthing parents

 - 401(k): 100% match on the first 3% contributed, plus 50% match on the next 2% (up to a 4% employer match), with immediate vesting

 - Onboarding travel to New Zealand: Fly to NZ for onboarding at Halter HQ in Auckland—meet the team, visit a test farm, and immerse yourself in all things Halter




OUR OFFICE FIRST APPROACH 

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.


JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

 - You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

 - This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. Role Overview

You’ll provide dedicated executive support to the CFO and designated Finance leaders. The core of the role is owning calendars and travel across offices and time zones, protecting time for priority decisions and making sure people have what they need before they walk into a room.

You’ll work with the Chief of Staff on the board and Finance operating calendars. You’ll own meeting and travel logistics, help prepare executive materials, and use sound judgment about what to resolve independently and what to escalate.

Responsibilities

• Own the CFO’s calendar and coordinate schedules for designated Finance leaders. Prioritize requests, protect preparation time, and resolve conflicts across time zones.

• Build and manage multi-leg domestic and international itineraries, including bookings, transfers, meeting logistics, and trip briefs. Handle disruptions and coordinate expense processing.

• Draft and edit routine correspondence, meeting briefs, presentations, and other executive materials. Coordinate inputs and track logistics and action items with the Chief of Staff.

• Support Finance recruiting by scheduling interviews and debriefs and coordinating changes with Recruiting and hiring managers.

Minimum Requirements

• 6+ years as an executive assistant supporting C-suite executives, with direct responsibility for complex calendars and executive travel.

• Evidence of staying organized and resolving priorities independently when schedules, travel, or sensitive requests change.

• Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to prepare polished executive materials and work with senior stakeholders.

• Strong working knowledge of Outlook, PowerPoint, and Excel. Sound judgment about confidentiality, access, and escalation.

Preferred Requirements

• Experience supporting a CFO or Finance leadership team, including board, investor, or audit meeting logistics.

• Experience in a fast-growing, multi-office technology, aerospace, or defense company.

• Familiarity with project management tools and senior-level recruiting coordination.

Why CHAOS?

jobs.description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic, creative, hands-on Senior Scientist II to join the Cell Culture Process Development group within PDS&T Biologics at the AbbVie Bioresearch Center in Worcester, MA.

Our group develops and scales the CHO cell culture processes that bring AbbVie’s therapeutic proteins from the clinic to commercial manufacturing. We support process development, technology transfer and commercial production, and we’re always pushing to make our processes more productive, more robust, and less costly. We value diverse perspectives, including scientists whose bioprocess experience comes from a wide range of cell-based systems. If you’re curious, rigorous, and excited to solve hard bioprocess problems, we’d like to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and characterize highly productive CHO cell culture processes suitable for cGMP biotherapeutic manufacturing within project timelines, including technology transfer and manufacturing support.
• Lead and execute development initiatives to reduce cost of goods (COGs) by improving platform processes and workflows, deepening scientific understanding, and applying new methods and technologies, including perfusion and Process Analytical Technology (PAT) tools.
• Design, execute, and analyze experiments using Design of Experiments (DOE) principles, and report data summary packages for multivariate analysis.
• Analyze data using modeling, machine learning and AI/LLM-based approaches.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Analytical Development, Cell Line Development, Discovery, Manufacturing and Quality.
• Communicate scientific data and concepts to internal and external audiences through reports, presentations and manuscripts. Author and review technical reports, protocols and other key documents.
• Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding code of conduct, safety, documentation and GMP compliance.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with a minimum of 12 years of experience, Master’s degree or equivalent with a minimum of 10 years, or PhD with 4 years, in chemical engineering, biochemical engineering, bioengineering, microbiology, cell biology or a related discipline.
• Hands-on experience with cell culture or fermentation processes.
• Proven ability to independently design experiments, troubleshoot technical issues and deliver high-quality scientific output.
• Strong understanding of bioprocess engineering and cell biology.
• Ability to lead a small team to deliver timely, high-quality data and processes.

You’ll join a high-impact, collaborative partnerships organization that works closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and our North America partnerships team to build differentiated joint offerings and go-to-market motions with top-tier partners across the AI and cloud ecosystem.

About the Role:

CoreWeave is seeking a Director, Business Development to support our growing Partner Ecosystem. You’ll join a high-impact, collaborative partnerships organization that works closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and our North America partnerships team to build differentiated joint offerings and go-to-market motions with top-tier partners across the AI and cloud ecosystem.

In this role, you will forge and lead strategic partnerships with leading infrastructure, cloud and ISV, with a strong focus on the Data & AI ecosystem. You’ll define joint strategies and integrations, drive co-sell motions, and build scalable programs that accelerate revenue and market expansion. You will work cross-functionally to design and execute quarterly business plans with partners and ensure our joint value proposition is clearly understood and adopted across partner GTM teams.

Key responsibilities

• Work with partners to develop new and innovative integrations and distribution models that drive revenue and expand the reach of CoreWeave solutions.

• Collaborate with Marketing to design and implement innovative partner marketing programs that support regional pipeline and revenue goals.

• Develop and execute quarterly business plans with partners, including goals, KPIs, and joint activities to ensure alignment and accountability.

• Nurture strong field engagement between CoreWeave teams and partner sales organizations to ensure active co-selling and opportunity sharing.

• Executive presence & GTM savvy: Top-notch presentation, negotiation, and business planning skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders.

• Collaborative operator: Demonstrated success in highly collaborative partnerships with GTM, Marketing, and Product teams, driving to shared outcomes.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

What We Offer

jobs.title: Maintenance Operations Specialist II
jobs.description:
Forge Your Future with Us:

At Forge Biologics, we believe in turning bold ideas into life-changing realities. Our mission is simple yet powerful: to enable access to life-changing gene therapies and help bring them from ideas into reality. We partner with scientists, physicians, biotech and pharma innovators, and patient communities — all united by one goal: improving lives. If you’re driven by purpose and excited to make a tangible impact, this is where your journey begins.

Our team works out of The Hearth, a state-of-the-art, 200,000-square-foot cGMP facility in Columbus, Ohio. Here, you won’t just watch innovation happen — you’ll be part of it. Whether you’re scaling AAV manufacturing, collaborating on cutting-edge therapies, or supporting complex technical projects, you’ll play a key role in bringing hope to patients with genetic diseases.

What sets Forge apart is our culture of H.O.P.E. We are hardworking, showing up each day with determination and grit. We are open, creating a space where ideas flow freely, and every voice is valued. We are purpose-driven, with every task directly tied to changing lives. And we are engaged, energized by the challenges we face and the milestones we achieve together.

At Forge, your growth matters. We’re committed to helping you expand your skills, take on new challenges, and develop your career through mentorship, hands-on learning, and opportunities for advancement. Our people are our greatest investment, and we’re proud to see team members grow with us.

If you’re ready to use your talent to help deliver hope to patients around the world, join us — and be part of something bigger than yourself.

About The Role:

The Maintenance Operations Specialist II supports the planning and scheduling of on-demand equipment maintenance, coordinating internal and external resources, materials, stakeholders, and vendor access through remediation. It also reviews documentation for GxP compliance and helps maintain equipment and utility systems in a reliable, GMP-compliant state to support timely development, production, and testing at the Hearth. This role manages the spare parts program, while driving cost control and continuous improvement efforts to streamline and forecast parts consumption. In collaboration with stakeholders across departments, the position helps evaluate and select service providers for maintenance, calibration, and emergent repairs.

Success in this role requires strong organization, time management, leadership, and collaborative interpersonal skills. It offers the opportunity to support Forge Biologics’ growth and the evolving field of gene therapy.

Responsibilities:

• Manages, coordinates, tracks, and reviews externally performed corrective maintenance for GMP and non-GMP assets.

• Leads contractors and vendors performing onsite maintenance. Escorts vendor/contractor to the job location. Ensures all work is completed in accordance with safety and quality compliant procedures.

• Reviews and approves completed work from the contractor/vendor, including record review and verification of documentation in accordance with GDP (Good Documentation Practice) standards.

• Uploads completed work and all applicable documentation into the Blue Mountain CMMS per defined standard work.

• Ensures equipment availability and readiness for maintenance by partnering with Asset Coordinator/BMRAM Administration and Asset Owners to coordinate equipment availability and staging status.

• Ensures spare parts and maintenance kits are available and onsite prior to the start of work.

• Manages the spare parts program (forecasting use, stocking parts, obtaining quotes, procuring items, and processing receipts, and accounting for consumption).

• Supports contractor management program and evaluates performance based upon completed work.

• Ensures equipment is returned to service in a GMP compliant readiness state to the asset owner.

• Supports Fixed Asset Accounting initiatives through routine auditing of Asset listings.

• Leverages ERP system to issue purchase orders in support of vendor services and parts acquisition in support of Facilities & Engineering activities.

• Supports CMMS Work order data entry and review process.

• Reviews vendor / contractor contracts / purchase orders for work deliverable alignment and accuracy.

• Manages the equipment ship out program (manages obtaining assets and shipping to vendor and schedule for return to the site). Maintains accuracy in the CMMS as it relates to the asset status.

• Builds effective partnerships with internal stakeholders to drive the business towards achieving company objectives.

• Exhibits professional behavior with both internal and external business associates that reflect positively on the company and is consistent with company policies and cultural values.

Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience managing equipment maintenance scheduling and contractor/vendor work, preferably in a regulated environment (GMP, FDA or similar).

• 3+ years of experience inventory management including research, sourcing, procurement, stocking, consumption while employing FIFO practices with LEAN methodologies.

• High school diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor's degree in a related field is preferred.

• Strong time management, planning, and organizational skills.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and compliance.

• Proven ability to work collaboratively across multiple departments in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to work the hours necessary to support production activities.

• Ability to work in loud noise environments and in Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

• Ability to work onsite in Grove City, Ohio, 5 days/week.

Preferred Skills:

• Knowledge of maintenance processes and general understanding of equipment being maintained by external services.

• Knowledge in managing a spare parts program/systems.

• Experience working in clean room conditions.

• Ability to interpret work orders, service contracts, and equipment maintenance documentation.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned.

Work Environment and Physical Demands

This position works in both a warehouse and typical office environment where the physical work demands will vary depending on the specific tasks and duties required of the job. The noise level in the work environment ranges from moderate to occasionally loud. Must be able to lift, carry, push, and/or pull objects weighing up to 35 lbs. Ability to frequently operate a computer, and communicate with others in person, over the phone, and via other devices. Must be able to move about the facility for moderate to extended periods of time. Ability to wear task dependent personal protective equipment as needed.

Forge Biologics, provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

We’ve Got You Covered:

At Forge Biologics, we believe our people deserve to be taken care of – in and out of the workplace. We’ve built a comprehensive compensation and benefits package designed to help you thrive, grow, and feel valued every step of the way:

Health from day one

• Health, dental and vision insurance start your first day – with 90% of premiums covered for you and your family.

Time to recharge

• A competitive paid time off plan – because rest fuels innovation.

• 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave so you can focus on family when it matters most.

Rewarding your impact

Your wellness, supported

Fuel for your workday

Grow with us

• Ongoing professional development resources, training, and mentorship programs to help you build your care and grow within Forge.

jobs.title: Content Lead, Customer Advocacy - Americas
jobs.description:
Hi, I’m Chris https://www.linkedin.com/in/cfrakes/, and I lead Corporate Communications at Ashby. My career has been far from linear: I started in sports journalism, moved into Comms consulting, went in-house at a major bank to do Corporate Strategy, transitioned to a startup to build out their Content function, and earlier this year I joined Ashby’s Content team. The throughline between these roles is storytelling; whether it’s triple-A players to watch out for, how to tell a comprehensive story to investors, or best ways to showcase customer love, it all boils down to finding the most compelling narrative.

What drew me to Ashby, in part, is the clarity of the product and audience. I was an Ashby customer for years as a hiring manager at Modern Treasury, so I saw firsthand how intentional this team is about building a product that makes hiring more effective, intuitive, and human.

While I’ve led a content and comms team before, the function will look a little different at Ashby. As I build out our mandate with our Head of Content, Anum, I’m trying to be thoughtful about scope, strategy, audience, and delivery. We’re a growing team with high standards, and those standards should carry into how we communicate about Ashby as a whole.

That brings me to this role, which I’ve owned since joining and am now evolving and “giving away the legos https://review.firstround.com/give-away-your-legos-and-other-commandments-for-scaling-startups/.” We have a working case study program and a customer base that loves talking about us, and a healthy bench of talent leaders and RecOps practitioners willing to share organic, unprompted love for Ashby. We have come a long way on customer stories, but we’re still only a fraction of the way to what they could become.

This role is about closing that gap by taking ownership of how our customers show up in the world. You’ll work across Marketing, Sales, and CS to scale our case study program, own enablement, and continuously improve the process of our customer content flywheel. In the near term, that means publishing a steady stream of written case studies; in the long term, you’ll define what a best-in-class in-depth customer story looks like at Ashby, from evaluation through implementation and beyond. Volume is important here, and so is depth, and the role is delivering on both.

This role reports to me. I’m looking for someone with editorial taste, and the kind of curiosity that digs deep on how our product solves real TA problems, and a personable demeanor that makes a busy talent leader happy to spend an hour on the phone with you. If that sounds like you, please apply!



What you’ll be responsible for in this role

Own Ashby’s customer storytelling strategy.

Building on a working case study program, you'll rethink our written stories and narratives with deeper operational detail that shows how great teams practice modern recruiting and the measurable, real-world impact of the product.

 - Interview customers and write stories yourself, building the kind of trust that gets talent leaders to share the specific, messy details that make a story useful.

 - Track how each story performs by channel and use what you learn to shape the next one.

 - Work with internal partners on a  plan for refreshing existing case studies and updating outdated ones.

 - Partner with Marketing to bring the strongest stories into key brand moments like Ashby One.

 - Work with our multimedia team on video and creative formats. You'll own the customer relationship and the story, and they'll own production, so the best customers end up in the most memorable formats.

You'll bring editorial taste and a deep read on the TA zeitgeist to make stories that feel unmistakably Ashby.

Collaborate with our Partnerships and CS teams to develop customer advocacy and reference programs.

They run strategic activation for our talent community, and you'll make sure the content and resources that show up in their in-person activations and engagement campaigns are sharp, clear, and genuinely useful to the founders and talent leaders in the room.

 - Establish clear systems for tracking advocacy contributions across content, product feedback, event participation, and references.

 - Build a reference process that protects customer time while giving Sales, Marketing, and Comms access to the strength of our user base.

 - Create meaningful ways to thank customers that stay objective and never cross ethical lines.

 - Work with Partnerships on joint customer stories, partner references, and co-marketing.

 - Partner with CS, Product, and RevOps so that insights and contributions flow back into the business.

Capture and amplify organic love from the community.

Each week, dozens of practitioners share unprompted stories about Ashby, our product, our sales cycle, our reliability, and our people. We capture some of it on our Ashby Wall of Love https://www.ashbyhq.com/customers#dan-mccarthy, but there's far more out there than we collect today.

 - Turn sentiment into assets people use, from testimonial moments to themed compilations to category education pieces.

 - Treat organic love as a sourcing channel, routing the best posts toward case studies, references, and employee content.

Your work will help prospects and the broader TA world see what our customers experience every day.

Help every team with customer story enablement.
You'll build the enablement structure that helps GTM teams tell customer stories with confidence, so one great conversation can become employee posts, sales references, and community moments.

 - Partner with Sales leadership to build customer stories into the Sales motion, matching stories to industries, regions, deal stages, etc.

 - Equip CSMs to share customer stories themselves on LinkedIn

 - Package every story into ready-to-use kits for employees, Sales, and CS.

 - Build feedback loops with Sales and CS to track which stories help win and keep customers, and where there are gaps in our customer stories

 - Measure across the program, including story pipeline, reference turnaround, organic mentions captured, employee participation, and influence on pipeline.

When this works, you'll be able to show how one great customer conversation turned into dozens of moments across the market.



You will probably love this role if…

 - You get more out of a great interview than a great byline. Much of the job is helping customers and employees sound like their best selves, and most of your best work will carry someone else’s name.

 - You like working across teams and getting things done through trust rather than authority, since CS, Sales, People, Partnerships, and Comms all touch this work.

 - You get real energy from customer stories, both the tactical workflow optimizations to the emotional transformation that comes with great hiring.

 - You see case studies not as artifacts, but as a strategic engine that shapes brand, community, and pipeline and you know how to develop case studies that both showcase the customer and hit on Ashby’s differentiation or market hesitation.

 - You have strong editorial taste and a knack for spotting the story inside the story.

 - You value nuance, ethics, and relationship-building. You never push a customer to say something that doesn’t feel natural or fair.

 - You’re as comfortable with operational rigor (tracking, tagging, measurement) as you are with creative storytelling and narrative craft.

 - You want to be part of a team that deeply believes content and community are the heart of modern GTM.


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF…

 - You only want 0 to 1 work. You’ll build new programs, but you’ll also run and improve a case study program and a reference process that already work.

 - You see advocates as a resource to extract from. This role depends on protecting customer time and never crossing ethical lines, even when Sales needs a reference by Friday.

 - You’re looking for a traditional case-study writer role focused on turning out assets on request.

 - You’re uncomfortable interviewing customers, synthesizing complex stories, or navigating sensitive feedback.

 - You’re not interested in learning the product deeply or building intuition about TA practitioners’ workflows, pressures, and culture.

 - You need AI to write your first draft. We believe AI has its uses, but at Ashby we believe people should drive the thinking, and the first draft is where most of the thinking happens.
   
   

Interview Plan

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together via project working sessions. Our interview process is:

 - 30-minute intro call (Recruiter Screen)

 - 45-minute interview with Chris Frakes (Hiring Manager)

 - 30-minute interview with Anum Hussain

 - A take home assignment reviewed by the hiring panel

 - A virtual on-site (1 hour) with
   
   - Rosalia Cefalu, Head of PMM
   
   - Hannah Small, Partnerships Team and Former Startup Sales AE

 - A 30-minute final round with our VP of Marketing, Harriet Johnston



Benefits

 - Competitive salary and equity.

 - Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.

 - 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

 - Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

 - Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

 - Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

 - $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

 - If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents with all premiums covered by us.
   
   

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

jobs.title: Rental Sales Agent (Palm Beach DJT Airport)
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by customer service and sales? At SIXT, you can truly showcase your strengths. You'll ensure customer satisfaction while advising on and up-selling our fleet of vehicles to meet the customer's needs and driving the rental experience at the airport branch. Everything you need to know about our vehicles, you'll learn with us. Benefit from flexible working hours and great development opportunities. Earn an hourly rate of $15 with the opportunity to earn uncapped bonuses, resulting in an average salary range from $60,000 up to $80,000 with unlimited earning potential.

YOURS TO OWN

• You are the first point of contact for our customers – friendly, professional and passionate about sales and service
• You pleasantly greet and guide all customers through the car rental process, building rapport and identifying needs from the first moment
• You prepare rental agreements and confidently upsell vehicle upgrades, protection packages, fuel options, and additional services to maximize every interaction
• You meet and exceed sales goals through successful upselling and cross-selling, motivated by performance-based earnings
• You handle customer inquiries with urgency and professionalism, always organized, service-oriented and with a smile

YOUR SKILLS MATTER

• You are a proven sales talent with upselling and closing experience, motivated by targets and direct customer contact
• You bring valuable experience from sectors such as retail sales, hospitality sales, banking, B2B, or car rental, with a service-oriented mindset and a track record of building customer relationships
• You possess excellent verbal communication skills and enjoy direct customer interaction
• You are comfortable working in a commission-driven environment and thrive under pressure
• You are willing to work various shifts, including nights, weekends and public holidays, with a flexible approach to working hours
• You have a valid US driver's license with a clean driving record and are authorized to work in the US without requiring sponsorship

WHAT WE OFFER

• Comprehensive Benefits Package Enjoy healthcare coverage (medical, dental, vision), life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and pet insurance, along with a 401k plan to secure your future
• Paid Time Off & Holidays Benefit from PTO, sick leave, and receive time and a half for working on public holidays
• Bonus Plan Take advantage of an uncapped commission and bonus plan – top performers are rewarded

jobs.description:

GoFundMe is the world’s most powerful community for good, dedicated to helping people help each other. You

• Detail-oriented, highly organized, and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

• Comfortable taking initiative and working independently in a fast-paced environment

• Interest in sales enablement, revenue operations, or go-to-market strategy is a plus.

• Exposure to cross-functional teams and strategic initiatives that impact the broader revenue organization

• Real-world experience using enablement tools and platforms

• Opportunities to build communication, project management, and content development skills

• Mentorship and guidance from experienced enablement professionals

jobs.title: Account Supervisor, Gaming and Emerging Tech PR
jobs.description:
ABOUT BERLINROSEN

BerlinRosen is part of Orchestra, a strategic communications and marketing company built for today’s complex and fragmented world. From decoding audiences to designing bold strategies, Orchestra integrates people, platforms, and stories that stick to help clients build lasting influence. The company offers programs that span from the highest level strategic business counsel through to tactical execution. Orchestra brings together 700+ people with experience across consumer and lifestyle, technology, nonprofit and philanthropy, real estate, sports, travel, hospitality, and more. Made up of leading firms BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. It also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communications professionals, and Versus Media Group, a strategy-first political media team. Learn more at www.orchestraco.com.

People of all backgrounds and abilities are strongly encouraged to apply. Orchestra is committed to building and maintaining a diverse staff, and recognizes that its continued success depends on hiring and retaining high-quality creative professionals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Opportunities for advancement exist, and we are committed to helping all staff develop and grow.

ABOUT THE DIGITECH TEAM

Our Gaming, Digital Entertainment and Emerging Tech division, known as the DigiTech team, is part of Orchestra and BerlinRosen's rapidly growing Tech & Innovation practice. We partner with leading brands and organizations across consumer technology, gaming, digital entertainment and emerging B2B technologies, helping them build awareness, launch products and shape conversations in fast-moving industries.

Our work spans three core areas: gaming and interactive entertainment, consumer technology and lifestyle products, and emerging and deep technology. We develop integrated communications strategies for both B2C and B2B clients, from established global brands to innovative startups, tailoring campaigns that drive meaningful media coverage, elevate brand visibility and support long-term business growth.

As our practice continues to expand, we're increasingly working at the intersection of consumer technology and emerging innovation, offering team members the opportunity to support a diverse portfolio of clients while developing expertise across multiple sectors.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Account Supervisor with a passion for gaming and emerging technologies to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in PR agency work, experience managing client accounts and a proven track record of securing meaningful media coverage across gaming and technology industries. They should be comfortable developing and executing creative PR strategies, managing multiple client priorities and building strong relationships with both clients and media.

This person will bring a proactive, hands-on approach to their work, balancing strategic thinking with strong execution and a willingness to roll up their sleeves. They will work closely with senior team members to support client growth, identify new opportunities and contribute to the continued success of our DigiTech practice.

This position offers exposure to product communications, executive visibility, new business opportunities and cross-functional collaboration across our Tech & Innovation practice.

ROLE LOCATION: This role can be based in our New York office on a hybrid schedule or can be fully remote.

ACCOUNTABILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

As an Account Supervisor, Gaming, you will:

• Manage PR campaigns for gaming clients, including video game launches and gaming-adjacent sectors such as game development technology, digital entertainment (anime, manga, streaming services), licensed IP products and gaming/tech accessories

• Support PR strategies for emerging tech clients in areas like AI, VR/XR and other innovative fields

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with top-tier journalists and media outlets, ensuring consistent, high-quality coverage for clients

• Personally secure media placements, working directly with reporters, editors and influencers in the gaming and tech space

• Work closely with clients to identify new opportunities for media coverage and thought leadership, continually positioning them as industry leaders

• Contribute to client strategy, providing recommendations on messaging, media opportunities and brand positioning in partnership with senior team members

• Lead day-to-day client communications, keeping projects on track, managing expectations and ensuring deliverables are completed to a high standard.

• Bring an entrepreneurial mindset to the role and showing enthusiasm for building and expanding client relationships and accounts

• Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members, helping support their development and the successful execution of client work.

• Collaborate with the team's lead to proactively drive business development, identifying and pursuing new opportunities in the gaming and emerging tech sectors to help grow and expand the department

• Coordinate multiple client priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail

Essential skills:

• Must have a minimum of 5+ years of PR agency experience in the gaming sector (non-negotiable)

• Must be passionate and interested in working on both gaming and tech accounts, demonstrating enthusiasm and expertise in both areas

• Must have a well-rounded PR expertise that goes beyond product launches, with experience in developing holistic PR strategies including thought leadership, corporate communications and reputation management

• Experience at a PR agency, with a proven track record of leading and managing client accounts effectively, is highly preferred

• A proven track record of securing top-tier media coverage through personal effort, not just team management

• Ability to develop and execute comprehensive PR plans, contribute creative campaign ideas, establish measurable KPIs and communicate results to clients

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for crafting compelling stories and pitches

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and clients simultaneously, with strong organizational skills

• Entrepreneurial spirit, with a track record of contributing to business development and department growth

• A proactive and solution-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to drive results and exceed client expectations

• Passion for emerging technologies and the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new industries and trends

• Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, with strong problem-solving skills and a positive attitude

• Knowledge and working experience in social media, influencer marketing and other integrated marketing areas is a plus

• Experience with media monitoring tools and analytics platforms to measure campaign success and make data-driven decisions

WORKING AT ORCHESTRA:

Salary range (commensurate with experience and skills): $85,000 - $115,000

We're part of Orchestra, the first communications company built for today’s media landscape. Since 2022, it’s acquired nine firms, including: BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. It also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communication professionals. Learn more at: www.orchestraco.com.

To ensure that applicants are matched with the job that best suits their qualifications and interests, information that you submit may be shared with our network agencies. By providing your information, you are consenting to allow us and our subsidiaries to keep your information on file and to contact you regarding job opportunities, recruitment events and other related updates.

jobs.title: Associate General Counsel, Commercial
jobs.description:
About Wing:

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

About the Role:

Wing is looking for an Associate General Counsel, Commercial to join our Legal team. This role is based remotely in the United States. As Associate General Counsel, Commercial, you will serve as a lead commercial strategist and senior legal advisor at the forefront of autonomous drone delivery. You will drive high-stakes enterprise commercial agreements, marketplace and delivery partnerships, and complex supply chain and hardware manufacturing transactions that power Wing's global scaling. In this role, you will partner closely with executive leadership, Business Development, Sourcing, Engineering, Product, and Finance to craft creative, pragmatic legal solutions, lead our CLM transformation from Simba to Accord, and establish standardized deal playbooks that accelerate business velocity while managing risk.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

Who We're Looking For

Deals are how the largest buyers and sellers on the open internet do business with each other at The Trade Desk. Buyers and sellers rely on deals to package, price, and enable unique targeting capabilities and commercial structures that are foundational to their business. We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to shape how deals are packaged, merchandised, discovered, and activated, and to make our supply integrations the easiest in the industry to build against.
This role sits where product, partnerships, and standards meet. You’ll build the experiences buyers use to discover inventory and act on it, including AI-based discovery and activation and integrations with buyer and seller agents. You’ll also support the supply integration partners who connect to us through our PDP API, and help steer how the industry adopts standards for supply and deal integration. You’ll work hand in hand with customer service, technical account management, Marketplace Quality, engineering, legal, and commercial teams to drive complex projects.
You combine technical depth with commercial judgment. You can talk through an API design with a partner’s engineers on Monday, explain a merchandising strategy to a commercial leader on Tuesday, and turn what you learn into a roadmap people outside your team will back.

What You'll Do

As a Staff Product Manager, you will set product direction for deal packaging, merchandising, and supply integration, and carry it from strategy through delivery and adoption. This is a senior individual contributor role with influence across the organization and across the industry.

• Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for deal packaging and merchandising, with explicit priorities, tradeoffs, and measures of success.

• Create best-in-class inventory discovery and deal merchandising experiences for buyers, so the right inventory is easy to find, understand, and buy.

• Lead product capabilities for AI-based discovery and activation, including how buyer and seller agents find, negotiate, and activate deals through TTD. Define what these workflows need from the platform and from partners.

• Support supply integration partners on our PDP API layer. Shape the API roadmap with engineering, help partners integrate successfully, and turn recurring partner issues into product improvements.

• Influence adoption of industry standards for supply integration, and deal integration in particular. Represent TTD’s point of view with partners and standards bodies, and bring what you learn back into the roadmap.

• Partner daily with customer service, technical account management, Marketplace Quality, engineering, legal, and commercial teams to drive growth in deal-based transactions. Bring customer and partner feedback into prioritization and close the loop after launch.

• Make dependencies and tradeoffs visible, build investment cases, and align directors and VPs around priorities. Drive decisions without formal authority.

• Use AI to move faster, applying AI tools across research, analysis, requirements, and delivery to raise the pace and quality bar of your PM work.

• Define and track success metrics, including deal adoption, discovery-to-activation conversion, partner integration health, and spend transacted through deals. Follow through when an investment falls short of expectations.

What You Bring to the Table

• 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in advertising technology or another marketplace or platform business, with a track record of launching complex, data-intensive products.

• Deep understanding of programmatic deal mechanics: how buyers and sellers discover, negotiate, and activate PMP, programmatic guaranteed, and other deal types, and how supply paths and integrations affect delivery.

• Strong technical fluency. You have worked on API products or partner integrations, can engage credibly with engineers on design and tradeoffs, and can reason through how changes affect partners downstream.

• Experience building discovery, curation, or merchandising experiences, and the product instincts to make a complex marketplace simple to navigate.

• Experience working with, or a clear point of view on, AI and agent-driven workflows in advertising, including how agents on the buy side and sell side will transact.

• Experience working across customer-facing, legal, commercial, and engineering teams, in a matrixed environment, to bring a product from concept to launch and adoption.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication. You write strong strategy and requirements documents and explain the business value of the work to technical teams, partners, and senior leaders.

• Comfort with data. You can use SQL and platform data to test assumptions and investigate issues without waiting on an analyst.

• Strong judgment and independent execution. You bring structure to ambiguous problems, prioritize across competing needs, and keep improving the product after launch.

• Hands-on AI experience: you have used AI tools to accelerate research, requirements, analysis, or delivery.

Nice to Have

• Experience on the sell side (SSP, exchange, or publisher platform) or in direct buyer-seller dealmaking.

• Experience participating in industry standards work, for example with IAB Tech Lab, or driving adoption of an industry specification with partners.

• Experience with Marketplace Quality, supply path optimization, or inventory curation.

• Experience migrating partners between integrations or product models.

jobs.title: Director, Incident Management & Prevention
jobs.description:
The Director, Fraud/Loss & Incident Management will lead the Global Controllership fraud and loss prevention program, end-to-end incident management for potential phishing and fraud events, and business continuity planning. This role is responsible for developing the analytics, controls, and operating processes needed to identify emerging risks, strengthen preventive measures, and support a proactive response to cyber and fraud threats impacting the Global Controllership environment. The Director will also coordinate communications across cross-functional stakeholders and senior leadership during active incidents.

The ideal candidate is a clear, independent, and analytical leader with strong curiosity about end-to-end processes, a controls-oriented mindset, and proven experience managing incidents from identification through resolution. They will be metrics-driven, comfortable interpreting data, and able to operate effectively in a fast-paced, customer-centric, and continuously evolving environment.

Here you can:

• Develop and implement strategies to identify, assess, and mitigate cyber-enabled fraud and financial loss risks across multiple teams, processes, and systems.
• Perform regular reviews and assessments of fraud prevention processes, identifying control gaps and driving continuous improvement.
• Provide training, guidance, and support to business teams to strengthen fraud awareness and reinforce preventive behaviors.
• Prepare and facilitate senior management report-outs for major Global Controllership incidents, including root-cause insights, operational and control gaps, and recommended remediation actions.
• Define and maintain metrics and reporting to monitor incident management activity, fraud and loss prevention trends, and management actions.
• Act as a key liaison between the business, Cyber, Legal, Treasury, and Global Controllership teams to support timely incident resolution and define short- and long-term mitigation actions.

Here you'll need:

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• 5+ years of experience in internal audit, fraud investigation, incident management, or a related risk and controls discipline.
• Exceptional understanding of financial fraud, cyber threats, adversary techniques, response procedures, threat detection, and cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST.
• Ability and willingness to work in a fast-paced, high-demand role that may require non-standard working hours during active incidents.
• Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, and escalation paths simultaneously.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Experience applying security, risk, and control concepts to financial processes.
• Knowledge of fintech developments and their implications for financial operations, fraud prevention, and control environments.
• Experience developing incident management processes and/or managing incidents through structured response and resolution frameworks.
• Ability to lead, influence, and communicate effectively in a collaborative team environment.

Desired Characteristics

• Self-starter with the ability to deliver consistently and independently with limited oversight.
• Solid stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to tailor approach and communication style to secure alignment and drive delivery.
• Proactive delivery mindset, with the ability to anticipate risks, remove barriers, and resolve conflict constructively.
• Experience working with international teams; Certified Fraud Examiner certification is a plus.

Mid-Level Aerospace Engineer provides Space and Missile Defense Center of Excellence (CoE) with professional engineering, technical and programmatic assistance to support efforts in development of a NCR-IADS MIC. • Requires the use of protective clothing appropriate to the work location (e.g., thick boots, hats).

The employee must occasionally lift or move tactical cases filled with sensitive equipment, up to 50 pounds.

• Employee must have a bachelor’s degree and 6 years of relevant experience.

• Familiar with communications and network support for NCR-IADS testing and training environment.

• Possess an in-depth knowledge on the NCR-IADS operational communications architecture.

• Deep understanding of Sentinel A3 radar and components unique to NCR-IADS.

• Familiar with Avenger weapon system.

• Must currently hold or be eligible to obtain a U.S. Secret security clearance. Per federal requirements, only U.S. citizens are eligible for this level of clearance.

jobs.description:

Graham Capital Management, L.P. (collectively with its affiliates, "Graham") is an alternative investment manager founded in 1994 by Kenneth G. Tropin. Specializing in discretionary and quantitative macro strategies, Graham is dedicated to delivering strong, uncorrelated returns across a wide range of market environments. As one of the industry’s longest-standing global macro and trend-following managers, Graham remains committed to innovation, evolving its strategies through a robust investment, technology, and operational infrastructure. Graham harnesses the synergies between its discretionary and quantitative trading businesses to offer a broad suite of complementary alpha strategies, each built on the principles of thoughtful portfolio construction, active risk management, and diversification by design. Graham invests significant proprietary capital alongside its clients – including global institutions, endowments, foundations, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, investment management advisors, and qualified individual investors – reinforcing alignment of interests across all strategies.

The foundation of Graham’s sustainability and success is the experience and contributions of its people. The firm seeks to cultivate talent, encourage the diversity of ideas, and respect the contributions of all. In turn, each employee shares in the responsibility of strengthening those around them.

Description

Graham is seeking a Portfolio Analyst to join our Portfolio Management team. The analyst will sit on the trading floor, working alongside a Global Macro PM in all aspects of trading and portfolio management. The ideal candidate possesses experience in trading, quantitative analysis, and fundamental research; exposure to fixed income, FX, macroeconomics, or equities is a plus. The candidate will be able to grow into an assistant PM role with time.

Responsibilities

• Assist Portfolio Manager with market research and trade idea generation

• Proficient in Bloomberg, and working with data in Microsoft Excel

• Strong problem solving and analytical skills

This role requires commuting into our New York City office Mondays through Fridays.

Base Salary Range

The applicable annual salary or hourly rate paid to a successful applicant will be determined based on multiple factors, including without limitation the nature and extent of prior experience, skills, and qualifications.  This wage range may be modified in the future.

In addition, the employee who fills this role will be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, as well as a wide array of benefit programs, such as medical and life insurance, 401(K) plans, and access to other healthcare programs.

No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. Other

 - Participate and lead meetings with clients

 - Prepare proposals/presentations materials for client outbriefs as needed

 - Contribute to practice growth and development

 - Develop thought leadership on behalf of TELUS Digital
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS

 - 4+ years of consulting experience in financial modeling and business analysis for F500 clients

 - Experience advising F500 C-level and VP-level executives on major initiatives

 - Strong understanding of financial concepts and business principles

 - Extensive experience with Excel and financial modeling software

 - Adept storyteller with the ability to deliver compelling presentations to various (seniorities and/or disciplines) client audiences

BONUS POINTS:

About the Role

The Manager II, Clinical Studies provides strategic and operational leadership for assigned clinical studies from study planning and start-up through execution, database lock, closeout, and archival. The Manager II, Clinical Trials is accountable for the successful operational delivery of assigned studies, ensuring that timelines, budgets, quality standards, and key study objectives are achieved.

Working closely with Clinical Development, Clinical Science, Data Management, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Safety, Quality Assurance, Clinical Supply, and other functions, the Sr. CSM ensures coordinated and compliant execution of clinical studies in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), company procedures, and study protocols.

Let’s talk about some of the key responsibilities of the role:

Clinical Study Leadership and Execution

• Lead the end-to-end operational planning, implementation, and execution of assigned clinical studies from feasibility and start-up through database lock, closeout, and archival.

• Support development of, and maintain, integrated study timelines, study management plans, operational strategies, risk assessments, decision logs, and study metrics.

• Drive achievement of study milestones and deliverables, including site activation, enrollment, data collection, monitoring, database lock, and study closeout.

• Monitor overall study performance and proactively identify risks related to timelines, enrollment, budget, quality, data, vendors, sites, and resources.

• Develop and implement mitigation and contingency plans to address study risks and operational challenges.

• Lead resolution of complex study issues and escalate significant risks or decisions to Clinical Operations leadership and appropriate governance forums.

• Provide regular study status, risk, budget, and milestone updates to program and functional leadership.

CRO and Vendor Management

• Provide operational oversight of CROs, central laboratories, imaging vendors, technology providers, and other external service providers supporting assigned studies.

• Participate in CRO and vendor identification, evaluation, selection, contracting, and study start-up activities.

• Monitor CRO and vendor performance against contractual obligations, timelines, budgets, quality requirements, deliverables, and key performance indicators.

• Review study plans, metrics, monitoring reports, study documentation, invoices, forecasts, and change orders as appropriate.

• Escalate significant vendor performance concerns and oversee corrective and preventive actions through resolution.

Site Management and Study Oversight

• Provide leadership and oversight for site identification, qualification, selection, activation, enrollment, retention, monitoring, and closeout.

• Monitor site performance, enrollment, protocol compliance, data quality, and other key study metrics.

• Oversee site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, and closeout activities.

• Review monitoring reports and trends to identify systemic issues, risks, or areas requiring intervention.

• Conduct or support co-monitoring and other oversight activities, as needed, to assess study quality and monitoring effectiveness.

• Maintain effective relationships with investigative sites and facilitate resolution of operational, recruitment, and protocol-related issues.

• Provide leadership and escalation support to CRAs and study team members regarding site management and monitoring issues.

Regulatory Compliance, Quality and Inspection Readiness

• Oversight of TMF documentation to ensure inspection readiness

• Support internal audits, CRO/vendor audits, investigator-site audits, and regulatory inspections.

• Ensure protocol deviations, quality issues, and significant operational risks are appropriately documented, assessed, escalated, and resolved.

• Partner with Quality Assurance and other functions to oversee CAPAs and other corrective actions, as applicable.

• Identify documentation gaps and ensure corrective actions are implemented and tracked to completion.
