jobs.title: Content Producer, Telemundo T62 Filadelfia
jobs.description:
Job Overview

Telemundo62 is seeking a News Content Producer to primarily support Telemundo62’s Spanish-language newscasts and news platforms. The producer will manage local stories from the first verified update through the live newscast and the next day’s follow-up. The role will also work with the NBC10 and Telemundo62 newsroom to share coverage across broadcast, streaming, web, social media, and out-of-home platforms.

We’re looking for a producer who understands what the audience needs to know and can choose the best way to tell each story. The producer must keep coverage current as new information develops, whether that means posting a digital update, creating a map for a live segment, or planning the next follow-up.

Responsibilities

• Own assigned stories throughout the shift. Establish what is verified, why it matters locally, what is missing, and what the newsroom should pursue next. Coordinate updates and handoffs so coverage stays current across platforms.

• Make digital-first decisions in breaking news. Work with the assignment desk, digital team, and newsroom managers to get verified information to audiences quickly. Help determine whether a push alert, live stream, social update, broadcast cut-in, or fuller explainer best serves the audience.

• Line-produce live Spanish-language newscasts. Build and continuously update rundowns, write conversational scripts, edit video, and coordinate with anchors, reporters, directors, and the control room. Make sound editorial and timing decisions as news changes.

• Develop original, audience-focused coverage. Contribute and lead discussion on assigned stories in editorial meetings. Pitch same-day reporting, producer-driven segments, and follow-ups that show how a story affects communities across Philadelphia, its suburbs, South Jersey, and Delaware.

• Plan visuals and formats early. Identify the video, graphics, maps, interviews, data, or demonstrations that will make the story clearer. Work with newsroom partners to adapt coverage appropriately for each platform.

• Protect accuracy across platforms. Verify facts, translations, names, video, social claims, and graphics. Follow NBCUniversal News Group standards, identify uncertainty clearly, and coordinate prompt corrections or updates wherever the story appeared.

• Communicate and collaborate across the newsroom. Keep relevant teams informed of material editorial changes, production issues, and handoffs. Work effectively with Telemundo62 colleagues while maintaining the editorial ownership of assigned work.

Basic Qualifications

• Two to four years of news producing experience, including line-producing live newscasts.
• Fluency in speaking, reading, and writing Spanish, and the ability to speak, read, and understand English.
• Strong news judgment, broadcast writing, video editing, rundown-building, and organizational skills.
• Ability to communicate editorial decisions clearly, participate in and lead story discussions, and produce accurately under intense deadline pressure.

Additional Requirements

• Must submit a résumé or CV through NBCUniversal Careers to be considered.
• Must be willing to work in the Philadelphia area and travel as needed for special assignments.
• Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the United States, be at least 18 years old, and hold a valid driver’s license.
• Must be willing to join SAG AFTRA Union
• Required On-Site. This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

Desired Qualifications

• Deep engagement with the news. Consistently follows local, national, and international news throughout the day, brings timely story ideas to editorial discussions, and quickly recognizes developments that matter to Telemundo62’s Spanish-speaking audiences.
• Audience judgment. Uses audience questions, community feedback, and performance data to identify coverage gaps and determine what deserves an update, an explainer, or additional reporting.
• Multiplatform fluency. Understands how people discover and use local news across streaming, mobile alerts, vertical video, search, social media, web, and broadcast, and can explain why a format fits a particular story.
• Verification and technology judgment. Knows how to verify eyewitness video and social media claims, recognize potentially manipulated media, and use approved newsroom technology with human review and editorial accountability.
• Local curiosity and follow-through. Brings ideas rooted in the communities Telemundo62 serves, understands the needs of Spanish-speaking audiences, and follows stories beyond the first headline.
• Visual and live-production experience. Anticipates what anchors, reporters, the control room, and digital teams will need and builds clear visual storytelling into coverage before air or publication.

Editorial Standards and Use of Technology

The producer is expected to uphold NBCUniversal News Group standards for fairness, accuracy, impartiality, transparency, sourcing, social media, corrections, copyright, and use of generative AI. Approved tools may assist the work, but the employee remains responsible for verification, human editorial review, and the accuracy of published or aired material

At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.



Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”



Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.



The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Data Integrations team owns the systems that move clinical and financial data between Commure and hundreds of external healthcare systems using FHIR, HL7, Flat files, RPA etc. The domain is EMRs and Portals like Availity, but the engineering problem is distributed systems at scale: durable orchestration on Temporal, strong delivery semantics against unreliable third parties, and a data and networking substrate that has to keep up as the business grows.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own multi-component projects on this platform end to end and help us scale as we move towards more enterprise customers.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own multi-component projects where requirements are incomplete or evolving: define the approach, sequence the work, and see them through design, implementation, migration, rollout, and running them in production.

 - Design and build robust systems across the orchestration layer, the pipelines, and the data stores, with strong boundaries and observability built in..

 - Set the bar for observability and operational readiness (monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, dashboards, alerting, SLOs, and safe production rollouts).

 - Work hand-in-hand with platform and product teams to keep sensitive customer data protected, tighten security boundaries, and stay on top of our regulatory and compliance obligations.

 - Make pragmatic calls that weigh security, correctness, reliability, performance, and simplicity against how fast we need to ship.

 - Mentor other junior and senior engineers on the team, lead team-level and cross-org design reviews, and help improve hiring and team processes.

 - Take real ownership in a fast-moving environment. Fix root causes instead of patching around them.




OUR TECH STACK

 - Backend: Python (FastAPI) monolith on Kubernetes; supporting services in Go (e.g. HL7/MLLP gateways)

 - Database: PostgreSQL (SQLAlchemy) · Redis

 - Cloud & orchestration: GCP (Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, GCS, Cloud Run / Knative), Temporal

 - Integrations: HL7 v2, FHIR R4, REST/OAuth (SMART), Selenium, SFTP

 - Monitoring: Prometheus + Grafana

 - Other tools: Linear, Notion, Slack




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent extensive experience.

 - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including leading multi-component projects with ambiguous requirements from design through production.

 - Deep experience building and operating distributed systems at scale, high-throughput pipelines, data-intensive services. You can talk about the non-obvious failure modes, not just the happy path.

 - Strong data-layer and concurrency judgment. You've made a relational database (Postgres or similar) do more than it wanted to, and you know when to reach for a DB lock, when Redis is the right tool, and when the right move is a design that doesn't need either.

 - Real depth in the boring-but-critical layers. Networking and egress (NAT, static IPs, connection lifecycle, DNS, TLS), the database, the container runtime. You're comfortable debugging when something below the application layer misbehaves.

 - Production experience with GCP and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Knative, or similar serverless-on-k8s), and fluency in a modern backend language (Python strongly preferred; Go or similar is a plus).

 - The ability to explain technical tradeoffs in language non-engineers can act on, and to coordinate dependencies across teams.

 - A history of leveling up the engineers around you.




BONUS

 - Healthcare integrations experience — HL7 v2, FHIR, and EHRs like Epic, Cerner, or Athenahealth. We can teach the domain; we're hiring for the systems judgment above.

 - Experience with the compliance envelope this work lives inside (HIPAA, SOC 2) and the security posture that comes with handling PHI.

jobs.title: Manager II, Talent Management
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced talent management professional and program manager to help bring our talent strategy to life. This role will be responsible for translating talent management priorities into well-designed, integrated programs and ensuring exceptional execution across the annual talent cycle.

This person will serve as the operational engine for our talent management programs, owning detailed program planning, cross-functional coordination, communications and change management, systems administration, measurement, and continuous improvement. They will work closely with Talent Management leadership, HR Business Partners, Compensation, HRIS, and other partners to ensure our talent processes are connected, thoughtfully executed, and aligned with the needs of the business.

The ideal candidate combines strong program management skills with talent management expertise. They can see the big picture while managing significant detail, anticipate dependencies and risks, work effectively across teams, and create the structure needed to move complex, enterprise-wide programs from strategy through execution.

Let’s talk about some of the key responsibilities of the role:

• Own the annual talent management operating calendar and program plans, translating strategic priorities into detailed timelines, milestones, dependencies, roles and responsibilities, communications, and deliverables across the annual talent cycle.

• Lead end-to-end execution of enterprise performance management programs, including annual performance reviews, annual goal setting, and the mid-year goal and performance check-in process.

• Coordinate interconnected talent processes across HR teams, ensuring performance management activities are effectively sequenced and aligned with related promotion and compensation processes owned by other teams.

• Lead communications and change management for talent programs, developing communication strategies, toolkits, guidance, FAQs, timelines, and other resources that enable Tarsans and managers to successfully navigate talent processes.

• Serve as a subject matter expert for manager enablement related to talent management programs. Partner with instructional design and other stakeholders to develop effective manager resources and learning experiences, and support HR Business Partners in delivering enablement to the organization.

• Manage the operational execution of talent review and calibration processes across functional leadership teams, cross-functional leadership forums, and the executive leadership team, including detailed planning, stakeholder coordination, timelines, data preparation, materials, and follow-up.

• Drive accountability for talent review outcomes, establishing mechanisms to track agreed-upon actions and ensuring appropriate follow-through in partnership with HR Business Partners and other stakeholders. This includes monitoring actions related to lower-performing Tarsans and surfacing areas where additional attention or intervention may be needed.

• Track longer-term outcomes for participants in key talent programs, including graduates of the company’s high-potential development program, and provide reporting and insights on participant progression and program impact over time.

• Administer the leadership 360 program, managing program logistics, participant and stakeholder communications, timelines, data, reporting, and other operational requirements to ensure a high-quality experience.

• Own Talent Management configuration and reporting in Lattice, including setting up and administering goal-setting and performance-review cycles, testing processes, troubleshooting issues, monitoring completion, and producing reports and data needed to support talent programs.

• Own measurement and reporting for Talent Management programs, establishing appropriate program metrics, monitoring participation and outcomes, identifying trends and opportunities, and translating data into clear insights for Talent Management and HR leadership.

• Partner with HRIS and other stakeholders on talent technology needs, including identifying opportunities to improve how talent review, critical-role, succession, and other talent data are managed. Serve as a Talent Management subject matter expert and business partner for future system enhancements or implementations.

• Continuously improve talent programs and processes, gathering feedback and data following major talent cycles, identifying opportunities to improve effectiveness and the user experience, and implementing approved enhancements in subsequent cycles.

• Build scalable, repeatable program infrastructure, including project plans, templates, documentation, governance mechanisms, reporting, and operating practices that enable talent programs to scale as the company grows.

Target Skills and Experience:

• Bachelor’s Degree and 8+ years of progressive experience in Talent Management, HR program management, HR operations, or related HR roles

• Hands-on experience with at least 2-3 major enterprise talent processes, ideally performance management, goal setting, and talent review

• Demonstrated ownership of large, cross-functional programs from planning through execution: building project plans, managing dependencies, coordinating stakeholders across HR teams, planning communications and measuring impact

• Comfortable defining program measures, extracting and manipulating talent data, monitoring completion/outcomes, spotting patterns, and creating leadership-ready reporting and insights

• Ability to look at an existing process, identify friction or unnecessary complexity, and make it simpler, more scalable, and more effective

• Able to produce polished, accurate materials for senior leadership and eventually grow into supporting and facilitating executive-level talent discussions

• Experience working on a small, nimble team is preferred

Factors for Success:

• Talent Management Expertise – Brings a strong understanding of talent management practices, particularly performance management, goal setting, talent reviews, calibration, and leadership assessment. Understands how individual talent programs connect to create an integrated talent management experience.

• Program Management Excellence – Can translate strategic direction into clear, actionable plans and independently drive complex, cross-functional programs from planning through execution. Anticipates dependencies, risks, and stakeholder needs and creates structure and clarity in complex environments.

• Operational Excellence and Attention to Detail – Manages multiple high-visibility processes with precision and consistently delivers high-quality work. Maintains strong attention to detail while understanding the broader objectives and business context behind the work.

• Influence and Stakeholder Management – Builds trusted relationships across HR and the business and effectively coordinates stakeholders with different priorities and responsibilities. Knows when to drive independently, when to collaborate, and when to escalate decisions or risks.

• Data and Insights Orientation – Uses data to evaluate program effectiveness, identify trends, and inform decisions. Can translate complex talent data into clear, meaningful insights for HR and business leaders.

• Systems and Process Mindset – Is comfortable working in talent technology platforms and learning new systems. Looks for opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve processes while maintaining appropriate rigor and data integrity.

• Change Management and Communication – Understands that successful talent programs depend on more than process design. Creates clear, thoughtful communications and enablement that help managers and Tarsans understand what is expected, why it matters, and how to participate effectively.

Tarsus Leadership Competencies

• Decision Making – Identifies, analyzes, and resolves issues or challenges effectively and efficiently. Demonstrates creativity, decisiveness, and the capacity to implement solutions in a structured and outcome-oriented manner. Navigates uncertainty when there’s not a blueprint for success. Owns their decisions and actions.

• Collaboration and Team Building – Builds strong relationships and networks. Is curious about and respectful of different points of view. Cultivates a safe space for discussion, readily engaging in group dialogue and debate. Puts the team first.

• Outcome Driven – Clearly defines mutual expectations of self and others in a team setting. Adapts to changing business needs. Is determined and resourceful in finding solutions, even when faced with obstacles. Takes appropriate actions, including calculated risks, to ensure obligations are met.

A Few Other Details Worth Mentioning:

• The position may be based in our Irvine office or remote with regular travel to Irvine. Our Irvine headquarters includes onsite gym, pool, snacks, drinks, and occasional catered meals. We provide a hybrid work environment.

• We are passionate about our culture! Our Tarsans live our values of commitment to patients, empowerment to champion innovation, and teamwork to amplify impact!

• This position reports directly to our Senior Director, Talent Management.

At Tarsus, we understand the importance of attracting and retaining top talent. The expected base pay range for this position is $120,000 - $168,000 plus bonus, stock equity, and comprehensive benefits. The base pay range reflects the target range for this position, but individual pay will be determined by additional factors such as job-related skills, experience and relevant education or training. Our benefits include health, dental and vision insurance benefits to ensure your well-being. We believe in work-life balance and offer generous paid time off, including vacation, holidays, and personal days. For more details regarding Tarsus benefits, please visit: https://eb.alliant.com/26tarsusbenefitssnapshot.

jobs.title: Senior Product Development Manager
jobs.description:
What's the Short Version?

The Sr Product Development Manager is responsible for supporting BELLA+CANVAS in managing product lines, developing product, and leading a team of product developers. The Sr Product Development Manager leads the development process from initial concept to commercialized product, while managing and developing strong, lasting relationships with our suppliers and global supply base. The role works closely with BELLA+CANVAS, design, and merchandising teams to create product strategies that lay out clear action steps to drive new product development, cost savings, responsible sourcing, and customer satisfaction. The Sr Product Development Manager is responsible for production management to ensure on time delivery of quality product. They also lead the training and development of junior staff within the Product Development Team.

What Will You Be Doing?

• Lead and drive the product development strategy and process from design, materials, and trim concepts into a manufacturable, top quality, and commercialized finished product; manage the life cycle of the product through approvals of prototypes to top of production.

• Manage vendor relationships for product lines; negotiate prices and resolve issues.

• Drive cost negotiation and maintain responsibility for the bottom line of product margin for responsible brands and categories.

• Lead the exploration and research of technologies, concepts, and materials that will add value to SanMar.

• Research emerging material, trim and style trends by attending material and industry shows, meet regularly with suppliers, mills and factories to present innovative ideas.

• Travel domestically and internationally on a frequent basis to meet with suppliers and visit factories.

• Develop fabric, trims, and styles with suppliers; oversee color development and management including lab dips and bulk materials.

• Collaborate with Sourcing team in establishing new business relationships and evaluating suppliers; review vendor score cards and develop an appropriate improvement plan for each individual vendor.

• Collaborate with Sourcing team to develop risk mitigation strategies for Key Programs; evaluate the risks associated with developed materials, trims, and products.

• Work closely with Technical Design to ensure an efficient fit process with minimum prototypes, address quality concerns, and offer alternative construction for cost consideration.

• Collaborate with cross functional teams on the design and engineering of seasonal development as well as proposing viable new products to brand partners.

• Execute seasonal development calendars to ensure deadlines, costing KPI’s, and quality standards are met.

• Manage monthly capacities and work-in-progress reports to ensure on-time delivery of product; collaborate with the planning team to balance order flows that fit with suppliers’ capabilities and capacities.

• Manage suppliers to ensure product is delivered on time and meets SanMar Quality and compliance requirements.

• Ensure the global quality program is fully executed across the entire product development lifecycle; support the requirements for social compliance and safety standards to ensure that they are met by the supply base.

• Responsible for coaching and developing direct reports/PD team in reaching their professional goals and objectives as well as department goals through consistent feedback and evaluations.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

• Comply with all policies and standards.

What Are We Looking For?

• 8+ years experience in product development and production management or equivalent education

• Deep understanding of the garment and textile manufacturing processes, factory evaluation techniques, and vendor compliance requirements

• High level understanding of forecasting, buy planning, factory loading, and capacity planning

• Knowledgeable in component costing; including garment construction, raw material options, and landing factors

• Sound understanding of international trade agreements, HTS codes, customs regulations, and product safety standards

• Strong ability to interact effectively with global supply chain at all levels of management

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate goals and objectives

• Strong problem-solving skills with a results driven mindset

• Consistently demonstrate strong people skills, acts with professionalism, can resolve conflicts and contribute to a positive work environment

• Frequent international travel

What's Our Offer?

Salary Range: You`ll earn between $100,000 - $165,000 annually, depending on experience.

Bonus: You`ll be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus up to 10% of base salary.

Paid Time Off: You`ll accrue paid time off on a bi-weekly basis based on hours worked up to 112 hours per year to start. Employees also receive 8 paid holidays and 1 paid family day off.

Additional Benefits:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits

• 401k plan and matches $1 for $1 up to 4% of earnings, matched & vested at every pay cycle

• Life insurance

• Short/long-term disability coverage

• Paid maternity/paternity leave

• Pet insurance

What Should You Expect?

Hybrid: SanMar's Eastpointe office is located in Issaquah, WA in the Seattle metropolitan area. Employees are required to work in our offices Tuesday through Thursday each week and additional days may be added based on business needs. Our standard working hours are 8:00-5:00 PST. jobs.title: Production Technician
jobs.description:
Job Opportunity: Production Technician with Formative 3D in Falls Church, VA

Do you enjoy hands-on work and have experience using hand tools and power tools? Do you take pride in precision, quality, and keeping work moving? Ready to put your skills to work in advanced manufacturing and 3D printing? If so, we’d love to meet you!

As a Production Technician, you'll support manufacturing and post-processing operations at our new production facility. Reporting to the Post-Processing Manager in the Production department, you'll use hand tools and power tools to drill, cut, sand, and finish 3D-printed parts while supporting material handling and general shop operations.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who is dependable, hardworking, and experienced with hand tools and power tools. Previous manufacturing or 3D printing experience is a plus, but not required. You'll have the opportunity to develop technical skills, contribute to our first project, and grow with the business in an advanced manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Perform post-processing tasks on 3D-printed parts, including drilling, hole cutting, sanding, deburring, trimming, and general finishing.

• Safely operate hand tools and power tools, including drills, impact drivers, hole saws, and other cutting equipment.

• Move, stage, and organize raw materials, finished products, and supplies throughout the facility.

• Follow work instructions, measurements, and standard operating procedures to ensure quality and consistency.

• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized shop floor through sweeping, scrap cutting, waste disposal, and recycling.

• Assist with basic assembly, material handling, and general production support as needed.

• Help restock consumables and organize tools, bins, and storage areas.

• Follow all safety procedures and PPE requirements.

• Support team members wherever needed to help keep production running efficiently.

Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience operating hand tools and power tools is required, particularly drills, impact drivers, hole saws, and cutting equipment.

• Previous construction, carpentry, fabrication, assembly, manufacturing, or 3D printing experience is a plus, but not required.

• Ability to follow instructions, measurements, and established standard operating procedures.

• Ability to safely and accurately drill, cut, and finish materials.

• Reliable, punctual, and able to work effectively as part of a team.

• Comfortable performing repetitive tasks requiring precision and attention to detail.

• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and stand or walk for extended periods.

• Interest in 3D printing and willingness to learn new technical skills.

• Willingness to work weekends as needed.

• Work involves regular movement between production areas, assembly stations, and shipping/receiving; standing or walking up to 8 hours per day, 6 days a week; and regularly lifting materials or equipment weighing 25-50 pounds.

• Work in an industrial environment with noise, dust, and varying temperatures, using required PPE such as safety glasses, gloves, and hearing protection.

What We Offer:

• $22-$28/hr based on experience.

• Comprehensive healthcare benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.

• Competitive paid time off plans.

• Competitive retirement savings plans.

• Opportunity to grow your career in advanced manufacturing and additive manufacturing technologies.

Why Join Formative 3D?

At Formative 3D, we’re a 3D-printing startup on a mission to change the built environment. By leveraging large-format and FDM additive manufacturing, we’re building sustainable, scalable, modular systems.

Our shared purpose is to build trust with our clients, partners, subcontractors, and teammates while creating extraordinary experiences. No matter your background, education, or career path, if you share that vision, you belong at Formative 3D.

As we launch our new production facility, we’re looking for dependable, hands-on team members to help produce our first project and grow the business. Join us to build your technical skills and contribute to a new approach to manufacturing.

Apply online today to join a great team!

Formative 3D is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to hiring and developing the most qualified individuals based on job-related experience, skills, and merit. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. jobs.title: Lab Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences has created the world’s first Operating System for Science, powered by Scientific Superintelligence™. Lila generates hypotheses, designs and runs experiments, and learns from new data in real time. The result is faster discovery for every field where breakthrough science matters, from human health to climate and sustainability. Learn more about this mission at www.lila.ai.

At Lila, every breakthrough begins as a question. That same spirit of curiosity fuels our technology, propels our people, and defines how our team works and grows. We are uniquely cross-functional and collaborative: scientists and engineers, technologists and experimentalists work side by side to turn questions into ideas, and ideas into breakthroughs. We seek individuals with an inclusive mindset and a diversity of thought, because we know that experience comes in many forms, skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way.

If this sounds like an environment you’d love to work in, even if you only have some of the experience listed below, we encourage you to apply.

Lab Operations is the operational backbone that lets science move quickly. As Lab Operations Manager, you lead lab operations for our Physical Sciences teams at our Alewife campus in Cambridge, MA. You own the labs end to end, including equipment, space, materials, and logistics, so experimental and automation teams can run without interruption.

You lead a team of Lab Operations specialists and service providers. You set priorities, build processes, and develop your people. You drive the standup of new lab spaces and partner closely with Facilities, EH&S, Procurement, and scientific leaders across sites.

What You'll Be Building

• Lead, hire, and develop a team of Lab Operations specialists and service providers.

• Own daily lab operations for Physical Sciences labs, including the service ticket queue and coverage.

• Drive new lab space standup: equipment installs, facility connections, relocations, and space readiness.

• Own the equipment install and preventive maintenance schedule across the site.

• Manage inventory for consumables, gases, chemicals, and cold storage.

• Build and manage vendor relationships for supplies, gases, waste, and equipment service.

• Partner with Facilities, EH&S, and Procurement to keep labs safe, compliant, and ready.

• Identify process and coverage gaps, and lead lab efficiency improvements.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 5+ years in lab operations, lab management, or a related lab support role.

• 2+ years managing people, including direct reports in a lab or operations setting.

• Hands-on experience standing up or relocating lab spaces and equipment.

• Experience managing vendors, service contracts, and equipment PM programs.

• Working knowledge of lab safety, chemical handling, and hazardous waste requirements.

• Ability to lift up to 40 lbs and work on your feet in a lab environment.

Bonus Points For

• Bachelor’s degree in a scientific field.

• Experience or training in materials science or other physical sciences.

• Exposure to automated or high-throughput laboratory environments.

• Familiarity with CMMS, inventory, or ticketing tools (e.g., eWorkOrders, MaintainX, Blue Mountain, ChemInventory, Jira).

• Experience running operations across multiple lab sites or in a fast-scaling organization.

• OSHA, HazMat, or DOT hazardous materials shipping certifications.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range

$108,000—$144,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

jobs.title: Banking Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Coastal is at the forefront of modern banking, combining strong financial infrastructure with cutting-edge Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) and fintech enablement strategies. We support not only individuals with their personal banking needs; we also empower businesses by integrating modern banking technology that drives growth, flexibility, and innovation.



At Coastal, we think and move like entrepreneurs; focused on impact, speed, and continuous improvement. We believe in working smart, collaborating deeply, and building solutions that unlock real potential. If you're someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, loves solving complex problems, and wants to help shape the future of banking, we’d love to meet you.



Check out our video here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UCWaDxFnla8&ab_channel=CoastalCommunityBank!



OVERVIEW

A Banking Operations Supervisor leads one or more team(s) within the Banking Operations Department. Responsibilities include people leadership, coordination of tasks due at varying times, reporting and process improvements across the team. Team tasks are focused on (but not limited to) one or more of the following areas: ACH, Checks, Wires, Research, Error Resolution, Legal Processing, Item Processing, Exception Processing, New Accounts, Compliance, Retirement Accounts, General Account Servicing.



Note: 

 - The salary range of $77,511 - $93,013 is posted for compliance reasons. However, we will not be hiring above $88,000.

 - Hybrid role at HQ Evergreen office 3 days per week.



RESPONSIBILITIES TO INCLUDE

 - Manage an Operations team(s) (for example ACH, Research & Adjustments, Electronic Payments, Wires, Check Processing).

 - Understand and maintain proficiency with daily operational tasks for the functional area(s) supported.

 - Responsible for oversight to ensure compliance with regulations, policies, procedures and audit requirements. Complete Risk Assessments and partner with audit, compliance and quality as needed in coordination with their manager.

 - Act as a subject matter expert and contact for Operations Team.

 - Build strong relationships (internal and external) and provide feedback for innovations and modernization that can lead to efficiencies.

 - Ensure all necessary reports are generated/worked in a timely fashion.

 - Evaluates and analyzes data to determine root cause of issues, create tickets to recommend improvements in process or technology.

 - Facilitate cross training throughout and amongst teams.

 - Participate in system process improvement discussions, and ensure all applicable procedures are created and updated as needed.

 - Manage team performance, set and review productivity targets and coach team/team leaders as needed to meet set goals.

 - Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging risks affecting operations area, and proactively adjust risk management strategies accordingly.

 - Responsible for reviewing and resolving operational alerts.

 - Work directly with clients to resolve issues; gathering customer needs and working with the product team and account managers to resolve in coordination with their manager.

 - May monitor various daily activities, reconciliations for settlements, provide approvals/sign off, up to personal limit for various job duties.

 - Assist with additional responsibilities as needed.



QUALIFICATIONS

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment with solid leadership skills.

 - Ability to resolve problems with minimal guidance and make general operational escalation decisions in the absence of the department manager.

 - Ability to interface with other departments, effectively present information and respond to questions from management, team members and customers/partners and operate in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.

 - Knowledge and understanding of FinTech with a solid operational background.

 - Maintain an understanding of products and services offered.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 - Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects and deadlines simultaneously.

 - Attention to detail and accuracy a must.

 - Cooperative and professional attitude.

 - Knowledge of wire transfer systems, payment networks, and regulatory requirements (e.g., BSA, AML, OFAC etc.).

 - This role is a hybrid position and may require you to be in the office.



EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

 - 2+ years previous banking experience preferred with an emphasis in Electronic Payments Processing and/or back-office operations or equivalent experience.

 - 1+ years of experience managing a team.

 - AAP/AFPP/APRP a plus.



 

HOW YOU’LL THRIVE AT COASTAL

 - Be the Best – Communicate effectively, pay close attention to detail, and prioritize your personal development.

 - Be Relentless – Thrive in a goal-oriented environment exercising both patience and persistence. Advocate for our customers and team members and strive to promote the Coastal Difference.

 - Be Un-Bankey – Be a forward thinker with a creative mindset. Build long-lasting relationships promoting the Coastal Difference, built on a foundation of integrity, honesty, and trust.

 - Embrace Gray Thinking – Use sound judgment while decision-making and problem-solving. Think outside the box.

 - Stay Flexible – Organize and strategize effectively while always being prepared to adapt on the fly. Seek efficiencies for Coastal to work smarter, not harder.

 - Take Care of Each Other – Understand what it means to be a true team player and have your teammate's back. Practice self-awareness and build your emotional intelligence.



BEING YOU AT COASTAL

Coastal is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws.



BENEFITS WE OFFER

We’re proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance. Our offerings include:

 - Medical Coverage: Choose from three competitive medical plans to find the coverage that best fits your needs and lifestyle.

 - Health Savings Account (HSA): Available with eligible medical plans, offering tax advantages and employer contributions.

 - Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA): Options for healthcare and dependent care expenses to help you save on out-of-pocket costs.

 - Dental and Vision Insurance: Plans to keep you and your family smiling and seeing clearly.

 - Life Insurance: Company-paid basic life insurance with options to purchase additional coverage for yourself and your dependents.

 - Long-Term /Short-Term Disability (LTD): Income protection in the event of a long-term illness or injury.

 - Supplemental Benefits: Including Hospital Indemnity, Accident Insurance, and Critical Illness coverage to provide extra financial support when you need it most.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse- Mother/Baby 11 Prentice Full Time Nights
jobs.description:
The Clinical Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Based on the NMH framework for practice, the registered professional clinical nurse (RN) is accountable and responsible for the provision and coordination of clinically competent, evidence-based care for an assigned group of patients that includes diagnosis, outcome identification, planning, implementation and evaluation. The nurse adheres to the ANA Scope and Standards of Professional Nursing, the Code of Ethics, and the Nursing Social Policy Statement.   As a member of the clinical care and unit team, the RN participates in decision-making, teaching, mentoring, and collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advance the patient plan of care, achieve exceptional outcomes and enhance unit operations.  The RN exemplifies the components of what it means to be an NMH nurse, reflects the Mission, Vision, and Values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

The role of the professional clinical nurse is unique and essential to the care of the patient.  The nurse demonstrates that unique and essential function through the framework for nursing practice.

Advocate:

• Practices in accordance with the patient centered care model
• Develops an individualized age-specific culturally sensitive nursing plan of care for the patient that is based on the nursing process
• Incorporates the role of patient advocate into the plan of care
• Uses a team approach to develop and achieve daily patient-centered individualized care goals
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of the patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care
• Identifies potential conflict situations and facilitates resolution using established communication channels
• Promotes and strives to protect the health, safety and rights of the patient
• Protects patients by maintaining a safe environment

Clinical Expert:

• Advances clinical expertise, as demonstrated through pursuit of informal and formal continuing education opportunities and obtaining specialty certification when eligible
• Continuously enhances skills and abilities to ensure the highest quality patient care
• Shares knowledge and expertise through educating team members, patients and students
• Demonstrates critical thinking by integrating theoretical knowledge and expertise to pose relevant clinical questions when evidence and practice differ
• Identifies priorities, sets realistic and measureable goals, prescribes and implements nursing interventions in a safe and timely manner
• Develops and implements individualized education plans for patients and families using suitable instructional materials and methods
• Evaluates and documents the patient’s responses to nursing interventions in the health record and properly individualizes the plan of care based on the evaluation of findings
• Identifies situations that require further intervention and escalates appropriately; Consults appropriate experts and resources when needed
• Participates in the formation, implementation and evaluation of team goals
• Appropriately delegates and supervises interventions to implement the plan of care
• Conveys complete, timely and accurate information at hand off at the bedside or any hand off
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice

Community Volunteer:

• Participates in one or more volunteer initiatives annually, Northwestern Memorial organized or on his/her own

Compassionate:

• Consistently demonstrates interpersonal connections with patients and families from introduction through discharge
• Proactively responds to patient concerns such as speaking to patients about possible/expected delays in plan of care
• Treats patients, families, visitors and staff in a caring manner with respect and dignity
• Facilities recovery and where appropriate helps ensure a peaceful death for patients

Professionally Engaged:

• Is a member of a professional organization or participates on an Northwestern Memorial committee or taskforce at the hospital-wide, departmental, or unit level
• Demonstrates accountability and collaborative practice with co-workers, other disciplines, and departments
• Assumes responsibility for continued professional growth and education reflecting knowledge and understanding of current nursing practice
• Serves as a community mentor for team members
• Serves as a preceptor for new team members
• Participates in the peer feedback process by conducting a constructive assessment and evaluation of peer performance
• Works collaboratively with all hospital services to accomplish daily work and maintain an environment of excellence
• Participates in the development of policies, procedures and systems to support safe and effective care and advance nursing practice at NMH through the Shared Leadership Process
• Assumes personal responsibility for meeting internal (i.e. Best People profile, ELMs, CPR, and health requirements) and external regulatory and accreditation requirements
• Identifies opportunities for innovation and quality improvement; participates in innovation projects and the quality improvement process, including unit based quality committees
• Demonstrates accountability to Northwestern Memorial strategic, operational and fiscal goals
• Exemplifies a professional image in appearance and communications

• Maintains and advances the professional image of nursing and the practice of professional nursing through an ongoing analysis of resources
• Professional Organizations, literature, electronic resources, etc.

Required:

• Graduate of an NLN accredited school/college of nursing
• Baccalaureate degree in Nursing or higher
• Current State of Illinois, Registered Professional Nurse license
• Basic Life Support (BLS) CPR through American Heart Association.
• Analytic ability (conceptual and quantitative)
• Oral, listening and written communication skills
• Strong human relation skills to interact effectively and collaborate with others in difficult situations
• Use of a keyboard to enter or retrieve data

Preferred:

• Experience in specific clinical area
• Nursing specialty certification, if eligible

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Associate Director
jobs.description:
About Us:

Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd. Powered by industry-leading AI and real-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. As of 2025, Pacvue powers 12% of total retail media ad spend worldwide excluding China. Combined with Helium 10’s SMB solutions, Pacvue delivers the industry’s most comprehensive platform for businesses of all sizes.

At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.

About the Role:

As an Associate Director, Strategic Account Management at Pacvue, you will serve as the primary point of contact, consultant, and commercial owner for a portfolio of our most strategic agency partners, with a focus on niche and independent agencies. This is not a traditional account management role: you will own the strategy, revenue, and growth of your book of business, and partner with agencies to bring new brands onto Pacvue. You will leverage strong leadership, analytical, and commercial skills, exceptional communication, and strategic insight to optimize client outcomes, influence decision-making, and grow the value of each partnership over the long term.

Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management:

• Independently own and drive outcomes for a complex, high-stakes portfolio, setting your own methods and evaluation criteria with minimal oversight beyond major milestones.

• Establish and maintain executive-level relationships with agency leadership to drive strategic alignment and long-term retention.

• Build strong, trust-based relationships and proactively map multiple contacts within each agency to ensure continuity even as individual roles change.

• Act as a strategic consultant, helping agencies use Pacvue’s technology to strengthen their own client retention and new business positioning.

Strategic Planning & Consultation:

• Tie account strategy to the metrics agencies care about most: client retention, new business win rate, and margin.

• Own account strategy end-to-end: set annual and quarterly growth objectives with each agency and run executive business reviews (QBRs/EBRs) that both prove value and advance expansion opportunities.

• Independently diagnose and solve complex, variable problems that don’t have a standard playbook – e.g., building net-new retention strategies for at-risk accounts or designing cross-agency cost models from scratch.

• Keep agencies informed on product roadmap and new capabilities, helping them stay ahead in competitive pitches.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Partner with Sales, Product, and Marketing to ensure agency needs inform roadmap priorities and go-to-market materials.

• Surface case studies and proof points relevant to independent agencies to support client conversations and renewals.

Performance & Reporting:

• Track account health and usage trends, with particular attention to key contacts and relationship continuity in smaller organizations.

• Translate platform performance into business outcomes agencies can use in their own client reporting and new business pitches.

Revenue Ownership, Expansion & Sales:

• Own a revenue target for your book of business, including renewal rate, net revenue retention, and expansion (upsell and cross-sell) goals.

• Build and execute strategic account plans that map whitespace within each agency and turn it into qualified expansion pipeline.

• Run the full sales cycle on expansion opportunities: discovery, solution design, business case and ROI development, proposal, pricing negotiation, and close.

• Proactively source net-new revenue by partnering with agency leadership to onboard their new and existing brand clients onto Pacvue, including supporting agency pitches and co-selling to brands where appropriate.

• Negotiate and close renewals and multi-year agreements, identifying risk early and protecting margin.

• Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasts in Salesforce and report on bookings, pipeline coverage, and account health to leadership.

• Serve as an internal advocate for the unique needs and buying behavior of independent agency clients.

Skills & Qualifications

• Minimum 8 years of experience in Account Management, Client Success, Sales, or Consulting, ideally in eCommerce, digital advertising, or SaaS, with direct experience serving independent or boutique agencies.

• Proven ability to build and manage executive-level relationships with agency leadership, and to influence strategic decision-making at that level.

• Wide-ranging expertise across agency economics, platform/product strategy, and competitive positioning – able to apply sophisticated, varied approaches across different account types and problems, not just one client segment.

• Skilled at building relationship continuity in smaller organizations, where a limited number of contacts can create real account risk.

• Proven track record carrying and exceeding a revenue quota (renewals, upsell, and cross-sell) in fast-moving, lower-layer approval environments.

• Consultative selling skills: comfortable leading discovery, building business cases, negotiating pricing and terms, and closing, not just managing the relationship after the deal is signed.

• Hands-on experience managing pipeline and forecasting in Salesforce or a similar CRM.

• Excellent communicator who can translate platform value into language agencies use with their own clients.

Benefits:

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Paid Holidays and Floating Holidays

• Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA with employer contribution, Life Insurance and Pet Insurance

• 401k with Employer Match

• Take up to 2 Days of Paid Time Off to Volunteer with a 501c Organization

• Paid Parental Leave

• Company-subsidized membership to Wellhub and Peloton

• Fertility and family-building information platform through Carrot

The annual OTE range for this position is $187,500-$225,000 USD. The actual salary will vary depending on the applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities as well as internal equity and market data for their location. This position is also eligible for an additional annual bonus compensation through one of Pacvue’s highly attractive incentive plans, full details will be provided during the recruitment process.

#LI-Remote

Pacvue is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

The Manager, B2B Marketing is an individual contributor who independently manages two primary, distinct pillars of responsibility to drive DailyPay's pipeline growth. First, you will own the full-funnel, omni-channel campaign strategy specifically tailored to capture and convert the small business vertical market. Second, you will serve as the organizational architect for the overall pre-sales B2B email marketing strategy, designing sophisticated automated nurture streams to systematically engage prospects across all segments. jobs.title: Staff/ Sr. Staff Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Lightmatter is leading the revolution in AI data center infrastructure, enabling the next giant leaps in human progress. The company invented the world’s first 3D-stacked photonics engine, Passage™, capable of connecting thousands to millions of processors at the speed of light in extreme-scale data centers for the most advanced AI and HPC workloads.

Lightmatter raised $400 million in its Series D round, reaching a valuation of $4.4 billion. We will continue to accelerate the development of data center photonics and grow every department at Lightmatter!

If you're passionate about tackling complex challenges, making an impact, and being an expert in your craft, join our team of brilliant scientists, engineers, and accomplished industry leaders.

Lightmatter is (re)inventing the future of computing with light!

About this Role

The Product Engineer role is pivotal to Lightmatter’s mission, sitting at the center of product delivery and operational excellence. This position offers a unique opportunity for end-to-end ownership, where you will define the product engineering landscape from the ground up and drive the strategic direction for our hardware portfolio. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams (design, foundry, assembly, process integration, packaging, test, validation, reliability) to optimize manufacturing flows, improve yield and quality, and reduce costs. The role’s focus areas include: optimizing Yield & Quality, implementing DFx principles and managing the product from initial silicon to high-volume manufacturing (HVM). The core responsibilities are specifically centered on optimizing manufacturing flows, yield Improvement, driving assembly and process integration readiness, and Test Point Optimization. Given the nature of our products, you will work extensively with silicon photonics and optical components, including high-speed electrical and optical interfaces.

Responsibilities

• Strategic Ownership: Own the product’s success by managing yield and quality indicators from first silicon to high-volume manufacturing (HVM).

• Manufacturing Excellence: Define manufacturing and test strategies, including DFx implementation, test hardware specs, and test program creation guidance for photonic and optoelectronic devices.

• DFx Leadership: Drive DFx requirements into design from architecture through tape-out for chips, boards, assembly and process integration and final module. Feed back learnings from assembly, test, and reliability into design.

• Yield & Cost Optimization: Drive continuous improvement in quality, yield, and cost by reducing test time, eliminating test sockets, closing test holes (DPM reduction), and increasing yield through root cause analysis with cross-functional teams (design, fab, assembly, packaging, firmware, software, data engineering). Apply these efforts to photonic integrated circuits (PICs), optical coupling and alignment, assembly-induced yield loss (e.g., warpage, stress, misalignment, and contamination), and optical component yield loss mechanisms.

• Hands on leadership: Debug test, yield, assembly, process, and power/performance issues, including optical loss, coupling efficiency, wavelength and thermal sensitivities, assembly process excursions, and high-speed electrical/optical signal degradation.

jobs.title: Director, Finance- Procurement
jobs.description:
The Director, Finance – Global Sourcing serves as the strategic finance leader supporting Fortune Brands Innovations' Global Sourcing organization and holds financial ownership for indirect procurement activities. Reporting to the Sr Director, Operations Finance, this role is the primary finance business partner to the VP, Global Sourcing and their leadership team, providing financial leadership, strategic decision support, and insight across a global direct material spend portfolio exceeding $2 billion annually, while leading the governance, strategy, and value delivery agenda for indirect spend.

This role is responsible for leading the financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and value realization processes supporting global sourcing initiatives, including commodity inflation and deflation management, purchase price variance, supplier negotiations, continuous improvement savings, working capital optimization, and standard costing activities.. The Director will proactively influence direct and indirect sourcing and procurement strategy through rigorous financial analysis, fact-based recommendations, and cross-functional partnership across Operations, Supply Chain, FP&A, Business Unit Finance, and corporate functions.

The role manages a team of two Financial Analysts and is expected to drive both talent development and continuous improvement across Global Sourcing Finance processes.

Position Location: Hybrid (Deerfield, IL) – 3 days per week in office. (Flexibility to work from home Mondays and Fridays)

RESPONSIBLIITIES:

Strategic Finance Partnership

• Serve as the lead finance partner to the Global Sourcing leadership team, providing financial guidance and strategic decision support across sourcing initiatives and priorities.
• Develop trusted advisor relationships with sourcing leaders by providing objective, data-driven insights and constructive challenge to business assumptions.
• Support the development and execution of sourcing strategies that improve profitability, cost competitiveness, cash flow, and enterprise value creation.
• Translate complex sourcing and market dynamics into actionable recommendations for Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership.

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Reporting

• Lead forecasting, annual planning, and long-range planning processes related to direct material spend, inflation/deflation, purchase price variance (PPV), supplier rebates, and sourcing productivity initiatives.
• Establish and maintain financial models used to forecast commodity, currency, and supplier cost impacts across the enterprise.
• Provide financial oversight and guidance for standard cost development and annual costing processes.
• Direct monthly reporting and communication of sourcing-related financial performance, key risks, opportunities, and variance analysis.
• Ensure alignment between sourcing forecasts, Operations Finance, FP&A, and Business Unit financial commitments.

Commodity, Supplier & Cost Management

• Lead financial analysis of commodity and currency market trends to identify risks, opportunities, and actionable sourcing recommendations.
• Provide financial leadership and support during supplier negotiations, contract development, and cost management initiatives.
• Oversee purchase price variance analysis and value-realization tracking to ensure sourcing initiatives deliver expected results.
• Direct financial evaluation of inflation mitigation, supplier productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives across the sourcing portfolio.

• Lead financial assessment of supplier concentration, continuity, country, tariff, duty, currency, and geopolitical risks, including scenario modeling and mitigation recommendations.
• Evaluate total landed cost and total cost of ownership when supporting supplier selection, sourcing transitions, localization, dual-sourcing, and make-versus-buy decisions.

Working Capital & Value Creation

• Partner with sourcing leadership to improve working capital performance through supplier payment term optimization and cash flow improvement initiatives.
• Monitor and communicate the financial impact of sourcing-related working capital initiatives and contractual changes.
• Validate realized savings and identify risks to value achievement, ensuring financial commitments are accurately measured and reported.

• Establish a consistent performance-management framework and executive scorecard for sourcing productivity, cost avoidance, purchase price variance, inflation and deflation, rebates, payment terms, working capital, forecast accuracy, and value realization.
• Define common baselines, ownership, timing, and validation standards so that sourcing benefits are measured consistently and reconciled to reported financial results.

Team Leadership & Process Improvement

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of two Senior Financial Analysts, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
• Establish priorities, allocate resources, and ensure effective execution of team responsibilities.
• Build organizational capability through mentoring, succession planning, performance management, and development planning.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reporting, forecasting accuracy, financial insights, automation, and overall process efficiency.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate closely with Operations Finance, Supply Chain, FP&A, Business Unit Finance, Procurement, and Operations leaders to ensure financial alignment and consistent methodologies.
• Influence business decisions across functions without formal authority through strong relationships, credibility, and analytical rigor.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or related field.
• 7+ years of progressive finance experience required; 10+ years preferred.
• Minimum 5 years of people leadership experience, including coaching, development, and performance management.
• Experience supporting sourcing, procurement, supply chain, operations, manufacturing, or related functions.
• Demonstrated success leading financial planning, forecasting, business analysis, and strategic decision support activities.
• Strong analytical and financial modeling capabilities with the ability to evaluate complex business scenarios.
• Proven ability to influence senior leaders and effectively challenge assumptions through fact-based recommendations.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex financial concepts into clear business insights.
• Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and financial reporting tools.
• Experience with financial systems such as Oracle, SAP, BPC, HFM, Essbase, Tableau, or similar platforms.
• Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, prioritize competing demands, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required to support sourcing priorities, supplier engagements, and team collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications

• MBA, CPA, CMA, or other advanced business or finance credential.
• Strong knowledge of procurement finance concepts, including total cost of ownership, total landed cost, purchase price variance, commodity and foreign-exchange exposure, supplier rebates, payment terms, and sourcing savings validation.
• Experience working within multinational manufacturing or consumer products environments.
• Experience developing commodity, currency, or supplier cost forecasting models.
• Proven track record of leading process improvement and finance transformation initiatives.
