• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes for large components, including when and why critical machining tolerances are required.

• Demonstrated hands-on fabrication, assembly, and testing skills.

• High competence with engineering first principles (statics, dynamics, mechanics of materials).

• Eligible for U.S. Security Clearance (DoD Secret, Top Secret)

• Up to 15% travel

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience in collegiate vehicle engineering teams (FSAE, Baja SAE, or similar hands-on design/build competitions).

• Industry background in automotive (chassis, body-in-white), robotics, heavy machinery, or mobile industrial equipment (e.g., masts, booms, lift mechanisms).

• Experience with low-rate initial production (LRIP), resolving manufacturing line bottlenecks, or designing production line tooling.

• Experience integrating actuators, hydraulics, sensors, and basic electrical interfaces.

• Proficiency in Siemens NX and Teamcenter.

US Salary Range

$132,000—$175,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Director, Culinary Strategy & Applications
jobs.description:
BUILT ON FLAVOR.  FUELED BY PEOPLE.

What’s it like to work at Kinder’s? Well, there’s a lot of snacking and geeking out over what we all cooked over the weekend. Beyond that, there’s also plenty of hard work. Because we don’t just like flavor, we’re obsessed with it.

With over 100 products sold nationwide, we’re now a top-five brand in multiple flavor categories at Costco, Walmart, Whole Foods, and more. We’re not your typical CPG company. Privately held and founder-led, we like to think of ourselves as a pirate ship in a sea of cruise ships. Our crew is adventurous and fearless. We chart our own course and chase big ideas to make food unforgettable.

As we expand globally and approach $1 billion in revenue, we need more smart-and-scrappy, flavor-obsessed people to come aboard. If you’re looking for a place where you can see the real impact of your work... this is it! Every day, you’ll be part of a journey to add flavor to millions of meals and lives.

How You Will Have an Impact at Kinder's

The Director of Culinary Strategy & Applications will play a critical leadership role in shaping how Kinder’s products come to life through food. This leader will translate our obsession with flavor into culinary programs, research, applications, and recipes that demonstrate what makes our products special and help ensure they consistently deliver against their culinary intent.

You will build and lead a team responsible for culinary research and applications, bringing together deep food expertise, consumer curiosity, and strong culinary judgment to help guide how we develop, evaluate, and showcase our products. You’ll look beyond individual products to identify ingredients, trends, techniques, occasions, and food concepts that should shape our culinary thinking, and turn those insights into actionable programs for the organization.

This is a highly collaborative role. You will work closely with Culinary Development, R&D/Product Development, Innovation, Brand, Creative, Field Culinary, and other partners to provide a culinary perspective and support the expansion of our product portfolio. You’ll be expected to be both strategic and hands-on: equally comfortable shaping a culinary point of view, leading product evaluation, upholding a high bar on quality, developing a menu concept, and coaching a team toward a better solution.

Key Responsibilities

Culinary Strategy & Research

• Drive the culinary research agenda and build the team that identifies relevant food, flavor, ingredient, menu, preparation, and consumer trends, translating them into actionable culinary direction.

• Establish a clear consumer point of view for how emerging trends, behaviors, and food culture could influence food development, applications, and programming.

• Partner with Culinary Development, Innovation, and Brand to ensure the culinary perspective informs ongoing innovation and renovation priorities.

• Build a culture of external curiosity, ensuring continual exploration of cuisines, ingredients, cooking techniques, competitive products, and broader food culture to keep Kinder’s culinary thinking fresh and relevant.

Applications and Food Programming

• Build a utility-based framework for how we approach consumer-facing recipe development (e.g., for inclusion on web and packaging), menu concepts (e.g., in advance of customer innovation sessions), and broader food programming (e.g., menu design for field events) that ensures we show up in the right way for the consumer and consistently deliver both exceptional eating experiences and value.

• Establish application strategies and standards that demonstrate product versatility and provide clear direction for how products can best be used by consumers across relevant foods, occasions, and cooking methods.

• Ensure applications are grounded in intended consumer usage and preparation realities, not simply what works in a test kitchen.

• Partner with Innovation/Brand, Creative, and Digital to align culinary direction for digital content, social, and other consumer-facing content (e.g., packaging), ensuring the food and applications authentically represent Kinder’s products.

Product Evaluation & Culinary Quality

• Establish the systematic approach to sensory product evaluation for the culinary product evaluation team to leverage, ensuring products are assessed consistently against the culinary gold standard in realistic applications.

• Oversee ongoing sensory evaluation of products in market across the portfolio, ensuring any potential taste deviations overtime from the culinary gold standard are identified, understood, and communicated to the relevant partners (e.g., R&D/PD, Innovation, Quality, Co-Man) to be appropriately addressed.

• Partner with R&D/Product Development, Innovation/Brand, and Operations to ensure relevant learnings from identified product opportunities / issues are captured and incorporated into any new development led by the Culinary Development team.

• Guide the team’s support of in-process product and sample evaluations across both innovation and renovation priorities (supporting needs from Culinary Development, R&D/PD, and Innovation/Brand).

Team Leadership & Capability Building

• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Culinary Strategy & Applications team, with the capabilities required to support growth and increasing complexity across Kinder’s portfolio of brands and products.

• Establish clear roles, expectations, and standards, empowering team members to independently lead their areas of expertise while maintaining alignment to the broader culinary strategy.

• Develop functional leaders and subject-matter experts, providing coaching, feedback, and stretch opportunities that both build individual capability and long-term bench strength.

• Identify capability needs and gaps and address them through structure changes, hiring, development, tools, and/or new ways of working.

• Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation, constructive debate, continuous learning, and exceptionally high standards

What You Bring to the Table

Education / Experience

• 10+ years of relevant experience spanning culinary innovation, food or consumer strategy, product applications, menu or recipe development, or related disciplines, with demonstrated depth in food and culinary judgment.

• Experience in CPG culinary development, food manufacturing, restaurant/foodservice innovation, or another environment where culinary ideas must translate into scalable products and real-world consumer experiences is highly desirable.

• Demonstrated success leading and developing high-performing culinary teams.

• Deep knowledge of food, flavor, ingredients, cooking techniques, menu development, and application development across a broad range of cuisines and occasions.

• Exceptional culinary and sensory judgement, with the ability to articulate not just whether something works, but why.

• Strong strategic thinking paired with the culinary fluency and willingness to be hands-on in the kitchen and close to the food.

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity, setting direction where the answer is not obvious, and making good decisions with incomplete information.

Personal Characteristics

• Low ego, highly collaborative, and energized by working with people who bring different expertise and perspectives.

• Thrives in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment where priorities evolve and everyone is expected to make a difference.

• Deeply passionate about food, flavor, and the craft of creating exceptional eating experiences.

• Strong curiosity for what people are eating, cooking, ordering, and discovering, and why.

• Proven coach who gets as much satisfaction from developing other culinary talent as from personally creating the answer.

Location and Travel

The position will be based out of our Walnut Creek, CA office. Travel may be required periodically to support culinary research, customer engagements, industry events, and other business needs.

Pay Transparency

The expected starting salary range for this role is $215,000- $240,000 per year. The salary range posted for this role reflects the good-faith base pay range Kinder’s reasonably expects to offer at the time of posting and may vary based on the location of the role. Individual compensation within the posted range will be determined based on factors such as relevant education, experience, qualifications, skills, and business needs.

SEASONED FOR SUCCESS:

• No two days here are the same.

• We try to be good team members and good communicators, but we don’t live by hierarchy and structure – everyone is a difference maker here.

• We make a lot of decisions in the face of incomplete information – our team embraces ambiguity and tries to make good decisions fast rather than great decisions slow.

• We believe our job is to take smart risk, not to eliminate risk.

• We believe in growing our skills and becoming a better company with more managerial expertise, but we are an entrepreneurial company at heart.

• We aren’t trying to be average – we want to do exceptional things, and we are willing to work hard to achieve them.

BENEFITS THAT BRING MORE TO THE TABLE:

We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, 401k, bonus / incentive eligibility, equity grants, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits, including parental leave. Kinder’s benefits vary based on eligibility and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

OUR RECIPE FOR BALANCE:

We believe great culture starts with people. We’re a people-first company built on connection, collaboration, and balance. Most of our work happens in the office to spark creativity and community, but we also offer flexibility so team members have the autonomy to work outside the office when needed to support their work-life balance and personal commitments.

WHERE EVERY INGREDIENT MATTERS:

Kinder's is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic. If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, and you need any accommodation during the application process or to perform these job requirements, please reach out to us at careers@kinders.com

jobs.title: Sr. Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential. FORT's platform ensures safe, secure, and dynamic control that surpasses legacy systems and next-generation AI capabilities.

While autonomous machines offer significant advantages, they also introduce new safety challenges. FORT addresses these concerns by providing solutions such as the Wireless E-Stop, which allows operators to instantly stop any machine from a safe distance, enhancing safety during emergencies.

Additionally, FORT's Safe Remote Control enables operators to manage heavy machinery remotely, reducing the risk of accidents and improving visibility.

By ensuring communications integrity across any network, FORT empowers customers to protect their most valuable assets—people, data, and machines—ensuring they remain safe and secure.

In this role, you will join a small, focused Systems Engineering team and partner with the Systems Engineering Manager to define the requirements and architecture for FORT's next-generation (NextGen) safety and control platform. You will own major portions of the system design across hardware, firmware, and cloud software: developing requirements and architecture, guiding engineers through design decisions, and making sure every feature is fully specified from happy path to edge cases before development begins.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can take a broad technical problem, work through it independently, and bring the team clear recommendations. You will hold periodic design reviews with cross-functional engineering leaders and will be trusted to carry your work from concept through verification with a high degree of autonomy.

Responsibilities

• Requirements Definition: Lead the definition of a complete set of system-level requirements for the NextGen platform, working with Development and Test teams to cover happy path, unhappy path, regulatory, safety, and security requirements.

• Architecture Development: Develop and maintain the NextGen system architecture, including functional decomposition, interface definitions, and allocation of requirements to hardware, firmware, and software elements.

• Design Decision Support: Guide Development Engineers through design decisions, review designs against the requirements and architecture, and resolve technical ambiguity so engineering teams can keep moving.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Engage Hardware, Firmware, Cloud Software, and Product teams to ensure requirements reflect the desired system behavior and attributes, and to identify gaps before they become problems downstream.

• Requirements Management: Author, organize, and maintain requirements in the requirements database (Jama) and steer cross-functional review cycles.

• Requirement-to-Test Traceability: Partner with Test Engineering to ensure every requirement maps to a test case and that coverage is complete before release. Leverage automation where possible to expedite tracing and ensure comprehensive coverage.

• Trade Studies: Lead trade studies for NextGen architecture and technology choices, and provide clear recommendations to Engineering Leadership with supporting rationale.

• Impact Analysis: Lead impact analysis for proposed changes, assessing scope across hardware, firmware, software, safety, and security domains to identify the downstream effects of an engineering change.

• Test Plan Review: Review test plans to verify alignment with requirements and flag gaps or ambiguities.

• Regulatory & Safety Requirements: Identify and incorporate applicable regulatory, functional safety, and cybersecurity requirements into the requirements baseline.

• Secure-by-Design: Translate findings from third-party threat assessments into security requirements and design mitigations, and help engineering teams build cybersecurity into the NextGen architecture from the start.

• Agile Execution: Operate effectively within iterative release cycles, decomposing requirements into sprint-ready work, participating in planning and review, and adapting to change without sacrificing requirements rigor.

Qualifications

Experience

• 5-8 years of experience in systems engineering, including ownership of requirements and architecture for complex hardware-software systems.

• Experience leading system architecture development for a new product or platform, from concept through design and verification.

• Demonstrated ability to develop comprehensive, testable requirements including edge cases, error handling, and failure modes, not just nominal behavior.

• Experience working cross-functionally with development and test teams in an agile or iterative development environment.

• Background in one or more of the following domains: embedded systems, wireless/IP communications, cloud software, user interface design, or robotics and autonomous systems.

Technical Skills

• Proficiency with requirements management tools such as Jama or equivalent; strong understanding of traceability best practices.

• Experience creating architecture artifacts such as block diagrams, interface definitions, and state and sequence diagrams; familiarity with MBSE tools (SysML or similar) is a plus.

• Working knowledge of communication protocols, including IP networking and radio communications (ISM, BLE, Wi-Fi, or similar).

• Familiarity with embedded systems and hardware-software integration.

• Experience conducting trade studies and documenting technical decisions.

• Preferred: knowledge of functional safety standards (IEC 61508, ISO 13849, or similar) and/or system safety (MIL-STD-882 or similar); experience supporting safety certifications or compliance efforts is a plus.

• Preferred: background in cybersecurity or secure-by-design development, such as threat modeling (STRIDE or similar), threat analysis and risk assessment (TARA), or standards such as IEC 62443 or EN 18031.

Competencies

• Methodical, detail-oriented approach to requirements; you close loops and don't leave ambiguity on the table.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate technical complexity into clear, precise requirement statements.

• Collaborative by nature, you build good working relationships with engineers and know how to facilitate productive cross-functional conversations.

• Comfortable working in a small team where you own your domain end-to-end.

• Able to work independently with a high degree of ownership: you take a broad assignment, drive it to completion, and use periodic reviews to align on direction.

• Willing to share knowledge with and support co-ops and early-career engineers on the team.

Education

• B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.

• Master’s degree in Systems Engineering preferred.

Work Style

• Remote, with travel to our Philadelphia office at least once per quarter.

What We're Looking For

• Someone who understands that good requirements are the foundation of good products and who takes that seriously.

• An engineer who can engage both development and test, ask the right questions, and drive alignment before work starts rather than after.

• A collaborator who earns trust with technical teams by being precise, responsive, and easy to work with.

• A self-starter who can take a broad assignment, run with it, and manage their own workload in an agile environment without losing track of the details.

• Familiarity with safety-critical or regulated systems is a strong differentiator; experience with functional safety certifications is particularly valued.

• Cybersecurity experience, particularly turning threat assessment findings into design mitigations, is a strong plus.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary range: $122,000–$165,000, based on experience and location.
Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited PTO; stock options; 3% 401(k) match, paid holidays, and parental leave.
Application window: Applications accepted through the end of December 2026. This date will be updated if the window is extended.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Payments
jobs.description:
ABOUT WARP

Warp is the AI-native Employee Management Platform for ambitious companies. HRIS, payroll, benefits, IT, tax compliance, and more, all built from scratch on one AI-native platform.

Every company runs on its people, and the software that manages them is some of the oldest in the enterprise. Incumbents like ADP and Workday built their businesses on complexity and large ops teams. Warp is built for AI to be the primary operator. Every advance in LLM capability widens our lead.

We process $X billion in annual payments for high-growth companies across all 50 US states + globally.

We've raised $85M from Battery Ventures, Sapphire Ventures, Peak XV, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher), and Y Combinator, alongside operators including Tobi Lütke (Shopify), Claire Hughes Johnson (Stripe), and the founders of Dropbox and Replit. Our team comes from MIT, Ramp, Brex, Google, Gusto, Rippling, and more.

We hire people who ship constantly, own outcomes, and care about craft. If you want to automate an entire category of work that every company depends on, this is the place.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Staff Software Engineer for Payments at Warp, you'll be the technical lead for the systems that move money for thousands of companies: payroll across all 50 US states and globally, tax payments to federal, state, and local agencies, contractor payouts, and the ledgers and reconciliation that make every dollar traceable. Warp runs payroll without asking customers to pre-fund, so correctness, timing, and recovery from failure are the whole job.

You'll own the technical direction for payments and lead a small pod of engineers building it with you. You've built money movement before, you've been the person accountable for its architecture and its failure modes, and you chose to keep building rather than move into people management. You'll work closely with the CTO.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the architecture and technical direction for money movement, ledgering, and reconciliation across Warp

 - Lead the design of payment rails and processor integrations (ACH, wires, real-time payments, card where it applies) and the idempotency, retry, and recovery logic around them

 - Design the systems that make payroll correct the first time: pre-run checks, balance and funding logic, tax remittance, and audit trails

 - Lead a pod of two to three engineers: set the technical bar, review their work, and grow them

 - Work directly with customers and the operations team to turn payment edge cases into product

 - Collaborate directly with the CTO and CEO on payments strategy

 - Help us scale 10x in the next year




YOU'LL BE GOOD FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have been the tech lead and primary decision maker on at least two meaningful payments, ledger, or financial infrastructure systems

 - Have built payment systems that moved real money at volume. Not just integrated a payments API.

 - Have seen a system grow from a few customers to thousands and know where the money gets lost along the way

 - Chose the technical track deliberately. You want to lead through architecture and code, not headcount.

 - Think in ledgers: double-entry, idempotency, reconciliation, and what happens when a processor returns something you didn't expect

 - Have strong opinions about the tools you use and can explain the trade-offs behind them

 - Get energized by domains where correctness matters more than demos




WHAT YOU NEED

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience, including leading technical efforts across a team

 - Experience building and operating payment, ledger, or money-movement systems in production

 - Familiarity with US payment rails (ACH, wires, RTP or FedNow) and the compliance requirements around them

 - Strong expertise in a modern, strongly typed language

 - Experience designing and operating reliable backend systems

 - Strong systems-level thinking and a correctness-first mindset

 - High agency and strong communication skills

 - Willingness to work from our NYC office five days a week


BENEFITS AT WARP: 

 - 100% Health Coverage: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents.

 - 401(k) Matching: Start investing in your future from day one.

 - Flexible PTO: We offer uncapped flexible PTO, meaning you’re trusted to take the time you need to recharge while balancing your responsibilities and team commitments.

 - Commuter Benefits: Pre-tax commuter benefits for your daily trip to our NYC office.

 - Catered Lunch Daily: Great food, every day, on us. No meal prep, no decision fatigue.

 - Quarterly Offsites: Beautiful locations to connect as a team. Past locations include Spain, Catskills, and San Francisco.

Warp is based in New York City, and most of our team works together in-office 5x per week. Please refer to the top of this page for this position's hiring location and working model.

jobs.title: Fleet Support Administrator (Palm Beach DJT Airport)
jobs.description:
Are you a people person with a passion for delivering premium experiences and keeping operations running like a well-oiled machine? As a Fleet Support Administrator at SIXT, you'll be the face of our brand, welcoming customers, guiding them through their rental journey, and ensuring every vehicle is ready for the road. From the moment a customer walks through the door to the moment they drive away, you'll play a vital role in making it seamless, professional, and memorable. Enjoy flexible hours, endless growth opportunities, and a starting salary of $18.50 per hour.

YOUR ROLE AT SIXT

• You welcome every customer with a professional, friendly attitude, directing them to appropriate stations and maintaining efficient flow while ensuring a clean, organized front-of-house presence that reflects SIXT's premium brand standards
• You verify customer documents, check driver's license validity, and assist customers in selecting the right vehicle while handling exchanges to meet business needs
• You offer additional products and services such as prepaid fuel and toll passes, address customer questions and concerns, and finalize rental agreements by confirming documents and explaining charges with accurate receipts
• You complete return transactions by inspecting rental vehicles for damage, fuel levels, and mileage, advising customers on final charges while discreetly handling findings and directing issues to appropriate channels
• You perform daily inventory checks, manage vehicle availability, coordinate with dealerships and body shops for repairs, and schedule maintenance while obtaining estimates and generating purchase orders
• You prepare new vehicles for rental by adding documentation, decals, and tags, enter them into the inventory system, oversee vehicle disposal preparation, and ensure personal belongings are removed from returned vehicles

YOUR SKILLS MATTER

• Customer Service You have at least 1 year of customer service experience, ideally with a background in sales, service, or hospitality, and a genuine passion for creating memorable guest experience
• Organization & Analysis You are highly organized with strong analytical abilities, capable of managing fleet inventory, repair schedules, work orders, and documentation while delivering data-driven insights
• Education & Licensing You hold a high school diploma or GED, are at least 18 years old, hold a valid driver's license with a clean driving record, and are authorized to work in the United States
• Technical Skills You possess basic computer navigation skills and are familiar with Microsoft Office applications such as Excel
• Communication & Teamwork You have excellent communication skills and thrive as a team player in a fast-paced environment, coordinating effectively across departments with a positive attitude
• Schedule Flexibility You can work up to 40 hours per week, including day or evening shifts and weekend shifts

WHAT WE OFFER

• Comprehensive Benefits Package Enjoy healthcare coverage (medical, dental, vision), life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and pet insurance, along with a 401k plan to secure your future
• Paid Time Off & Holidays Benefit from PTO, sick leave, and receive time and a half for working on public holidays
• Bonus Plan Take advantage of a bonus plan based on performance
• Employee Assistance Program Access support whenever needed through our Employee Assistance Program
• Exclusive Employee Rentals Benefit from employee-only rental rates, with family rental options and exclusive discounts for employees
• Uniform & Perks Receive a uniform with weekly dry cleaning, always ensuring a professional appearance

About us:

We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.3 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 360,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 100 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I, Agent Engineering (Remote Eligible)
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smart Assist is Smartsheet's AI agent for work management, used by enterprise customers to analyze, create, and act on their work. Agent Engineering owns the runtime layer behind it: the orchestrator, core sub-agents, memory, context management, and the MCP integration that ties it together. We are accountable for how the agent thinks, acts, and remembers in production.

We build the agent harness as a reusable platform so other teams can build, integrate, and evaluate agents on a shared foundation. We work four ways: harness engineering (tuning the agent loop for quality, latency, and cost), capability expansion (core agents, skills, and tools), platformizing (shared components and patterns), and keeping it running (on-call, security, cost, and access controls).

The role. You will own a significant part of the Smart Assist runtime (for example orchestration and agent loops, memory and context, long-running execution, or model readiness) and shape how agents are built on our harness through design reviews and guilds. You will make architecture calls, raise the bar for the team, and make it possible for other teams to build agents on the platform without us in the critical path.

You Will:

• Own the design and evolution of an area of the runtime, including trade-offs between model decisions at runtime and deterministic code, and between prompt/context fixes and structural ones.

• Lead harness engineering at depth: long-running and durable execution, checkpoints and persistent plans, inline and multi-agent patterns, memory architecture, model swaps, and cost and latency control at scale.

• Drive platformization: define the reusable components, shared libraries, intent routing, agent registry and integration patterns that let other teams build and integrate agents quickly, and drive adoption across teams.

• Shape the multi-agent architecture and the convergence of existing and new agents into one experience.

• Define how quality is measured and enforced: offline gating, online monitoring, and the prompt-analysis loop, working with AI Platform on the shared evals platform.

• Own operational excellence for Smart Assist: on-call health, post-incident reviews, security posture (including prompt injection and permission-aware access), cost control, and entitlement and access correctness.

• Lead through POCs and ambiguity: frame problems, run time-boxed experiments, write decisions down, and bring the team and partners along.

• Mentor SE I and II engineers through design and code review; help hire and onboard. Use AI tools in incident and on-call work, and show teammates how.

• Partner with the EM, PMs, AI Experiences, AI Platform, MCP, and external partners on roadmap and dependencies.

You Have:

• 5+ years building and operating production systems, with deep Python and strong system design (distributed systems, durable state and long-running workflows, APIs, data modeling).

• 2+ years building LLM agent systems in production, with real opinions from experience on context engineering, subagents, memory, tool design, async or deferred tools, and failure recovery.

• Track record of designing evals that gate releases and of attributing production failures to the right layer (model, prompt, tool contract, context, environment), using calibrated LLM judges and online behavioral signals.

• Experience building shared platforms or libraries that other teams adopt, and of influencing without authority.

• Experience with MCP and agent skills or tools at scale; familiarity with agent-to-agent and multi-agent patterns.

• Experience operating AI systems in production: observability, cost management, security and safety patterns (prompt injection mitigation, output validation, grounding, permission-aware retrieval).

• Fluency with AI-assisted development and a point of view on how it changes engineering practice.

• Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain trade-offs to executives and to engineers.

• Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis.

• Strong plus: model evaluation and swap tooling; Databricks or lakehouse data work; enterprise SaaS, permissions and entitlements; prior mentoring or tech-lead experience.

What success looks like:

• First 90 days: understand the runtime and its failure modes, ship a meaningful improvement in your area, and publish a design or decision doc the team adopts.

• First 6 months: deliver a measurable gain in reliability, latency, or cost per task in your area; land a reusable pattern or component adopted by at least one other team; and mentor at least one engineer to a visible growth step.

Why this role:

• You own how Smart Assist behaves in production, with real users and a measurable quality bar, not a supporting slot on someone else's roadmap.

• The problems are distinctive: enterprise-grade permissions and security, and one agent experience that works across a broad work-management product used by thousands of customers.

• You build the harness as a platform. Other teams build on what you create, so your work multiplies across the product.

• You work on the hard parts of production agents: long-running work, memory, context, and cost, on a team that values engineering rigor and diverse perspectives.

Current US Perks & Benefits:

• Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Identity & Access
jobs.description:
ABOUT WARP

Warp is the AI-native Employee Management Platform for ambitious companies. HRIS, payroll, benefits, IT, tax compliance, and more, all built from scratch on one AI-native platform.

Every company runs on its people, and the software that manages them is some of the oldest in the enterprise. Incumbents like ADP and Workday built their businesses on complexity and large ops teams. Warp is built for AI to be the primary operator. Every advance in LLM capability widens our lead.

We process $X billion in annual payments for high-growth companies across all 50 US states + globally.

We've raised $85M from Battery Ventures, Sapphire Ventures, Peak XV, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher), and Y Combinator, alongside operators including Tobi Lütke (Shopify), Claire Hughes Johnson (Stripe), and the founders of Dropbox and Replit. Our team comes from MIT, Ramp, Brex, Google, Gusto, Rippling, and more.

We hire people who ship constantly, own outcomes, and care about craft. If you want to automate an entire category of work that every company depends on, this is the place.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Staff Software Engineer for Identity & Access at Warp, you'll be the technical lead for the systems that control how thousands of companies manage who has access to what, on which devices, from day one of employment to the last. Authentication and authorization, role-based and attribute-based access control, application provisioning, and cross-platform MDM all sit in your area. It's high-stakes work that touches every part of the product.

You'll own the technical direction for this area and lead a small pod of engineers building it with you. You've done this before: you've been the person making the architecture calls on identity or access infrastructure that real customers depend on, and you chose to keep building rather than move into people management. You'll work closely with the CTO.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the architecture and technical direction for authentication and authorization across Warp's entire product

 - Design and lead the implementation of role-based and attribute-based access control systems that hold up as customers scale

 - Lead application provisioning and deprovisioning, automatically granting and revoking access as employees join, change roles, or leave

 - Own cross-platform MDM for macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android

 - Own the protocols that power it all: SAML, SCIM, OIDC, OAuth

 - Lead a pod of two to three engineers: set the technical bar, review their work, and grow them

 - Work directly with customers to define what automated IT management looks like at scale

 - Collaborate directly with the CTO and CEO on where identity and access go next

 - Help us scale 10x in the next year




YOU'LL BE GOOD FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have been the tech lead and primary decision maker on at least two meaningful identity, access, or security systems, and can explain the decisions you'd make differently now

 - Have built authentication or authorization systems. Not just configured them.

 - Have seen a system grow from a few customers to thousands and know what breaks along the way

 - Chose the technical track deliberately. You want to lead through architecture and code, not headcount.

 - Understand access control models (RBAC, ABAC) and how to implement them at scale

 - Have strong opinions about the tools you use and can explain the trade-offs behind them

 - Get energized by technically hard problems with serious security implications




WHAT YOU NEED

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience, including leading technical efforts across a team

 - Deep familiarity with identity protocols: SAML, SCIM, OIDC, OAuth

 - Experience building or owning MDM or cross-platform device management

 - Experience designing access control systems at scale

 - Strong expertise in a modern, strongly typed language

 - Experience designing and operating reliable backend systems

 - Strong systems-level thinking and a security-first mindset

 - High agency and strong communication skills

 - Willingness to work from our NYC office five days a week


BENEFITS AT WARP: 

 - 100% Health Coverage: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents.

 - 401(k) Matching: Start investing in your future from day one.

 - Flexible PTO: We offer uncapped flexible PTO, meaning you’re trusted to take the time you need to recharge while balancing your responsibilities and team commitments.

 - Commuter Benefits: Pre-tax commuter benefits for your daily trip to our NYC office.

 - Catered Lunch Daily: Great food, every day, on us. No meal prep, no decision fatigue.

 - Quarterly Offsites: Beautiful locations to connect as a team. Past locations include Spain, Catskills, and San Francisco.

Warp is based in New York City, and most of our team works together in-office 5x per week. Please refer to the top of this page for this position's hiring location and working model.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Agentic Computational Platform
jobs.location: Cambridge, MA USA; San Francisco, CA USA
jobs.description:
Your Impact at LILA

As Associate Director/Director of Agentic Computational Platform within the Physical Sciences AI division, you will lead and grow the team responsible for the software infrastructure that enables Lila's scientific superintelligence to autonomously construct, execute, and interpret complex physics-based simulations. Beyond your direct team, you will serve as a senior engineering leader across a broader portfolio of cross-disciplinary scientific computing efforts — coordinating strategy across workstreams that extend beyond your reporting structure and partnering closely with research and product leadership to bring Lila's scientific intelligence to customers at scale. This role requires both strong people leadership and the technical credibility to drive alignment and execution across a multi-team engineering portfolio.

What You'll Be Building

• Lead, hire, and develop a high-performing team of engineers and scientists; set the bar for technical excellence and foster a culture of collaboration and rapid iteration.

• Drive engineering strategy and coordination across a portfolio of cross-disciplinary scientific computing workstreams, including teams outside your direct organization; ensure coherent technical direction, shared standards, and well-sequenced delivery across the broader program.

• Define and own the technical vision and multi-quarter roadmap for your team's core platform capabilities, setting architectural direction for agentic frameworks, integration layers, and heterogeneous compute platforms — in close alignment with Physical Sciences AI research priorities and company goals.

• Build deep partnerships with AI research, platform, infrastructure, and software teams to translate scientific requirements into production-grade capabilities; serve as a primary point of engineering accountability for cross-team delivery and impact.

• Own execution across your direct team: prioritize projects, manage trade-offs, remove blockers, and ensure the team ships with high quality and velocity.

• Represent the broader engineering program to senior leadership and external collaborators; communicate technical strategy, cross-team progress, and business impact clearly.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, ML/AI, Scientific Computing, or a related technical field.

• Proven experience leading and growing engineering or research teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development.

• Track record of setting technical vision and delivering complex, multi-year platform or infrastructure initiatives in a fast-moving environment.

• Strong technical depth in ML-driven pipelines, agentic frameworks, or scientific workflow systems — enough to earn trust across teams, drive sound architectural decisions, and influence engineering direction across a multi-workstream program without direct authority over every contributor.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to operate effectively across research, engineering, and executive audiences.

Bonus Points For

• Experience leading teams building agentic frameworks, autonomous ML pipelines, or multi-step tool-using agents — particularly for scientific or computational applications — and scaling those teams from early-stage to mature, high-output organizations.

• Background in physics-based simulation infrastructure, large-scale scientific workflow orchestration, or automated computational experiment platforms; familiarity with the software and computational patterns that underpin atomistic, electronic structure, or surrogate-driven modeling workflows.

• Experience navigating the intersection of deep research and production engineering — knowing when to invest in infrastructure versus move fast.

• Familiarity with data-centric engineering practices: streaming systems, provenance tracking, distributed metadata services, or large-scale data orchestration.

• Sufficient depth in advanced ML techniques relevant to agentic reasoning (e.g., planning models, tool-using agents, RLHF/RLAIF workflows) to evaluate technical approaches and guide research-engineering tradeoffs.

• Familiarity with materials science simulation codes (VASP, LAMMPS) or workflow frameworks (atomate, aiida) is a plus.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range

$288,000—$480,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator II
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SUPPLY CHAIN

Rocket Lab’s Supply Chain team is responsible for the flow of all materials, products, and components through the business. With many of our own products functioning as critical components to our own and our customers’ missions, the Supply Chain team has a direct impact on the success of our rocket and satellite programs. They set up the assembly kits that enables our technicians to put together our Electron rockets, manage inventory, look after shipping and receiving, manage direct and indirect procurement, and inspect and ensure that all of our materials and products are compliant and up to standard. They are the chain that links our teams together, and are critical to our success.

PRODUCTION COORDINATOR II

Based onsite at Rocket Labs headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the Production Coordinator II follows up with production areas for updated status on open work orders, expedites deliveries where needed, and help resolve any blockers preventing on time delivery. The Production Coordinator is a key resources within the planning function, supporting production planners to ensure the timely delivery of fabricated materials from within our global production system.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Responsible for fulfilment within MRP for production work orders.

• Responsible for releasing kit requests to Inventory

• Responsible for supporting prioritization and expediting subassemblies to support integration timeline.

• Responsible for clearing blockers preventing production from completing production orders, including following up on issue tickets, part shortages, and yield loss.

• Work in a cross functional team environment as a strong team player and demonstrate ability to work with other functional groups to achieve company-wide goals.

• Other duties asked by your manager, relevant to your role

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

• High School Diploma and 2+ years of production experience in a high-paced manufacturing environment or equivalent years of education.

• Proficient using Microsoft products (Outlook, Excel, Word, Power Point, Access)

• Knowledge of MRP/ERP systems

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Bachelor’s degree in business or supply chain

• Proficient in MRP systems

• Team oriented, strong ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment and to multiple deadlines

• Proven ability to clearly communicate, manage work tasks, and provide status updates.

• Team oriented, strong ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment and to multiple deadlines

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize effectively and efficiently

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab. Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status, please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion.

Hourly Pay Range (CA Only)

$28—$34 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

jobs.title: Senior Multi-Media Designer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Goodway Group is an independent, 4th-generation family-owned connected commerce partner, helping retail, multi-location franchise, and CPG brands connect digital to in-store to drive incremental revenue. With a 90-plus-year history and a fully remote team of around 400 people across the United States and United Kingdom, we answer to our clients rather than shareholders.

We combine media, strategy, data, technology, and creative expertise to help brands grow through smarter, more effective marketing. Our clients include Bagel Brands, Publix, Benjamin Moore, and Unleashed Brands.

Goodway Group has been recognized as a multiyear Ad Age Best Place to Work, a Drum Awards winner, an AdExchanger award winner, and a certified service partner of The Trade Desk.

Who You Are:

The Senior Multimedia Designer is a highly conceptual, multidisciplinary creative within Goodway Group's Creative Intelligence Studio, specializing in motion graphics, video creation, and AI-powered creative production, with an exceptional foundation in graphic design and art direction.

This role develops original creative concepts and brings them to life across static, motion, and video formats, combining traditional design expertise with emerging AI technologies to deliver compelling, strategically informed creative.

As a senior individual contributor, this person takes ownership of creative development from concept through execution, establishes visual direction for assigned projects, and helps elevate the quality and capabilities of the broader team through mentorship and collaboration. The ideal candidate is an independent creative thinker who pairs strong visual storytelling and technical expertise with curiosity, experimentation, and a passion for pushing creative possibilities forward.

What You Will Do:

Concept Development & Creative Direction

• Independently develop original creative concepts and visual directions from briefs, audience insights, and business objectives, rather than relying solely on existing templates.

• Create visual territories, mood boards, storyboards, style frames, and design systems that guide static, motion, and video creative.

• Translate strategic ideas into compelling visual storytelling across channels and formats.

• Present concepts confidently, articulating creative rationale and alignment to client goals.

• Challenge conventional approaches and explore new creative techniques to make work more engaging, memorable, and effective.

Motion Graphics, Video & Multimedia Production

• Conceptualize, design, animate, and produce high-quality motion graphics and video creative for digital advertising, social media, and other campaign deliverables.

• Apply advanced motion design principles, including animation, timing, pacing, transitions, typography, and visual storytelling.

• Create and edit video content, combining motion graphics, footage, sound, and visual effects into cohesive creative experiences.

• Translate strong graphic design concepts into engaging motion and video executions.

• Maintain exceptional creative quality, brand consistency, and technical execution across formats, platforms, and deliverables.

Graphic Design & Visual Excellence

• Develop original, high-quality graphic design across digital advertising, social media, and campaign creative.

• Demonstrate exceptional design fundamentals, including typography, composition, layout, color theory, visual hierarchy, and brand expression.

• Establish cohesive visual systems and art direction that translate seamlessly across static, motion, and video formats.

• Apply strong design judgment and attention to detail to ensure creative work meets the highest standards of craft.

AI-Powered Creative Production & Innovation

• Leverage generative AI tools for image creation, video generation, animation, editing, and creative exploration.

• Combine AI-generated content with traditional design, motion, and video production techniques to produce polished, brand-appropriate creative.

• Experiment with emerging AI platforms and production technologies to expand creative possibilities and improve efficiency.

• Apply creative judgment to refine AI-generated outputs, ensuring visual quality, consistency, accuracy, and brand integrity.

• Collaborate with the Associate Creative Director to identify, test, and share AI-enhanced workflows that improve creative quality, speed, and scalability.

Creative Guidance & Mentorship

• Serve as a senior creative resource, providing guidance and mentorship to Interactive and Motion Graphics Designers.

• Offer constructive feedback that strengthens conceptual thinking, design execution, and technical capabilities.

• Share best practices, emerging techniques, and new creative tools that elevate the broader team's capabilities.

• Collaborate with the Associate Creative Director to maintain high standards of creative quality and consistency.

• Foster a collaborative, curious, and innovative creative environment.

Collaboration & Production Excellence

• Partner with the Associate Creative Director, Creative Strategy, copywriters, and production teams to develop integrated creative solutions.

• Collaborate with Media and other internal partners to ensure creative aligns with client objectives, audience needs, and channel requirements.

• Independently manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

• Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve production efficiency, and reduce unnecessary rework.

• Stay current on design trends, motion techniques, video production, and emerging creative technologies.

What You Bring:

• Extensive experience in multimedia design, with advanced capabilities in motion graphics, video production, graphic design, and art direction.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating original creative concepts, exceptional graphic design fundamentals, motion graphics, and finished video creative.

• Proven ability to independently develop and execute creative concepts from brief through final deliverables.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and Illustrator, as well as Figma.

• Hands-on experience using generative AI tools for image and video creation, with the ability to integrate AI-generated content into professional creative workflows.

• Strong understanding of animation principles, video editing, pacing, transitions, visual effects, and visual storytelling.

• Expert command of typography, composition, layout, color theory, visual hierarchy, and brand expression.

• Ability to establish cohesive visual direction across static, motion, and video deliverables.

• Experience mentoring designers and providing thoughtful creative direction and constructive feedback.

• Strong storytelling, presentation, communication, collaboration, and project-prioritization skills.

• Experience in an advertising, media, or creative agency, including paid social creative, performance-driven design, and multi-brand environments, preferred.

• Curiosity and adaptability, with a genuine passion for emerging creative technologies, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Additive Design Technician
jobs.description:
Job Opportunity: Additive Design Technician in Falls Church, VA

Do you enjoy turning digital designs into high-quality, finished products? Are you energized by hands-on problem-solving, advanced manufacturing, and the opportunity to help shape a growing production operation? If so, we would love to meet you!

As an Additive Design Technician, you will be at the center of the design and production process, operating and maintaining large-format robotic and FDM 3D printers, preparing print jobs, post-processing parts, and ensuring quality in every component produced. Reporting to the Design Director, you will work closely with design and engineering teams to translate design intent into finished, manufacturable products.

Salary range: $22-$30 per hour, based on experience.

Responsibilities:

• Operate, monitor, and maintain large-format robotic and FDM 3D printers for component-based production.

• Prepare 3D models in PrusaSlicer and other software, optimizing print settings, orientation, and toolpaths to balance surface finish, strength, and cycle time.

• Schedule and queue jobs across a fleet of printers to support continuous output and meet production demand.

• Manage pellet and filament inventory, load materials such as PLA and PETG, and track material utilization and print cycle times.

• Harvest and post-process printed parts through support removal, cleaning, sanding, and finishing.

• Assemble modular furniture components and verify fit, tolerances, connections, surface quality, color consistency, craftsmanship, and alignment with design intent.

• Troubleshoot printer issues and perform routine maintenance and calibration.

• Support rapid prototyping and design iterations by producing test prints, samples, and mockups and evaluating new materials, colors, and finishes.

• Maintain a sample library and fabricate jigs, fixtures, and other shop equipment as needed.

• Document production data, maintain a clean and safe workspace, and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.

• Collaborate with design and engineering teams to improve print quality, production efficiency, manufacturability, and the finished product.

Qualifications:

• Three years of experience in additive manufacturing, FDM printing, or a related production environment such as woodworking, metalworking, aerospace, CNC, a model shop, or prototyping.

• Comfort operating hand tools, power tools, and fabrication equipment.

• Familiarity with PrusaSlicer and 3D modeling in Fusion 360 is a plus.

• Experience with networked, PC-based computer systems, including Microsoft Office and ERP systems.

• Strong mechanical aptitude and hands-on problem-solving skills.

• Understanding of industrial design principles and how form, function, materials, and manufacturability come together in a finished product.

• A background in industrial design, product design, or a related field is a plus.

• Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment.

• Detail-oriented, dependable, and committed to quality and safety.

Physical Demands:

• Regular movement between production areas, assembly stations, shipping and receiving.

• Standing or walking for extended periods, up to eight hours per day.

• Regular lifting of materials and equipment weighing 25-50 pounds.

• Exposure to noise, dust, and varying temperatures typical of an industrial environment.

• Use required PPE, including safety glasses, gloves, and hearing protection.

What We Offer:

• Comprehensive healthcare benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.

• Competitive paid time off plans.

• Competitive retirement plans.

Why Join Formative 3D?

We are a 3D-printing startup on a mission to change the built environment, starting with furniture. By leveraging large-format and FDM additive manufacturing, we are building sustainable, scalable, component-based furniture systems.

As we are launching our new production facility, we are looking for passionate, dependable, and hands-on team members to help produce our first product and grow the business. Join us to build your technical skills, influence how our systems evolve, and contribute to a new approach to design and manufacturing.

Apply online today to join a team building the future of furniture manufacturing.

Formative 3D is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to hiring and developing the most qualified individuals based on job-related experience, skills, and merit. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We value a respectful, inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. Formative 3D maintains a drug-free workplace consistent with applicable local, state, and federal laws.

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer, Incident Response
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Senior Security Operations Engineer of Incident Response, you will be a hands-on responder, leading the investigation, containment, and remediation of security incidents across our environment. Outside of active incidents, you’ll build and tune detections, automate triage and response workflows, and improve the tooling and runbooks the team relies on. You’ll work closely with SOC operations to improve the quality of our alerts, partner with teams across the company during investigations, and help shape the roadmap for the Security Incident Response Team. Your work will directly protect Roblox’s platform, developers, and millions of users.

You will:

• Respond to security incidents: Investigate, contain, and remediate incidents from start to finish. Serve as Incident Commander for high-severity events.

• Build and tune detections: Write new detections and improve existing ones based on threat intelligence, incident findings, and coverage gaps. Work with SOC operations to reduce noise and make alerts more accurate.

• Automate response: Find manual, repetitive work in triage and response, and automate it with SOAR and custom tooling.

• Threat hunt: Run hypothesis-driven hunts informed by threat intelligence, and turn what you find into new detections.

• Improve process and documentation: Write and maintain runbooks, response plans, and workflows so the team responds consistently.

• Learn from incidents: Run blameless post-incident reviews and tabletop exercises, and turn lessons learned into concrete improvements.

• Partner across the company and grow the team: Work with Legal, Privacy, Comms, HR, and Engineering during incidents and on response planning. Mentor teammates and help shape the SIRT roadmap.

You have:

• Experience: 5+ years of experience across Infosec, IT, Infra/SRE, and/or Incident Response.

• Investigation skills: Hands-on experience investigating incidents across endpoints, cloud, and network, including log analysis and forensic triage.

• Incident command: You’ve led high-severity incidents, stayed calm under pressure, and kept stakeholders (including leadership) clearly informed.

• Detection engineering: Experience writing and tuning detections in a SIEM, with a focus on reducing noise and improving signal.

• Automation: Comfortable scripting (e.g., Python) and building automated response workflows with SOAR or similar tools.

• Security tooling: Deep hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, and SOAR.

• Frameworks: Working knowledge of IR frameworks (NIST, SANS) and threat frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain), and you know how to apply them in your day-to-day work.

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred or equivalent experience.

jobs.description:
Regional Vice President, Biddable

Location: Remote, United States

About Doximity

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Our Pharma sales team is a variety of individuals with diverse backgrounds, all committed to our goal of helping our clients bring their important messaging to the healthcare professionals on our platform. We are launching a biddable platform in January, 2027 and will have a new go-to-market team to work closely with our sales teams and clients. We look for individuals who face challenges head on and are highly motivated to exceed sales goals. Presentation, communication, and closing skills are essential to be successful in this role.

As a Regional Vice President:

• Develop expertise and sell biddable ad products

• Support our clients by developing strategies that help brand product teams and marketing agencies make informed decisions through a consultative sales approach

• Make data informed decisions through forecasting and business analytical skills to identify opportunities and reach goals

• Build relationships and trust with agency and brand decision-makers

Location: This role is Remote, in the United States and will require travel to client meetings.

What We're Looking For

We're excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications:

• Programmatic and HCP healthcare sales experience (required). You have sold programmatic or biddable media to pharma brands and health agencies, and you know how HCP audiences are targeted and measured.

• Auction-savvy. You can explain bids, budgets, pacing, and cost per engagement to a brand team, and you can coach a client from fixed guarantees toward performance-based buying.

jobs.title: Senior IT Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, we're Brigit! A holistic financial health company helping everyday Americans build a brighter financial future. With a business model that is aligned with our customers, we create transparent, fair, and simple financial products that put money back in the hands of our members, help them spend wisely, avoid unfair fees and build their credit quickly. If autonomy, ownership, and having meaningful input at the company you work for is important to you, come join our growing team!



Brigit is doing innovative and exciting work, but don’t just take our word for it, our work is being recognized by others:

 - Built In's 2026 Best Midsize Companies to Work For in New York City https://builtin.com/awards/new-york-city/2026/best-midsize-places-to-work#brigit

 - Built In's 2025 Best Places to Work For In New York City https://builtin.com/awards/new-york-city/2025/best-places-to-work#brigit
