jobs.title: Talent Manager - Creators & Content ($200k - $400k)
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY

Baton Corporation is the development company that builds and operates the entire technology stack behind pump.fun http://pump.fun, the largest memecoin launchpad in production today. The systems are low latency, high throughput, live under constant load, and break if you get them wrong.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for someone who’s well connected with creators and streamers, and knows how to turn those relationships into great partnerships and content.

You’ll be a day-to-day point of contact for creators we work with, while also finding new people we should know. You’ll help identify and shape the right opportunities, negotiate deals, develop ideas with creators, and coordinate the people and details needed to make them happen.

This role would suit someone who understands creators and live content from the inside. You might have worked at Kick, Twitch, an online casino, a prediction market, a gaming organisation, a content-heavy production company or a talent agency.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Manage day-to-day relationships with creators and streamers we have deals with, becoming someone they trust and want to work with.

 - Use your network to connect with creators, streamers and their teams, and identify new people we should work with.

 - Find and shape partnership opportunities that make sense for each creator, their audience and pump.fun http://pump.fun.

 - Help put deals together, including discussing terms, negotiating with creators or their representatives, and seeing agreements through to execution.

 - Develop content and streaming ideas with creators, then coordinate plans, schedules, appearances and deliverables across everyone involved.

 - Keep a clear view of what’s been agreed, what’s coming up and where someone needs help to get a project over the line.

 - Handle the unexpected calmly, whether that means a last-minute change to a stream, a new opportunity or a problem that needs sorting quickly.

 - Travel regularly to meet creators, attend events and support projects in person.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience working directly with streamers, creators or other public-facing online talent.

 - An established network of creators and a good sense of who’s emerging, who has a genuine audience and who would be a strong fit for us.

 - Experience sourcing, shaping and negotiating creator or talent deals.

 - A strong feel for live content, internet culture and what makes a creator’s audience engage.

 - Excellent relationship skills: you can build trust while being clear about commitments and deadlines.

 - Creative instincts and the practical ability to turn an idea into something that goes live.

 - Good judgement, organisation and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment.

 - Willingness to travel frequently.

You don’t need crypto experience. What matters more is that you understand creators, know how to work with them and can learn our product and community quickly.

jobs.title: Sr EHR Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Implementation Manager (IM) owns the delivery timeline and customer communication for

EHR implementations, from intake through go-live and hypercare, and keeps each project on

the agreed go-live date. The IM also acts as a trusted advisor to everyone involved in the

implementation, including the customer, internal teams, and EHR vendors, offering guidance,

setting clear expectations, and helping each group make informed decisions. The IM

coordinates the work, tracks progress, and ensures documentation and handoffs are complete.

The IM is not the analyst, but knows the build and its tasks well enough to keep delivery

smooth.

Key Responsibilities

Trusted Advisor

• Serve as a trusted advisor to the customer, internal teams, and EHR vendors throughout

the implementation

• Offer clear guidance and honest, timely input so each group can make informed decisions

• Build strong working relationships that keep everyone aligned and confident in the plan

Project Ownership & Execution

• Lead coordination of EHR projects from intake through go-live and hypercare

• Ensure projects are properly opened, scoped, and supported by a formal project plan

(timeline, milestones, resources, deliverables)

• Manage day-to-day execution, track progress, and drive adherence to timelines

Stakeholder Coordination

• Identify and align internal (Sales, Operations) and external (clients, EHR vendors)

stakeholders

• Ensure roles, responsibilities, and expectations are clearly defined, documented, and

agreed upon

• Maintain accountability across teams to ensure tasks are completed accurately and on

time

Communication & Documentation

• Serve as primary communication lead across all stakeholders

• Facilitate project meetings, status updates, and follow-ups

• Maintain clear, organized, and accessible documentation, including project plans, meeting

notes, and action items

Delivery & Compliance

Implementation Manager Job Description | Page 2

• Coordinate requirements gathering, workflow alignment, and build activities with client and

vendors

• Oversee testing execution, issue tracking, and formal validation/sign-off

• Ensure completion of go-live readiness checklists and required documentation

• Maintain accurate updates across all required internal systems

Post-Go-Live Support

• Coordinate go-live execution and hypercare (PLM) support

• Track and drive resolution of post-launch issues

• Ensure proper project closure, documentation completion, and handoff as needed

Project Lifecycle Duties

Across each phase of an implementation, the IM is responsible for the following.

Project Setup

• Prepare the project workspace, trackers, and templates once resources are aligned

• Align with internal teams on technical kick-off logistics

• Open the project in Salesforce, introduce yourself to the customer, and schedule the

technical kick-off

Technical Kick-Off and Implementation

• Set expectations with the customer and share the implementation plan

• Run regular check-ins, coordinate build calls, and track progress against the plan

• Stay aligned with the analyst on the go-live date and familiar with the build, without taking

on the analyst’s work

• Prepare the customer for testing

Technical Sign-Off and Training

• Lead the internal technical sign-off before training begins

• Coordinate training with the Training team and confirm go-live readiness

Go-Live and Hypercare

• Coordinate the production cutover and go-live support

• Track milestones and issues, and keep the client informed through hypercare

• Keep project information up to date in internal systems

Project Close-Out

• Hand the project off to long-term support and close out the project

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$128,400—$160,500 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. jobs.title: Director of Performance Marketing - Eataly Corporate
jobs.description:
The Director of Performance Marketing leads the strategy, execution, and optimization of Eataly’s integrated performance marketing across digital, CRM, and regional offline channels. Reporting to the VP, Marketing, this role drives measurable growth across e-commerce, in-store traffic, restaurant reservations, and events, connecting guests with Eataly at every touchpoint while supporting the brand’s positioning.

Core Responsibilities

• Strategy & Budget. Set the full-funnel performance strategy against three outcomes: eataly.com traffic and revenue, store visits, and restaurant and event reservations. Define each channel’s role, KPIs, and targets so they ladder up to company revenue goals. Own the full media budget across digital and offline, reallocating continuously based on performance.
• Digital Media. Manage all digital media and serve as the hands-on expert for Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Shopping), Delivery Apps (e.g., OpenTable), and Meta. Build and maintain paid media, publisher, and creator partnerships.
• Local & Regional Marketing. Own the marketing that brings guests into each Eataly location. Plan and buy regional offline media (e.g., out-of-home, radio, print, direct mail, local partnerships) alongside location-level digital such as local search, Google Business Profile, local inventory ads, and geo-targeted social. Partner with store and restaurant leadership to tailor plans to each market.
• CRM & Lifecycle. Own email, SMS, and loyalty strategy to grow repeat visits and customer lifetime value. Build segmentation and personalized journeys that connect online, in-store, and restaurant behavior.
• Campaign Execution. Lead campaigns end to end, from sales promotions and store openings to seasonal moments and company-wide initiatives. Keep concurrent projects aligned across channels and optimize every conversion path, from ad to purchase, store visit, and booked table.
• Measurement & Optimization. Build the function’s measurement framework, including attribution, incrementality and geo-lift testing, and marketing mix modeling where appropriate. Spot performance risks and growth opportunities early and deliver clear dashboards and insights to leadership. Run a disciplined testing roadmap that brings emerging channels (such as TikTok and Programmatic) and best practices into the program.
• Governance & Leadership. Define processes for brand safety, ad compliance, and campaign quality control. Manage agency and platform partners, and lead and develop a team of channel specialists.
• All other job duties as required or assigned.

• 8+ years in performance, digital, or growth marketing, including 3+ years leading teams, managing agencies, and driving cross-functional initiatives.
• Proven track record building integrated performance strategies and managing multimillion-dollar media budgets, ideally across multiple locations in retail, hospitality, restaurants, or e-commerce.
• Advanced, hands-on expertise in Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Shopping) and Meta Ads Manager, plus experience with paid social, programmatic, TikTok, publisher, and creator channels.
• Strong grasp of CRM and lifecycle marketing: email and SMS platforms, segmentation, customer journeys, and loyalty programs.
• Experience planning and measuring regional offline campaigns (out-of-home, radio, print, direct mail, local partnerships).
• Advanced analytical skills with GA4, attribution, incrementality testing, and BI tools such as Looker, and the ability to turn data into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
• Experience with OpenTable or similar reservation platforms, including using reservation data to drive guest acquisition and marketing preferred
• Experience with retail media, TikTok Shop, and Amazon preferred.
• Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Bachelor's degree in marketing, Business, Analytics, or related field, or equivalent experience.
• A genuine passion for food and curiosity about Italian cuisine, culture, and the Eataly experience.
• Ability and interest in working in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment

How We’ll Measure Success

Growth in e-commerce revenue, store traffic, restaurant and event reservations, and overall return on ad spend.

Annual Salary Range: $165,000 - $175,000

Eataly is an equal employment opportunity employer. It is the Company’s policy to not unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic made unlawful to consider by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Eataly also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also Eataly’s policy to comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws regarding consideration of unemployment status, salary history, credit/bankruptcy history and criminal background/conviction history in making hiring decisions.  If contacted for an employment opportunity, please advise Human Resources if you require accommodation.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - SaaS Industrials
jobs.description:
Come join a company who is a key leader in the industry scaling the next core commerce infrastructure and on the path from $100M to $500M! Founded in 2012, Salsify helps brand manufacturers, distributors, and retailers in over 80 countries collaborate to win on the digital shelf. As the market leader globally, our products are shopper-centric, frictionless, and create memorable commerce experiences. Our products provide a competitive edge through experiences that improve brand trust, amplify product differentiation and assortments, increase conversion rate, improve profit margins, and speed time to market.

Learn how the world’s largest brands, including Mars, L'Oreal, Coca-Cola, Bosch, and GSK, as well as retailers and distributors such as E.Leclerc, Carrefour, Metro, and Intermarché use Salsify everyday to stand out on the digital shelf.

At Salsify, we strive to embody an equitable, diverse, and inclusive company culture. We are united across countries, levels, tenures, and a host of other dimensions of diversity. We understand that while work is just one aspect of who we are, a truly inclusive culture accounts for the full authenticity of every single human being that works here.

About the Opportunity

Salsify is an award-winning Intelligent PXM platform that turns product data from an operational burden into a competitive advantage. Industrial manufacturers and distributors use it to centralize fragmented data, eliminate manual work with automated workflows and AI, and syndicate accurate product content everywhere their buyers and channel partners need it.

Salsify is rapidly expanding into the B2B industrials market and looking for a Senior Account Executive, New Business to hunt, win, and grow net-new accounts among industrial manufacturers and distributors. This is a pure new-business role: you own prospecting and closing, not renewals or expansion. Manufacturers and distributors in this space buy through relationships and trust as much as through product fit, so this role also requires real standing in the market: existing relationships with manufacturers, distributors, ISVs, SIs, or industry associations, and the credibility to open doors a cold call can't.

We've found that the most successful Senior Account Executives are masterful storytellers who can weave a complex solution into a simple one to connect with manufacturers and distributors and show them how to put their product data to work as eCommerce and AI reshapes how their buyers search, evaluate, and purchase.

What you'll do

• Prospect, engage, and close net-new accounts across industrial manufacturing and distribution (target account band: $50M–$2B in revenue — placeholder, confirm before posting)

• Build and use existing relationships with manufacturers, distributors, ISVs, SIs, and industry contacts to source and accelerate pipeline

• Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying groups across IT, product/MDM, marketing, and eCommerce

• Position Salsify's PIM and Intelligent PXM platform as a mission-critical system, not a point tool

• Run a disciplined sales process with accurate pipeline forecasting

• Partner with Solutions Consulting and Marketing to bring in named customer proof and industry credibility during the sales cycle

• Travel required (~25%) for industry events, trade shows, and prospect meetings

What you bring

• 5+ years exceeding quota in a SaaS focused closing role

• Enterprise SaaS sales experience to industrials or manufacturing customers

• Prior experience in industrial manufacturing, distribution, or a closely adjacent B2B vertical, with real relationships in that market (manufacturers, distributors, ISVs, or SIs)

• Proven track record of net-new logo acquisition (not account growth)

• Comfort with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles (this is not a transactional sale)

• Strong solution-selling background; MEDDIC or similar methodology a plus

• Hunter mentality, paired with the patience to work a market that is still educating itself on PIM

• Ability to travel up to 25% -Travel is a regular occurrence in this role for customer visits, executive relationship building, partner engagement and active participation in industry events. At events, the focus is to generate meetings and advance opportunities. We aim to maintain a strong physical presence in the market.

#LI-AS1 #LI-Remote

At Salsify, we maintain 3 core principles as part of our Compensation Philosophy:

• We pay market rates, which are competitive and equitable

• We pay based on performance and proficiency, not tenure

• We adjust proactively; when the market moves, we do too

The posted compensation range reflects the base salary for this position. In addition to base salary, some eligible roles may also have a commission plan or a bonus incentive. All full-time employees are invited to participate in our Total Rewards plan, which includes health & medical benefits, flexible spending accounts, flexible PTO, and more. Offers to join Salsify are based on a few criteria, including the scope of the role, the candidate’s work experience, targeted skills, internal equity of the team, and external market data.

US National Pay Range

$102,000—$120,000 USD

Salsify loves a good success story and it would be our privilege to help write yours! We recognize that talent and potential come in all forms and that years of experience does not guarantee on-the-job effectiveness or leadership potential. Our hiring process involves recognizing a person’s achievements, subject matter expertise, and passion, not just check marks next to a job description. If you have an interest in our roles please do not hesitate to apply - we would be happy to speak with you!

A member of Talent 'talent@salsify.com' will be reaching out about next steps if we would like to move forward.

Salsify’s mission is to empower brand manufacturers to win on the digital shelf.

Helping brand manufacturers to win online is what we do. Our culture is who we are. We are empowered. We are positive thinkers. We take action. We care deeply. These values have driven Salsify’s growth and earned the company numerous top workplace awards.

We are headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts and have hubs in Lisbon (Portugal) and Sydney (Australia). If you are excited to work in a fast-paced environment with a team that values agility, curiosity and passion, we want to hear from you!

As part of the hiring process, we may be conducting reference checks with your provided contacts.

Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for information on the personal data we process in connection with your application.

An Inclusive Place To Work

Salsify does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Studies have found that people of color and women do not apply to jobs if they do not meet all the requirements. At Salsify we are committed to empowering a diverse workforce. We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Accommodations

Salsify is committed to an inclusive hiring process, and we aim to provide accommodations for persons with disabilities. If you need any accommodations for the application or throughout the interview process please contact cx@salsify.com.

We take your security seriously. When applying for a position with us, please be aware of the following:

Official Communication Channels

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Platform
jobs.description:
Ambrook helps American family-run businesses become more profitable and resilient.
From volatile markets to climate shifts, independent operators face mounting pressure. While sustainable investments often yield the best long-term returns, they require financial clarity and capital that fragmented legacy systems can’t provide.

We are rebuilding the financial infrastructure that real economy operators rely on. By replacing paperwork with modern tools for accounting, banking, and spending, Ambrook gives owners the data they need to prove viability to lenders and the next generation. We empower the stewards of land and labor to make confident investments in their future.

We’re a Series B startup backed by Lachy Groom, Thrive Capital, Dylan Field, Thomson Reuters Ventures, Cameron Ventures, and leaders at Notion, Gusto, and Vercel. We’re looking for team members to help us untangle the intersection of American industry, climate, and the economy.

The opportunity

Ambrook’s AI Platform engineers build the shared systems that make everyone at Ambrook faster: engineers, operators, and the teams shipping AI to our customers. You’ll own two closely linked areas:

 - AI platform: the frameworks, evals, harnesses, sandboxes, tool integrations, and interfaces that let any team build, deploy, and operate agents with confidence.

 - Internal tooling: the environments, workflows, and internal products that shape how Ambrook's commercial team runs the business.

We’re working toward a world where any team can request an agent, deploy it, run evals against it, and see the results on a dashboard. Getting there means solving hard problems:

 - how agents get safe, auditable access to tools and data

 - how can we share these tools safely and securely, with auditable access

 - how can we publish custom apps or agents to share with customers

 - how we know whether a change made an agent better or worse

 - how we trace and debug what an agent did

 - how coding agents and engineers work well together in our codebase

 - how we keep cost, latency, and reliability in check as usage grows

This is engineering work, not IT. You’ll treat the people who use what you build as customers: learn how they work, iterate quickly from real feedback, and hold the quality, security, and data-integrity standards a financial product requires. Our stack is mostly TypeScript on GCP.

You’ll decide which problems are worth solving, define the patterns other teams follow, and change how the whole company works.

Within 1 month you’ll…

 - Build a working mental model of how Ambrook builds software and uses AI today: internal agent workflows, customer-facing agentic features, developer workflows and tooling, and where each breaks down.

 - Build relationships with non-engineering teams to learn where friction slows them down, and where agents could remove it.

 - Ship a meaningful improvement to production that makes it faster, safer, or easier to build software or run an agent at Ambrook.

 - Turn those conversations into a prioritized view of the biggest platform opportunities.

Within 3 months you’ll…

 - Own a platform project from discovery through rollout and adoption, such as an agent configuration interface, a shared evaluation system, a sandboxed harness for running agent loops, or a major developer workflow improvement.

 - Stand up a repeatable way to evaluate agents, so teams measure quality before and after a change instead of relying on spot checks.

 - Give agent runs real observability, including tracing, cost, latency, and failure visibility, so teams can debug and improve what they ship.

 - Set the defaults for how agents at Ambrook get context, permissions, and review, and get other teams to adopt them.

Within 6 months you’ll…

 - Own the roadmap for AI platform and developer experience, informed by internal customer needs, where the field is heading, and Ambrook’s standards for quality, security, and auditability.

 - Expand shared infrastructure that supports both internal workflows and customer-facing agentic features, including reusable evals, harnesses, sandboxes, tool integrations, and operational tooling.

 - Make it possible for a team outside engineering to request, deploy, and evaluate an agent with minimal help.

 - Show a measurable change in how Ambrook builds, such as engineering velocity, agent quality, or hours given back to operational teams.

 - Raise the bar for how Ambrook ships AI, internal tools, and customer-facing prototypes through clear design, mentorship, and production ownership.

 

About you

 - You have senior or staff-level experience building production systems that other engineers and teams depend on, and you’ve worked hands-on with LLMs in production.

 - You’ve built infrastructure for agentic systems, such as evals, agent loops, harnesses, sandboxes, or tool integrations, not only individual agents.

 - You care about developer experience and have improved how a team builds, tests, or ships software.

 - You think rigorously about measuring AI quality and understand the limits of evals, LLM-as-judge, and offline testing.

 - You treat internal teams as customers. You learn how they work, build with empathy, and measure success by adoption.

 - You can move quickly while holding the reliability and quality standards that shared infrastructure requires.

 - You’re security-minded and treat agent permissions, data access, prompt injection, auditability, and failure modes as part of ordinary engineering work.

 - Bonus: Experience with coding agents in a production codebase, tool protocols like MCP, or running untrusted code in sandboxes.

 - Bonus: Experience building financial products or systems where auditability and data integrity matter.
   
    

Our values

 - Real Talk – We create space for ourselves and others to be straightforward, vulnerable, and accountable.

 - Reach Understanding – We are driven by curiosity and empathy to learn about our customers, team, and world.

 - Be Proactively Resourceful – We are internally motivated and externally empowered to identify opportunities and solve problems.

 - Derisk Thoughtfully – We lean into the biggest risks we face as a company and put in the work to address them systematically.

 - Find the Positive-Sum – We believe in creating incentive structures that align the needs of our company, our customers, and our planet.

Benefits

 - Competitive salary

 - Health insurance

 - 401(k) with matching contribution

 - Flexible vacation time

 - Flexible work hours

 - Work-from-home/remote office stipend, or desk at Ambrook’s NYC office or Denver office

 - Wellness stipend

 - Professional development stipend

Our values

jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview 

Red 6 is an innovative Augmented Reality (AR) technology startup leading the way in synthetic air combat training. Our primary technology, supporting our ATARS product, enables pilots to simulate the cognitive challenges of flying while accessing realistic, scalable training in dynamic outdoor environments.

PRINCIPAL ELECTRICAL ENGINEER

Designing next-gen gaming for fighter pilots. Except the jet is real, the G's are real, and the mission is real.

Red 6 is a startup doing something that's never been done: bringing fully immersive 3D synthetic worlds into real aircraft in real flight. Pilots see the actual sky around them, with realistic adversaries, wingmen, terrain, and tankers layered into their view in real time. It replaces decades-old training methods that depend on costly live aircraft or ground simulators. Warfighters get more realistic, repeatable training at a fraction of the cost, and they show up to the fight better prepared.

First-generation hardware got people’s attention. Check it out for yourself The Official Red 6 Newsroom. https://red6ar.com/newsroom/ Now we need you to take it to the next level. We're not handing you an architecture to maintain. We're asking you to define it, and your decisions shape this product and everything that follows as Red 6 grows.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - A technically challenging electrical architecture, from a blank page. You'll lead the creation of next generation real-time hardware for a first-of-its-kind airborne augmented reality system.

 - The full lifecycle. You'll take hardware from requirements through prototype, qualification to MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-810, and manufacturing, then see it fly.

 - As for technical decisions, you get to innovate, run the trade studies, prototype the options, and influence the final design.

 - On the program side You shape proposals, budgets, and schedules alongside systems, optics, software, and flight test teams.

 - The team. You'll mentor engineers and build the standards and best practices for an EE group that's still taking shape.

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

 - You define the product. Your voice carries real weight in what first-generation hardware becomes.

 - Your work matters to warfighters. It directly improves how they prepare for real-world missions.

 - Your hardware flies. It goes into real aircraft, built with startup speed and defense-grade rigor.

 - You're in early at a company poised to grow and be a leader in the industry.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - A BS in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field.

 - Roughly 12+ years developing complex electrical systems for aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability applications, or an equivalent mix of education and experience.

 - 5+ years leading electrical architecture for complex airborne or mission-critical systems.

 - Deep expertise in subsystem electrical architecture, mission systems integration, and real-time embedded hardware.

 - Hands-on experience defining electrical interfaces, power architectures, integration strategies, PCBA and flex circuit designs.

 - A track record designing to military environmental and safety standards, specifically MIL-STD-461 (EMI/EMC) and MIL-STD-810 (environments).

 - Experience leading trade studies, architecture reviews, and multidisciplinary teams through tough engineering problems.

 - Comfort in the lab with oscilloscopes, power supplies, and spectrum analyzers.

 - The ability to plan, track, and communicate design work against cost and schedule.

 - Strong communication skills and a leadership style that makes engineers around you better.

 - U.S. citizenship, and the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance.

IDEAL IF YOU HAVE

 - Hands on military flight hardware development experience, especially taking hardware through qualification and airworthiness and into flight on military aircraft.

 - An MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering.

 - Experience with FPGAs, SoCs, SOMs, GPUs, displays, sensors, and test systems.

 - PCBA design and simulation experience with Altium.

 - High-speed design experience with DDR3/DDR4, PCIe 3.0/4.0, DisplayPort, USB 3.0, Ethernet, VPX, and rugged computing systems.

 - Knowledge of avionics protocols like MIL-STD-1553, ARINC 429, CAN, or other deterministic architectures.

 - Systems engineering ISO/IEEE 15288 and product development lifecycles experience.

 - Comfortable leading cross functional teams solving hard problems and mentoring staff.

 - Work with a sense of urgency and confidence; and take personal responsibility and commitment for completing tasks on time in the highest quality manner.

Estimated Base Salary Range:

$170,000 to $250,000 dependent on skills and experience



Full-Time Employee Benefits

 - Healthcare, Dental, and Vision (100% coverage for Employees)

 - Paid time off, including vacation, sick, paid holidays, and parental leave

 - Short and Long-Term Disability

 - Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

 - 401(k) Retirement Plan

 - Voluntary Worksite Benefits (Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity)

 - May be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance, subject to plan terms.

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
ABOUT CARTESIA

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.



About the Role

We’re looking for a Commercial Counsel to be Cartesia’s legal partner behind our enterprise customer and strategic partnership agreements. As our sole in-house counsel, you’ll work directly with our founders and with the GTM team, who own our customer and partner relationships.

Your focus is the legal side of each deal, from drafting and redlining to negotiating terms, along with building the contracting process the company will use as it grows. Beyond GTM deals, you’ll handle our vendor and marketing contracts and field legal questions across product, privacy, and corporate matters, bringing in outside counsel where it makes sense. Priorities shift quickly here, most processes are still being built, and our founders move fast and expect clear, confident recommendations.



Your Impact

 - Own the legal terms of enterprise customer agreements and strategic partnership deals from first draft to signature, balancing what the business needs with the risk we’re willing to take

 - Work directly with Sales, Partnerships, and executive stakeholders to unblock deals, find workable terms, and explain legal trade-offs in plain language

 - Assess legal and commercial risk on live deals, separate what is material from what is manageable, and escalate the right things to the right people

 - Own the data, privacy, and security terms in our agreements, including DPAs, BAAs, security exhibits, and security questionnaires, so our commitments on data use, retention, deletion, and incident response match how the product works

 - Set Cartesia’s commercial positions on AI and voice issues, including model training, output ownership, voice rights, and speaker consent, and help Sales navigate deals with regulated customers such as healthcare

 - Build out the contracting foundation: templates, negotiation playbooks with clear fallback positions, a simple intake path, and an approval process that lets routine deals move without you, extending to vendor, procurement, and marketing agreements

 - Manage outside counsel, decide what to build, buy, or send out, and set a practical roadmap for the legal function



What You Bring

 - J.D. from an accredited law school and active bar membership (California strongly preferred)

 - 7+ years of legal experience, with a mix of experience at a top-tier law firm and in-house experience at a B2B software, API, or tech infrastructure company

 - Deep experience negotiating enterprise customer agreements, including on customer paper, with the judgment to lead the legal side of those negotiations independently

 - Experience with complex strategic partnership, reseller, or integration agreements, including deals that didn’t fit a standard template

 - Working knowledge of privacy and data protection as it shows up in commercial deals, including GDPR and CCPA, and experience negotiating DPAs and security terms with enterprise customers

 - A record of building templates, playbooks, or contracting processes where little existed

 - Sound judgment about risk: you can tell a deal-breaking clause from a nuisance and explain the difference to a business leader quickly

 - A pragmatic, collaborative style with GTM teams. You want to help close deals, and you say no clearly when you have to

 - Confidence working directly with founders and executives. You give a clear recommendation, explain the reasoning to people who aren’t lawyers, hold your position when it matters, and earn trust through judgment rather than legal authority

 - Comfort with technical products. You can ask Engineering how data moves through a system and turn the answer into contract language

 - Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities. You set your own priorities, adjust quickly when the business changes, and do the drafting and negotiating yourself

 - Interest in building the legal function and growing in scope and responsibility over time



Nice to Have

 - Experience negotiating with regulated customers in healthcare, financial services, or government, including HIPAA business associate agreements

 - Experience with voice, speech, or other audio AI products, including consent and biometric privacy questions around voice data

 - Experience with international deals, cross-border data transfers, or on-premise and VPC deployments

 - Exposure to other legal areas common at tech companies, such as product counseling, corporate and financing work, or IP

 - Experience as an early legal hire at a startup (Series A to C), or with legal operations tools such as CLM platform




MORE DETAILS

🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.

🤝 We support each other. We have an open & inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.




OUR BENEFITS (US EMPLOYEES ONLY) 

💰 Compensation Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package.

🩺 Health Insurance Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family.

🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Parental Leave 9 weeks paternity & 12 weeks maternity leave 

🏦 401(k)

🚆 Commuter Allowance A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office.

🏖️ Flexible PTO Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries.

🍲 Meals & Snacks Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily.

🦖 Your own personal Yoshi




OUR COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Cartesia is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
ABOUT RETELL AI

Retell AI is using first-principles thinking to reimagine the call center with cutting-edge voice AI. Thousands of companies now use Retell's AI voice agents to handle sales, support, and logistics calls that once required large teams of human agents. Backed by Y Combinator, Alt Capital, and other leading investors. We've grown 20x from $5M to $100M+ in annualized revenue run rate in under two years, reaching a $1.5B+ valuation.

Our vision for 2026 is to build a modern CX platform where entire contact centers are powered by AI. Instead of basic automation that needs constant human tuning, we're creating intelligent AI “workers” that act as frontline agents, QA analysts, and managers, continuously executing, monitoring, and improving every customer interaction.

We're growing fast and looking for ambitious builders who want to tackle hard technical problems, move quickly, and have a real impact on one of the fastest-growing voice AI companies in the world.

Let's build the future together.

Recent recognition:

 - Voice AI Startup Hits $100 Million Run Rate With $4.6 Million Funding https://www.forbes.com/sites/timkeary/2026/11/12/voice-ai-startup-hits-100-million--run-rate-with-46-million-funding/

 - Top 50 AI Apps, a16z (2025) https://a16z.com/the-ai-application-spending-report-where-startup-dollars-really-go/

 - #3 Fastest-Growing Software Company, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://company.g2.com/news/g2s-2026-best-software-awards

 - Best Agentic AI Software, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://www.retellai.com/blog/retell-ai-recognized-as-the-best-agentic-ai-software-by-g2

 - #4 Fastest-Growing Software Vendor, Brex Benchmark 2025 https://www.brex.com/journal/brex-benchmark-december-2025

 - Enterprise Tech 30 Class of 2026, Nasdaq & Wing VC https://www.nasdaq.com/videos/retell-ai

 - Top-Ranked Startup, Lean AI Leaderboard https://leanaileaderboard.com/

 - Backed by Y Combinator https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/retell-ai

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Retell AI transforms customer experience with voice AI for enterprises, including customers like CVS/Aetna, San Antonio Spurs, Lenovo, and Grab. We have more customer stories than we can tell!

As Retell's first dedicated pricing hire, you will build pricing from zero across both of our motions: self-serve, product-led usage-based pricing, and enterprise pricing for large contracts. You will sit in Operations, report directly to a founder, and work every day with Sales, Finance, Product, and Growth. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strategy with execution: you will design the pricing, run the analysis, and get into live enterprise negotiations, at a company running at $100M+ in annualized revenue.




KEY RESPONSIBILITY

This hire owns how Retell prices its products across self-serve and enterprise, from usage-based pricing and packaging strategy through to closing large deals with Sales.

 - Own usage-based pricing and packaging for the self-serve (PLG) motion: pay-as-you-go rates, plans, free credits, and add-ons, so pricing drives conversion and expansion while protecting gross margin.

 - Build Retell's first enterprise pricing framework (commits, volume tiers, usage, outcome-based, or hybrid models) and structure large deals with Sales, including joining key negotiations.

 - Set up a models for deal desk: discount guidelines, approval thresholds, order form templates, and quoting that scales with deal volume.

 - Build the pricing data foundation (price realization, discount leakage, usage versus revenue, conversion and expansion by plan, margin by customer) so every pricing decision is backed by numbers.

 - Partner with Finance, Legal, Product, and Growth on contract terms, new product pricing, and price changes, with no surprises for customers.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have:

 - 4+ years in pricing, monetization, growth at a high-growth B2B SaaS, infrastructure, or AI company (or in consulting or banking followed by a startup operating role)

 - Hands-on experience designing usage-based or consumption pricing, ideally for a product-led (self-serve) motion

 - Experience structuring and pricing complex enterprise deals from proposal through close

 - Strong financial modeling. You can model unit economics and gross margin yourself

 - Have built a framework or process from scratch (a price book, plan structure, discount policy, or deal desk) in a fast-moving environment

Nice to have:

 - Experience pricing AI-native products, developer tools or APIs, voice AI, or contact center software

 - Experience with outcome-based pricing and building ROI or business cases for customers

 - Worked with quoting and billing systems (Salesforce CPQ, Stripe Billing, Metronome, or similar)

 - Python or AI tooling for pricing analysis and automation

How We Evaluate

We care less about checkboxes and more about:

 - the quality of your pricing judgment when data is incomplete and the answer is not obvious

 - rigor on unit economics: you know what each minute of a voice call costs us and what it should earn

 - judgment in customer-facing negotiations, including when to hold firm and when to flex

 - speed and ownership: how quickly you turn a pricing idea into a shipped, measured change


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF

 - You would rather ship a v1 pricing change in a week and iterate than plan for a quarter

 - You are equally comfortable in a spreadsheet, a self-serve funnel, and the negotiating table

 - You want to build the first version of pricing yourself, hands-on, rather than manage a team

 - You are curious about how AI costs work under the hood and how they should show up in price

 


JOB DETAILS

Location: Redwood City, California (Relocation support provided)

US Visas: Retell AI is open to sponsoring work authorization for qualified candidates, including H-1B, TN, L-1, E-3, and F-1 (OPT/CPT).

 


COMPENSATION

Our compensation ranges reflect different scopes of responsibility and cash/equity options. Your offer will depend on the skills and impact you demonstrate during interviews, the scope of the role, and your preferred cash/equity balance.

Annual base salary ranges:

 - Senior: $150,000–$190,000

OTHER BENEFITS

 - $300/month commuter reimbursement (gas, Caltrain, etc.)

 - $75/month phone bill reimbursement

 - $50/month internet reimbursement

 


COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

 - High ownership: small teams, >$1M revenue per employee, and significant equity

INTERVIEW PROCESS

jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

About the Team

Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead this team. This is a people leadership role with a real technical core. You will manage, coach and grow the engineers, own what the team commits to and ships, and be the engineering lead the team turns to on how the system works. Expect to spend roughly 30 percent of your time in the code: not heads-down on big features for weeks at a time, but close enough to the stack that you can answer a question, review a design, pick up the smaller pieces that keep the team moving, and sense when an estimate or a status is wrong.

Overview

• Lead the engineering team: hire, coach, develop and set the standard for six engineers, and hold that standard with direct, timely feedback in both directions.

• Own delivery for basketball: commit the team to work that is properly scoped, deliver what you committed inside the milestone, and tell us early and in your own words when the forecast moves.

• Own stability for basketball: be ready before the season starts and before every major release, be on the bridge for every P1 in your area, root-cause every incident and land a durable change so the lesson sticks.

• Be the engineering lead for the team: stay current across the stack, take part in the architecture and design discussions that matter, review code, and keep enough hands-on work to know how the system behaves in production.

• Be the team’s link to trading: know the senior traders for basketball, understand what they need and why, translate it for the engineers, and push back when the ask does not match the problem.

• Partner with product, quants to shape a basketball roadmap that is ambitious and achievable, and that the team believes in.

• Hold the quality bar against the date: small batches, tests that ship with the change, and review rigor that does not drop when the calendar gets tight.

• Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering workflows across the team, from development tooling and testing to code review and documentation, with the team still able to explain and defend everything it ships.

• Make the team measurably better every milestone: retros that produce specific changes the team owns, followed up until they stick.

• Travel occasionally to Fanatics offices and to the trading floor in Denver.

Required Qualifications

• Three or more years managing software engineers, with a track record of building a team that delivers and of holding people to a clear bar.

• Strong, recent, hands-on experience with C# and .NET, and with building and running services on Azure. You will be assessed at a senior engineer level on coding and system design.

• Experience with distributed, event-driven systems: message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Service Bus or similar), event sourcing, partitioning, and the failure modes that come with them.

• Experience owning production systems: on-call, incident command, post-incident reviews and operational readiness for peak periods.

• Proactive and self-directing. You find the people you need, make the call with 70 percent of the picture, and surface risk before you are asked.

• Comfortable with ambiguity and with a fast-moving environment where priorities change and decisions are made quickly.

• Able to communicate complex technical topics to engineers, traders, product and executives, in writing and in person.

• Based in the United States, ideally in the Eastern or Central time zones, with the right to work in the US.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in sports betting, trading, or another real-time pricing or risk domain.

• Experience with Azure Service Fabric or Kubernetes, and with moving workloads between them.

• Experience with live sports data feeds and the latency and correctness problems they bring.

• Experience working closely with quantitative or data science teams on models running in production.

• Knowledge of basketball and how it is traded.

If you have some of these qualifications but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Salary Range

jobs.title: Senior Beamline Scientist
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.

About The Role

As a Senior Beamline Scientist/Engineer at Antares, you will lead the testing, commissioning, and experimental validation of particle accelerator systems supporting nuclear technology development. Working within system requirements and performance specifications established by technical leadership, you will develop and execute test plans, characterize beamline performance, and provide experimental results and technical recommendations that inform hardware development and engineering decisions.

This role combines experimental physics with hands-on test engineering. Working closely with nuclear, mechanical, electrical, controls, and radiation protection teams, you will support the integration and operation of ion sources, beam transport systems, vacuum infrastructure, diagnostics, and associated instrumentation. You will take ownership of test planning, execution, data analysis, and performance verification while contributing to hardware development and troubleshooting. As a senior individual contributor, you will independently lead experimental activities, establish repeatable testing methodologies, mentor teammates, and help ensure safe and reliable operation of experimental systems.

Job Responsibilities

 - Own the development and execution of beamline test plans, commissioning procedures, and experimental validation activities based on established system requirements and performance specifications.

 - Develop test methodologies, measurement techniques, and acceptance criteria in coordination with system engineering and technical leadership.

 - Support the design, development, and integration of beamline hardware, including ion sources, beam extraction and transport, focusing and steering elements, neutralizers, vacuum systems, diagnostics, and experimental fixtures.

 - Lead experimental characterization of beamline performance, including beam current, energy, spatial distribution, divergence, stability, and measurement uncertainty.

 - Perform or support beam optics, particle transport, plasma, and radiation transport simulations to inform experimental configurations, interpret results, and investigate performance discrepancies.

 - Develop and integrate test instrumentation, including beam diagnostics, detectors, data acquisition systems, and associated measurement hardware.

 - Support hardware assembly, alignment, installation, integration, and commissioning activities in collaboration with responsible engineering teams.

 - Collaborate with electrical and controls engineers to integrate power supplies, instrumentation, data acquisition, monitoring, and safety interlocks into experimental test systems.

 - Lead troubleshooting and root-cause investigations of beamline performance issues, instrumentation failures, and experimental anomalies, coordinating corrective actions with hardware development teams.

 - Analyze experimental data, assess measurement uncertainties, and document test results to evaluate system performance against established requirements.

 - Provide technical recommendations and experimental feedback to support beamline design improvements, hardware modifications, and system optimization.

 - Work with radiation protection and facility teams to develop test procedures, establish safe operating conditions, and support experimental readiness reviews.

 - Coordinate with vendors and external research facilities to support specialized testing, instrumentation development, and hardware qualification.

 - Maintain test documentation, calibration records, experimental procedures, and performance reports to ensure traceability and repeatability.

 - Mentor engineers and scientists in experimental methods, instrumentation, data analysis, and safe laboratory practices.

Basic Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in physics, nuclear engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related technical discipline.

 - Five or more years of relevant experience in experimental physics, test engineering, accelerator systems, particle beamlines, or scientific instrumentation; relevant graduate research may count toward this experience.

 - Demonstrated experience developing and executing test plans, commissioning procedures, or experimental validation activities for complex scientific or engineering systems.

 - Strong understanding of experimental physics, particle interactions with matter, measurement techniques, and quantitative data analysis.

 - Hands-on experience integrating, operating, and troubleshooting scientific instrumentation, vacuum systems, detectors, power supplies, or data acquisition hardware.

 - Experience with experimental characterization, instrument calibration, measurement uncertainty, and performance verification.

 - Experience using scientific computing tools such as Python, MATLAB, or C++ for data analysis, simulation, automation, or instrument control.

 - Ability to apply first-principles calculations and computational modeling to experimental design, troubleshooting, and interpretation of measured performance.

 - Experience working within established laboratory safety procedures, including high-voltage, vacuum, radiation, or other relevant experimental hazards.

 - Ability to independently plan and execute experimental activities, investigate technical problems, and communicate results across multidisciplinary engineering teams.



Preferred Qualifications

 - Master's degree or Ph.D. in physics, nuclear engineering, accelerator physics, or a related discipline.

 - Experience testing, commissioning, or operating charged-particle accelerators, ion beam systems, neutral particle beams, or plasma-based ion sources.

 - Understanding of charged-particle beam physics, including beam extraction, electrostatic or magnetic focusing, beam transport, and neutralization techniques.

 - Experience with ultra-high-vacuum systems, high-voltage equipment, RF or microwave plasma systems, and associated instrumentation.

 - Experience with beam diagnostics, including Faraday cups, beam profile monitors, energy analyzers, or other charged-particle measurement systems.

 - Familiarity with particle optics or multiphysics simulation tools such as IBSimu, SIMION, COMSOL, or equivalent software.

 - Experience developing automated test systems, instrument control interfaces, or experimental data acquisition software.

 - Experience with hardware acceptance testing, subsystem qualification, commissioning, and performance verification.

 - Experience developing technical test reports, experimental procedures, and measurement uncertainty assessments.

Additional Requirements:

 - Ability to work long hours and weekends as necessary to support critical milestones

 - Ability to travel to customer and mission-relevant locations as needed.

 - Ability to obtain a Top Secret or Top Secret SCI clearance is preferred.

Location

 - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.





Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.description:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

Position overview: Ursa Major is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer within Mission Assurance to drive quality, reliability, and risk management in our propulsion systems. This role blends systems engineering and mission assurance to ensure our products meet the highest standards of performance and safety. You will work cross-functionally with design, test, manufacturing, and program teams to develop robust risk mitigation strategies and ensure successful mission execution.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and implement mission assurance processes to ensure product reliability and performance.

• Work directly with customer-facing operations teams to execute successful and safe test or flight campaigns

• Establish and maintain best practices for risk register management across different product lines.

• Work with design and product teams to find creative and efficient solutions to engineering challenges that ultimately reduce product risk.

• Support system-level risk analysis and mitigation; own and carry to closure system-level risks

• Lead root cause and corrective action (RCCA) investigations for product failures and quality issues.

• Work closely with test teams to evaluate performance and reliability data, as well as compliance and enforcement of Test Like You Fly philosophy.

• Perform system-level trade studies and analyses (ex. Failure Modes & Effects Analysis (FMEA), building fluid systems models) to develop system architecture concepts, with engine leads.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field (Master’s preferred).

• 4-8+ years of experience in mission assurance, systems engineering or propulsion.

• Experience with propulsion systems, launch vehicles, or defense aerospace programs.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Comprehensive knowledge of systems engineering processes, including requirements development and verification.

• Experience with risk analysis methods (FMEA, FHA, probabilistic risk assessment).

• Familiarity with aerospace industry standards (AS9100, NASA, MIL-STD, etc.)

• Hands-on experience with testing and validation of high-performance hardware.

Colorado law requires us to tell you the base compensation range of this role, which is $130,000 - $160,000 determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. What we can’t quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy.

Classification: Full-time Exempt

• Paid Parental and Adoptive Leave

• Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance

• Tax Advantage Accounts (HSA/FSA)

• Employer Paid Short and Long Term Disability, Basic Life, AD&D

• Additional Benefit Options Including Voluntary Life and Emergency Medical Transport

• EAP Program

• Retirement Savings Plan - 401k with Company Match

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Director, Field PM- AI in the Product Management- Security AI department. In this role, you will drive critical data security (DSPM and DLP) initiatives from concept to GA by establishing execution discipline, cross-functional accountability, and early visibility into risks and dependencies while ensuring that Engineering, Product, GTM, Legal, and Customer Success teams are fully aligned and launch-ready.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Drive a portfolio of data security initiatives from concept to GA, ensuring clear ownership, timelines, dependencies, and launch readiness

• Create cross-functional accountability across Engineering, Product, GTM, Legal, Customer Success, provisioning, partners, and field teams

• Surface risks early, challenge weak assumptions, and escalate with clear impact, owners, dates, asks, and recommendations

• Strengthen the existing launch process with lightweight mechanisms that improve speed, clarity, accountability, and predictability without adding bureaucracy

• Provide executive-ready visibility into portfolio status, risks, decisions needed, and readiness gaps

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• Thrive in ambiguity, comfortable building the path forward in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity as an opportunity to construct something meaningful.

• Act as an owner with a strong passion for the mission, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution while operating with deep integrity.

• Collaborate as a high-trust partner, embracing continuous feedback and clear, respectful communication to build teamwork and trust.

• Operate with urgency in high-growth environments, maintaining a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action to deliver high-quality results.

• Champion simplicity by distilling complex technical challenges, user needs, and product requirements into clear, focused, and actionable plans.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• Proven Principal TPM or senior technical program leadership experience driving complex, cross-functional product launches from concept to GA

• Strong technical credibility in DSPM, CASB, DLP, cloud, AI, or similarly complex technical domains

• Experience driving accountability across Engineering, Product, GTM, Legal, Customer Success, provisioning, partners, and field teams while operating with urgency and ownership in fast-moving environments

• Ability to identify risks early, challenge weak assumptions, and escalate with clear impact, owners, dates, and recommendations

• Strong executive communication skills with the ability to distill complex technical and cross-functional issues into concise, decision-oriented updates

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency

• Experience working with regulated, enterprise, or global customers where security, privacy, compliance, and reliability requirements influence launch readiness

• Ability to use data, metrics, and customer signals to assess launch health, adoption risks, readiness gaps, and post-GA outcomes

• Familiarity with DSPM and DLP product development lifecycles

jobs.title: Behavioral Health Therapist PsyD
jobs.description:
Licensed Behavioral Health Provider (Psychologist)

Reports To: BHP Pod Lead
Locations Hiring From: Remote within the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Hampshire, New Jersey, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Vermont, Virginia, Washington and Wisconsin. Candidates must hold a PSYPACT or be eligible

Employment Type: Full-time.

Role Overview
We’re seeking a licensed psychologist to deliver GI-focused behavioral services to adult GI patients through our virtual care model. You’ll work as a core member of a clinical team that includes GI physicians, GI-experienced nurse practitioners, and registered dietitians. You’ll receive ongoing training and consultation to build working knowledge of digestive conditions such as IBD, IBS, GERD, and SIBO, and to deliver psychological services that complement the rest of the care team. Prior experience in GI psychology or health psychology is preferred but not required.

What You’ll Do: Key Responsibilities

• Collaborate with a multidisciplinary care team, including MDs and dietitians, to provide coordinated care for members.

• Deliver evidence-based interventions, including cognitive behavioral therapy, relaxation strategies such as diaphragmatic breathing and progressive muscle relaxation, motivational interviewing, acceptance and commitment therapy, brain-gut psychoeducation, and gut-directed hypnotherapy.

• Complete biopsychosocial assessments and set goals that support meaningful outcomes for each member’s GI condition.

• Document encounters in the electronic health record and follow company clinical protocols.

• Take part in clinical coordination meetings and professional training to maintain licensure.

• Contribute to company-wide psychological best practices and share your experience to improve the member experience.

What We’re Looking For: Qualifications & Requirements

Required

• Doctoral degree (PhD or PsyD) in psychology.

• An active, unrestricted psychology license in good standing in a PSYPACT member state.

• An E.Passport and an active Authority to Practice Interjurisdictional Telepsychology (APIT) covering the states listed above, or willingness to obtain both before start.

• 2+ years of experience delivering cognitive behavioral therapy, relaxation strategies, or motivational interviewing.

• Ability to communicate effectively with MDs, nurse practitioners, health coaches, and dietitians.

• Comfort with electronic charting and common tools such as Zoom, Slack, and Google Drive.

Preferred

• Experience with GI-focused care or health psychology.

• Multi-state PSYPACT licensure.

• Experience delivering care on telehealth platforms.

Compensation & Benefits

• Salary Range: 125,000 base (commensurate with experience), plus bonus opportunities

• Flexible Schedules: Set the hours that work for you

• Time Off: Sick time can be used as PTO, plus 9 paid holidays and 1 floating holiday

• Health Benefits: Employer-paid premiums at 90% for employees, plus medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Life Support: Access to a “Life Concierge” through Overalls

• Growth: Advanced training from GI-specialized clinicians, guidance from our Licensure Specialist on cross-licensure, a CME management platform, CEU access through two partnerships, and research tools to inform evidence-based care

Compensation Range

$125,000—$125,000 USD
