jobs.title: Project Manager, Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril's Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) Manufacturing Engineering organization is seeking a Project Manager to drive the planning, tracking, and operational rhythm of our Project Engineering team. This Project Manager will partner with the Project Engineers who execute MDP/PDP stage gate deliverables and cross-functional manufacturing engineering work across every AD&S program. The Project Manager is accountable for the scope, schedule, and budget of the projects the team is responsible for delivering.

This is a high-leverage role with significant exposure and influence on the evolution of the production process. The Project Engineering team touches every program in the AD&S portfolio, and the Project Manager is the person who brings structure, visibility, and discipline to that work. You will own the project management apparatus: detailed scope definitions, schedules, CAPEX tracking, portfolio-level status comms, and the organizational systems that keep the manufacturing engineering function operating cleanly. You will also take on several adjacent operational workstreams critical to the health of the broader ME organization; program staffing and talent acquisition coordination, audits, and the confidential planning artifacts that support team growth.

The ideal candidate is a high-performing individual contributor with a demonstrated ability to bring order to complexity, hold people accountable to commitments without having positional authority over them, and operate with discretion on sensitive personnel and organizational information. We are open to a range of backgrounds namely project management, program operations, engineering operations, consulting, or similar operational leadership roles. You will be an integral part the operational backbone of AD&S Manufacturing Engineering.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Project Management for Manufacturing Engineering Projects

• Own accountability for scope, schedule, and budget across all Project Engineering team projects. The Project Engineers execute, but you are the one tracking commitments, surfacing risk, assisting the Project Engineers with cross-functional collaboration, planning, project management and communication.

• Build and maintain detailed scope definitions for every active project which requires clear, documented, and agreed to by stakeholders before execution begins.

• Build and maintain detailed, up-to-date project schedules in, including dependencies, critical path, and milestone tracking.

• Establish and run the project cadence with weekly status, stakeholder updates, risk reviews ensuring that the Project Engineering team has the visibility and support needed to deliver.

• Partner with Project Engineers to translate program and functional asks into structured project plans with clear deliverables, owners, and dates.

CAPEX & IRAD Tracking and Portfolio Communication

• Own detailed tracking of AD&S Manufacturing Engineering CAPEX with approvals, committed spend, actuals, and remaining balance by project, by quarter, and by fiscal year. Building a strong working relationship with program managers, finance, and divisional operations.

• Maintain the CAPEX and IRAD dashboard as the single source of truth for manufacturing engineering execution status that is ready to produce on demand for leadership reference and reviews.

• Prepare and maintain portfolio-level documentation that records investment justification and DOA approvals.

Hiring & Onboarding Operations Support

• Support hiring operations for the organization in partnership with the broader recruiting function by helping track open roles, coordinate interview logistics, and keep the overall process moving.

• Help coordinate interview panels across the engineering team, supporting consistent coverage and a positive new hire onboarding experience ensuring they have what they need to be successful in their first 45 days.

• Partner with recruiting on pipeline tracking, offer status visibility, and periodic process check-ins.

• Maintain the organization's job description library, ensuring open roles have approved, up-to-date postings.

Operational Infrastructure and Data Hygiene

• Run periodic data hygiene checks across the operational systems the team relies on, ensuring staffing, allocation, and reporting data are accurate and up to date.

• Partner with managers and program leads to confirm that team assignments, charge codes, and headcount data reflect reality.

• Maintain planning artifacts that support team growth and organizational design, working closely with leadership on structure and sequencing.

• Handle sensitive personnel and organizational planning information with complete discretion.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Build strong working relationships with Program Management, Chief Engineering, Finance, People Operations, and talent aquisition as the Project Manager is the manufacturing engineering function's operational liaison across every one of these groups.

• Drive accountability and commitments across teams and individuals who do not report to you, using influence, follow-through, and credibility rather than positional authority.

• Travel to other Anduril sites as needed to support project reviews and cross-site coordination (~10%, depending on business needs).

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, organizational management, or equivalent operational experience.

• 5+ years of experience in project management, program operations, engineering operations, business operations, or similar operational leadership roles including demonstrated ability to run structured workstreams across multiple stakeholders simultaneously.

• Track record of being a high-performing operator must be someone who brings order, structure, and follow-through to complex, cross-functional environments.

• Strong project management discipline with scope, schedule, budget, risk along with hands-on proficiency in Microsoft Project or an equivalent scheduling tool.

• Demonstrated ability to drive accountability with people who do not report to you through influence, communication, and persistent follow-through.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce executive-ready status communications and navigate conversations with divisional level stakeholders.

• Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with complete discretion, particularly around personnel, organizational planning, and compensation adjacent topics.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is routine.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience working with engineering or manufacturing organizations and being comfortable with technical teams, engineering workflows, and manufacturing terminology.

• Familiarity with CAPEX processes and budget tracking in a corporate engineering or operations environment.

• PMP certification or equivalent formal project management training. Willing to pursue in parallel if not previously.

• Experience building operating rhythms, scorecards, or reporting dashboards from scratch.

• Familiarity with org visualization, resource planning, or HR systems used in scaling organizations.

• Experience supporting an operations team through a period of rapid growth.

• Appropriate clearance classification or ability to obtain one.

US Salary Range

$1—$100,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Public Policy
jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role

As Senior Manager, Public Policy, you will be a key leader on our Policy and Government Affairs team, helping shape and execute SoFi’s policy strategy, analyzing and providing counsel on legislative developments, and crafting messaging. Serving as the strategic bridge between our core business operations and our key advocacy initiatives, you will engage with product, business, legal, and compliance teams to identify emerging policy opportunities, review upcoming product roadmaps to identify policy opportunities or regulatory hurdles, and educate the broader team on our product innovations. Additionally, you will drive the development of consistent policy narratives, executive talking points, and leadership reports that arm our team with the technical analysis and policy rationale needed to advance a modern, safe, and competitive financial ecosystem for our members. This role reports to the Senior Director, Policy and Government Affairs.

What you'll do

Business & Product Counsel

• Engage Across Business Units: Build proactive, collaborative partnerships with business unit, product, and marketing leaders through frequent one-on-one engagements, product syncs, team meetings, and operational touchpoints.

• Product-Driven Advocacy & Education: Translate company products, platform capabilities, and operational workflows into compelling external advocacy narratives. Partner directly with business units to identify policy opportunities early, coordinate rollout strategies for new products, and support the team in technical briefings with policymakers, regulators, and key external stakeholders.

• Identify Policy Opportunities and Emerging Issues: Partner with business and compliance teams to assess how existing regulations and emerging policy developments may affect operations, product roadmaps, and member access, and help identify opportunities for thoughtful modernization or clarification.

Policy Analysis

• Policy & Economic Impact Analysis: Conduct return-on-investment (ROI) and operational impact assessments on proposed federal legislation and regulatory rulemakings.

• Statutory & Regulatory Strategy: Develop advocacy strategies and support the development of comment letters.

• Proactive Framework Development: Translate commercial capabilities and business goals into proactive policy opportunities

Policy Advocacy

• Messaging, Thought Leadership & Content: Own and maintain core policy messaging libraries, issue briefs, and executive talking points that synthesize complex technical, operational, and legal issues into clear, accessible arguments. Draft executive thought leadership pieces, including op-eds, speeches, and executive social media content on key policy and regulatory issues. Support background briefings and media engagements with policy-focused reporters.

• Internal Leadership Reporting: Lead the editorial process and content development for the team’s regular executive reporting, providing senior leadership with timely analysis of legislative and regulatory developments and their operational implications.

• Advocacy Enablement: Arm colleagues with the substantive data, background papers, messaging, and analysis needed for Capitol Hill, regulatory, and trade association engagements.

What you'll need

• 8+ years of experience in public policy, financial regulation, or legislative analysis, with meaningful experience in financial services, banking, fintech, or relevant legislative/regulatory bodies.

• Product & Operational Fluency: Demonstrated ability to quickly master complex technical systems, consumer financial products, and business models, and translate them into statutory, regulatory, and policy frameworks.

• Technical Drafting Expertise: Proven hands-on track record analyzing, editing, and drafting legislative text, statutory proposals, amendments, and regulatory comment submissions.

• Exceptional Communications & Writing Skills: Strong track record of breaking down complex financial concepts into compelling executive memos, policy talking points, white papers, and presentation decks.

• Cross-Functional Relationship Builder: Demonstrated success embedding across corporate business lines, building trusted partnerships with product, engineering, legal, and other operational teams.

• Analytical & Strategic Judgment: Ability to evaluate policy matters through commercial, risk, and ROI lenses to help prioritize high-impact advocacy initiatives.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, Economics, Political Science, Communications, Business, or a related field required; Advanced degree (JD, MPP, or MBA equivalent) preferred.

Compensation and Benefits

The base pay range for this role is listed below. Final base pay offer will be determined based on individual factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, and location.

To view all of our comprehensive and competitive benefits, visit our Benefits at SoFi page!

SoFi provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, breastfeeding, and conditions related to breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age (40 or over), physical or medical disability, medical condition, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military and/or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable state or federal law.

The Company hires the best qualified candidate for the job, without regard to protected characteristics.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

New York applicants: Notice of Employee Rights

SoFi is committed to an inclusive culture. As part of this commitment, SoFi offers reasonable accommodations to candidates with physical or mental disabilities. If you need accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, please let your recruiter know or email accommodations@sofi.com.

We are unable to accommodate remote work from Hawaii, Alaska or Puerto Rico at this time.

Internal Employees

If you are a current employee, do not apply here - please navigate to our Internal Job Board in Greenhouse to apply to our open roles.

jobs.title: Director, Solutions
jobs.description:
The Director, Solutions leads commercially oriented Solutions Engineering, Experience Management, and Strategic Alliances work that connects customer needs, sales strategy, technical capabilities, and partner opportunities across the Relias portfolio. This people leader translates growth priorities into measurable commercial contribution, builds scalable team practices, and strengthens discovery, solution design, partner activation, and cross-functional execution. The Director stays actively involved in selected high-impact customer, partner, and sales opportunities while developing accountable teams and clear performance expectations. Reporting relationships and final functional ownership are subject to confirmation.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

Commercial Strategy and Revenue Growth

• Translating growth priorities into team plans, clear commercial accountabilities, and measurable outcomes across assigned Solutions Engineering, Experience Management, and Strategic Alliances responsibilities.
• Partnering with Sales leadership to identify opportunities, unblock stalled deals, strengthen pipeline progression, and improve win rates, deal value, and multi-solution adoption, while monitoring agreed commercial targets and revenue contribution.
• Engaging directly in high-impact opportunities to sharpen discovery, buying criteria, stakeholder alignment, business cases, competitive positioning, objection resolution, negotiation strategy, and executive decision-making.

Solutions Engineering and Consultative Excellence

• Leading and developing Solutions Engineers as proactive commercial partners to Sales, and establishing a pod- or segment-aligned coverage model that balances responsiveness with shared specialist expertise.
• Setting standards for customer discovery, value-led demonstrations, solution design, technical validation, feasibility, integrations, implementation dependencies, and commitments made during the sales process, while reinforcing MEDDPICC or a comparable sales methodology.
• Coaching teams to connect customer challenges, urgency, technical requirements, and buying criteria to measurable business value, and engaging Solutions Consultants and subject matter experts where specialized clinical or operational insight is needed.

Experience Management Growth

• Guiding the Experience Management growth agenda, including reputation management, employee and patient experience, and actionable insights, with expectations for customer value, pipeline contribution, bookings, expansion, and portfolio adoption, while confirming direct organizational ownership.
• Partnering with Sales, Product, and Marketing to connect Experience Management capabilities to workforce retention, quality, reputation, and growth, and to improve positioning, packaging, enablement, and go-to-market approaches.
• Integrating Experience Management capabilities into broader Relias solutions where doing so creates clear customer and commercial value.

Strategic Alliances and Commercialization

• Guiding a partnership strategy with defined priorities and partner-specific plans for market access, qualified pipeline, revenue contribution, milestones, executive engagement, and customer value.
• Overseeing partner evaluation, business cases, negotiation support, launch, enablement, co-selling, business reviews, and decisions to expand, adjust, or exit, while tracking partner-sourced and partner-influenced outcomes using agreed attribution rules.
• Coordinating Product, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to validate and commercialize partnership opportunities and new routes to market.

People Leadership and Capability Building

• Recruiting, coaching, developing, and retaining talent; setting goals, performance standards, development plans, and succession priorities; and building team capability through live deal, demonstration, and partner coaching.
• Building an accountable and collaborative culture in which team members surface risks early, use evidence, challenge assumptions constructively, and own outcomes.
• Addressing performance gaps promptly and strengthening individual and team capability through observation, feedback, practice, recognition, and follow-through.

Cross-Functional Execution, Data, and Operating Discipline

• Establishing engagement practices, opportunity prioritization, resource allocation, decision rights, and escalation paths across the Solutions organization.

• Using Salesforce and approved data to assess agreed commercial targets, partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, opportunity progression, win rates, Experience Management growth, resource capacity, and execution quality, while communicating risks and decisions needed to senior leaders.
• Using approved automation and AI-enabled tools to support research, analysis, planning, and productivity, while validating outputs and protecting customer, partner, and Relias confidential information.

YOU’VE GOT WHAT IT TAKES IF YOU HAVE:

• 8+ years of progressive experience in solutions engineering, solutions consulting, B2B SaaS sales, business development, strategic partnerships, or related commercial roles.
• 3+ years of formal people leadership experience, including goal setting, coaching, performance management, talent development, and building accountable teams.
• Demonstrated commercial ownership or material leadership of complex, multi-product B2B opportunities, including measurable contributions to pipeline, opportunity progression, negotiation, bookings, revenue, or portfolio adoption; direct individual quota ownership is not required.
• Experience leading multidisciplinary work across technical, commercial, customer, and partner stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
• Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, technology, marketing, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAD:

• Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, workforce solutions, learning technology, or another regulated B2B SaaS environment.
• Experience supporting complex six- and seven-figure opportunities and executive buying groups.
• Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across Solutions Engineering, partnerships, Experience Management, or specialized solution sales, including experience with reputation management, employee experience, patient experience, or customer insights.
• Experience building referral, reseller, affiliate, technology, association, or strategic-alliance partnerships.
• Experience commercializing new offerings and developing repeatable go-to-market approaches.
• Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology.

IN OFFICE REQUIREMENT:

Relias values collaboration and wants to ensure that our team members have opportunities to work with their teams regularly for professional development opportunities. Our flexible hybrid work environment requires that you live in the state of North Carolina, within a commutable distance to our office (~1-hour commute). You would be expected to work in our Morrisville, NC Headquarters (close to the Raleigh/Durham airport) approximately 30 days/quarter.

Relias is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free workplace. Relias welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities and is happy to make reasonable accommodations in all aspects of the selection process.  If you are an individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the job application process, please visit our career page for instructions.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, SAP S/4HANA & ERP Transformation
jobs.location: Englewood Cliffs, NEW JERSEY, United States
jobs.description:
The Role

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager (TPM) to lead Product and Engineering delivery across VERSANT’s Finance technology, starting with our move from SAP ECC to S/4HANA. The work runs through go-live and includes helping evaluate future-state financial systems, followed by ownership of the technical delivery, enhancements, integrations, and releases that come after.

Based in a PMO that supports both engineering and product teams, this TPM partners with Finance, HR, Payroll, Procurement, Legal and Privacy, SAP, our systems integrator, external vendors and technology partners, and executive leadership. This TPM turns priorities and solution direction into executable technical plans, with commitments driven across implementation, data migration, testing, deployment, integrations, environments, security and access, and boundary systems. The technical execution plan informs Program Management’s integrated plan, supports the Finance technology roadmap, and tracks readiness against current delivery evidence.

Success requires learning Finance’s business processes, understanding how SAP, integrations, and connected systems work together, and keeping complex technical work organized. This TPM brings information together across teams, reports a clear view of progress and risks, identifies the right owners, challenges incomplete answers, and anticipates downstream impacts.

Key Responsibilities

Lead ERP Transformation Technical Delivery

• Lead end-to-end technical finance systems transformation from assessment and planning through execution, breaking large initiatives into manageable phases for steady delivery.
• Own the technical execution plan for Finance implementations and ongoing enhancements across SAP, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and connected enterprise systems such as Workday.
• Define deliverables, owners, timelines, dependencies, risks and readiness criteria within that plan.
• Partner with Product team to align system capabilities with business needs, support the evaluation and selection of future-state ERP and financial systems, and translate product requirements into delivery plans.

Drive Technical Execution Across the Lifecycle

• Lead data migration and conversion planning, including mappings, loads, reconciliation and remediation across the systems integrator (SI) partner and internal teams.
• Coordinate technical testing across environments, data, access and dependent systems. Track and report defects, drive resolution with the accountable teams, remove blockers where possible, and confirm readiness using testing evidence.
• Drive technical release and cutover activities across Product, Engineering and implementation partners, including dependencies, readiness, fallback plans and risks. Provide validated technical inputs and status to the Program Manager for the integrated program plan.
• Guide post-go-live stabilization by tracking issues, coordinating resolution of the highest-impact items first and coordinating support handover.
• Run ongoing business-as-usual (BAU) delivery, enhancements and recurring releases with Product, Engineering and service owners.
• Make sure technical changes follow required approvals and controls, with traceable testing, deployment and audit evidence.

Partner Across Technical and Business Teams

• Work across Product, Engineering, business teams and technical partners to keep work aligned and meet commitments.
• Resolve blockers, dependencies and resource constraints across internal teams and external partners and bring technical decisions to closure with accountable owners.
• Map engineering work to program milestones and objectives and key results (OKRs), and track progress, risks, dependencies and impacts against them.
• Own technical delivery reporting tailored to Engineering, Product, Finance, Program Management and executive stakeholders, including trade-offs and decisions needed.

Manage Vendors and Resources

• Hold internal teams, SIs, managed service providers (MSPs), vendors and contract resources accountable for scope, quality, on-time delivery and acceptance criteria, resolving gaps with VERSANT’s own responsibilities.
• Track technical budgets, resource allocation and vendor deliverables, and provide resource, timing and cost inputs for program planning.

Improve Delivery Through Tools and AI

• Establish and manage Jira boards, workflows and dashboards that organize engineering work, track dependencies and give reliable delivery visibility, alongside delivery tracking in SAP Cloud ALM.
• Keep documentation current across project management and collaboration tools, and support adoption of tools and practices that improve visibility and execution.
• Use AI tools and automation to improve planning, reporting and delivery efficiency, streamline workflows, and reduce manual work.

Basic Qualifications

• 5+ years of technical project or program management experience delivering complex enterprise technology. Project management certifications, such as PMP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or similar credentials, are a plus.
• Proven track record leading ERP implementations, upgrades, or transformations and their ongoing enhancements, with SAP S/4HANA experience strongly preferred.
• Familiarity with Workday and its integrations with SAP or other finance systems, and SAP Cloud ALM experience, preferred.
• Working knowledge of finance systems and business processes, with the ability to learn end-to-end workflows and understand dependencies across systems and teams.
• Ability to manage technical delivery across integrations, boundary systems, data migration, environments, security and access, testing, releases, cutover, hypercare and post-go-live support.
• Proven ability to coordinate technical and functional teams, including Product and Engineering, and to manage SIs and vendors, resolving technical dependencies and translating decisions into executable work.
• Proficiency in using and integrating tools such as Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), Asana, Confluence, LucidChart, Slack, and Zoom.
• Experience establishing and continuously improving Jira boards, workflows, automations, and dashboards for planning, dependencies, defects, and reporting that support scalable delivery.
• Experience in Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controlled or audit-sensitive environments, including change control, access governance, and delivery evidence.
• Strong communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills, with the judgment to challenge incomplete answers and manage multiple priorities.

Desired Characteristics

• Proactive and detail-oriented, with strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and follow-through, and an eye for next steps, risks, and downstream impacts.
• Willing to challenge unsupported readiness claims, ownership gaps, and missed commitments.
• Able to build effective relationships and influence cross-functional teams and vendors without direct authority, while balancing transformation and ongoing delivery priorities.

Location: Englewood Cliffs, NJ or NYC (Hybrid – 3 days onsite)

Employees based in our Englewood Cliffs office have access to a variety of convenient on-site services and amenities, including free employee parking, complimentary electric vehicle charging stations, an on-site fitness center with locker rooms and towel service, and dry-cleaning drop-off and pick-up.

To support an easier commute, shuttle service is also available to and from the Englewood Cliffs campus, with pickup locations across Manhattan’s East Side and West Side, Brooklyn, Hoboken, Jersey City, Newark, and Secaucus.

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with a VERSANT Media employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. VERSANT Media's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to candidateaccessibility@versantmedia.com.

VERSANT Media is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We include a good faith pay range for each position to comply with applicable state and local pay transparency laws and to promote equity across our organization. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location and may include additional forms of compensation and benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, etc.

All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at VERSANT via-email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from VERSANT's Talent Acquisition team will be deemed the sole property of VERSANT. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by VERSANT as a result of the referral or through other means.

jobs.title: Senior Personal Injury Paralegal
jobs.description:
Build the case and lead the team as our senior plaintiff-side personal injury paralegal, doing hands-on legal work from pre-litigation through trial preparation and supervising legal assistants and law clerks.

Do you have what it takes to keep complex cases on track, teams accountable, and client satisfaction at the core of every legal decision?

Can you thrive in a fast-paced, woman-led firm where compassion meets litigation, ensuring no case detail falls through the cracks and every client feels seen and supported?

Is your case management style rooted in precision, urgency, and proactive communication, with a deep understanding of what it takes to guide a legal team through high-stakes challenges?

Final question: When faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?

** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

If you have any questions, please email recruit@crisp.co only.

• Please do not reach out through our website's contact information (telephone, email, or web chat) or via direct messaging on any social media platform.

To Apply: Submit your application by clicking the "Apply" button and applying on the Crisp Recruit page that opens.

**RECRUITERS DO NOT CONTACT**

At Oliver Law Office, we fight for individuals and families whose lives have been disrupted by serious injuries, dangerous products, and corporate negligence. Based in Columbus, Ohio, our firm is led by nationally recognized trial attorney Jami S. Oliver, whose decades of courtroom experience and fierce advocacy have earned record-breaking results for clients across the state. From motor vehicle accidents to complex mass torts, we deliver powerful legal strategies with compassion and integrity.

Grounded in the values of transparency, excellence, and client-first service, we treat every case with urgency and care. Our team takes pride in providing clear, consistent communication and unwavering support through each stage of the legal journey. Whether it’s a high-stakes injury claim or coordinating with lienholders in mass tort litigation, we strive to restore dignity and deliver results to those who need it most.

We are now hiring a Senior Personal Injury Paralegal to help lead and streamline our growing caseload of personal injury and product liability cases. This is a high-impact leadership role focused on proactive case progression, team accountability, and exceptional client communication. We are seeking a driven, solutions-oriented professional who takes ownership of results, ensures critical deadlines are never missed, and leads legal support staff with precision and urgency. You will work closely with attorneys, operations, and intake to ensure cases advance efficiently while maintaining the highest standards of client service.

What you’ll do:

• Case Portfolio Oversight: Oversee a high-volume portfolio of 200+ active personal injury and product liability cases, including mass tort and MDL matters. Maintain comprehensive oversight of both pre-litigation and litigation dockets, ensuring accurate milestone tracking, deadline management, case prioritization, and documentation. Proactively identify stalled cases, address bottlenecks, and ensure no critical deadline or case activity is overlooked.

• Strategic Case Progression: Proactively drive cases forward by upholding procedural timelines, ensuring all post-intake tasks, filings, and pre-SOL actions are completed within set windows. Maintain a system of accountability to minimize bottlenecks and reduce case cycle time.

• Team Supervision & Coordination: Lead, support, and coordinate legal team members, including paralegals, legal assistants, law clerks, and intake staff. Assign and monitor workloads, provide real-time feedback, and ensure established SOPs and workflows are consistently followed. Hold team members accountable for timely task completion, accurate documentation, and proactive case progression.

• Legal Task Oversight & Lien Resolution: Support attorneys in settlement preparation, lien resolution (Medicare, Medicaid, VA), and subrogation claim management, ensuring potential liens are identified and addressed early in the case lifecycle. Oversee the timely collection and processing of medical records and billing documentation by legal support staff. Ensure closing statements and required documentation are completed accurately and efficiently, with a goal of completing 90% of disbursements within 30 days of settlement.

• Client Communication & Satisfaction: Maintain consistent, proactive, and professional communication with clients throughout the lifecycle of their cases. Ensure clients receive timely updates, clear explanations of next steps, and responsive follow-up. Oversee client communication across the legal team, maintaining proactive monthly touchpoints, ensuring representation letters are sent within 24 hours, and supporting the firm's goal of achieving five-star reviews on 90%+ of closed cases.

• Docket, Calendar & Workflow Accountability: Maintain oversight of attorney calendars, pre-litigation and litigation dockets, and all critical case deadlines. Ensure legal assistants accurately enter and maintain case information, calendar entries, and required documentation. Proactively review records for errors, missing information, and approaching deadlines, taking corrective action before issues impact case progression. Ensure accurate and complete information is maintained in Filevine to support workflow automation, reporting, and efficient case closings.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with the Operations Manager, attorneys, and legal support staff to streamline case-related scheduling, reporting, vendor communication, and team onboarding. Bridge legal process excellence with firm-wide collaboration and shared goals.

What we’re looking for:

• Experience and Legal Expertise: 7–10 years of experience in personal injury, tort, or mass tort case management, with at least 3–5 years in a supervisory legal role. Proven success managing high-volume pre-litigation and litigation dockets, overseeing case progression, and navigating complex legal workflows. Experience with multidistrict litigation (MDL) coordination is a plus, but not required.

• Hands-On Leadership: Skilled at leading case teams through high-pressure environments with a leadership style grounded in empathy, clarity, and accountability. Promotes collaboration, delivers feedback constructively, and maintains team alignment with performance standards and deadlines.

• Technical Proficiency and Tools: Proficient in legal case management platforms, with Filevine experience preferred. Comfortable utilizing Dropbox, Slack, CRM systems, and lien resolution software to manage case information, coordinate team activities, and maintain efficient workflows. Demonstrates strong technological aptitude, attention to data accuracy, and the ability to leverage digital systems and automation to improve case progression and operational efficiency.

• Execution, Accountability & Drive: A highly motivated, proactive professional who thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and takes personal ownership of results. Demonstrates exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and an unwavering commitment to meeting deadlines. Approaches challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset, welcomes feedback, and is motivated by continuous learning, improvement, and professional growth. Leads by example, takes accountability for outcomes, and brings a positive, team-first attitude.

• Client-Centered Communication: Communicates with empathy, clarity, and timeliness. Upholds the firm’s commitment to integrity, client education, and proactive outreach—ensuring clients feel supported, informed, and valued throughout their legal journey.

Why you should work here:

• Purpose-Driven Mission: Join a personal injury firm where justice and compassion go hand in hand. Every case we take on is rooted in the belief that clients deserve both powerful legal advocacy and empathetic support during life’s most difficult moments.

• Strategic Impact & Leadership: Step into a high-ownership role where your operational expertise drives real outcomes. You'll play a pivotal part in streamlining case progress, elevating team performance, and shaping systems that scale with the firm’s growth.

• Culture of Collaboration & Respect: Become part of a values-based, woman-led team that fosters trust, celebrates wins, and puts client well-being at the center of everything we do. Your voice matters here, and so does your personal development.

• Career Growth & Advancement: Build a meaningful, long-term career with a growing and ambitious law firm that recognizes initiative, rewards strong performance, and invests in professional development. As the firm continues to expand, you'll have opportunities to take on greater responsibility, strengthen your leadership skills, and advance professionally. Your contributions will have a direct impact on the firm's success, and your growth will be an important part of ours.

Additional perks:

• Compensation: Competitive annual base salary of $90,000–$110,000, based on experience and qualifications, with additional performance-based bonus opportunities tied to firm revenue growth and client satisfaction.

• Work Structure: Full-time, hybrid position based in Dublin, Ohio, with three days in the office and two days working remotely each week. This position requires high accountability, operational consistency, and a commitment to excellence in legal service delivery.

• Growth-Oriented Environment: Be part of a forward-moving firm with strong leadership, clear systems, and a people-first culture. As the firm scales, so will your opportunity to lead, innovate, and grow within a respected legal team.

• Comprehensive Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and generous paid time off, including vacation and sick leave.

At Oliver Law Office, the Senior Personal Injury Paralegal role is central to delivering timely justice and exceptional client-focused service. You will oversee a high-volume portfolio of personal injury and product liability cases, ensuring each case progresses with precision, urgency, and accountability. From overseeing critical deadlines and early lien resolution to ensuring medical documentation is processed accurately and clients remain informed, your leadership will be instrumental in maintaining operational excellence and delivering outstanding results.

This is your opportunity to lead at the heart of a growing, ambitious law firm where initiative, accountability, and results matter. You'll work closely with attorneys, operations, and legal support staff to drive case progression, strengthen team performance, and deliver an exceptional client experience. If you're a driven professional who thrives on challenges, takes pride in your work, and is excited to grow alongside a successful team, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Head of Tax
jobs.description:
WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. 

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

About the role

We're hiring a Head of Tax to build Cognition's tax function as our first in-house tax hire. Reporting to the Controller, you'll own all direct and indirect tax across the company, bring outsourced work in-house, and build processes and controls ready for a public company. You'll be part of a lean, AI-first finance team that aims to redefine how the function operates.



In this role you will:

 - Build the tax function, including the calendar, processes, controls, and advisor relationships, and use AI tools like Devin to automate as much of the work as possible

 - Own the quarterly and annual ASC 740 provision and support the annual audit

 - Own federal, state, and international income tax compliance, and manage notices and audits

 - Own indirect tax (sales and use, VAT/GST) and associated tracking

 - Lead international tax and transfer pricing, including entity structure and intercompany arrangements

 - Lead tax on M&A and equity compensation, including diligence, integration, Section 382, and equity withholding



What we're looking for:

 - You've worked at a Big 4 firm and then in-house at a high-growth tech company, with 5+ years in tax.

 - You've owned an ASC 740 provision end-to-end through an audit.

 - You're credible across federal and state, international and transfer pricing, M&A, equity comp, and indirect tax, and you know when to bring in advisors.

 - You've been an early or first tax hire, or built a tax function from scratch, and you like being hands-on.

 - You use AI tools heavily in your work and can show how. Experience at an AI company is a plus.

 - You're based in San Francisco and willing to work from the office 5 days per week.


OUR COMMITMENT

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer – Agentic Platform Core
jobs.description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to build the core of our agentic engineering platform: the shared services, agent orchestration, and data layer that every engineering domain plugs into. You will make it possible for domain experts to add new disciplines as plugins, for agents to call solvers and tools safely, and for every result to carry the provenance an engineering program can trust.

You will be joining an early-stage team within Voyager's Advanced Technology Group building an AI-native engineering platform. We hire curious, highly motivated domain experts who already build with AI and have the taste to know what good looks like.

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now, Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

Responsibilities:

• Design and build core platform services: agent orchestration, tool and solver integration, workflow execution, the plugin framework new engineering domains build on, and manage the infrastructure that the platform runs on.

• Own the data layer for engineering artifacts (requirements, designs, parts, simulation and test results) with provenance and traceability end to end.

• Build evaluation, observability, and governance tooling: evals, tracing, cost controls, and guardrails on agent actions.

• Profile and optimize the performance of the agentic system and keep it current with all of the latest developments from the frontier.

• Create evaluation pipelines and run rigorous experiments to optimize agent performance.

• Ship user-facing features across the full stack (Python/FastAPI back end, React front end).

• Focus on creating a seamless, polished user experience.

• Harden the platform for partners: security, access control, multi-tenancy, and deployment to cloud and controlled environments.

• Pair with domain engineers and FDEs to turn their workflows into reusable platform capabilities.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field with 6+ years building production software, including distributed back-end systems.

• Working proficiency with Claude Code or Codex.

• Critical thinker and excellent communicator.

• Strong Python and TypeScript; FastAPI or similar; React.

• PostgreSQL and document stores (e.g., MongoDB), with data modeling for complex domain objects.

• Has shipped LLM- or agent-based systems to production: tool calling, orchestration, evals, and observability.

• Cloud infrastructure, containers, and CI/CD.

• Demonstrated AI-first workflow: ships with coding agents daily and knows when not to trust the output.

• S. citizen with ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance. TS preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience building engineering software (CAD, EDA, PLM, or simulation).

• Deployment in secure or air-gapped environments.

• Background in an engineering discipline.

Travel, Physical and/or Government Mandated Requirements:

• Remote (U.S.), with periodic travel to Voyager locations (Los Angeles, CA; Washington, D.C.; Seattle, WA) for lab work, hardware test events, and technical reviews.

• Clearance Required: Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance. TS preferred.

jobs.title: Regional Facilities Manager – Southeast / Florida
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.

About the Role

Success Academy is building a network of exceptional public schools in Florida. We are seeking a Regional Facilities Manager – Southeast / Florida (Internal Title: Specialist, Florida Facilities) to join our Renovations & Facilities team as the on-the-ground leader accountable for delivering and operating safe, compliant, instruction-ready school facilities across this growing portfolio of co-located district campuses.

This role covers both sides of a new campus. It builds operating requirements into design and construction, leads the readiness and acceptance work that gets a campus open, and then owns ongoing facilities performance and the working relationship with each district partner.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-moving, mission-driven environments, is comfortable moving between an active construction site and an occupied school, and wants to shape how a facilities operation is built rather than inherit one.

Key Responsibilities

• Represent facilities requirements during design review and construction coordination, reviewing plans and proposed systems for maintainability, reliability, life-safety compliance, service access, operating cost, resilience, and daily fit with the needs of scholars and school teams.

• Confirm that design and construction address wind loading, water intrusion, drainage, and power resilience appropriate to each site and to Florida conditions.

• Drive permitting, district approvals, inspections, accessibility, and fire and life-safety milestones through disciplined tracking and follow-through.

• Serve as Success Academy's on-site representative during construction, monitoring field progress, workmanship, safety, schedule, cost, submittals, and corrective work.

• Coordinate construction activity with host-campus operations so occupied areas stay safe and usable and site conditions remain controlled.

• Maintain credible budgets and schedules with commitments, contingency, forecast at completion, and variance, and require documented justification and approval before any change-order commitment.

• Build campus-specific readiness plans covering vendors, inspections, emergency procedures, utilities, spare parts, warranties, access, and facilities training.

• Lead commissioning, inspections, systems testing, punch-list management, occupancy approvals, and closeout, and confirm each campus is presented for operational acceptance with verified approvals, tested critical systems, and a documented open-items list with owners and dates.

• Own post-opening stabilization, driving defects, incomplete work, warranty claims, and contractor obligations to resolution.

• Own the working relationship with each host district's facilities organization, maintain a per-campus record of which party carries each obligation, and hold host partners to those obligations through documented requests, tracked response, and escalation.

• Own facilities performance in Success Academy space, including preventive and corrective maintenance, and manage the service providers Success Academy contracts with clear scopes, service levels, escalation paths, and performance expectations.

• Serve as the senior Florida facilities escalation point, participate in after-hours response, and establish hurricane preparedness, response, continuity, and recovery procedures coordinated with each host's plan.

• Build the repeatable playbooks for campus opening, turnover, inspection, maintenance, emergency response, and vendor management that later campuses will use.

Qualifications

• Seven or more years across facilities operations and renovation or construction delivery, with a demonstrated record in both.

• Direct experience bringing a new or substantially renovated facility from construction into stable operation, including commissioning and turnover.

• Experience delivering renovation or fit-out work inside an occupied building, under another party's approval process.

• Practical knowledge of core building systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, controls, fire and life safety, security, accessibility, and envelope.

• Ability to read and challenge drawings, specifications, estimates, schedules, bids, and change orders.

• Command of project budgets, forecasting, procurement, change control, closeout, and warranty administration.

• Experience managing preventive and corrective maintenance, emergency response, compliance activities, vendors, and operating budgets.

• Strong relationship judgment and composure with public-sector partners, and the discipline to document positions clearly.

• Experience with Florida districts, public agencies, co-located facilities, permitting authorities, hurricane readiness, and water-intrusion prevention is preferred.

• Credentials such as CCM, PMP, CFM, FMP, or OSHA training are valued but do not substitute for demonstrated delivery.

Work Expectations

• This is a Florida-based role requiring regular travel among current and future campuses, with occasional travel to New York.

• The role requires comfort working in active construction environments and occupied school facilities.

• Flexibility is required for early mornings, evenings, and weekends around critical inspections, turnovers, openings, and urgent conditions, and to support hurricane readiness, activation, response, and recovery.

Compensation, Benefits & Perks

At Success Academy, we invest boldly in our Network team with a comprehensive package designed to support your health, financial future, and overall well-being:

• Day-One Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting your first day (SA covers 82% of our core medical plan), plus a free One Medical membership and confidential mental health support via EAP/Talkspace.

• Financial Security: 403(b) retirement plan with a 3% employer match, up to $2,400/year in employer HSA contributions, employer-paid life/disability insurance, and Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligibility.

• Time to Recharge: Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and paid parental leave.

• Perks & Stipends: A 50/month cell phone stipend (600/year), pre-tax commuter benefits, backup family care, and performance-based earning incentives.

https://info.flclearinghouse.com

Exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience. This position is not bonus eligible.

$80,000—$95,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join our team! You'll serve as a key legal partner across Hudl's global business — minimizing risk, driving deals forward and translating complex legal questions into clear, actionable guidance.

As a Senior Legal Counsel, you'll:

• Lead legal specialties. You'll be the primary attorney for functional areas like privacy, IP, employment or M&A, building scalable policies that balance legal protection with our business goals.

• Be a versatile generalist. You'll work across multiple legal areas — vendor contracts, sales agreements, data protection and more — with the ability to juggle competing priorities without losing momentum.

• Be a strategic advisor. You'll research risk factors and provide proactive, clear guidance to leadership, translating complex legal issues into actionable advice for non-lawyers.

• Negotiate and collaborate. You'll draft complex agreements, build relationships of trust with external parties and regulators, and train internal teams on legal best practices.

Location

We'd like to hire someone for this role who lives near our office in Lincoln, but we're also open to remote candidates in Chicago, Kansas City, Des Moines or Minneapolis; must be willing to travel occasionally to our HQ in Lincoln.

Must-Haves

• Legally qualified. You're admitted to practice law in your jurisdiction with the ability to obtain in-house registration in Nebraska within 6 months of hiring, and have at least six years of experience at a law firm or as in-house counsel.

• A project management mindset. You don't just spot problems — you build scalable processes and templates that help the entire company move faster.

• Technically curious. You have a strong understanding of how legal principles apply to modern SaaS businesses and are comfortable using tools like Microsoft Office to manage your work.

• An elite communicator. You have exceptional writing skills and the ability to coach and mentor junior staff and non-attorney colleagues.

Nice-to-Haves

• Tech industry experience. If you've spent time navigating the legal landscape of a high-growth technology company, that's a major plus.

• Global perspective. Experience working with international teams or coordinating with local counsel across different geographic regions will set you apart.

Our Role

• Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.

• Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.

• Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.

• Provide an environment to help you succeed. We're always investing in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.

• Take care of your mental and physical health. Medical plans tailored for you and your family—including vision, dental, and fertility benefits—and stay supported with our EAP and Employee Resource Groups.

• Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that's free money. We'll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.

Base Salary Range

$159,000—$265,000 USD

Hudl Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy

jobs.description:

The Medical Assistant reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Medical Assistant is a member of the health care team primarily responsible for providing support to physicians, nurses, and other licensed medical staff by facilitating efficient patient flow, assisting with various patient care activities, and performing related administrative functions. The Medical Assistant is responsible for ensuring efficient patient flow through the clinic; maintaining neat, clean and safe patient care areas; promoting patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner; safeguarding patient confidentiality.

Responsibilities:

Obtains accurate vital signs, per organization standards. Documents reason for visit and updates/confirms, allergies, smoking history and pharmacy information. Promptly informs the provider and registered nurse of any significant change in vital signs or acute symptoms. Anticipates/sets up equipment or supplies needed for visit. Cleans and prepares exam room for next patient. Responds to needs to expedite visits and maintain flow of patients and prioritize tasks accordingly.

Offers assistance to others. Attends and participates in staff meetings. Communicates appropriately and effectively with patients and patient care team (in the office and on the phone)

jobs.title: Lead Mission Integration Engineer, Payload I&T
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Lead Payload Integration & Test Mission Integration Engineer, you will lead the team responsible for planning and executing customer payload integration and SV level test campaigns, turning our foundational spacecraft platform into the backbone of customer missions. You will be responsible for mentoring, tasking, and overall direction of the mission integration engineering team within the payload I&T specialty, serving as the primary technical liaison for complex SV level I&T. In this role, you will balance long term strategic integration planning with short term technical execution with a balance of roughly fifty percent management and fifty percent individual contributor work. We are looking for experienced engineers who are eager to solve complex mission integration challenges with a focus on practicality and scalability, and who thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced aerospace environment.



Responsibilities:

 - Lead, mentor, and develop a team of mission integration engineers within the payload I&T specialty, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career growth.

 - Set priorities, assign tasks, and balance workload across concurrent customer campaigns.

 - Serve as the team’s technical backstop: provide final technical review of test plans, procedures, and anomaly dispositions, and act as the escalation point for novel or high-risk integration challenges.

 - Own resource planning for I&T campaigns, including staffing, shift coverage, cleanroom and test facility needs, GSE, and schedule, in coordination with program management and operations.

 - Define and continuously improve standard integration and test processes, procedure templates, and lessons-learned practices so the team scales across programs and customers.

 - Lead and direct the team in planning space vehicle I&T campaigns, and drive execution on the cleanroom floor.

 - Serve as the primary technical liaison for complex SV-level I&T, leading customer technical engagements to develop bus-to-payload integration procedures

 - Own planning and oversee execution of SV-level environmental testing (random vibration, quasi-static load, TVAC) and functional testing, personally leading the highest-complexity or highest-risk test events.

 - Oversee propulsion loading operations for dynamic testing and launch, and ensure team members are trained and qualified for hazardous operations and compliant with safety requirements.

 - Ensure coupled loads analysis (CLA) and thermal analysis results are reviewed, challenged where needed, and incorporated into test planning, working directly with the analysis teams.

 - Support the launch engineering team in deploying to launch sites for launch vehicle integration, system checkouts, and launch rehearsals.

 - Review and approve customer-facing system-level documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and integration procedures.

 - Own the team’s technical risk posture: identify, assess, and drive mitigation of risks across design, integration, test, and operations, and escalate to leadership as appropriate.

 - Support requirements analysis, verification, and validation to ensure I&T plans align with customer needs.

 - Represent the team in customer meetings, design reviews, and status updates, communicating clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership, and negotiating schedule, scope, and interface changes.



Requirements

 - Bachelor’s degree or higher in Aerospace, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or related field.

 - 8+ years of spacecraft or complex flight hardware integration and test experience, including hands-on experience planning and executing SV-level I&T campaigns.

 - 2+ years of formal leadership experience, such as a team lead, supervisor, or senior technical lead directing the work of other engineers, with demonstrated experience mentoring and developing engineers.

 - Proven track record of delivering spacecraft or payload through SV-level environmental testing (random vibration, quasi-static load, TVAC) and functional testing to launch readiness.

 - Strong understanding of space systems integration, test planning, and verification, including interpreting coupled loads and thermal analysis results to derive test levels and margins.

 - Experience leading customer or payload-provider technical engagements, including developing interface documentation and integration procedures, ideally with prime contractors or government entities.

 - Experience managing schedules and cross-functional coordination across multiple concurrent campaigns in a fast-paced environment.

 - Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and adapt to shifting demands and to present concise technical content to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Willingness to travel to launch sites and work in cleanroom and hazardous-operations environments, including extended or irregular hours during campaigns.

 - U.S. Person status is required, as this position needs access to export-controlled data.



Preferred

 - Experience with propulsion loading operations or other hazardous spacecraft ground operations, including safety and procedure authorship.

 - Experience with CubeSat, small satellite, or rideshare mission integration across multiple spacecraft or vehicle classes.

 - Previous spacecraft, launch vehicle, or payload engineering experience in leadership roles within satellite manufacturing or related aerospace industries.

 - Background in system-level FMEA, anomaly investigation, and reliability engineering methods.

 - Proficiency with Python or MATLAB for test data analysis and automation.

 - Familiarity with flight software, embedded systems, and space communications protocols.



#LI-RC1


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Cash bonus eligibility: share in Apex’s success with eligibility for a performance-based cash bonus on top of your salary, rewarding the impact you make

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave: Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

 - Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks: To keep you fueled throughout the day

 - Vibrant community: Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family

 - Your dream desk setup: All the tools you need to be your most productive self

 - World-class Playa Vista office: With the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life

 - Real impact opportunity: Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

Compensation ranges are set by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. A candidate's specific level and base pay are determined case by case and may vary with job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities, and internal equity. Beyond base salary, full-time hires are also eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.
