jobs.title: Business Development Lead, ANZ
jobs.description:
About Persona

Persona https://withpersona.com/ is the configurable identity platform built for businesses in a digital-first world. Verifying individuals and organizations is harder — but more important — than ever, with AI enabling fraudsters to launch sophisticated accounts at scale and regulations evolving rapidly.

We’ve built Persona to support practically every use case and industry — that’s why we’re able to serve a wide range of leading companies. For example, Reddit relies on Persona for age assurance and verification to comply with online safety regulations, protecting younger users while maintaining a seamless experience. Meanwhile, OpenAI relies on Persona to keep bad actors out, protecting one of the world’s most powerful AI platforms from large-scale abuse in a time when AI is reshaping the way we work and live.

We’re growing rapidly and looking for exceptional people to join us!




ABOUT THE ROLE

Persona is building its first dedicated commercial presence in APAC. This opportunity has a main focus in Australia & New Zealand but would be an integral part of the broader APAC team. The person who stands up ANZ sales arm should also be able to support strategic deals, regulatory groundwork, and partnerships across the wider region as we expand as well as attend conferences for lead generation and brand awareness in the region. This is a first-AE, build-from-scratch seat with lots of ownership. It's deliberately broader than a pure sales quota. We're looking for someone who can sell, but who can also be our in-region regulatory partner, lead major tender responses, and build the ecosystem of relationships that a new market requires. If ANZ ramps more slowly than we'd like, this role still delivers regional value through APAC deal support, accreditation groundwork, and partnerships.




WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

You'll be Persona's first dedicated seller in the region and define the ICP, the partnerships, and the regulatory playbook from first principles. You'll be the person we lean on for the Australian digital identity regulatory regime, for leading complex public-sector and enterprise tenders, and for representing Persona in industry and regulatory forums. You'll operate cross functionally - one week you might be running a strategic enterprise deal; the next, coordinating Product, Legal, Compliance and Security into a government tender, or partnering with our Compliance team on an accreditation path.




WHAT YOU'LL DO AT PERSONA:

 - Stand up and own the ANZ sales motion as Persona's first dedicated in-region seller. Build the ICP for ANZ. Today we segment between companies founded in Australia expanding globally vs. companies founded internationally with an Australian arm; how we work with each differs.

 - Contribute to strategic and enterprise deals across APAC, partnering with the AE team and APAC leads on relevant accounts, so the role delivers regional value beyond ANZ.

 - Contribute to Persona's regulatory accreditation strategy across ANZ. Based on prospect feedback, proactively identify where an accreditation or certification would unlock the market, build the internal case for it (the why, backed by concrete deal and buyer examples), and then lead the process end-to-end, in partnership with Compliance and Legal, to secure it.

 - Lead ANZ tender responses (RFP / RFI / RFT) end-to-end from qualification and win-strategy through to coordinating Product, Legal, Compliance and Security inputs into a polished submission. These are major, time-intensive efforts and are often the primary route into government and large regulated buyers across the region.

 - Represent Persona at regional and global identity, fraud, and RegTech conferences, nurturing an existing network into qualified pipeline.

 - Act as the in-region competitive subject-matter expert for opportunities across APAC.

 - Establish relationships with industry, compliance and regulatory bodies to generate leads, identify key stakeholders, secure certifications, advocate for Persona's interests, and help shape regulation.

 - Identify and develop alternative sales channels and strategic partnerships (resellers, distributors, system integrators) to grow regional market presence.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - Proven enterprise / strategic sales experience in identity verification, RegTech, fintech, compliance technology, or an adjacent regulated space — ideally selling into APAC/ANZ.

 - Deep familiarity with the Australian regulatory and compliance landscape (KYC/AML, digital identity, AUSTRAC direction).

 - Experience owning complex, multi-stakeholder deals and coordinating cross-functional inputs (Product, Legal, Compliance, Security) to drive a specific outcome.

 - A genuine networker who is comfortable representing a company on stage and at industry events, and turning that presence into pipeline.

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes, playbooks, and ICPs where none exist yet.

 - Strong written communication with ability to explain complex technical and regulatory topics clearly.

As part of our interview process, all candidates will be asked to verify their identity with Persona. This step is used solely to confirm that candidates are who they say they are, and will have no impact on hiring decisions.

jobs.title: Client Data Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For:

The Client Data Operations Analyst will work closely with our Client Success and Operations teams to locate and retrieve the medical records of patients on behalf of those patients’ health insurance companies. Health insurance companies run multiple medical chart retrieval projects a year, and this role is responsible for deep, technical data analysis that drives how we prioritize retrieval efforts and helps us achieve — or surpass — our clients’ record retrieval goals.

This is a highly analytical role. You’ll be working directly with large, complex operational datasets, writing production-quality SQL and Python, and building the dashboards and models that shape how Operations prioritizes its work across Datavant’s clients.

Key Responsibilities:

• Write SQL and Python to analyze large-scale retrieval and inventory data, identifying patterns in chart location, retrieval likelihood, and operational bottlenecks across Datavant’s clients.

• Coordinate with the Client Success team (including joining client calls as needed) to communicate project status and performance drivers, using data to tell a clear, credible story — and to identify what additional information from clients would improve our results

• Analyze large-scale retrieval and inventory data with SQL and Python to identify patterns in chart location, retrieval likelihood, and operational bottlenecks.

• Build and maintain Sigma dashboards and recurring reports tracking project pacing, performance against goals, and emerging trends.

• Develop analytical models and logic that help Operations prioritize chart-retrieval efforts.

• Partner with Client Success to communicate project status and performance drivers, including joining client calls as needed.

• Identify what additional client information would improve retrieval results.

• Monitor KPIs, conduct ad hoc analyses, and recommend improvements based on findings.

• Evaluate business initiatives by measuring their impact on customer and operational outcomes.

• Create presentations and visual stories that explain complex findings clearly.

• Gather requirements from stakeholders and define reporting needs.

• Validate data accuracy and consistency across dashboards, reports, and analyses.

• Document metric definitions, methodologies, and key findings.

• Support scalable reporting and customer insights capabilities for the business.

Bonus Points if you have:

• Experience working in the healthcare insurance/risk adjustment industry, or healthcare/health IT more broadly

• Experience with data pipeline or workflow automation (e.g., scheduled Python jobs, API integrations)

• Familiarity with Power BI or similar BI tools — helpful context as we complete our transition to Sigma

How success is measured in this role:

• Delivering accurate, reliable reporting the team can trust — but accuracy and on-time delivery are only part of the picture, not the whole measure of success

• Investigating and confirming the root cause behind performance changes, not just flagging that something changed

• Recommending clear, actionable next steps that lead to real action or improved results, not just surfacing data

• Identifying risks early, before they become bigger issues

• As we complete our transition to Sigma, expect reporting benchmarks to be reset based on performance under the new platform rather than carried over from pre-migration metrics

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Why Shiftsmart

We’re building the Amazon of labor. We’re a labor platform pairing end-to-end workforce management technology with a rapidly growing global network of 5M flexible workers to create scalable labor solutions for the largest companies in the world, like Circle K, Pepsi, Dollar General, Starbucks and more. Our unique business model fractionalizes jobs down to shifts and makes it easy for workers to work across multiple companies through a digital marketplace. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the country. We’ve grown 2-3x each year since we started and raised $120M+ from top-tier investors including D1 Capital & Imaginary Ventures…and we’re only getting started.



Our mission is to build the world’s leading platform for hourly workers and enterprises enabling flexibility, choice, and upward social mobility.



 - Join a rocketship. This is a unique opportunity to join the ground floor of a rapidly scaling business that is changing the way hourly labor works and capturing a $2 trillion dollar opportunity in the US alone.

 - Ownership + impact. Join a team that is challenging and supporting one another to build a great business and create flexibility, choice, and upward social mobility for workers everywhere.

 - Captain your career path. Enjoy accelerated learning and growth working with a world-class team from top tech companies (e.g. Uber, Airbnb, Google, Amazon), business schools (e.g. HBS, GSB, Wharton), and professional services (e.g. Bain, BCG, Goldman).

 - Become a world-class executor. We believe that #ExecutionIsBinary, and are dedicated to helping you master that skill for life here and beyond.



Role overview

The mission of the Product & Design at Shiftsmart is to build products and features that empower both employers and workers on our platform. Designers are embedded within functional teams across the organization and act as information magnets, working in close collaboration with stakeholders to move the needle on key metrics. This role sits within our Customer team and is focused on building high-quality products that our enterprise customers use every day.  As we onboard new business and expand to new use cases and verticals, you'll improve and expand upon dashboards and SaaS products that support our commercial objectives. You will own your workflow from inputs to outcomes, starting with gathering context and defining requirements all the way through developing, testing, and iterating on live features.You http://features.You’ll be involved in every step of the design process, blending design, research, prototyping, and strategy with a user-first approach, and leveraging a tech stack that enables you to move fast without sacrificing quality. You’ll work closely with other designers, engineers, data experts, and commercial stakeholders, and have plenty of room to learn and grow your ownership over time.



What you’ll do:

 - Own the design of our customer-facing products, iterating on and improving existing platforms as we onboard new customers and expand to new use cases. Design high quality wireframes, mockups, user flows, and prototypes with an eye towards accessibility.

 - Take designs from requirements through engineering handoff and design QA, making sure what ships matches what was designed.

 - Review and synthesize customer feedback to inform design changes, and gather new feedback directly from users when needed.

 - Conduct user research and usability testing to validate functionality and uncover opportunities for improvement.

 - Build a working understanding of each customer’s org structure and user personas, and use it to make sound design calls as we adapt and scale existing experiences for new customers.

 - Maintain and contribute to our Customer Design System, keeping design and development in sync and upholding standards of consistency and accessibility across products.

 - Support design needs for new business proposals.

 - Collaborate with Engineering, Data, and other Customer team stakeholders, and clearly articulate your design rationale to help them align on decisions.

Who you are

You enjoy starting with the user, digging deep into a problem, and understanding pain points. You’re excited to design for large, multi-layered retail organizations and the unique design challenges they present. You are eager to grow, take ownership, and learn from a collaborative design team.

 - Product design: You have 2-5 years of experience in UX, UI, product design, or a related role. You’re proficient in Figma and AI design tools like Lovable, Claude Design, and Claude Code. You  are comfortable owning work end to end, from gathering context and clarifying requirements  through engineering handoff and post-launch testing and iteration

 - User research: You can understand and empathize with end users and turn what you learn into actionable insights. You’re comfortable running user interviews and usability tests.

 - Systems thinking: You care about consistency and scalability, and have experience working within (or helping build) a design system.

 - Technically minded: You work well with engineers, investigate  technical constraints, and understand how the flow and structures of complex data systems impact design.

 - AI fluency: AI tools are already a core part of how you work, whether for exploration, prototyping, or getting closer to code. You can point to concrete examples of how they’ve helped you ship high-quality designs faster.

 - Collaborative: You partner effectively with engineers, data, and our Customer team, and you can translate input from business and technical stakeholders into thoughtful design decisions. You welcome feedback and keep others aligned on your rationale.

 - Growth mindset: You seek out the context you need rather than waiting for it to be handed to you, and drive work to completion in partnership with product and engineering. You’re curious and excited to learn and take on more ownership over time.

Compensation philosophy

To provide greater transparency we share base salary ranges, which are based on role and level benchmarked against similar stage, high growth companies. Offers are determined based on multiple factors including skills, work experience, and relevant credentials.

In addition to competitive salaries and meaningful equity we offer the following benefits:

 - Comprehensive healthcare coverage: We cover 100% of employee premiums for medical, dental, and vision care (60-75% for dependents)

 - 401(k) match program: We match 100% on the first 3% of your contributions and 50% on the next 2% for a maximum match of 4%

 - Generous, fully paid parental and family leave policies

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits

 - Collaborative office with fully stocked kitchen @ 1 World Trade in Manhattan



Equal opportunity employer

Shiftsmart is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.



Operating Principles @ Shiftsmart

Inspired by Leadership Principles @ Amazon https://www.amazon.jobs/en/principles



Execution Is Binary

We #GetShiftDone. We take immense pride in both the quality of our work and our relentless determination to deliver on our commitments. If we say we are going to do something, we do it.

We own the outcome with an unstoppable mindset through the finish line and are impatient to move the ball forward. This means we work really hard, execute with urgency, and ruthlessly challenge timelines for anything important. As a result, we do not defer responsibility to other teams or individuals. Instead, we take the problem as far as we can and only when needed ask others for help.

Each time a crisis or opportunity emerges we take the hill as one team, because we are allergic to the words “it can’t be done”.



Missionaries, Not Mercenaries

We before me. We believe in our mission to build a better world for workers. We understand why our work matters and take seriously how it impacts our customers and our partners. This belief permeates everything we do from the strategic to the mundane.

We are energetic, ambitious, and want to win. We constantly raise the standards for ourselves and everyone around us. We show up for our customers, our partners, and most importantly our teammates, and make every effort to build lasting relationships with each of them.

We do not measure success based on our titles or the size of our empires. This also means we put the needs of the business before the details of our job descriptions. Rather than fight for a bigger piece of the pie, we fight to grow the entire thing and recognize this is how to grow our careers too.



Inputs > Outcomes

We work really hard. Fundamentally changing how labor works is not easy. It often requires long days, late nights, and weekends to deliver on our commitments. We lean into this challenge.

We focus on the process. We think in terms of value chains and appreciate that a bad process with a good outcome is simply dumb luck. 

We lead with data. We use facts, not fiction, to build narratives and make decisions. To do this we prepare written memos in advance and resist the urge to engage in endless water cooler what ifs, because we value the time and attention of our teammates.

We hire and develop the best. When we decide to hire a new team member, we do so because we believe they will increase the talent density on our team. We view ourselves as leverage maximizers rather than inconvenience reducers and strive to increase the output of everyone we interact with.



Honesty Over Harmony

We share the truth even when it is painful. We do not, however, share the truth callously to hurt people’s feelings or make them look bad. We also assume positive intent. If someone is not delivering in a way that we need, we ask them and tell them before assuming the worst.

We embrace mutual feedback. As people leaders we care more about our team’s growth and success than how much others like us. As individuals we seek, accept, and apply feedback. We do not give or take feedback personally because we understand it enables us to learn and grow.

We tell the truth to ourselves. We reject a pollyannaish view of our world. Instead if something isn’t going well that we are responsible for, we call it out. And when someone calls out their own truth that may be less optimal, we don’t punish them for it.

We have the meeting in the meeting. If something is broken or we disagree, we call it out and say something in the moment even if it feels uncomfortable to do so. This means that if something is broken, we do not just accept it and complain later.



Invent & Iterate

We are inventors @ heart. We categorically reject the phrase “that is how it’s always been done”, and constantly discover new and better ways to do more with less. This means we are resourceful and often do things that don’t scale, only to create ways to scale them later. We’re builders.

We think BIG. At every level of the company, we embrace big, hairy, audacious, and transformative goals. We fear lack of progress and incremental thinking more than failing to deliver or falling short of an audacious goal. We believe courage means to try without fear and learn without ego.

We do not let perfect get in the way of better. When faced with the choice we prioritize delivering something, even if imperfect, over endless debate and alignment. We embrace good mistakes.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Market Insights & Analytics - Neuroscience Pipeline
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, APEX (Analytics & Performance Excellence) Neuroscience Pipeline Commercialization & Strategy (PCS) is responsible for designing, implementing, managing, analyzing and communicating insights generation activities, including market research, analytics and competitive intelligence, in support of assigned franchises/brands and pipeline assets. The individual will derive high-impact learnings from many sources and techniques, lead key internal initiatives, and partner across teams and organizations to inform strategic and tactical decision-making. The ability to influence decisions through careful, strategic thinking and a deep understanding of the business is critical to success.

Key responsibilities include independently leading Business Insights planning, implementation, communication of results, and alignment of brand strategies and plans. The Senior Manager manages all aspects of Business Insights, including initiation of the RFP process, vendor selection, study design, contract execution, budget management, and direction on the scope of services provided by vendors.

The Senior Manager leads all aspects of project planning, including coordination, setting timelines, gaining cross-functional alignment, shaping conclusions and recommendations, presenting interim and final results, and communicating project progress and initiatives to Brand Teams, Senior Management and Vendors, where appropriate.

Key Responsibilities Include:

• Serve as the APEX lead supporting assigned Neuroscience pipeline assets, covering multiple disease states and indications. Act as a trusted intelligence partner to Brand and PCS Leadership, guiding strategy and advising on key initiatives through knowledge of the business, market trends and data and analytics capabilities.
• Enable and demonstrate leadership on cross-functional business teams across assets and pipeline indications, supporting better and more rapid decisions by framing and prioritizing critical brand questions.
• Develop and maintain working relationships with the APEX cross-functional team and US and key affiliate contacts to co-create and execute plans, eliminate redundancies and ensure consistency of market understanding.
• Collaborate across Commercial and R&D to ensure insights are leveraged to inform strategic and tactical decisions, building strong relationships while maintaining objectivity to represent the voice of the customer.
• Be conversant with custom research methods, adept at supplier and stakeholder management, and able to independently lead custom research projects that deliver compelling, actionable learnings.
• Proactively identify analytics opportunities and perform sophisticated syntheses across research, analytics and market intelligence sources to ensure decisions are based on the most current, objective and comprehensive insights.
• Play a leading role in the continuous brand planning process through a deep understanding of market drivers, patient journey, competition and positioning, highlighting opportunities to enhance patient and HCP experience and address leverage points and gaps.
• Incorporate commercial competitive intelligence to help AbbVie anticipate competitor strategies and achieve market leadership; maintain and communicate knowledge of the market, competitive trends and industry developments to internal stakeholders.
• Provide insights on current dynamics and future market evolution over the next 3-10 years to guide brand teams in developing successful clinical programs and launch strategies for multiple indications.
• Design and execute measurement plans, including selected operational and performance indicators, to ensure understanding of the execution, engagement and impact of in-market tactics.
• Leverage internal resources, external vendors and AI to maximize learnings and accelerate AbbVie's understanding of key therapeutic categories within Neuroscience.
• Lead and participate in initiatives to improve APEX data and analytics capabilities.
• Present learnings with thoughtful confidence across all levels of the organization.
• Monitor and manage research and analytics programs within budget, identifying cost-saving opportunities where appropriate.
• Ensure all APEX research and analytics activities are conducted on time and in accordance with financial and ethical compliance guidelines.

• BA or BS degree required. Advanced degree (MA, MS, MBA, PhD) preferred, with a concentration in marketing research, marketing or social sciences. Statistical knowledge is a plus.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Coordinator - Dublin, OH
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer’s experience through service, focus, and participation—so, you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say yes and put patient and customer experience above all else. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online

• Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly

• Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say “yes” to customer needs

• Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate

• Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience.

• Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions

• Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information

• Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet’s care and strengthen relationships

• Celebrate and capture special moments (with permission), creating lasting connections between customers, their pets, and the hospital

WHAT YOU NEED

• 2+ years of experience in a customer service role

• Advanced knowledge in computer programs and practice management software

• Highly organized, with strong attention to detail

• A strong communicator; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone

• A strong multitasker, able to thrive amid chaos

• High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly

• Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

As the Human Resources Manager at one of the most iconic ski resorts in the world, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the employee experience and bringing our culture to life. You’ll lead a broad range of HR functions, including talent onboarding, employee relations, compensation and benefits, learning and development, and compliance, ensuring our people have the support and resources to thrive. As a trusted partner to leaders and employees, you’ll champion an exceptional workplace experience while fostering a culture built on connection, integrity, and service. This position reports to the Director of Human Resources.

This position is required to work in person at Aspen Highlands Human Resources office.

The salary range for this position is $64,500- $85,000. Actual pay will be dependent on budget and experience, all our salaried roles are eligible for bonus.

jobs.title: GTM Operations Analyst

Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalized and profitable guest experiences. We're hiring a GTM Operations Analyst to build the pipeline generation engine our sales teams run on. jobs.title: Construction Manager - Owner's Construction Representative
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atwell, LLC is a bold leader in the consulting, engineering, and construction services industry, delivering a broad range of creative solutions to clients in the real estate & land development, and energy markets. We have a strong national presence and a diverse, award-winning project portfolio. Atwell is a privately owned company, with 2,000+ passionate team members across 75+ locations and growing!

Atwell, LLC is a proud recipient of the following 2025 awards:

• Ten consecutive years in a row as a “Best Place to Work” by Zweig Group (#11)

• Recognized as #70 in the ENR Top 500 Design Firms, ranked in every region

• Recognized in Crain's “Fast 50” as one of the fastest-growing companies (#14)

• Recognized as the 2025 ENR Design Firm of the year for the Southeastern US

Job Summary

The Construction Manager serves as Atwell’s Owner’s Construction Representative for client pavement and roadway rehabilitation programs, supporting pavement assessment review, rehabilitation planning, procurement, construction-phase coordination, budget and schedule oversight, reporting, closeout, and warranty-phase services. This role reviews pavement condition data, plans, budgets, and schedules with Owner, design, and construction teams to recommend rehabilitation strategies, identify constructability, budget, and schedule concerns, and develop mitigation strategies to reduce project risk.

The Construction Manager coordinates horizontal construction activities, including roadway, pavement, drainage, and civil/site improvements, with design consultants, paving and specialty contractors, municipalities, governmental agencies, suppliers, vendors, utility providers, and Owner stakeholders to maintain project schedules, control budgets, resolve issues, and support successful project delivery consistent with approved plans, specifications, contracts, and Owner expectations. The role supports recurring, multi-site programs for repeat clients, requires frequent short-duration travel, and may support other civil and site development projects as needed.

This position provides advisory construction management services on behalf of the Owner. Atwell does not act as the Contractor or Constructor and does not supervise, direct, or control contractor means, methods, techniques, sequences, procedures, site safety programs, site security, or contractor personnel.

Owner Representation and Client Relationships

• Serve as Atwell's client-facing Owner's Construction Representative for assigned pavement programs and other construction management projects.

• Build strong, long-term relationships with repeat program clients; client confidence directly supports program renewals and new work.

• Coordinate communication among Owner stakeholders, community and property managers, contractors, design consultants, municipalities, utility providers, and internal Atwell resources.

• Identify risks, resolve issues, and escalate items requiring Owner direction or approval.

Pavement Assessment and Program Planning

• Review pavement condition data gathered with AI-based pavement assessment technology and help interpret condition ratings.

• Prepare preliminary cost estimates and budgets for rehabilitation plans to support Owner decision-making and bid evaluation.

• Work with pavement program leadership to develop rehabilitation action plans, recommending treatments such as crack sealing, seal coating, patching, mill and overlay, and full-depth reconstruction.

• Evaluate drainage, catch basins, curb and gutter, and other roadway elements that affect the scope and longevity of repairs.

• Help prioritize multi-year rehabilitation programs within the Owner's annual budget.

• Bring forward new tools, technologies, and methods that could improve how Atwell assesses and delivers pavement work.

Procurement and Bidding

• Prepare and issue bid packages for pavement and civil work; manage bid solicitation, bidder coordination, RFIs, clarifications, and addenda.

• Assist with contractor vetting and prequalification, including qualifications, relevant experience, safety history, bonding, and insurance.

• Perform bid leveling to identify scope gaps, exclusions, unit pricing differences, alternates, and allowances.

• Prepare comparative bid summaries and written contractor recommendations to the Owner based on cost, scope, schedule, risk, and overall value.

• Recommend value engineering and cost-saving alternatives while maintaining Owner objectives.

• Support contract readiness, including insurance documentation, Owner review of contract documents, and final budget confirmation.

Construction Management and Coordination

• Schedule and lead pre-bid and pre-construction meetings with contractors, Owner stakeholders, and other project participants.

• Conduct periodic site visits during construction to observe progress, quality, and conformance with plans and specifications.

• Identify deficiencies and nonconforming work, and track corrective actions through completion.

• Coordinate required inspections, testing, permits, and agency requirements with regulatory authorities.

• Manage or coordinate RFI, submittal, testing, inspection, and project documentation processes.

• Support other civil and site development construction management projects when pavement program workload allows.

Reporting and Documentation

• Prepare progress reports for Owner stakeholders covering completed work, upcoming activities, schedule, budget, open issues, risks, and required Owner decisions.

• Lead project meetings, prepare agendas, track action items, and document decisions.

• Maintain an organized project documentation repository for reports, RFIs, submittals, change orders, payment documentation, inspection records, and closeout materials.

Budget, Change, and Payment Management

• Monitor project and program budgets, cost-to-complete forecasts, allowances, contingencies, and potential cost exposure.

• Review, evaluate, and negotiate contractor change order requests; identify cost, schedule, and scope impacts for Owner approval.

• Review contractor payment applications, sworn statements, lien waivers, and retainage; recommend approval, withholding, or adjustment of payments.

• Prepare reconciled budget updates, final cost summaries, and payment recommendations.

Closeout and Warranty

• Conduct punch list walk-throughs and final inspections with Owner stakeholders and contractors; track completion of corrective work.

• Confirm completion of testing, inspections, agency approvals, and permit closures.

• Assist with final contractor payments, retainage release, and project closeout documentation.

• Coordinate warranty inspections and follow-up correction items.

• Conduct lessons-learned reviews to improve future program delivery.

Travel and Work Environment

This role requires frequent, short-duration travel to client sites across the country. A typical trip is a single day for a pre-bid meeting, pre-construction meeting, site visit, or final inspection, with a return home the same or next day. Back-to-back trips within the same week are common during the construction season.

This is not a resident field position. The Construction Manager does not remain on a single job site for extended periods; most program management, bid analysis, and reporting is performed between site visits.

Required Competencies

• Working knowledge of how roads are built, maintained, and repaired, including asphalt and concrete pavement, base and subgrade, drainage, and catch basins.

• Ability to interpret pavement condition data and translate it into practical, budget-conscious rehabilitation recommendations.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead client-facing meetings and build lasting client relationships.

• Knowledge of construction drawings, contracts, specifications, schedules, budgets, RFIs, submittals, change orders, pay applications, and closeout documentation.

• Ability to manage multiple active projects and client programs at once, often in different locations.

• Versatility to support a range of civil and site development projects beyond pavement work.

• Openness to new technology and a willingness to suggest better tools and processes.

• Sound judgment, accountability, follow-through, and the ability to escalate cost, schedule, scope, quality, or risk matters appropriately.

Education / Experience

Required

• Seven plus (7+) years of construction management, Owner's representative, construction administration, or project management experience in horizontal construction.

• Substantial experience managing road and pavement construction or rehabilitation. Relevant backgrounds include pavement maintenance and rehabilitation programs, municipal or DOT roadway projects, and residential, multifamily, or commercial land development with significant roadway scope.

• Experience with bid solicitation, bid leveling, and contractor recommendations.

• Experience reviewing construction documents, budgets, schedules, contracts, change orders, payment applications, RFIs, submittals, and closeout documentation.

• Willingness to travel frequently on short trips.

Preferred

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field; equivalent education and experience may be considered.

• Ten plus (10+) years of relevant experience.

• State DOT certification or roadway construction inspection experience.

• Experience with pavement management or condition assessment tools, especially AI-based or automated systems (such as Vialytics). Experience with traditional rating systems such as PASER or PAVER is also welcome.

• Experience with recurring, multi-site programs for repeat clients.

• Broader civil and site development experience (grading, storm and sanitary utilities, site improvements).

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Bluebeam, Adobe Acrobat, and scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project.

• OSHA 30 or related construction safety training.

Scope of Authority

• Has authority to work independently as Atwell's Owner's Construction Representative within the assigned project scope and Owner-approved direction.

• Coordinates project stakeholders and Atwell resources to support Owner objectives, schedule performance, budget control, issue resolution, and project delivery.

• Makes recommendations to the Owner regarding pavement rehabilitation treatments, contractor selection, bid evaluation, value engineering, project risks, change orders, payment applications, schedule impacts, budget impacts, and corrective actions.

• May make initial decisions regarding contractor claims, disputes, deficiencies, nonconforming work, and contract interpretation on behalf of the Owner within established thresholds, escalating items affecting cost, schedule, scope, quality, or risk as required.

• Does not supervise, direct, or control contractor means, methods, techniques, sequences, procedures, jobsite safety, site security, or contractor personnel.

Disclaimer

While AI tools may support your application process, this role is built on human talent. Your judgment, experience, and character matter most, so we encourage you to showcase what makes you uniquely you.

Atwell does not accept unsolicited resumes from any 3rd party agencies. No fee will be paid to 3rd parties who submit unsolicited resumes to any Atwell employee. Resumes from approved vendors must be specifically requested by Atwell and approved by the Atwell Talent Acquisition Team.

#LI-MT1

Pay Range

$100,000—$140,000 USD

Atwell Benefits: To attract and retain the best professionals in the industry, we aim to provide an excellent working environment and a progressive benefits program designed to support your personal and professional needs.

‘Atwell’ness:

jobs.title: Procurement Director
jobs.description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is hiring a Procurement Director to build and run the function that turns every dollar of company spend into leverage, from cloud and software to professional services, marketing and facilities. You will report to the SVP of Corporate Finance, Accounting and Treasury, lead an initial team of one, and partner with Finance, Treasury, Legal, Security, and Product Development to make procurement a strategic discipline. You will set category strategy, own the source-to-pay operating model, and deliver measurable savings and risk reduction without slowing a fast-moving company. This is a hands-on seat: you will negotiate your own deals while building the team, policy and systems that scale.

This is an ideal fit for someone who is comfortable in a fast-paced, challenging startup-like environment while wanting to join a fun and collaborative team. You will be working with a group of highly skilled and driven individuals, who thrive on building a great business and company culture. The right candidate will drive business insights and continuous improvement, bring a quantitative, data-driven mindset, and have outstanding communication and interpersonal skills.

How You’ll Contribute:

Strategy and category management

• Build a three-year procurement strategy tied to Xometry's growth plan, margin targets and cash-flow priorities

• Own category strategies for technology and cloud, professional services, marketing and media, payments and financial services, logistics, facilities and travel

• Use spend analytics to find savings, consolidate vendors and shift spend to better commercial terms

Negotiation and commercial leadership

• Lead complex, high-value negotiations (multi-year SaaS, cloud commitments, outsourcing) and structure terms that protect price, flexibility and exit rights

• Partner with Treasury on payment terms, working-capital optimization and FX exposure

• Partner with Legal on MSAs, SLAs, data-protection and liability terms

Operating model and controls

• Design and run an intake-to-pay process: request, approval, sourcing, contracting, purchase order, receipt and payment

• Optimize procurement and spend-management tooling integrated with the ERP and AP workflow

• Enforce delegation-of-authority, competitive-bid thresholds and policies that satisfy SOX and audit requirements

• Work with Accounting on accruals, prepaid and commitment tracking, and the treatment of cloud, software and implementation costs

Supplier risk and performance

• Run supplier onboarding, due diligence, security and compliance reviews, and sanctions and anti-corruption screening

• Track supplier performance, concentration risk and renewal calendars; own a quarterly business review cadence for strategic vendors

Leadership

• Manage and develop your initial direct report, and build the business case and hiring plan to grow the team (category managers, sourcing analysts, procurement operations) as the function scales

• Act as a trusted advisor to executives, translating procurement data into decisions in the budget, forecast and board reporting cycles

• Coordinate with regional leadership so that direct sourcing and corporate procurement share data, practices and supplier intelligence

What You’ll Bring to Xometry:

• 12+ years of progressive procurement, strategic sourcing or vendor management experience, including experience leading or mentoring others and operating at director level or equivalent scope, including as a player-coach in a lean team

• A track record of building or scaling a procurement function at a high-growth technology, marketplace or manufacturing company, with documented savings and cost-avoidance results

• Deep experience negotiating technology, cloud and professional-services contracts, including usage-based, committed-spend and multi-year agreements

• Strong financial acumen: you can model total cost of ownership, read a P&L and balance sheet, and discuss payment terms, working capital and accounting treatment with Controllers and Treasurers

• Hands-on experience with source-to-pay and spend-management platforms (for example SAP Concur, Coupa, Ariba or similar) and ERP integration (Sage Intacct, NetSuite, SAP or Oracle)

• Working knowledge of SOX controls, internal audit expectations and vendor risk, privacy and security frameworks

• Executive presence and the ability to influence without authority across Finance, Products, Legal and the business

This role will partner closely with product, analytics, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous business needs into reliable technical solutions, while helping establish strong engineering standards across data pipelines, cloud platforms, data models, APIs, automation, and observability. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who can work independently, mentor others, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners, and continuously improve how data is delivered, governed, tested, and supported in a fast-moving environment.

• Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable data pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and publish structured and semi-structured data from internal and external sources.
• Translate business and product requirements into technical designs, data models, integration patterns, and execution plans that support reliable analytics and operational workflows.
• Develop reusable, maintainable code using modern data engineering practices, with an emphasis on performance, testability, observability, and long-term supportability.
• Build and optimize batch, event-driven, and serverless data processing patterns using cloud-native services and distributed processing frameworks.
• Contribute to architecture decisions across data lake, warehouse, orchestration, metadata, API, and application integration patterns.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Perchwell is the modern real estate listings platform built for agents to search smarter, collaborate better, and close deals faster. We are building the future of residential real estateʼs critical listings infrastructure: a platform where market  research and client collaboration converge. Our modern architecture enables continuous innovation at a pace legacy systems cannot match, with AI-powered features and mobile-first capabilities designed for how agents actually work. As consumer expectations and technology evolve, Perchwell remains focused on our core vision:  empowering real estate professionals with the most intelligent, data-driven, and connected platform in the industry.

Backed by leading venture capital firms including Lux Capital and Founders Fund, along with strategic partnerships with some of the country's top Multiple Listing Services (MLSs), Perchwell represents the first major new platform to enter the listings technology market in decades. This unique combination of institutional investment and deep industry alignment provides both the resources and market validation needed to transform the multi-trillion dollar residential real estate industry.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're hiring a Product Manager to own a segment of critical agent workflows in Perchwell's platform as we build the MLS and real estate vertical operating system of the future. This is an individual contributor role for a technically fluent product leader who can take a significant, ambiguous problem space and turn it into a clear strategy, a credible roadmap, and shipped outcomes.

You'll own core platform areas including client collaboration, reporting, and how agents engage with, analyze, and understand real estate data. You'll lead product for the teams delivering interactive client reports , partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Customer Success, and product leadership at our MLS and brokerage clients.

You'll be expected to make strategic product decisions, influence direction beyond your immediate team, and raise the bar for the product managers around you.

This role is a strong fit if you've led product for data- or API-heavy SaaS platforms, are comfortable going deep with engineers on schemas and integrations, and want outsized impact at a company in its next phase of scale. This role is based in our New York City HQ.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the data product strategy and roadmap - Lead full lifecycle product management for core platform capabilities including search, listing management, and data analysis tools, from discovery and definition through launch and iteration.

 - Lead significant, cross-team initiatives - Drive large-scale efforts such as new vendor API integrations, data ingestion pipelines, and MLS data delivery, coordinating across Engineering, Data, Design, and Customer Success to ship high-quality work on time.

 - Make strategic product decisions - Set priorities and make clear trade-offs that align your area with company goals, and own the outcomes and key performance targets your team commits to.

 - Solve intricate, cross-functional problems - Proactively identify the right problems to solve, weigh multiple approaches, and partner with stakeholders to deliver solutions that hold up for both today's needs and long-term scale.

 - Go deep on the data - Work directly with our APIs, data models, and SQL to validate requirements, investigate data quality issues, and measure product impact.

 - Partner with clients at the leadership level - Engage with product leadership at MLS and brokerage clients to understand their needs and translate them into an executable roadmap.

 - Build clarity and raise the bar - Write crisp product requirements and strategy docs, advise peers on data and API product decisions, and mentor more junior product managers.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 4+ years of product management experience, including significant time owning data, platform, or API products at a high-growth SaaS company.

 - A track record of leading product for teams building and integrating APIs, including working directly with external vendors and partners.

 - Strong technical fluency: you write and run SQL, understand data models and ingestion pipelines, and engage engineers on architecture, sequencing, and trade-offs.

 - Experience leading significant, cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous problem to shipped outcome, with measurable impact on business goals.

 - Strong product sense paired with customer- and problem-centricity; you prioritize the right problems and their solutions with sound judgment.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior internal stakeholders and client leadership.

 - Experience mentoring or advising other product managers is a plus, as is experience with real estate, MLS, or other data-heavy vertical software.


WHO YOU ARE

 - Technically Inclined - You're as comfortable in a SQL editor or API spec as you are in a roadmap review, and engineers trust your technical judgment.

 - Ownership-Driven - You take full responsibility for your product area's outcomes and do whatever it takes to make your product and team successful.

 - Structured Thinker - You turn chaos and ambiguity into structure and clarity, for yourself and for the teams around you.

 - Excellent Communicator - You bridge gaps across design, engineering, customer success, product leadership, and users with clear, organized communication.

 - Creative Problem Solver - You bring fresh perspectives, take smart risks, and move forward confidently in uncertain circumstances.

 - Growth Minded - You have an insatiable appetite for learning, question "the way things have always been done," and help others grow too.


SALARY INFORMATION

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. Our ranges are based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including skills, job-related knowledge and depth of work experience.

We believe in transparency. The base salary for this role is $155,000-$175,000, with equity and benefits. Final compensation will depend on experience and fit.


STRONG BENEFITS PACKAGE

 - Flexible PTO, plus 10 paid company holidays

 - 401K with a company match

 - Medical, dental, and vision plans

 - HSA and FSA options

 - Commuter benefits

 - Parental leave

 - Company-wide onsite or offsite each year

 - Beautiful office in Soho, Manhattan with a stocked kitchen, catered breakfast and lunch once per week, happy hours and meet-ups

 

Note: At this time, we are only considering candidates who are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

Rocket Lab’s Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER II

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Senior Software Engineer II for Rocket Lab Optical Systems in Chantilly, VA, you will design flight software in support of spacecraft for Tranche 3 of the U.S. Space Development Agency's Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Play a key role supporting the development of payload flight software for our Space Systems programs

• Focus on deployment of novel algorithms into austere environments on Size/Weight/Power constrained sensor systems

• Participate in all aspects of software design and development starting with requirements generation and following through implementation, testing, deployment

• Drive core software fundamentals of performance-oriented programming leveraging a variety of accelerator technologies

• Be part of a team of driven pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER II:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering,

• 8+ years of experience in embedded software engineering experience

• Experience in designing complex multithreaded application

• Experience designing flight software

• Ability to obtain and maintain an U.S. Government security clearance

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Familiarity with high-performance and parallel processing

• Exposure to novel architectures including FPGA, CUDA, etc.

• Familiarity with flight software system management

• Experience with algorithm implementation

• Exposure to Python and MATLAB is highly desired

• Familiarity with numerical computing principles

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

The expected salary range for the position is displayed in accordance with the state of Virginia’s pay transparency requirements. Final agreed upon compensation is based upon individual qualifications and experience.

Base salary is only one part of Rocket Lab’s compensation package for this role. You may be eligible for company stock, or cash incentives, and can purchase discounted stock through Rocket Lab’s Employee Stock Purchase Program. Employee benefits also include medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401(k) retirement plan options; paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave; paid parental leave; and other discounts and perks.

Base Pay Range (VA Only)

$143,300—$214,850 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. The Sr. Director of Global Security is the Company’s senior security executive, accountable for setting the vision, strategy and operating model that protect our people, products, brand, facilities and operations in every market where we do business. This leader owns the global security and Enterprise Security Risk Management (ESRM) agenda, serves as the trusted advisor to the Executive Leadership Team on critical and emerging security risks, and leads enterprise crisis management and business continuity readiness. The role builds an intelligence-led, globally integrated security function that enables business growth, safeguards brand and product integrity, and strengthens organizational resilience. It operates with significant autonomy and enterprise-wide influence, and is accountable for measurable risk reduction and loss avoidance.

RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE:

• Global Strategy & Governance: Develop, own and execute a multi-year global security strategy and roadmap aligned to business priorities, growth plans and risk appetite. Establish the policies, standards, procedures and governance that protect the Company across supply chain security, workplace violence prevention, insider threat, physical security, product tampering and brand protection.

• Enterprise Security Risk Management (ESRM): Build and lead the ESRM program, applying a risk-based, business-aligned methodology to identify gaps in, assess the effectiveness of, and continuously improve all security policies and practices. Partner with business owners, departments and markets to drive risk reduction and loss avoidance, and report program maturity, key risk indicators and performance metrics to senior leadership.

• Executive Advisory: Serve as the trusted advisor to the Executive Leadership Team (and the Board or its committees as required) on critical, emerging and time-sensitive security issues. Translate complex threats into clear, decision-ready guidance, risk tradeoffs and investment recommendations.

• Crisis Management & Business Continuity: Lead enterprise Crisis Management and Business Continuity planning with senior management and key stakeholders. Develop the policies, playbooks and escalation protocols that protect people and operations; direct crisis response and communication to impacted employees; and validate readiness through regular exercises, simulations and post-incident reviews.

• Threat Intelligence & Investigations: Establish a global threat intelligence and monitoring capability that anticipates geopolitical, criminal, workplace and brand-related risks. Direct sensitive, high-impact investigations, in partnership with Legal, Human Resources and Compliance, ensuring integrity, confidentiality and regulatory compliance.

• Integrated Security Operations: Set global standards for, and integrate, physical access control, security technology, monitoring, third-party protection services and vendors, and profile management of employees, contractors and visitors across offices, manufacturing sites and distribution centers. Optimize cost, coverage and service levels through a disciplined vendor and budget strategy.

• Supply Chain, Product Integrity & Brand Protection: Partner with Operations, Quality, Procurement and Legal to secure the end-to-end supply chain and protect product integrity. Lead the response to product tampering, counterfeiting and diversion, and coordinate enforcement efforts with law enforcement and industry partners.

• Global Incident Management: Own the global incident management system, including oversight, audit, triage and trend analysis. Convert incident data and metrics into insight that informs the ESRM program, resource allocation and executive decision-making.

• Travel, Event & Executive Security: Oversee travel risk management, including monitoring and restricting high-risk travel, and ensure risk and threat assessments and an effective security posture for Company events and senior leaders globally.

• Converged Security & Cyber Partnership: Partner with IT, Compliance and Audit to align physical, personnel and information security practices and ensure effective security of information systems and technology. Advise the Executive Leadership Team on cybersecurity matters when appropriate.

• Culture & Awareness: Design and deliver enterprise security awareness and training programs that embed risk-conscious behavior and shared accountability across all levels of the Company.

• Leadership & Talent: Build, lead and develop a high-performing global security organization, including direct reports and a matrixed network of regional and site security personnel. Set clear goals, mentor future leaders, and foster a culture of accountability, integrity and continuous improvement.

EXPERIENCE

• 12+ years of progressive experience in corporate security, risk management or related disciplines, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role with direct accountability for global security at a multinational organization.

• Proven track record of designing, implementing and governing enterprise-wide security programs across multiple regions, including management of leaders, budgets and third-party providers.

• Demonstrated crisis leadership, having directed the response to significant incidents and business disruptions with visibility to senior executives.

• Experience advising C-suite executives and presenting security risk, strategy and performance to senior leadership and Board-level audiences.

• Background in law enforcement, intelligence, military or government security with international exposure is highly valued.

• Experience in consumer products, manufacturing or another brand-driven, regulated industry with a complex global supply chain is strongly preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

• Strategic and enterprise-level thinking, with the business acumen to align security strategy, policies and investments with corporate objectives, risk appetite and growth plans.

• Deep expertise in Enterprise Security Risk Management (ESRM), threat and vulnerability assessment, crisis management, business continuity and investigations.

• Executive presence and influence: the ability to build trust at the highest levels, challenge constructively, and communicate complex risks clearly and persuasively to the Executive Leadership Team, the Board and the global organization.

• Strong leadership and talent development skills, with a record of building high-performing, diverse and geographically dispersed teams

• Sound judgment, composure and decisiveness under pressure in high-stakes, ambiguous situations, with the highest standards of integrity and discretion.

• Established relationships with law enforcement, intelligence and other government agencies globally, as well as private sector and industry counterparts.

• Sophisticated cross-cultural fluency and understanding of the legal, regulatory and geopolitical landscape across multiple regions.

• Ability to lead change and drive results through both formal channels and informal networks across a matrixed, global organization.

• Financial and vendor management skills, including budget ownership and the use of metrics and analytics to demonstrate program value.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATION

• Bachelor’s Degree in Criminal Justice, law, security management, risk management, business or a related field required; Master’s Degree preferred.

• Professional security or risk certification such as Certified Protection Professional (CPP), ASIS ESRM Certificate, Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP), or a government equivalent.

KEY INTERFACES

jobs.location: Seattle, San Francisco, Chicago, New York, Remote
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

What You’ll Do

As technology evolves, so do our tax reporting requirements, especially with the multitude of state and local taxes around the US.  Our state-related indirect obligations and filing requirements continue to grow with the business, and we are looking for someone who can not only maintain but help further build our US sales tax practice in achieving our tax goals.  This individual will need to be versed in indirect tax systems used in compliance, and be able to work with our talented group of engineers who support the state tax function. This position will report to the State & Local Tax Lead.

This position can be office-based in Seattle, South San Francisco, Chicago, New York City, or Remote-US.

Responsibilities

• Help establish the direction, goals, and priorities for Stripe’s US indirect tax function, with a strong moral compass and integrity.

• Manage and improve state indirect tax compliance systems across our portfolio of companies, and work with the tax reporting and eng teams to ensure coverage on all of our tax filings. This includes systems used in compliance filings, business registrations, and working with our both tax and non-tax vendors to ensure we are meeting our compliance obligations.

• Oversee and run point on special projects impacting US indirect tax systems.

• Run models and analyses for state indirect tax planning.

• Assist in data collection used in state controversy across different tax types and resolve tax issues.

• Monitor SALT developments across the US, including local impacts of federal law.

• Proactively identify areas for operational improvements and implement solutions to streamline downstream US indirect tax reporting.

• Participate in special projects as needed including state tax attribute studies, nexus reviews, and evaluating state tax impacts of new tax regimes, M&A transactions, and new products before they launch.

Who You Are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

• 6+ years of relevant indirect tax experience, including in public accounting (Big 4 preferred) and/or - preferably - at a multinational publicly listed company.

• Deep knowledge of state indirect tax issues and solutions in the technology industry.

• A strong background in tax compliance, specifically US indirect taxes.

• Experience in working with teams and engineers in building out US indirect tax infrastructure.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to research and communicate complex technical tax issues clearly to non-tax team members and work effectively across functional teams.

• Flexibility to react quickly to changes in state tax laws including proposed changes as well as changes in the company’s products and services.

• Exhibit strong analytical thinking, ability to work in a fast-paced environment with excellent prioritization and organizational skills.

• Empathy, humility, and some comedy

You will also likely have (not required):

• An advanced degree or professional qualification in tax, accounting, or law (CPA, JD or Master’s degree).

• Experience working in a high-growth, rapidly scaling environment.

• Industry experience at a multinational organization; experience working in technology, payments, or financial services is a plus.

• A willingness to work with a diverse crew of tax nerds who care deeply about Stripe’s tax issues and each other.

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.
