jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager, Agent Experience Insights
jobs.description:
Conviva is the experience analytics platform for AI agents, apps, and streaming. Conviva pioneered quality of experience measurement for streaming video and has supported live digital experiences across 20 Super Bowls, 10 Olympic Games, and five FIFA World Cup tournaments. With full-census, real-time, stateful analytics, Conviva shows what consumers actually experience, not just whether systems are running, and connects that experience to revenue, retention, and risk.

Senior AI Product Manager, Agent Experience Insights

Agent effectiveness is the defining problem of the AI agent industry, and it is still unsolved. Conviva has the technology, the customers and the head start to be the company that solves it. Agent Experience Insights (AEI) is our answer to the core of that problem: understanding how well an agent actually works, where and why it falls short, and what to change to make it better. We are hiring a Senior AI Product Manager to build industry-leading AI solutions in AEI.

About Conviva

Conviva is the experience-centric observability company for AI agents. We help agent teams understand how effective their agents are, where they fall short and how to improve them. Our platform is built on patented Time-State Technology, which analyzes complex, stateful experience data in real time and at massive scale. The same technology powers Conviva’s streaming video business, where the world’s leading streaming publishers rely on us to measure and improve every viewer’s experience.

The role

As Senior AI Product Manager for AEI, you will own a key part of the product end to end. You will work with cutting-edge AI technology, stay obsessed with customer value, and help build an industry-leading product.

The work covers the many types of AI agents that we help our customers measure, analyze and optimize.

Speed is one of the core traits we look for: how fast you learn, how fast your thinking evolves, and how fast you execute. The AI agent industry changes by the month, and the product has to move with it.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with real ownership. You will work closely with the head of the AEI product line and the senior product leaders on the team, and partner daily with AI engineering, forward deployed engineers and go-to-market. In an industry changing this quickly, much is being defined for the first time or redefined, and you will be one of the people doing it.

What success looks like

• Deliver dramatically differentiated products. Ship products and solutions that are clearly ahead of the alternatives and lead the industry.

• Own product outcomes. Own the roadmap and success metrics for your part of AEI, and contribute to the wider vision and strategy.

• Win with customers. Work with enterprise agent teams every week, turn what you learn into sharp product bets, and support proofs of concept and early deployments through to real improvements in their agents.

• Define what agent effectiveness means in practice. Help shape the metrics, dimensions and workflows that agent teams use day to day to find where their agents fall short and why.

• Build to think. Use AI tools to prototype ideas, analyze real agent data and validate direction with working artifacts before asking engineering to build.

• Move fast. Prioritize well, manage tradeoffs, unblock your team and ship at a pace that keeps us ahead of the industry.

• Grow your scope. Take on larger and more ambiguous problems as you go, including new types of agents.

Who you are

Product foundation

• 5+ years in product management, ideally with time on analytics, data platforms, developer tools or AI products.

• You have shipped products end to end and can turn fuzzy problems into clear direction.

• Comfortable working directly with technical and business stakeholders at enterprise customers.

• Clear in writing and in live discussion. You can move between the big picture and the details.

• A fast learner who takes ownership and keeps teams moving.

AI depth

• Hands-on understanding of how LLM-based agents work: prompts, tools, context, evaluation and where they fail.

• Daily user of AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor for prototyping and analysis. Show us what you have built.

• Comfortable reading agent traces and conversation data. An engineering or computer science background is strongly preferred.

Bonus points

• Experience with agent observability, evaluation or LLM operations tooling.

• Experience in analytics or data-related solutions.

• Experience building agents, or building products for the teams that build them.

• Side projects, writing or open-source work that shows how you think about product and AI.

What we offer

• A real chance to help lead the market on one of the most important problems in AI, and to change how the industry builds and improves its agents.

• Enterprise customers and real agent data from day one.

• A talented team that combines multiple disciplines, from AI research and engineering to product and customer work.

• Room to grow quickly in scope and level as the product and the team expand.

• This is an in-office position at our Foster City, CA headquarters.

The expected salary range for this full-time position is $235,000–$270,000 + equity + benefits. Actual level and compensation are determined by qualifications, professional background, and relevant experience.

Learn more at conviva.ai and follow the company on LinkedIn and YouTube.

jobs.title: Senior Avionics Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ODYS

At Odys, we’re mobilizing power, with Hybrid Power Systems developed for aerospace and in-demand everywhere. It’s the kind of mission diversity that demands a fresh way of thinking.

We began with an early bet on hybrid, when the mobility industry was focused on batteries. We designed, tested, and validated our first 1 MW high-speed generator in 12 months. And then we pushed further, developing systems with greater power density in less time. Today, our Hybrid Power Systems offer outputs ranging from 20 kW to 4 MW, with applications in the air or on the ground.

One of those applications is Laila, an unmanned drone designed for critical logistics and defense missions. With its 100 kW-class onboard Hybrid Power System, Laila can support medical cold-chain transport or serve as an aerial platform for counter-UAS measures.

The market interest has been overwhelming: Over 30 inbound requests from leading US and global manufacturers, and 14+ DoD contracts.

Our team comes from deep tech and aerospace, with backgrounds spanning drone and aircraft development, high-volume production, and electrified mobility.

We operate with urgency and ownership at every level. We validated high-speed generator technology faster than our peers, not because we skipped steps, but because we've been doing this long enough to know which ones matter most.

Creating the future of power, in the air and on the ground, is a challenge we’ve been training our entire lives for. If that sounds like you, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

 

About the Role

Have you taken avionics hardware from a blank-page architecture to an aircraft that powers up cleanly and flies? Have you designed the flight computer electronics, sensor interfaces, and harness, brought them up on the bench and in hardware-in-the-loop, and supported them through ground and flight test? Join our engineering team as a Career Avionics Hardware Engineer.

We are looking for engineers who have defined an avionics hardware architecture, designed the electronics, sensor conditioning, harness, and RF and datalink integration around it, and carried that hardware all the way onto an aircraft in flight test. You will own that same path on Laila, working with flight controls, flight software, systems, and test. You will design and lay out the avionics boards, build and install the harness, close EMI/EMC issues at the aircraft level, plan qualification with external laboratories, and judge supplier hardware on its technical fit and its design-assurance and environmental data.

Responsibilities

Avionics Architecture and Electronics

 - Define the avionics hardware architecture with flight controls, flight software, and systems, including redundancy, fault detection, and the split between hardware monitoring and software.

 - Architect and design avionics electronics for the air vehicle, including the flight computer, sensor conditioning, discrete and analog I/O, and the interfaces to actuators and payloads.

 - Select and integrate sensors and line-replaceable units, including inertial, air-data, and GNSS equipment, and define the electrical and data interfaces that flight software and the control laws depend on.

 - Own schematic capture and PCB design for Odys-designed avionics boards, and drive layout reviews for signal integrity, power integrity, thermal performance, and aerospace creepage and clearance.
   
   

Harness and Installation

 - Design and integrate the avionics harness and electrical wiring interconnect system: connectors, shielding, grounding, routing, and installation on the aircraft.

 - Optimize harness architecture and routing for weight, reliability, and maintainability, and produce the wire lists, drawings, and installation data needed to build it.

 - Define equipment-level power distribution and protection for the avionics, and coordinate the electrical boundary with the propulsion power system.
   
   

RF, Datalinks, and EMC

 - Integrate RF and datalink hardware and analyze electromagnetic compatibility at the aircraft level, including grounding, shielding, and filtering so radios, sensors, and computers coexist.

 - Protect avionics and datalinks from the electromagnetic environment of a high-power hybrid-electric propulsion system, including generators, inverters, and high-voltage cabling.



Bring-up, Qualification, and Assurance

 - Lead hardware bring-up and debug on the bench, in software- and hardware-in-the-loop, and on the aircraft, closing issues that show up as noise, dropouts, or interface faults, and support ground and flight test.

 - Produce and review hardware design data for a safety-critical avionics program, including requirements, interface control documents, and design-review packages.

 - Plan environmental and EMC qualification with external laboratories, and evaluate supplier design-assurance and environmental data before the program relies on it.

 - Serve as an independent reviewer of hardware and interface designs across the engineering team.
   
   

Required Qualifications

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

 - 5+ years designing, integrating, or qualifying airborne electronic hardware for avionics, UAVs, eVTOL, or similar embedded aerospace systems.

 - Owned or were a core contributor to avionics hardware on at least one aircraft program from architecture through flight test.

 - Hands-on schematic capture and PCB layout in Altium, Cadence, or equivalent, carried through fabrication, assembly, and board bring-up.

 - Analog and mixed-signal design for sensor conditioning, including filtering, excitation, and data conversion.

 - Experience with aircraft or vehicle harnesses: connector selection, shielding, grounding, and installation constraints.

 - Experience integrating flight computers and sensors (IMU, air data, GNSS, or equivalent) over CAN, Ethernet, RS-422/485, and discrete or analog I/O.

 - Experience designing power distribution and protection for embedded or avionics equipment.

 - Practical EMI/EMC work, including layout, grounding, filtering, and lab debug with oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, current probes, and LISNs.

 - Experience debugging hardware side by side with software engineers on a real-time embedded system.

 - Clear communication with flight controls, software, systems, and test engineers, and with suppliers and external laboratories.



Preferred Qualifications

 - DO-254 development, or review of supplier airborne-electronic-hardware assurance data.

 - DO-160 environmental and EMC qualification planning and test campaigns.

 - MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-464 EMC requirements for defense platforms.

 - Avionics integration alongside high-voltage or high-power electric propulsion systems.

 - RF and command-and-control datalink hardware integration on an aircraft.

 - Redundant or dissimilar avionics architectures, including monitoring and failover.

 - Electrical wiring interconnect design to aerospace wiring practices such as AS50881.

 - ARP4754B development, hardware-software interface control, or FMEA for avionics equipment.

 - Bring-up of FPGA, SoC, or other complex flight-computer hardware, or integration of embedded compute modules such as NVIDIA Jetson for autonomy and payloads.

 - Data buses such as ARINC 429 or MIL-STD-1553.

 - Harness design tools such as Zuken E3.series, Siemens Capital, or equivalent.

 - Component derating, reliability prediction, and obsolescence management for airborne electronics.

 - VTOL or other unmanned aircraft programs.

jobs.title: Oracle Principal Pre-Sales & Delivery Architect
jobs.description:
Oracle Principal Pre-Sales & Delivery Architect

Center of Excellence | Working alongside Tessera AI Agents

Location: US-based.

Remote: Yes, within the US, with travel to customer and partner sites as needed.

Experience: 15+ years

Employment type: Full-time, permanent.

Positions: 1

Reports to: VP, Center of Excellence

Start date: Immediate.

Engagement model: Multi-engagement pre-sales and delivery architect role. Approximately

70% engagement work across several concurrent customer engagements, 30% pre-sales, go-

to-market and product input. Works US business hours alongside customers, distributed

delivery teams and go-to-market teams.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Customer engagements (~70%)

 - Act as lead architect on several customer engagements at once, accountable for the solution design and its outcome.

 - Lead discovery and current-state assessments of Oracle landscapes: configuration, customizations, integrations, data and infrastructure.

 - Design target-state architectures for upgrades, migrations, consolidations and cloud moves, including to OCI.

 - Direct Tessera's AI agents and a distributed delivery team: set the plan, review agent output, and own quality and governance.

 - Be the senior technical voice with customer IT leaders and executives, raising risks early and keeping programs on track.

 - Turn engagement learnings into reusable patterns, accelerators and agent improvements.

Pre-sales, go-to-market and product (~30%)

 - Run technical discovery and solution demos, and show how an AI-native approach changes the timeline and cost of a program.

 - Scope engagements and write solution approaches, estimates and the technical parts of proposals and SOWs.

 - Work with sales, alliances and Oracle partner teams on opportunities, and represent Tessera at customer and partner meetings.

 - Give product and engineering structured feedback on what customers need and where the platform should go next.

 - Help build the Oracle practice's offerings, reference architectures and pre-sales assets.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 15+ years in Oracle enterprise applications, including senior architect or lead roles on complex programs.

 - Hands-on, current depth in at least one major Oracle ERP product line (JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, E-Business Suite or Fusion Cloud), including its technical foundation: CNC, DBA, integrations, security.

 - A track record of upgrades, migrations or implementations taken to go-live, including cloud moves (OCI, AWS or Azure).

 - Pre-sales experience: you've led discovery, given demos, scoped work and written the solution sections of winning proposals.

 - Comfort running several customer engagements at once without losing quality or the customer's trust.

 - Clear communication with both executives and engineers, in writing and in the room.

 - Real curiosity about AI in delivery: you've used AI tools in your own work and want to help shape how agents do this job.

 - Based in the US, able to work US business hours and travel to customer and partner sites as needed.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience across more than one Oracle product line (for example JD Edwards plus EBS or Fusion), or with NetSuite or PeopleSoft.

 - Oracle certifications, especially OCI architecture, migration or generative AI.

 - Work with automation and integration tooling such as JDE Orchestrator/AIS or Oracle Integration Cloud.

 - Experience building a consulting practice: partner programs, packaged offerings, or reusable accelerators.

 - Led distributed or offshore delivery teams.

 - Security, SOX or compliance background on ERP systems.


YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

 1. Days 1–30: Learn the Tessera platform and its agents in depth, shadow live engagements, and join active pre-sales pursuits.

 2. Days 31–60: Take architecture ownership of your first customer engagements and lead discovery and demos on new opportunities.

 3. Days 61–90: Run several engagements at once and give the product team a first set of Oracle priorities.


WHY JOIN

 - Help redefine how Oracle transformation gets delivered, replacing years-long, consultant-heavy programs with weeks of AI-driven execution.

 - Senior scope from day one, with direct influence on product, go-to-market and how the Oracle practice is built.

 - Work alongside AI agents that take on the repetitive delivery work, so your time goes to architecture, customers and judgment calls.

jobs.title: Business Operations & Strategy Associate

SuperDial helps healthcare organizations get answers from payers through voice AI, human support, and digital channels. Work directly with our Business Operations & Strategy Director to improve business performance and build the systems that help us scale.

You’ll combine personally handling day-to-day work with improving and automating your and others’ workflows. Specific responsibilities will shift as business needs evolve, with opportunities to own projects from analysis through implementation.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Manage cross-functional projects: Coordinate owners, timelines, and follow-through across teams to deliver operational improvements and special projects.

Build better systems: Develop dashboards, contract tracking, and AI-enabled workflows, turning early tools into reliable systems with accurate, consistent data that the team uses.

Strengthen invoicing: Organize billing inputs and contract terms, reconcile discrepancies, and improve the monthly invoicing process with Finance.

Internal operations: Coordinate equipment, onboarding and offboarding, and recurring administrative work.

Drive organization and vendor contract tracking: Keep shared documents and vendor contracts organized, current, and accessible. Improve or devise systems and processes.

Margin improvement analyses and projects: Analyze performance by customer, payer, and channel; identify opportunities to reduce costs, improve routing, or refine service scope; and help implement recommendations.

Help evaluate AI tools: Assess AI tools for internal workflows and coordinate adoption, documentation, and compliance review.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 2+ years of experience in business operations, consulting, finance, analytics, or a related role.

 - Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with the ability to turn imperfect data into clear recommendations.

 - An organized, practical approach and the follow-through to move between open-ended projects and recurring operational work.

 - Clear communication and sound judgment. Experience at a startup or in healthcare is a plus.

WHO WE ARE

SuperDial is transforming AI in healthcare by building scalable, AI-powered solutions that optimize revenue cycle management. Join us and help shape the future of AI in healthcare.

jobs.title: Capture Specialist
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Capture Specialist to lead and support the identification, qualification, capture, and proposal development of strategic opportunities within our Program Management Federal practice. The successful candidate will collaborate with federal market leaders, operations, technical teams, pricing, legal, contracts, and marketing professionals to develop differentiated, compliant, and executable pursuit strategies.

The Capture Specialist responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Leads or supports the full federal business development lifecycle, including opportunity identification, qualification, client positioning, capture planning, solution development, proposal development, interview preparation, and post-submittal activities.
• Develops and maintains actionable capture plans that address customer priorities, competitive positioning, teaming, staffing, pricing, solution development, decision gates, win strategies, and win themes.
• Coordinates cross-functional responses to federal market research and procurement activities, including Sources Sought notices, Requests for Information, draft solicitations, Requests for Qualifications, Requests for Proposals, task order requests, and oral presentations or interviews.
• Conducts customer, market, and competitor analyses to identify likely evaluation drivers, competitive advantages, vulnerabilities, potential teaming partners, and actions required to improve probability of win.
• Supports teaming strategy by identifying potential partners, evaluating capability and competitive fit, coordinating initial outreach, and working with legal and contracts personnel to facilitate nondisclosure and teaming agreements.
• Develops pursuit staffing strategies by aligning key personnel, subject matter experts, and labor categories with solicitation requirements, technical scope, deliverables, customer expectations, and evaluation criteria.
• Tracks and manages the pipeline of opportunities including Salesforce entries and Workbench set up; manages the pursuit budget
• Assists with submissions for legal reviews and preparation for risk reviews
• Represents AECOM, as appropriate, at industry events, customer outreach activities, conferences, and relevant professional associations to build market awareness and business relationships.
• Supports strategic recruiting and talent identification when specialized personnel or key staff are required to strengthen priority pursuits.
• Captures and applies lessons learned from customer debriefs, competitive outcomes, and internal pursuit reviews to strengthen future positioning, capture strategies, and proposal development.
• Leads or supports pursuits in which AECOM serves as a prime contractor, joint venture member, mentor, subcontractor, or subconsultant, including coordination with small-business partners and other strategic teammates.
• Collaborates with pricing, finance, operations, and technical leaders to develop competitive and executable pricing strategies, labor mixes, rate structures, and supporting assumptions; coordinates required pricing reviews with internal stakeholders.

Minimum Requirement:

• BA/BS plus four years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• Due to the nature of the work and applicable contract requirements, U.S. citizenship is required.

Preferred Requirement:

• Experience supporting capture, business development, proposal development, program management, or related activities for government or other complex, regulated clients.
• Experience coordinating multidisciplinary contributors and stakeholders under schedule-driven conditions.
• Demonstrated ability to develop clear written materials, facilitate working sessions, communicate with senior leaders, and manage multiple concurrent priorities.
• Experience supporting federal civilian, defense, or national-security pursuits.
• Working knowledge of the federal acquisition lifecycle and familiarity with Sources Sought notices, RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, task order requests, and related procurement documents.
• Experience developing or supporting capture plans, win strategies, competitive assessments, teaming strategies, staffing approaches, pricing strategies, and proposal responses.
• Experience with program management, construction management, architecture-engineering, infrastructure, environmental, or professional-services opportunities.
• Experience working with small businesses, joint venture partners, prime contractors, subcontractors, or subconsultants.
• Familiarity with customer relationship management and opportunity-management platforms, such as Salesforce or comparable systems.
• Ability to rapidly learn and apply AECOM’s markets, services, governance processes, and business systems.

• Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
• Relocation is not available for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Manager, Actuarial Services
jobs.description:
At Diverge Health, we are passionate about improving access and outcomes for those most in need. We partner with primary care providers to improve engagement and management of their Medicaid patients, offering independent practices specialized resources and clinical programs to close gaps in care. Our teams address medical, social, and behavioral needs, lowering costs and improving lives. Guided by our core values of humility, continuous learning, and feeling the weight, we strengthen communities from within so people can live their healthiest lives.

In October 2026, Diverge merged with Medical Home Network (MHN), a mission-driven public benefit corporation that has partnered with Federally Qualified Health Centers since 2009 to transform care in the safety net and build healthier communities. MHN helps FQHCs succeed in value-based care through technology, care model innovation, and strong partnerships.

Together, Diverge and MHN bring more capacity, infrastructure, and community-based resources to our partnerships with health centers and practices caring for underserved patients.

We are looking for a Manager, Actuarial Services to join our team! You will lead core reserving, forecasting, and analytics work across multiple lines of business while building the team that carries it forward. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable in the claims data and in the room with finance, clinical, and market leaders.

What You'll Do

As the Manager, Actuarial Services, you will play a pivotal role in building a shared Actuarial Services function from the ground up, setting the standard for how two value-based care organizations understand their financial performance. Reporting to the Senior Director of Actuarial services you will play a key role in turning complex claims data into clear financial insight, so leaders can make confident decisions for the communities we serve.

Key Areas You'll Add Value

• Lead the reserving and forecasting process, including incurred but not reported (IBNR) models and financial close packages, so finance and market leaders can rely on accurate, timely results across both organizations.

• Review the work of external actuarial consultants, reconcile their outputs against internal data, and decide whether to adopt, adjust, or build alternative approaches in-house.

• Work with the Head of Actuarial to review medical cost trends, utilization, and performance driver analyses across Managed Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, MSSP, and ACO REACH, surfacing insights that guide market strategy and contract negotiations.

• Help support the build and upkeep of contract scenario models and drilldown tools that allow leadership to pressure-test assumptions and understand the financial impact of operational and clinical decisions.

• Partner with actuarial, finance, clinical, data, and market leaders to translate technical findings into clear, executive-ready exhibits that support confident decisions.

• Set standards for documenting methodology, assumptions, mappings, and code, keeping work reproducible, auditable, and easy to hand off as the team grows.

• Identify data quality issues early, document limitations, and define data requirements and analytical frameworks that scale as new lines of business and markets come online.

• Support the evaluation of how AI and automation can be built into actuarial workflows to improve accuracy, speed, and scalability for the actuarial team.

• Shape team processes, hiring plans, and ways of working alongside the Senior Director of Actuarial Services as the function takes form.

jobs.title: Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician (Shift Lead) - Houston, TX
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

Veterinary nursing Shift Leads are the glue that holds each shift together—and the spark that keeps it moving. You own the rhythm and flow of each shift, making sure patients get top-tier care and every VEGgie has what they need to thrive. From team huddles and rounds to break coverage and on-the-floor coaching, you’re the steady presence keeping things smooth, safe, and supported. You don’t need to know every detail, but you do keep a big picture view—anticipating what’s next and jumping in wherever needed. You lead with heart, hustle, and a belief that when your team is empowered, great care follows.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Keep a clear pulse on patient status, team bandwidth, and shift-wide needs

• Manage daily workflow and help the team pivot when the unexpected hits

• Ensure shift roles are assigned and adapted as needed, with clarity and care

• Jump in on the floor when help is needed—no task is too small

• Coordinate breaks, assist with conflict resolution, and model calm under pressure

• Lead shift transitions, team huddles, and start/end-of-day wrap-ups

• Communicate clearly, direct questions appropriately, and elevate key issues

• Help the team turn downtime into learning time—or just a moment to breathe

• Flag incidents or notable events with a mindset of transparency and growth

• Work with hospital leadership on coverage, call-outs, and ongoing coaching

WHAT YOU NEED

• Credentialed Veterinary Technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) or enrolled in the VEG Credentialing Support Program preferred

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician or assistant role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred.

• Strong grasp of clinical workflow and team dynamics

• Confidence in navigating floor operations while guiding others with empathy

• Excellent communication and conflict resolution skills

• Flexibility and a willingness to step in wherever needed

• Leadership instincts, an ownership mindset, and a desire to grow professionally

• Basic computer skills, comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, QPR training, and access to free therapy or counseling

• Depending on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave; up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager II, Fintech (LoyaltyPlay)
jobs.description:
Mistplay is the category creator and leader in the 'play-and-earn' mobile loyalty space, built to reward gamers for playing.
LoyaltyPlay is our B2B monetization platform, a powerful Gaming Reward Hub designed for mobile app Publishers. We partner with app owners (e.g., utility, commerce, or entertainment apps) to help them unlock a new, consistent revenue stream and boost user engagement. By integrating LoyaltyPlay, publishers can offer their users rewards (in-app currency) for installing and playing mobile games from our vast advertiser network. This creates a deep engagement loop and a powerful monetization channel for the publisher.


Senior Business Development Manager II, Fintech (LoyaltyPlay)
Location: United States
Reports to: Head of Sales, North America
About Mistplay and LoyaltyPlay
Mistplay is the category creator and leader in play-and-earn mobile loyalty, built to reward gamers for playing. LoyaltyPlay is our B2B business: a gaming rewards hub that consumer apps add to their own experience. Their users play mobile games and complete offers from our advertiser network to earn the app’s own rewards, and the app gets higher engagement and a new revenue stream, typically on a revenue-share model.
The role
Consumer fintech apps such as neobanks, earned wage access, credit-building, budgeting and payments apps compete for daily engagement with users who often open the app to check a balance and leave. LoyaltyPlay gives them a rewards experience users come back to every day, plus a new revenue line.
As our fintech vertical lead in North America, you will own the vertical end to end: building the target list, opening relationships with growth, product and partnerships leaders, and turning them into live LoyaltyPlay partners. You will focus on mid-market to large fintech apps, working alongside our Enterprise Sales Director on the largest brands in the category.
We will teach you the product. We are hiring for your fintech relationships and your understanding of how these companies grow.
Who you will sell to
Heads of Growth, Engagement and Lifecycle, Rewards and Partnerships at consumer fintech apps. They care about daily active users, retention, direct deposit and card activation, and new revenue, and they hold a high bar for brand safety and compliance.
What you will do
Own the fintech vertical: Build and prioritize a target list across neobanks, earned wage access, credit-building, budgeting and payments apps, and carry a quota for the vertical.
Open doors: Use your network and targeted outreach to start conversations with VP- and C-level leaders in growth, product and partnerships.
Build the business case: Tailor the LoyaltyPlay story to each partner’s goals and build ROI cases with our analytics and finance teams.
Run the deal: Lead discovery, negotiation and contracting, including partner compliance, data privacy and legal review in a regulated environment.
Structure the commercials: Design revenue-share and incentive structures that align long-term incentives for the partner and Mistplay.
Manage your pipeline: Keep pipeline and forecast accurate in Salesforce and report on progress against your quota.
Work across teams: Translate partner requirements for Product and Engineering, and bring in Legal and Finance early so launches stay on track.
Hand off for growth: Transition launched partners smoothly to Customer Success and stay involved as they scale.
What you will bring
6+ years in business development, partnerships or sales into consumer fintech companies.
An existing network of growth, product and partnerships leaders at consumer fintech apps.
A track record of closing complex partnerships with multiple stakeholders, including legal and compliance review.
A solid understanding of how fintech apps acquire, engage and monetize their users.
Strong negotiation and commercial structuring skills, including revenue-share models.
Comfort working in Salesforce and with market research tools such as Sensor Tower.
Based in the United States.
Nice to have
Experience in ad tech, mobile monetization, rewarded advertising or loyalty.
Experience selling into banking-as-a-service or fintech infrastructure platforms.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a strategic, hands-on Talent Acquisition Manager to lead our recruiting function and help us attract the talent that drives our business forward.

This is an exciting opportunity for a recruiting leader who enjoys building talent strategies, developing people, partnering with business leaders, and rolling up their sleeves to make an impact. You will lead recruiting efforts across our multi-state multifamily portfolio while managing a personal requisition load of approximately 20 open positions.

Reporting to the Vice President of Human Resources, you will oversee recruiting strategy, lead and develop our Talent Acquisition Team, and partner closely with HR and Operations leaders to ensure our communities and corporate teams have the talent they need to succeed.

What You'll Do

Lead Recruiting Strategy & Workforce Planning

• Develop and execute recruiting strategies aligned with business priorities, property growth, acquisitions, and workforce needs.
• Partner with leadership to forecast hiring needs and anticipate seasonal, high-volume, and difficult-to-fill positions.
• Analyze labor market and compensation trends to develop competitive sourcing strategies.

Drive Full-Cycle Recruiting

• Manage approximately 20 open requisitions, recruiting for corporate, leadership, specialized, and property-level positions.
• Oversee the active requisition portfolio and balance recruiting workloads across the TA team.
• Manage the full recruiting lifecycle, from intake meetings and sourcing through interviews, offers, and onboarding handoffs.
• Maintain consistent, structured, and compliant recruiting practices.

Lead & Develop the Talent Acquisition Team

• Coach, mentor, and develop the Talent Acquisition Team through clear expectations, regular feedback, and performance goals.
• Balance recruiting coverage during peak hiring periods, absences, and staffing gaps.
• Support ongoing professional development and strengthen the team's recruiting capabilities.

Build Strong Partnerships & Candidate Experiences

• Serve as a trusted recruiting advisor to hiring managers, Regional Managers, and Operations leaders.
• Guide hiring managers on interviewing, candidate evaluation, selection strategies, and offer decisions.
• Ensure candidates receive a professional, responsive, and positive experience throughout the hiring process.

Strengthen Employer Branding & Talent Pipelines

• Lead employer branding and recruitment marketing initiatives, including job advertising, social media, job fairs, and recruiting events.
• Develop sourcing strategies, job board relationships, and community and school partnerships.
• Promote internal mobility, employee referrals, and rehire programs that support retention and career growth.

Use Data to Drive Results

• Track and report recruiting KPIs, including time-to-fill, requisition aging, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, quality of hire, and early retention.
• Use recruiting metrics and labor market insights to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Manage recruiting budgets, vendor relationships, and agency usage while improving recruiting efficiency and cost-per-hire.
• Ensure recruiting practices, applicant records, and selection processes comply with applicable employment laws and Company policies.

What Success Looks Like

You will help ensure our communities and corporate teams remain fully staffed with qualified talent. Through effective recruiting strategies, strong hiring manager partnerships, and a well-developed talent pipeline, you will help reduce vacancy-related costs, improve quality of hire, and strengthen retention.

You will also build a high-performing TA team that delivers consistent results, maintains strong candidate relationships, and supports the continued growth of Cirrus.

• A minimum of five years of progressive full-cycle recruiting or Talent Acquisition experience, including at least two years in a lead or supervisory role. - Required
• Experience recruiting high-volume, hourly, and professional positions within a multi-site or multi-state organization. - Required
• Experience in multifamily property management. - Required
• Demonstrated success developing sourcing strategies, building talent pipelines, and using recruiting metrics to improve hiring outcomes.
• Strong knowledge of employment laws and compliant recruiting, interviewing, and selection practices.
• Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop recruiting professionals.
• Exceptional communication, organizational, relationship management, and consultative skills.
• Proficiency with applicant tracking systems, HRIS platforms, and Microsoft Office applications.
• Experience with SmartRecruiters, Yardi Voyager, Aspire, or comparable systems is preferred.
• A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
• SHRM-CP, PHR, or other relevant professional certifications are preferred.

Salary: $100,000 - $110,000 per year

Monday through Friday - 9:00 am - 6:00 pm

Three days per week will be in-office at our Irving, TX corporate office.

The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant (Part-Time) - Houston, TX
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®..

THE JOB

At VEG, we don’t just hire assistants—we grow future emergency rockstars. As a part-time Emergency Veterinary Assistant, you’ll be in the heart of the action from day one, supporting your team, comforting pet parents, and learning the ropes in real time. You’ll be there for everything—the triage, the treatments, and the tail wags. You’re embarking on a path where careers start, grow, and thrive. Whether you’re on your way to becoming a credentialed technician or exploring where your passion can take you, we’ll say yes to your growth every step of the way.

WHAT YOU’LL DO*

• Be the first warm welcome and a steady support, triaging incoming patients and helping guide them toward care

• Assist with treatments, nursing care, and diagnostics, from bloodwork and imaging to catheter placement and oxygen support

• Work alongside our credentialed veterinary technicians and veterinarians to set up and monitor anesthesia and sedation cases

• Set up and manage IV fluids, blood transfusions, and medication administration

• Assist during every moment of care: outpatient or inpatient, exam room to treatment area.

• Join patient rounds and stay close to the clinical picture to ensure continuity of care.

• Learn how to perform CPR and become a RECOVER Certified Rescuer (training provided!)

• Grow into more advanced responsibilities, such as anesthesia support, ultrasound, and catheterization through guided training pathways

*As permitted by state law

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• Enrolled in an AVMA-accredited veterinary technology program a plus

• 1+ years in a veterinary assistant role (emergency or specialty experience is a bonus!)

• Basic computer skills and an understanding of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• A BIG focus on learning and growth from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to Unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (No really!). Part-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend. Part-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $400/year travel stipend.

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

jobs.title: Senior Accounts Payable Analyst
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

We are seeking a detail oriented AP Analyst to join our Accounts Payable team and support day-to-day AP operations across the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle. Responsibilities include supplier onboarding and maintenance, processing supplier invoices and employee expenses, ensuring accurate coding and timely approvals, supporting procurement and travel-related workflows, resolving supplier and internal inquiries, and assisting with month-end close activities.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing high transaction volumes in a fast-paced environment. They take ownership of resolving issues, maintaining accurate financial records, and ensuring compliance with company policies and internal controls. An accounting background and experience with financial systems are strongly preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Manage supplier onboarding and ongoing maintenance, including collecting required documentation, validating banking information, and ensuring supplier records are accurate

• Process supplier invoices accurately and timely, ensuring proper GL coding, appropriate supporting documentation, alignment with purchase orders and company policies

• Review employee travel and expense (T&E) transactions for accuracy, appropriate GL coding, and compliance with company policies

• Assist with payment preparation and payment-related inquiries, ensuring transactions are properly reviewed and supported

• Monitor daily AP queues and invoice approval workflows, follow up on outstanding approvals, and proactively address bottlenecks to ensure transactions are processed timely

• Manage AP inboxes and respond to supplier and employee inquiries regarding invoice status, payment timing, travel, and expense-related matters

• Partner with Procurement and internal stakeholders to resolve purchase order discrepancies, missing supporting documentation, invoice discrepancies, and other P2P-related issues

• Support month-end close activities, including AP account reconciliations, review of outstanding balances, and resolution of reconciling items

• Review and resolve system error logs regularly, investigate recurring issues, and coordinate with the Financial Systems team to ensure timely resolution

• Identify opportunities to streamline AP workflows and improve process efficiency

• Support internal and external audits by preparing requested documentation

• Support annual 1099 preparation and filing activities, including supplier tax classification reviews and data validation

• Drive AP cleanup activities, including reviewing aged open items, deactivating inactive suppliers, and obtaining supplier statements to reconcile outstanding balances

• Prepare routine and ad-hoc reports

WHO YOU ARE

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• 1–3 years of experience in Accounts Payable, accounting operations, or a related finance role

• Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a high-volume environment

• Proficiency in Google Sheets, with the ability to leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude or Gemini) to improve productivity, analyze information, and streamline routine tasks

• Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and collaborate effectively across teams

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with suppliers and internal stakeholders across different functions

• Experience with ERP, procurement, and expense management systems; familiarity with Coupa, Ramp, and NetSuite is a plus

• Experience supporting audits and/or working in a SOX-controlled environment is a plus

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $72,000 and $113,000/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $80,000 and $125,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

• Competitive compensation that may include equity

• Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans

• Flexible paid time off

• Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave

• Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend

• A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation

• Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching

• Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze

• Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. jobs.title: Customer Experience Coordinator - Katy, TX
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer’s experience through service, focus, and participation—so, you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say yes and put patient and customer experience above all else. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online

• Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly

• Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say “yes” to customer needs

• Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate

• Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience.

• Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions

• Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information

• Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet’s care and strengthen relationships

• Celebrate and capture special moments (with permission), creating lasting connections between customers, their pets, and the hospital

WHAT YOU NEED

• 2+ years of experience in a customer service role

• Advanced knowledge in computer programs and practice management software

• Highly organized, with strong attention to detail

• A strong communicator; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone

• A strong multitasker, able to thrive amid chaos

• High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly

• Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

• You build trusted relationships with corporate travel managers, procurement leaders, and key decision-makers through regular business reviews and client visits

• You lead commercial discussions, rate reviews, and contract renewals within established guidelines
• You partner cross-functionally with Operations, Pricing, Legal, and Sales Support to deliver effective client solutions, resolve challenges, and drive account growth

• Commercial Judgment You demonstrate strong negotiation, analytical, and strategic planning skills, with a track record of delivering measurable revenue growth

• Additional Perks Experience the advantages of working in a dynamic work environment and ample opportunities for professional advancement

About us:

We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.3 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 360,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 100 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

As a per diem Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from first triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a veterinary technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation.

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation ($ - $) and 401k match

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

Reporting to the Culinary Leadership, responsibilities and essential functions include, but are not limited to:

• Maintain and follow all state, hotel, and departmental safety, sanitation, and health code regulations and requirements.
