jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ARTSY AND ARTNET

Artsy and Artnet have combined to create the world’s largest online art marketplace and information platform. Together, we connect collectors, galleries, auction houses and institutions across a global market valued at over $60 billion. Our products serve both the art world’s largest institutions and individual collectors, supporting art discovery, research and transactions.

We are at a pivotal moment, bringing together an unrivalled customer base, uniquely valuable proprietary data and a proven team. With ambitious plans for growth and innovation, we see significant opportunities to transform how people discover, value and transact in art, particularly as AI reshapes the industry.




THE ROLE

We’re looking for a CFO who knows our numbers cold and uses them to drive the business forward. Operating across three countries and integrating a series of acquisitions, we need a finance leader who can build one cohesive function: one set of numbers, one forecast and one monthly operating rhythm that every leader can rely on.

This is a hands-on seat alongside the CEO for someone fast, driven and entrepreneurial. You'll play a central role in shaping financial strategy, driving accountability and supporting our next phase of growth. 




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own Every Number: Take full accountability for FP&A, Accounting, cash management and financial controls. You'll know the business well enough to anticipate issues, ensuring consistent, accurate reporting across leadership, the Board and investors.

 - Build the Monthly Operating Rhythm: Deliver a timely monthly close and clear KPI and business-unit reporting, with accountability for revenue performance and its underlying drivers.

 - Build Forecasts Leadership Can Trust: Deliver reliable financial and cash flow forecasts, clearly explaining changes, assumptions and risks to support confident decision-making.

 - Be the CEO’s Strategic Partner: Help shape investment priorities, resource allocation and strategic decisions, bringing a sharp perspective on the economics of AI investments.

 - Lead M&A Financial Strategy: Own acquisition modelling, financial due diligence, and the tracking and realisation of post-acquisition synergies.

 - Hold the Line: Challenge leaders on their plans, hold them accountable for financial performance and make difficult decisions when necessary, including on spending and resource allocation.

 - Tell Our Story: Own the financial narrative with the Board and investors, communicating our performance, strategy and long-term value proposition with credibility and precision.

 - Keep the House in Order: Oversee the cap table, equity grants, statutory accounts, audit and tax across our US, UK and German entities, partnering closely with our General Counsel.

 - Lead and Develop the Finance Team: Provide strategic leadership across FP&A, Accounting and Controllership, fostering collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement across New York, London and Berlin.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You move fast and act like an owner. You see an opportunity and go after it without waiting to be asked.

 - You use AI in your own work and know how to keep Finance and Accounting lean as the business scales.

 - You have experience in technology-focused investment banking or equity research, with a strong understanding of how investors evaluate and value technology businesses.

 - You understand how investors evaluate and value technology businesses from the operating side. You have built and presented Board and investor reporting yourself, not just the model behind it.

 - Your strength is strategic finance: modelling, planning and capital decisions, with real accounting and controllership depth. You have run or rebuilt a monthly close, a management reporting pack and an audit.

 - You have built KPI reporting for a subscription or marketplace business and can name the leading indicators that move revenue six to twelve months out.

 - You bring strong M&A experience, having led financial due diligence on acquisitions and supported their integration into one ledger, one forecast and one reporting cycle.

 - You have multi-entity, multi-currency experience across the US, UK and EU.

 - You’ve worked at an earlier-stage company where speed matters and you did the work yourself. Ideally, you’ve also seen the growth-stage or PE-backed side, so you know what different investor types expect.

 - You bring substantial finance leadership experience, ideally within a venture- or PE-backed SaaS or marketplace business. You may already be an established CFO or a strong second-in-command ready to step into your first CFO role, with the experience, judgement and confidence to lead the full finance function and serve as a credible partner to the CEO, Board and investors from day one.
   
   


THIS ROLE PROBABLY ISN’T FOR YOU IF…

You prefer managing established processes to building new ones, are more comfortable delegating financial analysis than doing it yourself, treat a reforecast as a new number rather than a variance to explain, or see Finance primarily as a reporting function rather than a driver of growth.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST YEAR

First 90 Days

 - One reconciled 2027 plan and budget

 - A monthly KPI pack live, with a named owner for every revenue line

 - A 13-week cash forecast in use

By Six Months

 - A ten-day close

 - A rolling forecast with every change bridged

 - Synergies reported net of churn

By Twelve Months

 - Clean audits across all entities

 - Acquired businesses on one ledger

 - Board and investor materials that reconcile to the books without adjustment




WHAT WE OFFER

 - The opportunity to partner directly with our CEO and senior leadership team to shape the future of Artsy and Artnet

 - The opportunity to drive growth, investment and financial innovation as two category-leading businesses come together

 - A talented, ambitious Finance and Accounting team to lead and develop within a collaborative, mission-driven company

 - Competitive compensation and meaningful equity in the combined business, with the opportunity to share in its future success

 - A New York City base with the flexibility of a hybrid working model

 - Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, parental leave, disability coverage, mental health support, 401(k), commuter benefits, flexible spending and health savings accounts, and financial wellness resources

The NYC base salary range for this role is $325,000–375,000 USD annually, plus meaningful equity and competitive benefits.

Artsy and Artnet are committed to equitable compensation practices, and your offer will depend on the relevant experience and skillset you bring to the team.

Please note that we do not accept applications sent by email. You should submit your application directly through our careers website!


ARTSY AND ARTNET VALUES

Our values guide how we work, shape our decisions, and bring us together as one team. They keep us aligned and help drive us toward our mission: to expand the art market, support more artists, and bring more art into the world—helping us create a future where everyone is moved by art, every day.

Own the Outcome: We need all of us to achieve our mission. We take individual responsibility for team results, and we push to get the job done.

Move Fast, Learn Fast: We are building and reinventing every day, iterating quickly on multiple ideas to find what drives impact. We believe learning happens by doing and seeing what works.

Be Direct, Be Kind: We trust our colleagues and treat them with respect. Solving hard problems requires having hard conversations, and we support one another by being candid and kind.

Build for the Customer: We believe the art market has to evolve in order to flourish. We have a unique role to play in that growth, so we work hard to deeply understand the industry and build tools that solve real user needs.

Embrace Change: Achieving our mission in a dynamic tech environment demands constant change. We lean in to opportunity, face ambiguity bravely, and model to others and the industry a state of constant innovation and evolution.



Artsy is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, and veteran status.

jobs.title: Engineer: Special Projects
jobs.description:
ABOUT EVENTUAL



Eventual is building data curation that helps Physical AI learn from failure. We process video and sensor data at petabyte scale to find the moments that matter: a grasp that slips, a dropped object, a failed attempt followed by a successful recovery. We turn these moments into signals that help Physical AI labs and robotics teams understand which failures their data covers, where it falls short, and what belongs in their next training run. Our goal is to help robots learn to recover when the unexpected happens.

We’ve raised $30M from investors like Felicis, CRV, Y Combinator, and angels from the co-founders of Databricks and Perplexity. Our team comes from AWS, Lyft, and Tesla. We powered the last generation of Physical AI in self-driving; now we’re doing it for the next.

Join our small (but powerful!) team, 4 days/week in our SF Mission District office.




YOUR ROLE

As a Special Projects Engineer, you'll start on a contract-to-hire basis and report to our Chief of Staff, working across technical content, demos, community, and launches, often on the same day. You might ship a sample pipeline in the morning, draft a launch post after lunch, and prep a customer call before you leave, then reprioritize when something more urgent lands. You own what you take on and see it through.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build demos and sample pipelines that show our product on real Physical AI workloads.

 - Write technical posts, tutorials, launch content, and customer case studies.

 - Run meetups, hackathons, and developer community engagement.

 - Partner with engineering on launches: positioning, announcements, docs, and the follow-up after.

 - Track competitors and turn what you learn into positioning and sales material.

 - Join customer calls with sales to run demos and answer the hard technical questions.



WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - 1–4 years in technical GTM, product, solutions, DevRel, or engineering.

 - Technical fluency — comfortable in Python and data/AI tooling; you hold your own with engineers and customers.

 - A storyteller — you make complex systems sound simple without dumbing them down.

 - Clear, fast writing — posts and docs people actually read.

 - You thrive on variety — demos, content, events, and customer calls in one week — and reprioritize without dropping threads.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Exposure to data or AI infrastructure, or Physical AI (AVs, robotics, ADAS, aerospace).

 - Side projects, hackathons, meetup demos, or open-source work you’ve shipped yourself.




PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive comp and meaningful startup equity

 - Catered lunches and dinners for SF employees

 - Health, vision, and dental coverage

 - Flexible PTO

 - Latest Apple equipment

 - 401(k) plan with match



Eventual is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate every applicant on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Principal AI Product Manager, Agent Experience Insights
jobs.description:
Conviva is the experience analytics platform for AI agents, apps, and streaming. Conviva pioneered quality of experience measurement for streaming video and has supported live digital experiences across 20 Super Bowls, 10 Olympic Games, and five FIFA World Cup tournaments. With full-census, real-time, stateful analytics, Conviva shows what consumers actually experience, not just whether systems are running, and connects that experience to revenue, retention, and risk.

Agent effectiveness is the defining problem of the AI agent industry, and it is still unsolved. Conviva has the technology, the customers and the head start to be the company that solves it. Agent Experience Insights (AEI) is our answer to the core of that problem: understanding how well an agent actually works, where and why it falls short, and what to change to make it better. We are hiring a Principal AI Product Manager to build industry-leading AI solutions in AEI.

About Conviva

Conviva is the experience-centric observability company for AI agents. We help agent teams understand how effective their agents are, where they fall short and how to improve them. Our platform is built on patented Time-State Technology, which analyzes complex, stateful experience data in real time and at massive scale. The same technology powers Conviva’s streaming video business, where the world’s leading streaming publishers rely on us to measure and improve every viewer’s experience.

The role

As Principal AI Product Manager for AEI, you will own a major area of the product end to end. You will work with cutting-edge AI technology, stay obsessed with customer value, and build an industry-leading product.

The work covers the many types of AI agents that we help our customers measure, analyze and optimize.

Speed is one of the core traits we look for: how fast you learn, how fast your thinking evolves, and how fast you execute. The AI agent industry changes by the month, and the product has to move with it.

This is a senior individual contributor role with wide scope. You will work directly with the head of the AEI product line, and partner daily with AI engineering, forward deployed engineers and go-to-market. In an industry changing this quickly, much is being defined for the first time or redefined, and you will be one of the people doing it.

What success looks like

• Deliver dramatically differentiated products. Ship products and solutions that are clearly ahead of the alternatives and lead the industry.

• Own product outcomes. Set the vision, strategy, roadmap and success metrics for your area of AEI.

• Win with customers. Work with enterprise agent teams every week, turn what you learn into sharp product bets, and guide proofs of concept and early deployments to real improvements in their agents.

• Define what agent effectiveness means in practice. Shape the metrics, dimensions and workflows that agent teams use day to day to find where their agents fall short and why.

• Open new ground. Take AEI into new types of agents and find the product shape that fits each one.

• Build to think. Use AI tools to prototype ideas, analyze real agent data and validate direction with working artifacts before asking engineering to build.

• Move fast. Prioritize ruthlessly, manage tradeoffs, unblock teams and ship at a pace that keeps us ahead of the industry.

• Represent the product. Explain our point of view clearly to customers, prospects and the market.

Who you are

Product leadership

• 8+ years in product management, with meaningful time on analytics, data platforms, developer tools or AI products.

• A record of taking a product from zero to one and turning fuzzy problems into clear direction.

• Comfortable leading conversations with senior technical and business stakeholders at enterprise customers.

• Clear in writing and in live discussion. You can move between strategy and detail without getting stuck in either.

• You build alignment fast and keep teams moving.

AI depth

• Hands-on understanding of how LLM-based agents work: prompts, tools, context, evaluation and where they fail.

• Daily user of AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor for prototyping and analysis. Show us what you have built.

• Comfortable reading agent traces and conversation data. An engineering or computer science background is strongly preferred.

Bonus points

• Experience with agent observability, evaluation or LLM operations tooling.

• Experience in analytics or data-related solutions.

• Experience building agents, or building products for the teams that build them.

• Published writing, talks or open-source work on product and AI.

What we offer

• A real chance to lead the market on one of the most important problems in AI, and to change how the industry builds and improves its agents.

• Enterprise customers and real agent data from day one.

• A talented team that combines multiple disciplines, from AI research and engineering to product and customer work.

• This is an in-office position at our Foster City, CA headquarters.

The expected salary range for this full-time position is $265,000–$300,000 + equity + benefits. Actual level and compensation are determined by qualifications, professional background, and relevant experience.

Learn more at conviva.ai and follow the company on LinkedIn and YouTube.

Position Summary:
The Senior Finance Business Partner – Central Region serves as the lead Finance partner to the Central Regional President, Market Presidents, and other operating leaders across the region. The role combines advanced financial expertise with a deep understanding of the Central Region’s markets to improve performance, strengthen forward-looking planning, and support strategic and operating decisions.

The Senior Finance Business Partner operates with a high degree of independence and applies specialized expertise to ambiguous, complex, or high-impact issues across the region. The role translates market and regional financial and operating information into clear implications and recommendations, constructively challenges assumptions, and influences senior leaders without relying on formal authority.

Working closely with Corporate FP&A, Accounting, HR Business Partners, People Analytics, Sales Operations, Operations, and other enterprise functions, the Senior Finance Business Partner connects Central Region and market context with enterprise financial priorities. The role strengthens consistent standards and operating rhythms across the region while ensuring Central’s opportunities, risks, and business realities are represented in enterprise planning and decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:

Responsibilities:

Makes rounds of patients and anticipates their needs and observes newborns in the nursery.Responds to patient call lights in a timely manner, especially emergency lights.Distributes fresh drinking water and nourishments to patients. Required:

jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.description:
The Role

As a Product Manager II at Everlaw, you'll own core product features from initial discovery through launch and adoption, turning complex user workflows into clear, intuitive solutions that help teams find critical facts faster. As you grow in the role, you'll take on larger roadmap initiatives and make key product decisions that shape how Everlaw delivers value to users.

This is a full-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.

What you'll do

• Define user problems, scope priorities, and write clear requirements that guide product decisions and roadmap execution.

• Partner with design and engineering to build, test, and ship features from initial concept through launch and iteration.

• Conduct user research and analyze product metrics to evaluate tradeoffs, validate solutions, and measure adoption.

• Work with technical writers to produce user-facing documentation, support articles, and videos that help customers get value from new releases.

• Lead a large roadmap initiative over time, aligning internal stakeholders and driving progress through product and organizational complexity.

• Refine team workflows around release processes, release messaging, and product reporting.

About you

• You have at least two years of experience in product management, shipping features from discovery through launch.

• You've led complex projects under tight deadlines and know how to weigh tradeoffs using data and user feedback.

• You communicate clearly in writing and conversation, translating complex problems into actionable plans.

• You're a self-motivated problem solver who takes initiative and works well with engineering, design, and business partners.

• You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.

Bonus points

• You have experience working in litigation, eDiscovery, or have a law degree.

• You have experience in engineering, UX, or product design.

• You have experience taking an ambiguous problem from early discovery through launch and iteration.

• You have experience with data analysis and tools such as Looker, Heap, SQL, Python.

• You have experience prototyping with agentic coding tools

Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.

The Team — Product

The Product team shapes products used by everyone from document reviewers and corporate teams to government attorneys and law firm partners, each with distinct needs across a broad and complex domain. The team brings together user insight, market context, business priorities, design, and technical feasibility to decide what Everlaw builds and why. This work turns deeply capable technology into intuitive experiences and helps define the next era of legal work.

Total Rewards & Benefits

The expected salary range for this role is $163,000–$202,000. Final salary depends on factors including the candidate's experience and skills, and the base pay range is subject to change. This role is also eligible for equity and the benefits below.

Health & well-being

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses

• Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness

• Paid parental leave

• Company-sponsored life and disability insurance

Financial rewards

• Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long-term growth

• 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

Growth & everyday perks

• 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave

• Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company-wide days off) per year

• Annual allocation for learning & development and relevant professional membership dues

• Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life's logistics

• Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup

• Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices

About Everlaw

When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

We're the kind of place that's ranked #1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you.

At Everlaw, you'll shape how AI re-wires the legal industry, at a category-leading business built on a mission to illuminate the truth.

jobs.title: Services Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
About Boomi and What Makes Us Special

Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.

The SSA is a critical role in the Boomi services sales model. You work with Enterprise Solutions Managers (ESMs), Account Executives, customers, Pre-Sales, PSO Delivery, and partners. The SSA is accountable for the quality of the technical work behind each engagement: architecture soundness, SOW quality, estimate accuracy, and delivery outcomes after the sale.

Join us to do the best work of your career as a Services Solutions Architect in North America on our Global Services Solutions Team.

What You'll Do

Solution Architecture and Strategy

• Engage with customer business and technical leaders, up to C-level, to understand business objectives, use cases, and technical requirements.

• Support the design of high-level solution architectures that align Boomi capabilities to customer roadmaps.

• Recommend the services strategy and delivery approach, such as phased, factory, or migration.

• Act as a trusted technical advisor, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with best practices.

• Provide architectural validation for proposed engagements to support long-term success.

• Own the architecture for strategic engagements and provide guidance for proofs of concept and pilots delivered by PSO.

• Connect the pre-sales vision to what Delivery can build and support after the sale.

Discovery, Scoping, and Estimating

• Define detailed services activities, assumptions, dependencies, and constraints for accurate SOWs, in partnership with the Platform Strategist where one is assigned.

• Identify delivery risks, complexity drivers, and potential roadblocks early in the sales cycle, and validate scope and estimates with Delivery.

• Contribute architecture, approach, and technical content to Professional Services proposals and SOWs.

Engagement and Collaboration

• Support ESMs in building pipeline for managed services and implementation projects, and in closing services deals with prospects, customers, and partners.

• Collaborate with Sales and Pre-Sales on assigned opportunities to set the services strategy for prospect accounts.

• Understand competitor positioning and customer needs to position the value of Boomi Professional Services.

• Present architecture and services approaches to customers, prospects, and partners.

• Identify follow-on needs, including managed services and platform adoption, and pass them to the ESM.

• Assist in effective knowledge transfer and hand-offs to Delivery and post-implementation teams.

• Contribute to reusable architecture patterns, estimating standards, and enablement for ESMs, Sales, and Pre-Sales,.

The Experience You Bring

Every Boomi team member brings something unique to the table. Here is what we are looking for in this role.

Essential Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in integration or solution architecture, including customer-facing consulting, delivery, or pre-sales work.

• 4+ years of experience with iPaaS, cloud and application integration, or B2B integration.

• 2+ years of hands-on Boomi experience, with specific knowledge of integration development and runtime architecture.

• Experience supporting services pre-sales, including solution design, scoping, and estimating for implementation projects.

• Proven experience designing high-level solution architectures and recommending delivery approaches such as phased, factory, and migration.

• Experience delivering or directing complex proofs of concept or pilots on a cloud integration platform.

• Ability to explain complex business and technical topics to executive and technical audiences.

• Excellent business, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, written and verbal.

• BA/BS in CS, CIS, MIS, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Ability to travel 20% of the time, including overnight travel.

Desirable Requirements

• Understanding of additional Boomi capabilities, such as API management, B2B and EDI, data management, runtime architecture.

• Experience selling or supporting professional or consulting services for software implementations.

• Experience with packaged software implementation or delivery.

• Experience leading and facilitating executive meetings and workshops.

• Strong troubleshooting and risk management skills.

Boomi is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The expected annual pay range for this position represents base salary or On-Target Earnings (OTE) for commission-based roles.

Final compensation will be determined by various factors including the candidate's knowledge, skills, experience, geographic location, and role type. Non-commissioned roles may also be eligible for an annual performance bonus.

Click here for an overview of our benefits at Boomi!

$240,000—$300,000 USD

Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi. We take pride in our culture and core values and are committed to being a place where everyone can be their true, authentic self. Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities.

jobs.title: Scientist
jobs.description:
The Scientist joining our team is responsible for executing and supporting the development, qualification, validation, and transfer of cell-based bioassays in a GMP-regulated laboratory environment. This role contributes to critical testing activities for biologics, cell and gene therapies, vaccines, and other pharmaceutical products by generating scientifically sound, high-quality data to support product development, release, stability programs, and regulatory submissions

Key Responsibilities

Bioassay Execution

• Perform cell-based potency, functional, neutralization, reporter gene, proliferation, viability, and ELISA assays.
• Maintain mammalian cell cultures and prepare reagents, standards, and controls.
• Execute GMP release, stability, characterization, and comparability studies.
• Monitor assay performance using established system suitability criteria and control trending.

Method Development & Validation

• Support assay development, optimization, qualification, validation, and method transfer activities.
• Execute studies assessing precision, accuracy, specificity, linearity, range, robustness, and system suitability.
• Assist with data evaluation, acceptance criteria establishment, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Data Analysis & Documentation

• Analyze data using bioassay and statistical software.
• Evaluate dose-response curves, relative potency, and assay suitability.
• Author and review protocols, reports, SOPs, and technical summaries.
• Maintain accurate, complete, and GMP-compliant laboratory records.

Quality & Compliance

• Perform work in accordance with GMP, GDP, GLP, ALCOA+, and established quality systems.
• Participate in deviations, OOS/OOT investigations, CAPAs, and change controls.
• Support internal, client, and regulatory audits.

Collaboration

• Work closely with project managers, QA, study directors, and scientific staff.
• Support client interactions, technology transfers, and laboratory continuous improvement efforts.

Education

• BS or MS in Biology, Cell Biology, Immunology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, or related scientific discipline.

Experience

• BS with 1–3 years or MS with 0–2 years of relevant laboratory experience in industry settings.
• Experience with mammalian cell culture, ELISA, flow cytometry, or cell-based assays preferred.

Technical Skills

Required

• Mammalian cell culture and aseptic technique
• Cell-based assay execution and troubleshooting
• Data analysis and interpretation
• Technical writing and documentation
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and scientific software

Preferred

• Cell-based potency, reporter gene, ADCC, and neutralization assays
• ELISA, flow cytometry, and ligand-binding assays
• qPCR/ddPCR methods
• GraphPad Prism, SoftMax Pro, PLA, JMP, or similar software
• GMP assay validation experience

Competencies

• Ability to work flexible schedules, including occasional non-standard hours, as needed to support laboratory operations and client
• Strong desire and ability to learn, adapt to, and master new laboratory techniques, technologies, and scientific methodologies
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Team-oriented with the ability to work independently
• Effective written and verbal communication skills
• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data integrity
• Strong scientific and analytical problem-solving skills
• Commitment to quality and regulatory compliance
• Strong organizational and time-management abilities

Physical Requirements

• Perform routine laboratory activities including standing, pipetting, and equipment operation.
• Work in biosafety cabinets and cell culture laboratories.
• Lift and move laboratory supplies up to 25 pounds.

Position is full-time. Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of San Diego, CA are encouraged to apply.

As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Fleet Operations Engineer to join Crusoe’s Fleet Operations team. This role is focused on the advanced diagnosis, maintenance, and repair of high-performance GPU compute clusters, ensuring maximum uptime, reliability, and performance across our fleet.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

POSITION SUMMARY:

We have an exciting opportunity to support our client in analytical testing and implementation of novel analytical methodologies for our clients CAR-T cell therapy products. These Scientists will work with a talented and experienced client team in Research and Development and will be important points of contact for the coordination and execution of molecular, potency and characterization assays, qualification studies, and method transfer activities within area of expertise. This team will interface regularly and build relationships with other functions at the client site such as Process Development, Quality Control and Manufacturing Sciences & Technology to collaboratively drive projects to meet the established timelines while maintaining the highest quality and data integrity standards.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Perform analytical testing including flow cytometry, cell count, cell viability, qPCR/dPCR, ELISA, potency, etc. following appropriate SOPs and procedures. In addition, review and approve data by other team members
• Record and maintain meticulous records in electronic laboratory notebook in compliance with Quality standards
• Identify opportunities for method improvement
• Execute qualification/optimization of analytical methods
• Drive project timelines and deliverables while meeting internal quality and data integrity requirements
• Communicate effectively and present complex data within the department and cross-functionally
• Author and review method related technical documents to ensure completeness, accuracy, consistency and clarity
• Support tracking and trending systems, and programs, which assist in the testing, evaluation and monitoring of quality and efficiency

BASIC MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• BS in biology, chemistry, biochemistry, microbiology or other related science with 5+ years industry experience or MS and 3+ years of industry experience
• Understanding of the basic scientific principles underpinning the analytical methods such as flow cytometry, PCR, ELISA, cell-based assays
• Expertise with aseptic technique
• Ability to communicate clearly with internal or cross-functional teams
• Detail-oriented with expertise in problem solving & demonstrated ability to work in a team environment
• Established ability to work in a regulated environment
• Good presentation skills and scientific/technical writing skills
• Understanding of the concepts of cGxP
• Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience with mammalian cell culture, Human T-cell culture
• Experience writing laboratory SOPs and technical instructions
• 3-5 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biologics industry

This role is a full-time, permanent position Monday-Friday 8am-5pm with overtime as needed. Candidates currently located within commutable distance to East Hanover, NJ are encouraged to apply. Daily on-site work is expected in order to be effective in this role.

jobs.title: Insights Manager, Data Science
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

Want to use data to deepen NPR’s connection with our audience? In this supervisory role, you will lead the statistical work that helps us understand how listeners become dedicated fans and donors. You’ll transform complex data points into clear user journey insights that our teams can use to engage people more effectively. We need someone who has a deep statistical toolkit and is eager to turn predictive models into action and impact.

This role supervises the Analyst for Data Systems and is integral to ensuring the standardization and reliability of data infrastructure, automation, and reporting accuracy.

Responsibilities

• Perform foundational user journey analysis and develop of predictive models that guide NPR and Member stations to best engage potential donors

• Conduct the underlying statistical analyses and modeling to design behavioral indexes, propensity analyses, lifetime value (LTV) frameworks, and conversion funnels based on audience engagement and content consumption

• Partner with teams across NPR to study both anonymous and logged-in user habits, turning engagement data into models that predict what will entice them to the next action

• Analyze audience data to group our digital audiences by segments, allowing us to anticipate what they need next and deliver personalized experiences

• Run predictive analyses that will guide the redesign of our app and other platforms, influencing strategy to significantly grow and retain audiences

• Master complete command of all data flowing through NPR’s platforms

• Supervise and cultivate Insights Analyst, Data Systems to ensure a reliable source of truth for all reporting within Audience Insights

Required Skills and Experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Economics, Journalism or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience

• Experience managing, coaching, and motivating teams

• Strong background in data science methods including statistical modeling, regression analysis, and predictive analytics

• 5+ years proven expertise in advanced SQL (e.g., window functions, complex joins, query optimization, and data transformation)

• Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency, including pivot tables, complex formulas, data manipulation, and visualization for ad-hoc analysis and reporting

• Demonstrated experience in R or Python to analyze, manipulate, and develop statistical models on large datasets

• Experience analyzing digital user journeys that lead to conversion

• Proven ability to define data requirements, mapping out what data needs to be collected and how it should be structured to support downstream analysis

• 2+ years of experience supporting or managing data systems including data collection, standardization, summarization, QA, and automations

• Demonstrated experience and comfort working with large datasets, with the ability to develop expertise in new and proprietary datasets

• Strong technical analytics skills with a keen sense for troubleshooting issues and identifying data gaps and inconsistencies

• Familiarity with data warehousing and ETL concepts

• Self-starter with the ability to work independently as well as in a collaborative team environment

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience in a media or subscription-based industry with a focus on audience retention, funnels, and acquisition

• Familiarity with identity resolution within privacy-first tracking standards

• Experience building dashboards or data modeling with Looker

• Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

• Experience working with version control systems (Git)

This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

Compensation

The contributions you will make:

The Manager Software Engineering is responsible for building, leading, and evolving high-performing software engineering teams accountable for delivering scalable, resilient, and high-quality technology solutions aligned to organizational priorities. Operates as both a technical leader and people leader, fostering a culture of ownership, engineering excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement through coaching, mentorship, and talent development. Accountable for team-level technical direction, architecture alignment, and execution quality, this role guides engineering practices across the software development lifecycle, optimizes delivery flow, removes impediments, and supports adoption of modern engineering practices and technologies including cloud-native development, automation, Agentic AI and AI-assisted engineering capabilities that improve team productivity, quality, and delivery effectiveness. This role provides credible team-level technical leadership across the software development lifecycle, evaluates technology and engineering trade-offs, advances team's modern engineering practices and AI-enabled capabilities. It serves as a trusted, value-added partner to product, architecture, security, infrastructure, and operations peers while developing an inclusive, high performing engineering culture.

A typical day:

• Leads Engineering Team and Technical Capability by building, developing, and sustaining a high-performing engineering team through workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance management, coaching, succession planning, and intentional development of engineers and emerging technical leaders. Establishes clear expectations, accountability, psychological safety, inclusive leadership practices, and the technical and professional capability required to deliver current priorities and grow future engineering capacity.

• Owns Team Delivery and Outcomes by translating product, business, and technology priorities into clear team commitments and measurable outcomes. Aligns capacity, manages dependencies and risks, removes impediments, coordinates internal and third-party resources as needed, and maintains accountability for predictable delivery, quality, security, reliability, maintainability, supportability, and sustained production outcomes.

• Guides Technical Direction and Engineering Judgment by maintaining strong technical depth and partnering with Principal, Senior and other Engineers, Architecture, Product, Security, Platform, Data, and Operations to shape team-level architecture, design decisions, modernization priorities, and engineering standards. Evaluates significant technical trade-offs, challenges approaches when needed, addresses technical debt, and ensures solutions align with broader architecture while balancing scalability, resilience, security, operability, cost, and long-term business value.

• Advances Engineering Excellence, Learning Agility, and Innovation by evolving modern engineering practices across cloud-native development, DevSecOps, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, reliability, quality engineering, and product delivery. Creates conditions for curiosity, experimentation, rapid learning, feedback, and evidence-based adaptation. Responsibly advances AI-enabled engineering tools, Agentic AI patterns, and AI agents to improve developer productivity, quality, learning, and delivery effectiveness while protecting sensitive information, preserving human accountability, and upholding engineering and risk standards.

• Connects Engineering to Business Outcomes by developing a strong understanding of product strategy, client needs, business processes, risk, and technology context and translating them into practical engineering priorities, options, and recommendations. Operates as a trusted, value added partner who anticipates opportunities and risks, communicates feasibility and capacity, frames technical and delivery trade-offs, constructively shapes solutions, and follows through on commitments to deliver measurable client and business value.

• Strengthens Culture, Collaboration, and Team Effectiveness by aligning engineers and partners across Product, Architecture, Quality, UX, Platform, Security, Data, Infrastructure, Operations, and business teams around shared outcomes. Models curiosity, trust, bold and calculated risktaking, expertise, and resilience; communicates transparently; constructively challenges assumptions; leads through ambiguity and change; resolves team friction; creates an inclusive, engaging environment where people learn, perform, and celebrate progress together.

• Demonstrated people leadership experience building and developing software engineering teams through hiring, performance management, coaching, talent development, and accountability for team outcomes.

• Experience leading engineering teams in a product-oriented operating model and a regulated or risk-sensitive environment.

• Experience within financial services, agriculture, or another regulated industry.

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Strategic Partnerships Lead to build the partnerships that will help Base become the largest home battery developer and retail energy provider in the country. Our ambition spans the entire electricity market, from homes and small businesses to large commercial and industrial customers. Partnerships will be central to getting there, allowing us to reach millions of customers through companies that already serve them, more efficiently than we could on our own.



You'll own the entire partnership lifecycle: identifying the biggest opportunities, building relationships with the country's leading companies, negotiating and closing deals, and turning those agreements into channels that deliver tens of thousands of customers. You'll set the strategy, not just execute it, and remain accountable for each partnership's success well beyond signing. The role covers all partnership categories except homebuilders and land developers, which are managed separately.



This is a senior role on Base's small, high-impact business operations team, with broad ownership and visibility across the company. You'll work directly with sales, marketing, product, engineering, finance, deployment, and member experience to bring partnerships to market and scale them. We're looking for someone equally comfortable negotiating with executives at major companies and getting into the details to solve problems and drive results.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Set the partnership strategy. Identify and prioritize the companies, channels, and customer segments that can drive the most growth for Base, across residential and commercial markets.

 - Source and close major partnerships. Build relationships with executives at some of the country's largest companies, develop compelling proposals, negotiate terms, and close deals.

 - Structure deals that scale. Design commercial models that create value for Base, its partners, and customers, including commissions, revenue sharing, co-marketing, and strategic pilots.

 - Own performance from launch through scale. Turn signed agreements into high-performing acquisition channels, with clear accountability for customer growth, acquisition costs, and unit economics.

 - Drive cross-functional execution. Work closely with product, engineering, marketing, sales, and operations to build the integrations, customer experiences, and operational capabilities needed to launch and grow each partnership.

 - Own senior partner relationships. Serve as the primary point of contact, from executive leadership through operating teams, and drive accountability through regular business reviews and performance reporting.

 - Build a repeatable growth engine. Develop the processes, tools, and playbooks that make each new partnership faster to launch and easier to scale.

 - Travel regularly to build relationships, close deals, and work directly with partners.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 7+ years in business development, partnerships, or go-to-market roles, ideally with experience at a high-growth technology company.

 - A track record of building and scaling meaningful revenue or customer acquisition channels. You've taken partnerships from zero to significant scale and have the numbers to back it up.

 - Experience negotiating and closing complex deals with large companies, and making those partnerships successful long after signing.

 - Strong commercial judgment. You can build your own financial models, understand customer acquisition costs and unit economics, structure creative deals, and know when to walk away.

 - Comfort working directly with data, dashboards, and CRMs to understand performance and identify what needs to change.

 - A bias for action. You're comfortable figuring things out as you go, building processes from scratch, and getting into the details to make things happen.

 - Bonus: Experience across multiple industries, particularly energy or retail electricity.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

The Base Business Operations team is responsible for some of the company's most important priorities: financing our growth, commercial partnerships, acquisitions and integrations, new market and product launches, and cross-functional initiatives that don't have a natural owner. We're a small team of generalists who work directly with Base's founders, take on the problems that matter most, build the structure and analysis needed to solve them, and create solutions that can scale.



Within Biz Ops, Commercial Partnerships is responsible for driving demand for Base's products. We build our own batteries, and every one we make needs a home. We also aim to become the largest retail electricity provider in the country. Partners that already serve millions of households and businesses help us grow faster and acquire customers at a lower cost than we could on our own. Getting this right has a direct impact on how big Base becomes, how efficiently we grow, and how quickly we can bring more affordable, reliable energy to more customers.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

Our Growth & Transformation Team at Red Ventures empowers partners through a unique blend of high-scale proprietary distribution, data models, AI-enabled applications, and strategic client partnerships. We help our clients unlock significant and sustainable growth across the home services and financial services ecosystems, ranging from telecommunications and deregulated energy to credit cards and deposits. As a Red Ventures company, we have more than 20 years of experience building strategic, long-standing relationships with some of the world's most powerful brands across industries like financial services, retail, real estate, and entertainment.

We believe the next phase of advantage will come from integrated operating systems that connect decisioning, execution, intelligence, and governance into a shared foundation that improves over time. We are investing in that future through our Growth Operations platform, a set of reusable workflows, agents, context layers, and governance mechanisms designed to help our teams and our partners drive growth more efficiently, more intelligently, and at greater scale.

Compass is Growth & Transformation’s platform layer for the phone sales journey, connecting the digital and voice experience to drive incremental revenue. It brings together an AI voice agent that understands, qualifies, and routes callers, real-time co-pilot guidance that helps human agents recommend, pitch, and handle objections, and offline coaching that turns call recordings into individualized coaching and practice. As a product leader, you set the vision for the platform, define how it serves delivery teams and partners, and build the team that executes it.

This is a people-leadership role. You'll lead and develop product managers while staying close enough to the work to engage directly in analysis, modeling, prototyping, or product artifact creation when that's what it takes to unblock progress or influence a decision. You'll also carry the day-to-day economics of what you own, reporting ROI, opportunity, and go-forward to department leadership.

We expect this leader to be deeply technical, analytically rigorous, and relentlessly curious. You should bring a strong grasp of data science and ML practices, real familiarity with the realities of production voice AI (latency, accuracy, guardrails, evaluations, reliability), and the judgment to decide what belongs in the platform versus what should stay with an individual partner implementation. You are comfortable operating close to the details, solving complex analytical and technical problems, and being hands-on when needed to drive our hardest challenges.

Curious how Growth and Transformation fits into Red Ventures? Click here.

What You’ll Do:

• Set the platform strategy: Own the vision and roadmap for Compass across its three capability areas, the AI Voice Agent, real-time agent guidance, and offline coaching, and decide what to standardize as platform, what to make configurable, and what to leave to individual partner implementations.

• Identify & drive initiatives: Lead multiple AI product initiatives, ensuring alignment with product leadership, partner objectives, customer needs, and our broader strategy. Develop business cases and assess feasibility, impact, and ROI in partnership with business and client stakeholders.

• Translate vision into action: Turn high-level strategy into actionable workstreams, defining sequencing, resourcing, and execution plans in partnership with product team members and cross-functional leads. Create clarity and alignment.

• Own outcomes: Own the P&L and business impact of your initiatives, communicating progress, ROI, risks, and opportunities to leadership and client partners, shaping the go-forward for each workstream to ensure it’s positioned to deliver meaningful impact, getting hands-on where necessary to unblock our hardest tasks and hurdles.

• Advance the Operating System: Package Compass’s voice-specific context, tools, workflows, and learnings into agent ready context and process so that teams can move from spotting an opportunity to shipping and validating an experience change, and every partnership benefits from what Compass has already learned.

• Develop talent: Manage and develop 2+ product manager(s), creating specific plans, providing hands-on product and analytical support, delegating appropriate work, and instilling a performance-driven environment through clear expectations, regular feedback, and recognition of achievements.

What We’re Looking For:

• Commercially grounded: You know your numbers, and you create accountability for your team to know theirs. You can tell the difference between a workstream that's underperforming and one that's still early.

• Technically fluent: You can dissect complex problems and define what must be true at a high level for delivery, connecting patterns across workstreams, teams, and technologies to design scalable, maintainable solutions — grounded in a real understanding of the problem space and of AI, ML, and software capabilities.

• Customer centric: You hold your teams to solving the partner's and the customer's actual problem, and you look far enough ahead across initiatives that risk mitigation is a plan rather than a scramble.

• Deeply curious: You stay close to how AI capability is changing and translate it into what your teams should be doing differently next quarter.

• A team builder: You promote a culture of collaboration and inclusivity by encouraging diverse perspectives and facilitating effective teamwork. You provide frameworks and approaches that help others identify, break down, and optimally solve problems, and you negotiate with cross-functional leadership for the resourcing and sequencing your teams need.

Experiences You've Had:

• End-to-end ownership: Experience driving AI/ML products from concept through iteration, guiding a team through delivery, and owning the outcomes and business impact of the work.

• People leader: Managed product managers directly — setting expectations, giving feedback, and holding direct responsibility for your team's contributions and growth.

• Owned the economics: Experience accountable for the P&L or ROI of a set of products or initiatives, including the investment, reinvestment, and deprecation conversations with leadership.

• Built from experience: You've worked hands-on with production-grade AI systems — evaluating model behavior, running analyses in SQL and Python, building agents, or optimizing data pipelines — enough to lead the teams building them and make informed technical decisions without needing a translator.

• Platform product ownership: Built and scaled a technical platform, AI/ML infrastructure, or shared product capability used by multiple teams, partners, or customers, including the hard calls about build/buy and what to standardize and what to leave custom.

About the Team

OpenAI’s Technology Strategic Sourcing team helps Engineering, Research, and other technology teams secure the supplier capabilities they need to scale. We work with technical, finance, legal, security, and business leaders to shape commercial strategy, negotiate critical agreements, and build resilient supplier relationships.



About the Role

Own sourcing strategy for infrastructure software and the Engineering and Research stack. You’ll manage billion-dollar-scale spend, personally lead the most complex commercial negotiations, and deliver measurable savings while protecting the capabilities Engineering and Research rely on.

This is a principal-level individual contributor role with no direct reports at launch. You’ll lead cross-functional deal teams and coach sourcing peers. People management experience is a plus; the role may expand to include management as the team and spend grow.

Build multi-year category strategies across data platforms, observability, developer tools, and software for machine learning research, training, and inference. Use technical roadmaps, demand, and market intelligence to decide where to build, buy, consolidate, compete, or transition. Develop credible alternatives before they’re needed.

Build lasting relationships with senior Engineering and Research leaders and supplier executives, including suppliers that are also OpenAI customers. Work with Sales, Finance, and Legal to align buying and selling strategies while evaluating each decision on its own merits.



This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.



In this role, you will:

 - Personally lead large, complex infrastructure software and technology negotiations, from developing leverage and modeling deal economics through executive alignment and signature.

 - Keep deals, renewals, dependencies, and decisions organized. Set clear owners and milestones, communicate proactively, and surface risks early enough to act.

 - Find commercial opportunities before requests or renewals come in. Use demand, usage, pricing, and market data to improve commitments, licensing, unit economics, or supplier mix.

 - Partner with Engineering and Research leaders, existing Sourcing owners, and Finance, Legal, Security, IT, and Corporate Development as relevant to align the deal strategy and approval path.

 - Lead 360-degree supplier reviews covering spend, commitments, performance, technical dependencies, risk, and the broader partnership.

 - Shape complex deal structures with cost, equity, revenue, partnership, risk, and long-term strategic implications.

 - Advise executive leadership on where to invest, renegotiate, or walk away. Present credible options, financial and operational trade-offs, and a clear recommendation.

 - Manage strategic suppliers beyond signature, including performance, renewals, escalations, and transitions. Plan migration milestones, overlap costs, exit rights, and fallback options with technical owners.

 - Deliver significant savings and better unit economics, and validate results with Finance against comparable baselines.

 - Build negotiation and supplier-governance practices peers can use independently.



You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 10+ years of experience leading complex commercial negotiations in strategic sourcing, technology procurement, strategic partnerships, deal strategy, corporate development, or a related field.

 - Use AI in recurring sourcing workflows, such as market analysis, scenario modeling, or negotiation prep. Verify outputs, protect sensitive information, and own the final judgment.

 - Have led experienced peers and cross-functional deal teams without relying on formal authority. You can show how you clarified ownership, coached others, and improved commercial outcomes across multiple complex workstreams.

 - Have personally led large, complex infrastructure software or technology contracts with sophisticated pricing and licensing, capacity or usage commitments, service levels, and commercial protections.

 - Understand enterprise software business models, including usage-based pricing, multi-year commitments, ramp structures, pooled consumption, growth protections, and performance-based economics.

 - Have led complex relationships with suppliers that are also customers. You can evaluate buying economics and customer commitments separately, identify where the two create value or risk, and advise executive leadership on how to proceed.

 - Understand how ML experimentation, training, and inference affect demand, cost, reliability, and supplier dependencies; use that knowledge in commercial decisions.

 - Bring executive presence on both sides of a deal. You can explain the economics and technical trade-offs plainly, recommend a path, and hold a position with senior leaders and suppliers under pressure.

 - Take initiative, keep complex workstreams organized, and communicate recommendations, decisions, and risks without being asked.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. jobs.description:

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

Employment type:

What you'll be working on:

One Medical providers also demonstrate:

jobs.title: Consultant, Biologist
jobs.location: New York, New York, , United States
jobs.description:
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Are you excited about understanding, interpreting, and navigating complex policy issues? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature? Are you a curious and open-minded person?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment & Health Division as our new Biologist Consultant and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

As our new Biologist Consultant, we invite you to bring your strong technical abilities into play as you support natural resource delineation, habitat assessment, and permitting on a variety of linear infrastructure and site development projects.

Your responsibilities will be:

• Conduct environmental and ecological field assessments, including wetland delineations, biological surveys, habitat assessments, vegetation surveys, aquatic habitat assessments, wildlife surveys, and environmental sampling and monitoring in freshwater, estuarine, coastal, and terrestrial environments.
• Apply knowledge of marine and estuarine ecology, species-habitat relationships, and coastal ecosystems to support environmental permitting and monitoring.
• Perform data management, quality-control review, and analysis of ecological and environmental datasets, and assist with the development of tables, figures, maps and other data visualizations.
• Prepare high-quality deliverables, including field reports, environmental survey and monitoring reports, technical memoranda, environmental impact assessment reports, and permit applications in support of regulatory compliance and environmental monitoring.
• Communicate regularly with project managers, clients, regulators, and multidisciplinary project teams regarding project updates, schedules, findings, and key developments.
• Conduct site visits at industrial, commercial, coastal and waterfront, and undeveloped properties, including local and out-of-state travel, while managing multiple projects and maintaining safe work practices.

About you

• Candidates must have a BA/BS or MS in Marine Science, Marine Biology, Fisheries Science, Environmental Science, Natural Resources Management, biology, ecology or a closely related discipline from an accredited institution and have a minimum of 2+ years of relevant experience in environmental consulting, preferably involving marine, estuarine, coastal, or aquatic ecosystems. Master’s degrees are strongly preferred.
• Working knowledge of marine and estuarine ecology, biological communities, species-habitat relationships, and ecological monitoring methods. Demonstrated experience with field identification and taxonomy of marine, estuarine, or coastal organisms is preferred.
• USACE wetland delineation training (or equivalent)
• 40-hr HAZWOPER training desired
• Willingness/ability to travel up to 40% of the time on average during the year and possess a valid driver’s license. Travel may include overnight stay and may be out of state. Travel duration is typically 1-2 days, depending upon the specific requirements of each project.

What we can offer you

• Investment in your development
• Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
• Being valued for the unique person you are
• Never being short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $80,134 -   $100,167 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

Ready to join us?

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.
