jobs.title: Order Operations Analyst (Contractor)
jobs.description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

As an Order Operations Analyst Contractor, you'll help shape how Boulevard manages the customer lifecycle after the sale. You'll be the operational gatekeeper for amendment quotes, support complex deal structures, troubleshoot issues, and help improve the systems and processes behind our quote-to-cash operations.

You'll partner with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Technical Operations to make sure contract amendments and customer requests are accurate, compliant, and ready to go. It's a chance to build deep expertise in commercial operations, act like an owner, and see the impact of your work every day as we scale a fast-growing business built for salons, spas, and medspas. This role is fully remote.

What you’ll do here:

• Review customer amendment quotes for completeness, accuracy, and compliance before contracts are executed.

• Act as the first line of defense for amendment requests, catching issues early and making sure quotes are right before signature.

• Process complex or non-standard amendments, including terminations and strategic contract changes.

• Partner with Customer Success, Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and Technical Operations to resolve amendment and order processing issues.

• Investigate provisioning failures and work with teams across the company to resolve them quickly.

• Spot trends in amendment quality, then share guidance, documentation, and training to strengthen upstream processes.

• Support ad hoc operational initiatives and special projects as the business evolves.

What you’ll need to thrive:

• 2-5+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Order Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a related operational role.

• Experience supporting a B2B SaaS business, with an understanding of quote-to-cash (QTC) or order-to-cash (OTC) processes.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to review complex quotes and contract amendments accurately.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Technical Operations.

• Comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• A plus: Experience with Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud.

• No educational requirements.

How we'll take care of you:

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we're happy to share a good-faith estimate of the hourly rate range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated rate range is $33-$39 per hour. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

Benefits: As this is a contract position, it isn’t eligible for Boulevard’s standard employee benefits. We’re happy to share more details about the role and contract terms throughout the interview process.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

• Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.

• Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.

• Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.

• An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.

• 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.

• 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.

• Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free.

• Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success.

• $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.

• And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

To learn how Boulevard collects, uses, and protects personal information related to candidates and employees, please review our Boulevard Employee & Personnel Privacy Notice.

Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Outside Employment Disclosure
Boulevard serves the beauty, wellness, and self-care industry, and many of our employees have access to our customers' business and client data. Because of that, we ask all candidates to disclose any concurrent employment, self-employment, ownership interest, or advisory role during the hiring process, including the company name and industry. Disclosure is a normal part of our process and is not by itself a barrier to being hired. Employees in Tier 1 Restricted Roles may not hold concurrent employment, ownership, or an advisory role with a beauty, wellness, self-care, or med-spa business, or with a company that competes with Boulevard. If you currently hold such a role, you are still welcome to apply — please raise it early with your recruiter so we can talk it through.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Maps & Routing
jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

Maps & Routing sits at the center of Zipline: helping our marketplace determine which customers we can serve and giving onboard autonomy the geographic context and routes needed to fly safely.

What You'll Do

Your primary focus will be routing and path planning: building graph algorithms and optimization systems that guide aircraft through changing airspace. You’ll incorporate real-time weather, airspace restrictions, and fleet traffic into safe, efficient routes.

Zipline’s partnership with Uber targets one million drone deliveries per day by the end of 2029, and our Walmart expansion includes plans for 300 additional sites. You’ll help build the systems that support this growth.

Working with autonomy, onboard software, marketplace, and operations teams, you’ll turn better routing into quieter flights, greater range, broader coverage, and more efficient deliveries.

• Company-wide impact. Connect serviceability and merchant reach with the maps and routes that power autonomous flight.

• Real-time planning. Incorporate changing conditions and fleet traffic into routing decisions, balancing delivery speed, reliability, and network throughput.

• Algorithmic depth. Improve path planning and graph search to reduce noise and energy use, extend range, and handle airspace congestion while meeting safety requirements.

• Critical distributed systems. Scale and harden low-latency routing services with fault tolerance, predictable performance, and observability.

• End-to-end ownership. Take changes from design and validation through safe rollout, production hardening, and operational feedback.

There’s also room to broaden your impact into maps platform services, geospatial data quality, and customer serviceability – you can shape architecture and technical direction across routing and these supporting systems.

What You'll Bring

We value problem-solving and engineering judgment. Strong candidates bring:

• Experience building and operating reliable, low-latency backend services or distributed systems

• Experience with path planning, graph search, or related optimization problems, and the ability to reason about algorithmic tradeoffs

• A track record of owning projects from design through production operation

• An ability to reason about correctness, performance, and failure modes in production systems

• Comfort collaborating across teams and turning ambiguous problems into practical solutions

• Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and system design

Our stack includes Rust, Go, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, and AWS. We value engineering judgment over familiarity with specific tools; maps or geospatial experience is a plus.

We use AI-assisted engineering tools while maintaining high standards for design, validation, and code quality.

What Else You Need To Know

The starting cash range for this role is $230,000 - 260,000. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; overtime pay; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more.

jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

Employment type:

• Full time

jobs.title: Business Applications Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Mirantis Inc. is looking for a Business Applications Support Specialist to be the first point of contact for our core business systems. You’ll support internal teams across Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Legal, and Operations, as well as customer-facing processes that run through our applications. A key part of this role is building and maintaining a strong knowledge base, so users can find answers quickly and our support scales as the company grows.

Main Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary support contact for business applications (ERP, CRM, document management, travel, and other tools), triaging, prioritizing, and resolving incidents and service requests through Jira Service Management
• Support AI tools and RAG-based systems used across the company, including user access, usage questions, and issue resolution
• Own the BizApps knowledge base: create, organize, and keep up to date user guides, how-to articles, FAQs, and troubleshooting procedures in Confluence
• Turn recurring tickets into self-service documentation, and help build AI agents and RAG solutions that automate answers and reduce repeat requests
• Document system configurations, processes, and changes so the team has a reliable, up-to-date reference
• Support internal users and customer-facing teams with access, configuration, data, and workflow issues, and escalate complex cases to the relevant system owners or vendors
• Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and the BizApps team: gather requirements, clarify requests, and translate business needs into actionable tickets
• Perform day-to-day administration and user management: user provisioning and deprovisioning, permissions, field and picklist updates, reports, and dashboards
• Monitor business systems for compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements, including access reviews, data handling, and audit readiness
• Onboard and train new users on business applications
• Participate in testing (UAT and regression) for new releases, configuration changes, and integrations
• Identify recurring issues and propose improvements to processes, automation, and self-service
• Process compliance requests, collaborating with the Legal and Compliance teams and the internal business applications team to execute them end to end
• Monitor SLAs for business applications support, proactively track ticket status, and escalate risks before deadlines are missed
• Act as a business analyst for medium and large change requests: gather requirements, document business processes, and coordinate delivery with stakeholders

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience
• 2+ years of experience supporting business applications, ideally ERP and CRM systems
• Hands-on admin-level experience with at least one major SaaS platform, not only as an end user
• Proven experience supporting both internal employees and external customers in a service-oriented role
• Strong documentation skills and experience building or maintaining a knowledge base (Confluence or similar)
• Strong stakeholder management skills: able to work with users at all levels, from individual contributors to executives
• Experience with ticketing systems such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or Zendesk
• Strong troubleshooting skills and attention to detail
• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal
• Based in the US, with availability to overlap with EMEA team hours

Nice to have

• Understanding of regulatory requirements, especially GDPR and data privacy laws in both the US and Europe
• Experience with SOX and SOC 2 controls (e.g., access reviews, change management)
• Basic SQL and reporting skills
• Familiarity with integration platforms or APIs
• Hands-on experience with AI tools (e.g., Claude), AI agents, or RAG systems for support automation and documentation

Why you’ll love Mirantis

• Work with an established leader in the cloud infrastructure industry.
• Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies.
• Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.
• Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.
• Receive a competitive compensation package with strong benefits plan.
• We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com

By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

jobs.location: South San Francisco, CA, United States
jobs.description:
Purpose:

With supervision, leads the direction, planning, execution and interpretation of clinical trials or research activities of a clinical development program. Participates in cross-functional teams to generate, deliver and interpret high-quality clinical data supporting overall product scientific and business strategy.

Responsibilities:

• With appropriate supervision, executes the design and implementation of study protocols for a clinical development program in support of the overall Product Development Plan, based on strong medical and scientific principles, knowledge of compliance and regulatory requirements, AbbVie’s customers, markets, business operations and emerging issues. Oversees project-related education of investigators, study site personnel and AbbVie study staff.
• Has responsibility for review, interpretation, and communication of accumulating data pertaining to safety and efficacy of the molecule. Along with Clinical Operations, may be responsible for oversight of study enrollment and overall timelines for key deliverables.
• Contributes to design, analysis, interpretation and reporting of scientific content of protocols, Investigator Brochures, Clinical Study Reports, regulatory submissions and responses and other program documents.
• May be asked to contribute to the development of a rigorous, cross-functionally-aligned, vetted Clinical Development Plan in collaboration with matrix team members.
• Participates in opinion leader interactions related to the disease area(s); partners with Medical Affairs, Commercial and other functions in these activities as required, consistent with corporate policies.
• Stays abreast of professional information and technology through conferences, medical literature and other available training, to augment expertise in the therapeutic area.
• Responsible for understanding the regulatory requirements related to the clinical studies and global drug development and accountable for complying with those requirements. May be asked to contribute to regulatory responses and discussions.
• Ensures adherence to Good Clinical Practices, pharmacovigilance standards, standard operating procedures and to all other quality standards in conducting research.

• Bachelors degree in the sciences; advanced degree (e.g., MS, PhD) preferred.
• Ability to provide input and direction to clinical research with appropriate supervision.
• Strong desire to collaborate in a cross-functional setting.
• At least 3 years relevant Clinical trial experience in the pharmaceutical industry or equivalent is preferred.
• Knowledge of clinical trial methodology, regulatory and compliance requirements governing clinical trials and experience in the design of study protocols is desirable.
• Ability to interact externally and internally to support global scientific and business strategy.
